All_category_skus means the supplier manages all SKUs in the covered category; selected_skus means only specific SKUs are included; new_items_only restricts to newly introduced items; seasonal_only covers seasonal assortment only.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF VMI Best Practices

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this VMI agreement record originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer and MDM reconciliation.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM; SAP S/4HANA MM; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: supplier_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary supplier contact for VMI replenishment communications and SLA escalations under this agreement.

attributes.name: supplier_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary supplier contact responsible for managing inventory replenishment under this VMI agreement. Used for operational communication and escalation.

attributes.name: target_fill_rate_pct
attributes.description: The contractually agreed Fill Rate (Order Completion Percentage) that the supplier must achieve under this VMI agreement, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 98.50 = 98.5%). Fill Rate is the percentage of replenishment orders fulfilled completely and on time. Used as a key SLA (Service Level Agreement) KPI for supplier performance measurement.
attributes.references: NRF VMI Best Practices; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: target_inventory_units
attributes.description: The optimal on-hand inventory quantity (in units) that the supplier aims to maintain at the covered location. Represents the ideal stock position between the minimum and maximum thresholds for service level and working capital balance.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; NRF VMI Best Practices

attributes.name: target_otd_rate_pct
attributes.description: The contractually agreed on-time delivery rate the supplier must achieve, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00 = 95%). Measures the proportion of replenishment deliveries arriving within the agreed lead time window. Distinct from fill rate which measures order completeness.
attributes.references: NRF VMI Best Practices; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: target_weeks_of_supply
attributes.description: The target number of weeks of inventory coverage (Weeks of Supply / WOS) the supplier is contractually required to maintain at the covered location. Calculated as on-hand units divided by average weekly sales rate; the target value is defined in the agreement.
attributes.references: NRF VMI Best Practices; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why this VMI agreement was terminated or not renewed. Populated only when status is terminated or expired. Supports supplier relationship analysis and VMI program retrospectives.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Supplier Management Best Practices

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure used for inventory thresholds and replenishment quantities in this VMI agreement. EA = Each; CS = Case; PK = Pack; PAL = Pallet; KG = Kilogram; LB = Pound. Aligns with GS1 unit of measure codes.
attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this VMI agreement record was last modified, formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Tracks the most recent change for audit and change management purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: vmi_agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the VMI agreement. Draft indicates the agreement is under negotiation; active means the supplier is actively managing inventory; suspended indicates a temporary halt; terminated means the agreement has been ended before expiry; expired means the end date has passed without renewal; pending_renewal indicates the agreement is under renegotiation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA MM

products.name: expiry_tracking
products.description: Tracks perishable and date-sensitive inventory at the SKU-location-batch level. Captures batch/lot number, manufacture date, expiry date, best-before date, quantity on hand, days-to-expiry, expiry risk status (fresh, near-expiry, expired), and recommended action (markdown, pull-from-shelf, donate, destroy). Supports FEFO (First Expired First Out) picking logic, grocery and perishables compliance with food safety regulations, and waste reduction programs. Serves as the SSOT for batch/lot identity and date-sensitive inventory within the inventory domain.

attributes.name: expiry_tracking_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each expiry tracking record at the SKU-location-batch level. Primary key for this data product.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.category. Business justification: Expiry/perishable management programs are organized by category (food, pharmacy, cosmetics). Category managers own markdown and disposition strategies for near-expiry inventory. Regulatory reporting f

attributes.name: food_safety_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.food_safety_plan. Business justification: Expiry monitoring and FEFO (First Expired, First Out) procedures are integral to food safety plans. Retail grocers must link expiry tracking to facility food safety plans for regulatory compliance, au

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inventory node (store, DC, MFC, dark store) where the batch is physically held. Supports omnichannel inventory visibility.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: markdown_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.markdown. Business justification: Near-expiry inventory triggers automated markdown workflows to accelerate sell-through before disposal. Perishables management, FEFO optimization, and waste reduction programs depend on linking expiry

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order under which this batch was procured. Enables end-to-end traceability from supplier PO to expiry event for recall and chargeback management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); FDA FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which expiry is being tracked. Links to the product master.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Product Classification; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier who produced or delivered this batch. Used for food safety traceability, recall management, and chargeback (vendor compliance penalty) processing for expired goods received below MRSL.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Traceability Rule; GS1 GLN (Global Location Number); Informatica MDM Supplier Golden Record

attributes.name: action_completed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recommended_action was fully executed (e.g., markdown applied, product pulled from shelf, donation completed). Null if action_status is pending or in_progress.
attributes.references: Internal Inventory Policy; FDA FSMA Compliance Tracking

attributes.name: action_status
attributes.description: Execution status of the recommended_action: pending (action not yet started), in_progress (action initiated), completed (action fully executed), waived (action overridden by manager with justification). Tracks operational follow-through on expiry management.
attributes.references: Internal Inventory Policy; FDA FSMA Compliance Tracking

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Supplier-assigned or internally generated batch or lot number uniquely identifying a production run of the SKU. Critical for FEFO (First Expired First Out) picking logic and food safety recall traceability.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); GS1 Batch/Lot Traceability Standard; SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management

attributes.name: best_before_date
attributes.description: Date until which the product is guaranteed to be at peak quality. Distinct from expiry_date — product may still be safe after this date but quality may degrade. Used for markdown and donation decision triggers.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101 Food Labeling; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this expiry tracking record was first created in the Silver layer lakehouse. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date/Time Standard; ISO 27001 Information Security; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: critical_threshold_days
attributes.description: Number of days before expiry at which the batch escalates to critical risk status, triggering urgent pull-from-shelf or destroy actions. Configurable at the SKU or category level.
attributes.references: Internal Inventory Policy; FDA FSMA; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the inventory_cost_per_unit (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency retail operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Code Standard; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: days_to_expiry
attributes.description: Calculated number of calendar days remaining from the current date to the expiry_date. Negative values indicate the batch has already expired. Used to drive expiry risk classification and recommended action assignment. Refreshed daily by the Silver layer pipeline.
attributes.references: Internal Inventory Policy; FDA FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Method used to dispose of expired or near-expiry inventory: destroyed (waste disposal per regulatory guidelines), donated (food bank or charity), returned_to_vendor (RTV), composted (organic waste program), none (no disposal yet). Required for waste reduction program reporting and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; EPA Waste Disposal Regulations; NRF Sustainability Best Practices

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The hard expiry date after which the product must not be sold or consumed. Drives pull-from-shelf actions, waste management, and regulatory compliance. Primary date field for FEFO (First Expired First Out) picking sequencing.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); FDA 21 CFR Part 101 Food Labeling; CPSC Product Safety Standards

attributes.name: expiry_risk_status
attributes.description: Current risk classification of the batch based on days_to_expiry thresholds: fresh (well within shelf life), near_expiry (approaching threshold), critical (imminent expiry requiring urgent action), expired (past expiry_date), pulled (removed from shelf). Drives recommended action and waste reduction workflows.
attributes.references: Internal Inventory Policy; FDA FSMA; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: fefo_sequence
attributes.description: Picking sequence rank assigned to this batch within the same SKU-location combination, ordered by ascending expiry_date. Rank 1 = earliest expiring batch to be picked first. Drives FEFO (First Expired First Out) fulfillment logic in WMS and store replenishment.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS FEFO Configuration; FDA FSMA; ISO 22000

attributes.name: inventory_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) value per unit for this batch at the time of receipt. Used to calculate the financial write-off value of expired or disposed inventory. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI/CO module.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module

attributes.name: is_recall_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch is subject to an active product recall issued by the supplier, FDA, or CPSC. True = recall in effect, requiring immediate pull-from-shelf and quarantine. Integrates with Salesforce Service Cloud for customer notification.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); CPSC Recall Regulations; FTC Consumer Protection

attributes.name: is_rfid_tracked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch is tracked using RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) technology for real-time inventory visibility. True = RFID tag attached and active; False = barcode-only tracking.
attributes.references: GS1 EPC/RFID Standard; Manhattan Associates WMS RFID Module

attributes.name: is_vendor_managed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch is managed under a Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) agreement where the supplier retains ownership and responsibility for replenishment until sold. Affects COGS recognition timing.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; Internal VMI Policy; SAP S/4HANA MM Consignment

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical cycle count or inventory audit that verified the quantity_on_hand for this batch. Used to assess data freshness and trigger recount workflows for high-risk expiry batches.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Cycle Count Module; SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory node holding this batch: store (retail floor), DC (Distribution Center), MFC (Micro-Fulfillment Center), dark_store (fulfillment-only), or vendor (VMI-managed stock).
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date on which the batch was manufactured or produced by the supplier. Used to calculate shelf life and validate compliance with minimum remaining shelf life (MRSL) requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); CPSC Product Safety Standards; GS1 Date Encoding Standard

attributes.name: near_expiry_threshold_days
attributes.description: Number of days before expiry at which the batch transitions to near_expiry risk status. Configurable at the SKU or category level to reflect product-specific shelf life policies (e.g., dairy = 3 days, bakery = 1 day, pharmaceuticals = 30 days).
attributes.references: Internal Inventory Policy; FDA 21 CFR Part 101; ISO 22000

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: Merchandise category of the SKU (e.g., Dairy, Bakery, Produce, Meat, Pharmaceuticals, Frozen Foods). Used for category-level expiry policy configuration, waste reporting, and food safety compliance segmentation.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC); Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) Category Hierarchy

attributes.name: quantity_at_risk
attributes.description: Portion of quantity_on_hand that is classified as near_expiry or critical based on current expiry_risk_status. Used for waste forecasting, markdown planning, and shrinkage reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Inventory Policy; NRF Shrinkage Best Practices

attributes.name: quantity_disposed
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of this batch that has been disposed of (destroyed, donated, or returned to vendor) due to expiry. Contributes to shrinkage (inventory loss) reporting and COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) write-off calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting; Internal Shrinkage Policy; NRF Shrinkage Best Practices

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: Current physical quantity of the batch available at the inventory node, expressed in the SKU's base unit of measure. Updated by POS sales, cycle counts, adjustments, and RFID scans.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Management; Manhattan Associates WMS; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: recall_reference_number
attributes.description: Official recall reference number issued by the FDA, CPSC, or supplier for the active recall affecting this batch. Populated only when is_recall_active = True. Used for regulatory reporting and audit trail.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Recall Regulations; CPSC Recall Database; FTC Consumer Protection

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date the batch was received at the inventory node from the supplier or DC. Used to calculate time-in-location and validate minimum remaining shelf life (MRSL) at receipt.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt; FDA FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: recommended_action
attributes.description: System-recommended disposition action for the batch based on expiry risk status and business rules: none (no action needed), markdown (apply price reduction to accelerate sell-through), pull_from_shelf (remove from sale floor), donate (transfer to food bank or charity), destroy (dispose per regulatory guidelines), return_to_vendor (RTV). Supports waste reduction programs and food safety compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); NRF Waste Reduction Best Practices; Internal Markdown Policy

attributes.name: remaining_shelf_life_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total shelf life remaining at the current date, calculated as (days_to_expiry / shelf_life_days) * 100. Used to enforce minimum remaining shelf life (MRSL) thresholds for receiving and selling.
attributes.references: Internal Inventory Policy; Supplier MRSL Agreement

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unit-level serial number for serialized perishable or date-sensitive items (e.g., pharmaceutical products, high-value electronics with warranty expiry). Nullable for non-serialized bulk items.
attributes.references: GS1 Serial Shipping Container Code (SSCC); SAP S/4HANA MM Serial Number Management

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Total shelf life of the SKU in calendar days from manufacture date to expiry date. Used to calculate remaining shelf life percentage and minimum remaining shelf life (MRSL) compliance at receipt.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management; Supplier Specification Sheet

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this expiry tracking record was sourced: SAP_S4 (SAP S/4HANA), ORMS (Oracle Retail Merchandising System), MANHATTAN_WMS (Manhattan Associates WMS), INFORMATICA_MDM (Informatica MDM), MANUAL (manual entry). Supports data lineage and audit.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; ISO 27001 Information Security

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required storage temperature zone for this batch: ambient (room temperature), chilled (2–8°C), frozen (below -18°C), controlled (specific temperature-controlled environment). Used to validate storage compliance and flag temperature excursions that may accelerate expiry.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 110 Current Good Manufacturing Practice; ISO 22000 Food Safety; CPSC Product Safety

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for the quantity on hand (e.g., EA=Each, KG=Kilogram, LB=Pound, L=Litre, CS=Case). Aligns with GS1 unit of measure codes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|LB|L|ML|OZ|CS|PK|DZ — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Code List; SAP S/4HANA MM UOM Configuration

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: Universal Product Code (UPC) or GTIN-14 barcode associated with the SKU. Used for POS scanning, RFID matching, and food safety traceability.
attributes.references: GS1 GTIN Standard; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this expiry tracking record (e.g., quantity adjustment, status change, action completion). Follows ISO 8601 format. Used for change data capture (CDC) and incremental processing.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date/Time Standard; ISO 27001 Information Security; Internal Data Governance Policy

products.name: reservation
products.description: Records all inventory encumbrances that restrict stock from general availability — including soft-allocations (BOPIS reservation, ship-from-store allocation, e-commerce hold) and hard holds (quality hold, regulatory recall, legal hold, damage hold, price investigation). Captures encumbrance type, SKU, quantity, node, start/expiry timestamps, associated order or case reference, authorizing party, hold reason, authorizing department, release status, and resolution details. Single source of truth for all reserved and held stock, enabling accurate ATP calculation on stock_position.

attributes.name: reservation_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each inventory reservation or hold record. Primary key for the reservation data product.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: System identifier of the employee or system user who authorized the inventory hold or reservation. Required for hard holds (quality, legal, regulatory) for audit and compliance purposes. For automated soft allocations, this may reference a system service account.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; ISO 27001 Access Control; OSHA Workplace Safety Standards

attributes.name: cart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.cart. Business justification: Inventory reservations are created from cart items during checkout to hold stock. Tracks cart-to-reservation lifecycle for abandoned cart inventory release and reservation expiry management.

attributes.name: checkout_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.checkout. Business justification: Reservations are created during checkout to hold inventory during payment authorization. Links reservation lifecycle to checkout session for payment-hold-release coordination and checkout abandonment

attributes.name: fulfillment_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.fulfillment_line. Business justification: Reservations are SKU-level allocations matching fulfillment line granularity. Retail WMS systems reserve specific SKU quantities for specific order lines during wave planning and pick task generation.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.fulfillment_order. Business justification: Inventory reservations are created during fulfillment order allocation in retail operations. When an online order or BOPIS order enters fulfillment, the WMS reserves specific inventory for that fulfil

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer order (OMS order) that triggered this inventory reservation. Populated for BOPIS, ROPIS, ship-from-store, and e-commerce hold encumbrances. Null for non-order-driven holds (quality, legal, regulatory). Links reservation to the order fulfillment lifecycle.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud OMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail SD Module

attributes.name: inventory_node_id
attributes.description: System identifier for the inventory node (store, DC, MFC, dark store) where the reserved stock physically resides. Central to ATP calculation and omnichannel fulfillment routing (BOPIS, SFS, ship-from-DC).
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: loyalty_membership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.membership. Business justification: Retail operations reserve inventory for loyalty members (VIP early access, tier-based allocation, BOPIS for members, exclusive product launches). Enables member-specific holds, tier-based inventory pr

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.profile. Business justification: Retail omnichannel fulfillment (BOPIS, ship-from-store, curbside pickup) requires tracking which customer profile created each inventory reservation. Essential for customer service, order fulfillment,

attributes.name: rfid_tag_id
attributes.description: RFID tag identifier associated with the specific unit(s) reserved, enabling item-level tracking and automated hold verification. Populated when RFID-based inventory tracking is active at the node. Supports real-time inventory visibility for omnichannel fulfillment.
attributes.references: GS1 RFID Standards (EPC/RFID); Manhattan Associates WMS RFID Module

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: System identifier for the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) whose inventory is being reserved or held. Links to the product master for item-level ATP (Available to Promise) calculation and omnichannel fulfillment routing.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Product Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Informatica MDM

attributes.name: sku_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.sku_price. Business justification: Order promising and ATP calculations require current pricing to validate order profitability and margin. Reservations for BOPIS, ship-from-store, and e-commerce fulfillment need pricing context for ma

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the stock_position record at the SKU-node level that this reservation encumbers. Enables direct linkage between the reservation and the ATP calculation on the stock_position product, ensuring accurate real-time inventory visibility.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: supplychain_edi_transaction_id
attributes.description: EDI transaction identifier when the reservation was triggered by an EDI message (e.g., EDI 940 Warehouse Shipping Order, EDI 947 Warehouse Inventory Adjustment). Enables end-to-end traceability for supplier-driven holds and VMI transactions.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; SAP S/4HANA Retail EDI Module

attributes.name: authorizing_department
attributes.description: Name or code of the business department that authorized the hold (e.g., Quality Assurance, Legal, Compliance, Store Operations, E-Commerce Fulfillment). Supports departmental accountability reporting and hold resolution workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO Module; NRF Retail Operations Standards

attributes.name: case_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the service case, quality investigation, legal matter, or regulatory recall case that authorized a hard hold. Populated for quality_hold, legal_hold, regulatory_recall, and damage_hold encumbrance types. Links to Salesforce Service Cloud case management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud; CPSC Recall Procedures; FDA Food Safety Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated timestamp when the reservation record was first written to the data platform (Silver layer ingestion time). Distinct from reservation_timestamp which captures the business event time. Used for data lineage and audit trail.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Confidentiality)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the inventory_cost_per_unit value (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency inventory valuation for international retail operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: encumbrance_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the inventory encumbrance. Soft allocations (e.g., BOPIS reservation, ship-from-store allocation, e-commerce hold) are temporary and customer-driven; hard holds (quality hold, regulatory recall, legal hold, damage hold, price investigation) restrict stock from sale pending resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: soft_allocation|hard_hold|quality_hold|regulatory_recall|legal_hold|damage_hold|price_investigation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Inventory Management Standards; CPSC Recall Procedures

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the reservation automatically expires if not fulfilled or manually extended. Critical for BOPIS and e-commerce holds where stock must be released back to general availability after a defined window (e.g., 24–48 hours). Null for indefinite holds such as legal or regulatory holds.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; NRF BOPIS Standards

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Retail fiscal period (year and period number, e.g., 2024-P07) during which the reservation was created. Supports financial reporting of encumbered inventory valuation, OTB (Open to Buy) impact analysis, and period-end inventory reconciliation per FASB ASC 330.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting; NRF Retail Fiscal Calendar Standards

attributes.name: fulfillment_channel
attributes.description: The omnichannel fulfillment method associated with this reservation. BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store), ROPIS (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store), ship_from_store (SFS), ecommerce (ship from DC), drop_ship (vendor direct), in_store (POS hold). Null for non-order-driven hard holds.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; NRF Omnichannel Standards; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific business reason for the reservation or hold (e.g., BOPIS_ALLOC, SFS_ALLOC, ECOM_HOLD, QA_FAIL, RECALL_CPSC, LEGAL_HOLD, DMG_INBOUND, PRICE_INVEST). Enables operational reporting and root-cause analysis of inventory encumbrances.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; CPSC Recall Procedures; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: hold_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the specific reason for the inventory hold or reservation, providing operational context beyond the structured hold_reason_code. Required for legal holds and regulatory recalls per compliance documentation standards.
attributes.references: CPSC Product Safety Standards; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act; NRF Best Practices

attributes.name: inventory_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) per unit for the reserved SKU at the time of reservation creation. Used for financial valuation of encumbered inventory, shrinkage reporting, and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) analysis. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO module.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330 Inventory Accounting; SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO Module

attributes.name: is_recalled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reservation was created in response to a regulatory product recall (CPSC, FDA, or other governing body). When true, the hold cannot be released without explicit compliance authorization. Supports mandatory recall reporting and quarantine workflows.
attributes.references: CPSC Consumer Product Safety Standards; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); NRF Recall Procedures

attributes.name: is_vendor_managed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reserved inventory is managed under a Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) agreement, where the supplier retains ownership and replenishment responsibility. Affects financial liability and hold authorization workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; NRF VMI Standards

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the reservation, governing queue position in fulfillment workflows and hold resolution SLAs. 'critical' applies to regulatory recalls and legal holds; 'high' to same-day BOPIS; 'standard' to regular e-commerce holds; 'low' to pre-emptive soft allocations.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF SLA Standards

attributes.name: release_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing resolution details, disposition instructions, or compliance notes recorded at the time of hold release. Required for regulatory recalls and legal holds to document the resolution rationale for audit purposes.
attributes.references: CPSC Recall Procedures; FDA FSMA; ISO 27001 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: release_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for releasing a hard hold. 'pending' — release request submitted awaiting authorization; 'approved' — release authorized by responsible department; 'rejected' — release denied, hold remains active; 'auto_released' — system-triggered release upon expiry or order fulfillment; 'escalated' — requires senior authorization.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: release_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the reservation was released, cancelled, or converted. Null while the reservation is active. Used for hold duration analysis, SLA compliance reporting, and ATP recalculation upon release.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable business identifier for the reservation, used in operational communications, order management, and customer-facing references (e.g., BOPIS confirmation codes). Sourced from OMS or WMS upon creation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: reservation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the inventory reservation. 'active' — stock is currently encumbered; 'expired' — reservation lapsed past expiry without fulfillment; 'released' — hold manually or systematically lifted; 'cancelled' — reservation voided before fulfillment; 'pending_release' — awaiting authorization to release; 'converted' — soft allocation fulfilled and converted to a shipment.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module; NRF Inventory Standards

attributes.name: reservation_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) when the inventory encumbrance was created — the principal business event timestamp. For BOPIS/e-commerce holds, this is when the customer completed checkout. For quality/legal holds, this is when the hold was authorized.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); ISO 8601

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of the SKU encumbered by this reservation. Subtracted from on-hand quantity to derive ATP (Available to Promise) on the stock_position product. Must be positive and not exceed available on-hand at time of reservation creation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module; NRF Inventory Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this reservation record (e.g., WMS = Manhattan Associates WMS, OMS = Order Management System, ECOM = Salesforce Commerce Cloud, ERP = SAP S/4HANA, MANUAL = manually entered hold). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WMS|OMS|ECOM|ERP|ORMS|CAR|SFCC|MANUAL — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Informatica MDM; ISO 27001 Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: storage_bin
attributes.description: Specific bin, shelf, or slot location within the node where the reserved inventory is physically stored. Enables warehouse associates to locate and pick reserved stock efficiently. Sourced from Manhattan Associates WMS bin management.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the reserved_quantity (e.g., EA = Each, CS = Case, LB = Pound, KG = Kilogram). Aligns with the SKU's base unit of measure in the product master to ensure accurate inventory accounting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|LB|KG|OZ|FT|M|L|GAL — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode identifier for the reserved item. Used for RFID scanning, POS reconciliation, and regulatory recall identification per GS1 standards.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards for Barcodes and Product Identification

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated timestamp of the most recent modification to the reservation record (e.g., quantity adjustment, status change, expiry extension). Used for change data capture (CDC) and incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; Databricks Delta Lake CDC Standards

products.name: reorder_policy
products.description: SKU-location level replenishment parameters defining when and how much to reorder. Captures reorder method (min/max, days-of-supply, WOS-based, forecast-driven), reorder point, safety stock, min/max levels, order multiple (MOQ/case pack), lead time, review cycle, supplier preference, and policy effective/expiry dates. Trigger thresholds generate inventory_replenishment_order records when stock_position breaches defined levels. Owned and maintained by replenishment planners; consumed by automated replenishment engines.

attributes.name: reorder_policy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the reorder policy record. Primary key for the reorder_policy data product in the inventory domain.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Reference to the demand forecast record from Blue Yonder Demand Planning that drives replenishment quantity calculations for forecast_driven reorder method. Null for non-forecast-driven methods.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inventory node (store, Distribution Center (DC), or Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC)) where this reorder policy governs stock replenishment. Combined with sku_id, forms the natural business key.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA Retail WM Module

attributes.name: margin_target_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.margin_target. Business justification: Replenishment planning must respect category margin targets to maintain financial objectives. Automated reorder policies need margin guardrails to prevent over-buying low-margin SKUs and ensure replen

attributes.name: replenishment_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent replenishment plan that governs or generated this reorder policy. Links the policy to the broader supply chain planning context managed in Blue Yonder Demand Planning.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which this reorder policy applies. Combined with location_id, forms the natural business key for a reorder policy.
attributes.references: GS1; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Informatica MDM

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preferred supplier for replenishment orders generated by this policy. Used by the replenishment engine to route purchase orders. May be overridden at order generation time if the supplier is unavailable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: ABC classification of the SKU at this location based on sales velocity and revenue contribution: A (high-velocity/high-value), B (medium), C (low-velocity/low-value), D (dead stock or near-dead). Influences replenishment priority, safety stock levels, and review cycle frequency.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Industry Standards; ISO 9001

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the replenishment planner or manager who approved this reorder policy for activation. Supports governance, audit trail, and accountability for policy parameters.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal Governance Standards

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this reorder policy was formally approved for activation by the authorized planner or manager. Supports audit trail and policy lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this reorder policy record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and policy lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this reorder policy becomes active and the replenishment engine begins applying its parameters. Supports time-bound policy management and seasonal policy transitions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date after which this reorder policy is no longer active. Null indicates an open-ended policy with no planned expiration. Used to manage seasonal policies, promotional replenishment windows, and policy version transitions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: is_auto_replenishment
attributes.description: Indicates whether replenishment orders are automatically generated and submitted when the reorder trigger is breached (True), or whether a replenishment planner must manually review and approve the suggested order (False).
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: is_seasonal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reorder policy applies seasonal adjustments to replenishment parameters (e.g., elevated safety stock or WOS targets during peak seasons). When True, seasonal override parameters may be applied by the replenishment engine.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: is_vendor_managed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU-location replenishment is managed by the supplier under a Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) agreement. When True, the supplier is responsible for monitoring stock levels and initiating replenishment orders rather than the retailer's automated engine.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF VMI Standards

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which a replenishment planner reviewed and validated the parameters of this reorder policy. Supports governance and audit of policy maintenance cadence.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The expected number of calendar days from placement of a replenishment purchase order to receipt of goods at the destination location. Used to calculate the reorder point and ensure stock does not fall below safety stock during the replenishment cycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Blue Yonder Demand Planning; NRF Industry Standards

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory node type to which this policy applies: store (retail store), DC (Distribution Center), MFC (Micro-Fulfillment Center), dark_store (fulfillment-only location), or warehouse. Drives replenishment logic differences by node type.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Industry Standards

attributes.name: max_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The maximum allowable on-hand inventory level (in units) for this SKU at this location. Used in min/max reorder method as the upper bound. Replenishment orders are sized to bring stock up to this level without exceeding it.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: min_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum allowable on-hand inventory level (in units) for this SKU at this location. Used in min/max reorder method as the lower bound. Stock falling below this level triggers an urgent replenishment order.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: The minimum number of units that must be ordered per replenishment order as stipulated by the supplier contract. Replenishment engine enforces this floor when generating inventory_replenishment_order records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); EDI Standards (GS1)

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next planner review of this reorder policy's parameters. Calculated from last_reviewed_date plus the review_cycle_days. Drives planner workqueue prioritization.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for replenishment planners to document rationale for policy parameter choices, exceptions, seasonal considerations, or supplier-specific constraints associated with this reorder policy.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Internal Operational Standards

attributes.name: order_multiple
attributes.business_glossary_term: Order Multiple (Case Pack / Minimum Order Quantity)
attributes.description: The quantity increment in which orders must be placed, reflecting the supplier's case pack size or Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ). All replenishment order quantities are rounded up to the nearest multiple of this value to comply with supplier constraints.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; GS1; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: order_quantity
attributes.description: The fixed quantity (in units) to order each time a replenishment trigger is activated. Used for fixed_quantity reorder method. For other methods, this field may be null and the order quantity is dynamically calculated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: policy_code
attributes.description: Business-facing unique alphanumeric code identifying the reorder policy, used by replenishment planners and referenced in automated replenishment engines (e.g., Blue Yonder). Externally visible identifier across systems.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: policy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the reorder policy, used by replenishment planners to identify and manage policies (e.g., 'DC Grocery Min/Max Weekly', 'Store Electronics WOS-Based').

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reorder policy. Controls whether the policy is actively used by the replenishment engine to generate inventory_replenishment_order records. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|inactive|draft|pending_approval|expired|suspended — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: policy_version
attributes.description: Incrementing version number for this reorder policy record, incremented each time parameters are materially changed. Supports policy change history tracking and rollback capability for replenishment planners.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: reorder_method
attributes.description: The replenishment calculation method applied by this policy: min_max (reorder when stock falls below minimum, order up to maximum), days_of_supply (maintain a target number of days of inventory), wos_based (Weeks of Supply (WOS) target), forecast_driven (demand forecast from Blue Yonder), fixed_quantity (constant order quantity), vendor_managed (VMI — Vendor Managed Inventory where supplier controls replenishment). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: min_max|days_of_supply|wos_based|forecast_driven|fixed_quantity|vendor_managed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Industry Standards

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: The on-hand stock level (in units) at which a replenishment order is automatically triggered. When the stock_position in inventory falls at or below this threshold, an inventory_replenishment_order record is generated. Core parameter for min/max and fixed-quantity reorder methods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: review_cycle_days
attributes.description: The frequency in calendar days at which the replenishment engine evaluates this policy and checks whether a reorder trigger has been breached. Defines the periodic review interval (e.g., daily=1, weekly=7, bi-weekly=14).
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Buffer stock quantity (in units) maintained above the reorder point to protect against demand variability and supply lead time uncertainty. Prevents stockouts during replenishment cycles. A key input to the reorder point calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Blue Yonder Demand Planning; ISO 9001 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this reorder policy was originated or last updated: ORMS (Oracle Retail Merchandising System), SAP_MM (SAP S/4HANA MM Module), BLUE_YONDER (Blue Yonder Demand Planning), MANUAL (planner-entered), MDM (Informatica MDM). Supports data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: target_days_of_supply
attributes.description: The desired number of days of inventory coverage to maintain at this location for this SKU. Used in days_of_supply reorder method to calculate the replenishment order quantity based on forecasted daily demand.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: target_wos
attributes.description: The desired number of weeks of inventory coverage (Weeks of Supply — WOS) to maintain at this location for this SKU. Used in wos_based reorder method. Replenishment orders are sized to achieve this WOS target based on forecasted weekly demand.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; NRF Industry Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which all quantity fields (reorder_point_quantity, safety_stock_quantity, min/max, order_quantity, etc.) are expressed for this policy. Aligns with the SKU's base unit of measure in the product master. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PK|LB|KG|OZ|L|ML|FT|M — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; ISO 80000

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this reorder policy record was most recently modified. Tracks parameter changes made by replenishment planners and supports change audit trails.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Internal Audit Standards

products.name: asn
products.description: Advance Shipment Notice (ASN) records received from suppliers or DCs prior to physical goods arrival. Captures ASN number, sender (supplier or DC), destination node, expected arrival date, carrier, tracking number, total cartons, total units, SKU-level line details, and ASN status (sent, in-transit, received, discrepant). Enables pre-receiving workflows, dock scheduling, and receiving discrepancy detection against corresponding inventory_goods_receipt records. Received via EDI 856 or API from trading partners.

attributes.name: asn_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Advance Shipment Notice record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: asn_inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating inventory node (DC, MFC, store, or supplier facility) from which the shipment was dispatched. Used for inter-node transfer ASNs.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: asn_supplier_vendor_id
attributes.description: FK to supplier.vendor

attributes.name: asn_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor who originated the shipment. Populated when asn_type is 'supplier' or 'drop_ship'. Links to the supplier master record in Informatica MDM.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the logistics carrier responsible for transporting the shipment. Used for carrier performance tracking and SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: destination_node_inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the receiving inventory node (store, DC, or MFC) where the shipment is expected to arrive. Drives dock scheduling and pre-receiving workflows in the WMS.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: dock_appointment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dock scheduling appointment associated with this ASN arrival. Links to supplychain.inbound_appointment for dock door and labor resource planning.

attributes.name: food_safety_log_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.food_safety_log. Business justification: Inbound shipments trigger temperature and quality monitoring logs at receiving. Retail food operations require linking ASNs to food safety logs for HACCP compliance, critical limit verification, and c

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inventory goods receipt record created upon physical receipt of this shipment. Links ASN to the goods receipt for discrepancy detection and inventory valuation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order that this ASN fulfills. Links to the supplychain.purchase_order product for PO-to-ASN reconciliation and receiving discrepancy detection.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: supplier_edi_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the EDI 856 transaction set that originated this ASN record. Used for EDI audit trails, reprocessing, and trading partner dispute resolution.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 856; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: actual_arrival_date
attributes.description: Date the shipment physically arrived at the destination node dock. Compared against expected_arrival_date to measure carrier on-time delivery performance and lead time actuals.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the ASN as transmitted by the supplier or DC via EDI 856 or API. Used for cross-system reconciliation and dock scheduling.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 856 Ship Notice/Manifest; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: asn_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the ASN. 'sent' = transmitted by sender; 'in_transit' = shipment en route; 'arrived' = at destination dock; 'receiving' = active receiving in WMS; 'received' = fully received; 'discrepant' = quantity or SKU variance detected; 'cancelled' = voided prior to receipt. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sent|in_transit|arrived|receiving|received|discrepant|cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: asn_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ASN by origin and fulfillment pattern. 'supplier' = inbound from vendor; 'dc_transfer' = inter-DC or DC-to-store transfer; 'cross_dock' = direct cross-dock flow; 'drop_ship' = vendor direct-to-customer; 'return_to_dc' = store or customer return to DC.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number issued by the carrier for the shipment. Legal document of title used for freight claims, customs clearance, and receiving verification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ASN record was first created in the system, either upon EDI 856 inbound processing or manual entry. Audit trail for record lineage.

attributes.name: destination_node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the receiving node. Determines which receiving workflow and dock door assignment logic applies in the WMS.

attributes.name: discrepancy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a receiving discrepancy (quantity overage, shortage, or SKU mismatch) was detected when comparing the ASN to the actual goods receipt. Triggers discrepancy resolution workflow.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: discrepancy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the receiving discrepancy detected against the ASN. 'overage' = more units received than declared; 'shortage' = fewer units; 'sku_mismatch' = wrong SKU received; 'damage' = goods received in damaged condition; 'none' = no discrepancy.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: dock_door_number
attributes.description: Assigned dock door at the destination node for unloading this shipment. Pre-assigned during dock scheduling to optimize receiving throughput and yard management.

attributes.name: expected_arrival_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date the shipment is expected to arrive at the destination node. Drives dock door scheduling, labor planning, and replenishment availability projections.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: freight_terms
attributes.description: Freight payment responsibility terms for the shipment. 'prepaid' = supplier pays freight; 'collect' = receiver pays; 'third_party' = billed to a third party. Drives accounts payable freight accruals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; GS1 EDI 856

attributes.name: is_cross_dock
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment is designated for cross-docking (direct transfer without storage) at the destination DC. Triggers cross-dock workflow in the WMS and bypasses putaway.

attributes.name: is_rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether RFID tags are present on cartons or pallets in this shipment, enabling automated receiving and inventory tracking via RFID readers at the dock.
attributes.references: GS1 RFID Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: External purchase order number as referenced on the ASN document. Denormalized from the PO for cross-system matching with EDI 856 transmissions and supplier invoices.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; GS1 EDI 856

attributes.name: pro_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned Progressive (PRO) number for LTL (Less-Than-Truckload) shipments. Used for freight bill matching and carrier invoice reconciliation.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 856; National Motor Freight Traffic Association (NMFTA)

attributes.name: receiving_complete_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when all line items on the ASN were fully received and confirmed in the WMS. Marks the transition from 'receiving' to 'received' or 'discrepant' status.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: ship_date
attributes.description: Date the shipment was physically dispatched from the source node or supplier facility. Used to calculate lead time and measure supplier on-time shipping performance.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 856; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: shipment_mode
attributes.description: Transportation mode used for the shipment. Drives freight cost benchmarking, carrier selection analytics, and carbon footprint reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: truckload|ltl|parcel|rail|air|ocean|intermodal — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the originating node. Distinguishes supplier facilities from internal DC, MFC, store, or dark store nodes to support routing and receiving workflow logic.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this ASN record. Supports data lineage tracking and multi-system reconciliation in the lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: total_cartons
attributes.description: Total number of cartons (cases/boxes) included in the shipment as declared on the ASN. Used for dock receiving verification, pallet count planning, and discrepancy detection.

attributes.name: total_pallets
attributes.description: Total number of pallets in the shipment as declared on the ASN. Used for dock door capacity planning, unloading labor scheduling, and yard management.

attributes.name: total_units
attributes.description: Total number of sellable units across all SKU lines declared on the ASN. Used for pre-receiving inventory projection and receiving discrepancy detection against goods receipt.

attributes.name: total_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total cubic volume of the shipment in cubic meters as declared on the ASN. Used for trailer utilization analysis, DC storage capacity planning, and freight density calculations.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Gross weight of the entire shipment in kilograms as declared on the ASN. Used for freight cost calculation, carrier compliance, and dock equipment planning.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned tracking number for the shipment. Enables real-time in-transit visibility and last-mile delivery monitoring via carrier APIs.

attributes.name: transmission_method
attributes.description: Channel through which the ASN was received. 'edi_856' = GS1 EDI 856 standard; 'api' = REST/SOAP API integration; 'manual' = entered by receiving staff; 'portal' = supplier self-service portal.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 856; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: transmission_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ASN was transmitted by the supplier or DC via EDI 856 or API. Distinct from created_timestamp; used to measure EDI lead time and supplier advance notice compliance.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 856; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the ASN record, including status transitions, quantity updates, or carrier information changes. Supports change data capture in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: lot_id

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.category. Business justification: Product recall and quality issue management requires category-level aggregation for buyer notification and regulatory reporting. Lot traceability reporting is organized by merchandise category. Catego

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: Lot-level costing for FEFO/FIFO valuation and batch-specific cost tracking. Perishables, pharmaceuticals, and regulated products require lot-specific cost basis for accurate inventory valuation, recal

attributes.name: food_safety_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.food_safety_plan. Retail grocers must link lot records to facility food safety plans to demonstrate supply chai

attributes.name: certification_code

attributes.name: country_of_origin

attributes.name: expiry_date

attributes.name: fefo_sequence

attributes.name: gtin

attributes.name: inspection_date

attributes.name: inspection_result

attributes.name: is_private_label

attributes.name: is_recalled
