products.name: node_assortment
products.description: This association product represents the assortment planning decision between inventory_node and item_hierarchy. It captures the strategic and operational decisions about which merchandise categories are carried at which locations, including space allocation, planogram assignments, and replenishment rules. Each record links one inventory_node to one item_hierarchy node with attributes that govern how that category is merchandised at that specific location.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, assortment planning is a core business process where each inventory node (store, DC, MFC) carries multiple merchandise categories, and each category is carried across multiple locations with location-specific merchandising rules. Store planners and category managers actively manage these node-category assortment decisions, allocating shelf space, assigning planograms, setting presentation quantities, and defining replenishment priorities that vary by location format, customer demographics, and regional preferences. This is not a derived analytical correlation but an operational planning entity that humans create, update, and monitor.

attributes.name: node_assortment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this node-category assortment plan record

attributes.name: inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the inventory node (store, DC, MFC) where this category is carried

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the merchandise hierarchy node (category, subcategory, segment) carried at this location

attributes.name: actual_sku_count
attributes.description: Current number of distinct SKUs from this category actively stocked at this location. Compared against target_sku_count for assortment compliance monitoring

attributes.name: assortment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this category at this location. ACTIVE means category is currently stocked and sold; PLANNED means approved for future rollout; DISCONTINUED means category removed from location; SEASONAL_INACTIVE means temporarily not carried

attributes.name: category_manager_override_name
attributes.description: Name of category manager responsible for this specific node-category combination when it differs from the hierarchy-level default. Used for regional or format-specific category ownership

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this node assortment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and assortment planning history

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this category assortment was discontinued at this location. Null for currently active assortments. Supports assortment history and space reallocation analysis

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this category assortment became active at this location. Supports assortment history tracking and seasonal rollout planning

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this node assortment record was last updated. Tracks assortment plan changes and space reallocation events

attributes.name: local_assortment_override
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this location has local merchandising authority to deviate from corporate assortment plan for this category. True for high-autonomy formats or test stores

attributes.name: max_presentation_qty
attributes.description: Maximum number of units that can be displayed on shelf for this category at this location based on allocated space and planogram design

attributes.name: min_presentation_qty
attributes.description: Minimum number of units that must be displayed on shelf for this category at this location to maintain acceptable customer presentation standards

attributes.name: planogram_count
attributes.description: Number of active planograms assigned to this category at this location. Planograms define shelf layout and product placement; count indicates space allocation complexity

attributes.name: replenishment_priority
attributes.description: Priority classification for replenishing this category at this location. CRITICAL for high-velocity destination categories; HIGH for key traffic drivers; MEDIUM for routine; LOW for convenience/impulse

attributes.name: shelf_capacity_units
attributes.description: Total shelf capacity allocated to this category at this location, measured in unit facings or shelf positions. Drives maximum inventory display quantity

attributes.name: space_allocation_sqft
attributes.description: Physical floor space allocated to this category at this location, measured in square feet. Used for space productivity analysis and category performance reporting

attributes.name: target_sku_count
attributes.description: Target number of distinct SKUs from this category that should be carried at this location. Drives assortment depth decisions based on node format and customer demographics

products.name: promo_stock_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment between stock_position and promo_offer. It captures the allocation of specific SKU-location inventory to promotional campaigns, including promotional pricing, reserved quantities, display placement, and offer-specific timing. Each record links one stock position to one promotional offer with attributes that exist only in the context of this promotional inventory allocation.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, promotional inventory allocation is an active operational process where promotion managers assign specific SKU-location stock positions to promotional campaigns. A single stock position can participate in multiple concurrent promotional offers (e.g., a loyalty-exclusive discount stacked with a category-wide sale, or sequential promotions as inventory rolls from one campaign to another). Conversely, a single promotional offer applies to multiple stock positions across stores, DCs, and e-commerce fulfillment nodes. The business actively manages these allocations with relationship-specific data including promotional pricing, reserved quantities, display locations, and offer timing that varies by location.

attributes.name: promo_stock_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each promotional stock allocation record

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Promo Stock Allocation - Promo Offer Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the promotional offer to which this stock position is allocated

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Promo Stock Allocation - Stock Position Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific SKU-location stock position allocated to this promotional offer

attributes.name: actual_units_sold
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of units sold from this stock position under this promotional offer, tracked for promotional performance analysis

attributes.name: allocation_created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that created this promotional stock allocation

attributes.name: allocation_created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotional stock allocation record was created by the promotion planning system

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this promotional stock allocation. planned: allocation created but offer not yet active; active: offer live and inventory allocated; depleted: reserved inventory exhausted; cancelled: allocation cancelled before completion; completed: offer period ended normally

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for promotional price and revenue amounts

attributes.name: display_location_code
attributes.description: Specific in-store display location code for this promotional stock allocation (e.g., ENDCAP_A1, FEATURE_TABLE_3, GONDOLA_END_B5), indicating where this SKU should be merchandised for this promotion

attributes.name: offer_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this specific stock position is no longer eligible for this promotional offer at this location

attributes.name: offer_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this specific stock position becomes eligible for this promotional offer at this location (may differ from campaign-level dates due to inventory availability or regional rollout)

attributes.name: promotional_inventory_reserve_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of inventory at this stock position reserved specifically for this promotional offer, ensuring adequate stock for the promotion duration and preventing depletion by non-promotional sales

attributes.name: promotional_price
attributes.description: The specific promotional price for this SKU at this location under this offer, calculated based on the offer discount mechanics applied to the regular price

attributes.name: promotional_quantity_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum or target quantity threshold for this SKU-location to participate in the promotional offer (e.g., minimum display quantity, BOGO threshold)

attributes.name: promotional_revenue
attributes.description: Total revenue generated from sales of this SKU at this location under this promotional offer

products.name: location_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between inventory_node and associate. It captures the operational assignment of retail workforce members to specific inventory-holding locations (stores, DCs, MFCs) including cross-training assignments, seasonal redeployments, temporary transfers, and multi-location coverage. Each record links one inventory_node to one associate with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship, enabling tracking of primary vs secondary locations, assignment duration, role-specific access levels, and workforce deployment history across the retail network.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, associates routinely work at multiple locations throughout their employment: store associates provide cross-store coverage during peak periods, DC workers are temporarily deployed to stores for inventory events, seasonal staff rotate between locations, and employees receive cross-training assignments at secondary facilities. Simultaneously, each inventory node (store, DC, MFC) has many associates assigned to it with varying roles, access levels, and assignment types. The business actively manages these assignments through workforce management systems, tracking assignment dates, primary vs secondary location status, role-specific access, and deployment history.

attributes.name: location_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each location assignment record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the retail workforce member (associate) who is assigned to the inventory node location.

attributes.name: inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to inventory.inventory_node. Identifies the location where the associate is assigned.

attributes.name: node_inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the inventory node (store, DC, MFC, or other location) where the associate is assigned to work.

attributes.name: access_level
attributes.description: Level of system and physical access the associate has at this specific inventory node. Values: FULL (full operational access), LIMITED (restricted areas only), TRAINING (supervised access during cross-training), EMERGENCY (backup coverage only). Drives security permissions, badge access, and system authorization at the location level.

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the associate's assignment to this inventory node location ended. Null for active assignments. Used for tracking transfers, temporary assignments, and historical workforce deployment.

attributes.name: assignment_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the associate's assignment to this inventory node location began. Used for tracking assignment history, tenure at location, and temporal workforce deployment analysis.

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assignment nature. PERMANENT indicates standard long-term assignment, TEMPORARY for defined-duration transfers, SEASONAL for holiday/peak period deployment, CROSS_TRAINING for skill development assignments, EMERGENCY_COVERAGE for short-term staffing needs. Drives scheduling rules and labor planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this location assignment record was created. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: primary_location_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory node is the associate's primary work location (true) or a secondary/cross-training location (false). Used for labor cost allocation, scheduling priority, and determining home base for workforce planning.

attributes.name: role_at_location
attributes.description: Specific role or function the associate performs at this inventory node, which may differ from their primary job title. Examples: Floor Associate, Receiving Clerk, Shift Supervisor, Cross-Training, Seasonal Support. Used for location-specific scheduling, task assignment, and workforce capability tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this location assignment record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: assortment_deployment
products.description: This association product represents the deployment of a strategic assortment plan to a specific inventory node (store, DC, or fulfillment center). It captures the implementation status, compliance metrics, and timing of assortment execution at each location. Each record links one inventory_node to one assortment_plan with attributes that track how well the planned assortment is being executed at that specific location.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, assortment plans are deployed to multiple inventory nodes (stores, DCs, fulfillment centers), and each node carries multiple assortment plans across different categories and seasons. Merchandising teams actively manage these deployments by tracking compliance (planned vs actual SKU count), implementation status, and timing at each location-plan combination. This is a recognized operational relationship where the deployment itself has meaningful attributes that belong to neither the plan nor the node alone.

attributes.name: assortment_deployment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this deployment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: assortment_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the strategic assortment plan being deployed to this location

attributes.name: inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the inventory node (store, DC, MFC) where this assortment plan is deployed

attributes.name: planogram_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific planogram (shelf layout) used to implement this assortment plan at this location. May vary by store format or size.

attributes.name: responsible_buyer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise buyer responsible for ensuring this deployment is executed successfully at this location.

attributes.name: actual_sku_count
attributes.description: Number of SKUs actually stocked and available at this inventory node as of the last measurement. Used to calculate compliance.

attributes.name: compliance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of planned SKUs that are actually in stock at this location, calculated as (actual_sku_count / planned_sku_count) * 100. Key metric for assortment execution quality.

attributes.name: deployment_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the assortment was fully deployed and reached initial compliance at this location.

attributes.name: deployment_start_date
attributes.description: Date when deployment activities began at this location (receiving, stocking, planogram setup).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this assortment plan became effective at this specific inventory node. Marks the start of deployment execution.

attributes.name: implementation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the assortment deployment at this location: planned (not yet started), in_progress (actively rolling out), deployed (fully implemented), non_compliant (deployed but below compliance threshold), discontinued (plan no longer active at this location).

attributes.name: last_compliance_check_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance measurement for this deployment. Compliance is typically measured weekly or monthly.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes about deployment challenges, adjustments, or special circumstances at this location (e.g., 'Reduced SKU count due to limited shelf space', 'Delayed deployment due to remodel').

attributes.name: planned_sku_count
attributes.description: Number of SKUs planned to be carried at this specific inventory node under this assortment plan. May differ from the plan-level target due to store cluster or format-specific adjustments.

domains.name: customer
domains.description: Single source of truth for all customer identity, profiles, households, segments (B2C and B2B), contact information, preferences, and RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary) analytics. Manages customer lifecycle, NPS scores, CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value), CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost), consent/privacy preferences, and omnichannel interaction history. Supports personalized clienteling and customer recognition across POS, e-commerce, and mobile.

products.name: profile
products.description: Golden record for every customer (B2C and B2B) served by Retail. Stores core identity attributes sourced from Informatica MDM including full legal name, date of birth, gender, preferred language, nationality, customer type (individual/corporate), acquisition channel, CAC, CLTV score, NPS score, lifecycle stage, privacy consent flags (GDPR/CCPA), and golden-record confidence score. This is the single authoritative master entity for all customer identity data across POS, e-commerce, and mobile channels.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customer profile. Primary key for the golden customer record in Informatica MDM.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer's preferred or most frequently visited store location, used for localized assortment and clienteling.

attributes.name: acquisition_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the customer was originally acquired, used for CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) analysis and channel effectiveness measurement.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer first engaged with the business, marking the start of the customer lifecycle.

attributes.name: cac_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred to acquire this customer, including marketing spend, promotional discounts, and channel costs. Used for CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) to CAC ratio analysis.

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Date
attributes.description: Timestamp when CCPA opt-out request was processed, required for compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the customer has opted out of personal data sale under CCPA regulations.

attributes.name: cltv_score
attributes.description: Predicted total revenue value this customer will generate over their entire relationship with the business, calculated using RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary) models and predictive analytics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the customer profile record was first created in the master data management system.

attributes.name: customer_type
attributes.description: Classification of customer as individual consumer (B2C) or corporate buyer (B2B), including special categories such as employee or VIP.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the customer, used for age verification, lifecycle marketing, and personalized birthday promotions.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for customer communication across all channels including e-commerce, loyalty programs, and promotional campaigns.

attributes.name: email_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating customer consent to receive promotional emails and newsletters.

attributes.name: employee_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the customer is an employee eligible for employee discount programs.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first name or given name of the customer as recorded in the master data management system.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: Complete legal name of the customer, typically concatenated from first, middle, and last name components.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Date
attributes.description: Timestamp when GDPR consent was granted by the customer, required for compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the customer has provided explicit consent for data processing under GDPR requirements.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Self-identified gender of the customer, used for personalized merchandising and assortment planning.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this customer to a household group for family-level analytics and shared loyalty benefits.

attributes.name: last_interaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the customer's most recent interaction with the business across any touchpoint including POS, e-commerce, mobile app, or customer service.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to any attribute in the customer profile record.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last name or family name of the customer as recorded in the master data management system.

attributes.name: last_purchase_date
attributes.description: Date of the customer's most recent purchase transaction across all channels, used for recency analysis in RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary) segmentation.

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the customer lifecycle journey, used for targeted marketing campaigns and retention strategies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: prospect|new|active|at_risk|dormant|churned|reactivated — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: loyalty_tier
attributes.description: Current tier level in the loyalty program, determining benefits, discounts, and personalized services.

attributes.name: marketing_consent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the customer has consented to receive marketing communications including email, SMS, and direct mail.

attributes.name: mdm_confidence_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Master Data Management (MDM) Golden Record Confidence Score
attributes.description: Confidence score (0-100) from Informatica MDM indicating the quality and reliability of the golden record match and data completeness.

attributes.name: mdm_last_match_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Master Data Management (MDM) Last Match Date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the last MDM matching and survivorship process execution that updated this golden record.

attributes.name: mdm_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the primary source system that contributed the authoritative data for this golden record (e.g., SAP CAR, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, POS).

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the customer. Nullable field for customers without a middle name.

attributes.name: mobile_number
attributes.description: Mobile phone number used for SMS notifications, mobile app authentication, and last-mile delivery coordination.

attributes.name: nationality
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the customer's nationality or citizenship.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score indicating customer satisfaction and likelihood to recommend, scored from -100 to 100.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for customer service, order notifications, and BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) communications.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: Customer's preferred method for receiving communications and notifications from the business.

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-2 three-letter language code representing the customer's preferred language for communication and marketing materials.

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the customer profile, controlling access to services and transactions across all channels.

attributes.name: sms_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating customer consent to receive promotional SMS messages and mobile notifications.

attributes.name: vip_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the customer is designated as a VIP for special clienteling services and exclusive offers.

products.name: account
products.description: Commercial relationship record between a customer and Retail, distinct from profile (identity). Tracks account number, status (active/suspended/closed), open date, tier (standard/premium/VIP), credit limit, preferred store, preferred channel (in-store/online/mobile), default payment method reference, and account-level flags (employee discount eligibility, tax-exempt status, B2B pricing flag). One profile may have multiple accounts (e.g., personal + business). Supports account-level reporting, credit management, and omnichannel preference routing.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee assigned as the dedicated account manager for this account (typically for high-value B2B or VIP accounts). Null for standard consumer accounts without dedicated management.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: billing_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the default billing address for this account. Used for invoicing, credit checks, and payment processing. Null if no billing address on file.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer's preferred or home store location for in-store pickup, returns, and personalized store-based services. Null if no preference set.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: B2B and corporate accounts require contract-specific pricing (volume discounts, negotiated rates, special terms). Account managers assign custom price lists during contract setup. Essential for wholes

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer profile who owns this account. One customer may have multiple accounts (e.g., personal and business).

attributes.name: shipping_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the default shipping address for this account. Used for order fulfillment and delivery. Null if no default shipping address set.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique account number used for customer communication, statements, and customer service lookup. Distinct from internal account_id.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the account. Active accounts can transact; suspended accounts are temporarily blocked; closed accounts are permanently terminated; pending_activation awaits customer verification; frozen accounts are under investigation; dormant accounts have no recent activity.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: account_tier
attributes.description: Service tier or membership level of the account, determining benefits, discounts, and service priority. Standard is base tier; premium, VIP, and platinum offer escalating benefits.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the account indicating the nature of the commercial relationship: personal (B2C consumer), business (B2B corporate), employee (staff discount account), or wholesale (bulk buyer).
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: b2b_pricing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account receives B2B contract pricing instead of standard retail pricing. True for wholesale and corporate accounts; false for consumer accounts.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: Date when the account was permanently closed. Null for active accounts. Used for churn analysis and account lifecycle reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum credit amount (in base currency) extended to this account for deferred payment or credit purchases. Null for cash-only accounts. Used for credit management and risk assessment.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the account's base currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). All monetary transactions and balances for this account are denominated in this currency.

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account holder has consented to sharing their data with third-party partners for analytics, advertising, or personalization. True if consented; false otherwise. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 - Lawfulness of Processing, CCPA - California Consumer Privacy Act

attributes.name: default_payment_method_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer's default payment method for this account (e.g., credit card on file, bank account). Null if no default set. Used for one-click checkout and recurring billing.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: employee_discount_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is eligible for employee discount pricing. True for employee accounts and authorized family members; false otherwise.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent purchase or transaction on this account. Used for recency analysis, dormancy detection, and customer lifecycle segmentation (RFM analysis).
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: loyalty_program_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is enrolled in the retailer's loyalty or rewards program. True if enrolled; false otherwise. Used for loyalty analytics and targeted promotions.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account holder has consented to receive marketing communications (email, SMS, direct mail). True if opted in; false if opted out. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 - Lawfulness of Processing, CCPA - California Consumer Privacy Act

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the account holder provided marketing consent. Null if never opted in. Used for consent audit trail and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 - Conditions for Consent, CCPA - California Consumer Privacy Act

attributes.name: marketing_opt_out_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the account holder withdrew marketing consent. Null if currently opted in or never opted in. Used for consent audit trail and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 - Conditions for Consent, CCPA - California Consumer Privacy Act

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal notes about the account (e.g., special handling instructions, VIP preferences, service history, escalation notes). Used by customer service and account management teams.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: Date when the account was first opened and activated. Used for account age calculations, tenure-based benefits, and lifecycle analytics.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Current outstanding balance owed by the account holder (in base currency). Positive values indicate amounts owed to Retail; negative values indicate credit balances. Used for accounts receivable and collections.

attributes.name: preferred_channel
attributes.description: Customer's preferred interaction channel for shopping and service. Used for omnichannel routing, personalized marketing, and channel-specific offers.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that is the authoritative source for this account record (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Oracle Retail, Informatica MDM). Used for data lineage and master data management.

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Date when the account was most recently suspended. Null if never suspended or currently active. Used for compliance and risk management reporting.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the account was suspended (e.g., payment default, fraud investigation, customer request, policy violation). Null if never suspended.
attributes.references: FTC - Federal Trade Commission Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: tax_exempt_certificate_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax exemption certificate number for tax-exempt accounts. Null for non-exempt accounts. Required for audit and compliance verification.
attributes.references: FTC - Federal Trade Commission Pricing Transparency Standards

attributes.name: tax_exempt_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the tax exemption certificate. Null for non-exempt accounts or perpetual exemptions. Used for compliance monitoring and renewal reminders.
attributes.references: FTC - Federal Trade Commission Pricing Transparency Standards

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is exempt from sales tax (e.g., non-profit organizations, government entities, resellers with valid tax exemption certificates). True if exempt; false otherwise.
attributes.references: FTC - Federal Trade Commission Pricing Transparency Standards

attributes.name: total_lifetime_orders
attributes.description: Cumulative count of all orders placed by this account since inception. Used for frequency analysis in RFM segmentation and customer value scoring.
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Best Practices

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

products.name: household
products.description: Groups individual customer profiles into a household unit for B2C clienteling, basket analysis, and loyalty aggregation. Stores household identifier, household name, primary member profile reference, household address, estimated household income band, household size, and combined CLTV. Enables Retail to recognize family purchasing patterns, apply household-level promotions, and support omnichannel personalization across all household members.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the household unit. Primary key for the household entity.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store location most frequently visited by household members. Used for localized promotions and inventory planning.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary customer profile within the household. This member typically represents the household in loyalty programs and receives primary communications.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the household. Used for delivery, geo-targeting, and household matching.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information (apartment, suite, unit number). Optional field for household address.

attributes.name: average_basket_value
attributes.description: Average transaction value (ATV) across all household purchases. Used for household-level pricing and promotion strategies.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the household address. Used for regional marketing and store assignment.

attributes.name: combined_cltv
attributes.description: Aggregated Customer Lifetime Value across all household members. Represents the total predicted revenue from the household over its lifetime. Used for household-level loyalty tier assignment and VIP treatment.

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: Preferred method for household-level marketing communications. Honors consent and privacy preferences.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the household address (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Used for international operations and compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the household record was first created in the system. Used for audit and data lineage.

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has consented to sharing data with third-party partners. True if consented, False otherwise.

attributes.name: estimated_income_band
attributes.description: Estimated annual household income range. Derived from third-party data enrichment or modeled from purchase behavior. Used for targeted marketing and assortment planning.

attributes.name: external_household_code
attributes.description: Household identifier from the source system or external partner. Used for cross-system reconciliation and data integration.

attributes.name: household_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the household (e.g., 'Smith Family', 'Johnson Household'). Used for clienteling and personalized marketing.

attributes.name: household_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the household record. Active households are eligible for household-level promotions and loyalty benefits.

attributes.name: household_type
attributes.description: Classification of the household structure. Used for targeted marketing and assortment planning.

attributes.name: last_purchase_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent purchase made by any household member. Used for recency analysis in RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary) segmentation.

attributes.name: loyalty_tier
attributes.description: Household-level loyalty program tier based on combined spending and engagement. Determines household-level benefits and promotions.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has consented to receive marketing communications. True if opted in, False otherwise.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the household address. Critical for delivery routing, geo-analytics, and demographic segmentation.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP Code Standards; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: preferred_channel
attributes.description: Primary shopping channel used by the household. Supports omnichannel personalization and channel-specific promotions.

attributes.name: primary_language
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO language code representing the household's preferred language for communications (e.g., en, es, fr). Used for localized marketing and customer service.

attributes.name: segment
attributes.description: Marketing or behavioral segment assigned to the household based on RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary) analysis, purchase patterns, and demographics. Used for targeted campaigns.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Number of individual members in the household. Used for basket size prediction and household-level promotions.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that originated this household record (e.g., Informatica MDM, Salesforce, SAP CAR). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the household address. Used for tax calculation and regional compliance.

attributes.name: total_loyalty_points
attributes.description: Aggregated loyalty points balance across all household members. Used for household-level redemption and rewards.

attributes.name: total_purchase_count
attributes.description: Total number of transactions made by all household members. Used for frequency analysis in RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary) segmentation.

attributes.name: total_spend_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative monetary value of all purchases made by household members. Used for monetary analysis in RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary) segmentation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the household record was last modified. Used for audit and change tracking.

products.name: corporate_account
products.description: B2B corporate customer entity representing business clients such as small businesses, restaurants, and institutional buyers purchasing from Retail. Stores legal business name, tax ID / EIN, DUNS number, industry classification (SIC/NAICS), credit terms, assigned account manager, annual spend tier, contract pricing flag, and parent-subsidiary hierarchy reference. Supports B2B procurement workflows distinct from B2C consumer accounts.

attributes.name: corporate_account_id

products.name: customer_membership
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of customer profiles to market segments for targeted marketing, personalized pricing, and differentiated service delivery. It captures the operational reality that customers can simultaneously belong to multiple segments (e.g., VIP Gold + High CLTV + Geographic Northeast) and that segments contain many customers. Each record links one profile to one segment with lifecycle attributes (start/end dates, status), assignment metadata (method, confidence, override flags), and qualification tracking that exist only in the context of this membership relationship.. Existence Justification: Customer segmentation in retail operates as a true many-to-many relationship where individual customer profiles are simultaneously assigned to multiple segments (e.g., a customer can be both 'VIP Gold Tier' and 'High CLTV' and 'Northeast Geographic' at the same time), and each segment definition contains thousands of customer profiles. Marketing teams actively manage these memberships as operational business entities, tracking when customers enter/exit segments, how they were assigned (auto-refresh vs. manual override), and qualification confidence scores. The segment table currently has no FK relationships to profile—it is a definition table that requires an association product to operationalize the membership relationship.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the segment definition to which this profile is assigned

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer profile participating in this segment membership

attributes.name: assignment_confidence_score
attributes.description: Confidence score (0.00-100.00) indicating the strength of this customer's qualification for this segment. For rule-based assignments, reflects how strongly the customer meets qualification criteria. For ML-based assignments, reflects model prediction confidence. Used for prioritizing marketing outreach and identifying borderline members.

attributes.name: assignment_method
attributes.description: Mechanism by which this customer was assigned to this segment. AutoRefresh: automatically assigned via scheduled segment refresh process. ManualOverride: manually assigned by business user overriding qualification rules. RuleEngine: assigned via real-time rule evaluation. MLModel: assigned via predictive model scoring. BulkImport: assigned via batch data load.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this membership record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: customer_membership_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this segment membership. Active: customer currently qualifies and membership is in effect. Expired: membership ended due to disqualification or time-based expiry. Suspended: temporarily inactive due to business rules. PendingQualification: awaiting next refresh cycle to confirm eligibility.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this customer profile exited this segment or the membership was terminated. Null for currently active memberships. Used for churn analysis and segment tenure calculations.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this membership record was last updated (status change, confidence score update, override modification). Audit field for change tracking.

attributes.name: last_qualification_check_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent evaluation of this customer's eligibility for this segment. Updated during auto-refresh cycles or manual re-qualification checks. Used for audit trails and determining when next qualification check is due.

attributes.name: manual_override_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this membership was manually assigned by a business user, overriding automated qualification rules. True: manual override in effect, customer may not meet standard qualification criteria. False: standard rule-based or automated assignment. Used for governance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by business user when manual_override_flag is true. Documents business justification for overriding automated qualification rules (e.g., 'VIP customer per executive request', 'Strategic account exception', 'Retention offer'). Null when no override is in effect.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when this customer profile was assigned to this segment and the membership became active. Used for lifecycle tracking and historical analysis of segment transitions.

products.name: issuance
products.description: This association product represents the issuance event between a customer profile and a coupon. It captures the operational lifecycle of a coupon from the moment it is issued to a specific customer through redemption or expiration. Each record links one customer to one coupon with attributes that track when and how the coupon was issued, personalization overrides, redemption status, and channel-specific metadata. This is distinct from promo_redemption which tracks transaction-level usage; issuance tracks the coupon lifecycle per customer.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, coupon issuance is a managed many-to-many relationship where customers receive multiple coupons from different campaigns and channels, and each coupon is issued to multiple customers. The business actively tracks the lifecycle of each customer-coupon pairing including when issued, through what channel, personalization overrides, redemption status, and redemption details. This is distinct from transaction-level redemption tracking (handled by promo_redemption) and represents the operational management of coupon distribution and lifecycle per customer.

attributes.name: issuance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this coupon issuance record. Primary key.

attributes.name: coupon_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the coupon instrument that was issued

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer profile who received this coupon issuance

attributes.name: redemption_location_id
attributes.description: Store or channel location where this customer redeemed this coupon. Null if not yet redeemed. Foreign key to location/store master.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this issuance record was created in the system.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date for this specific issuance. May differ from the coupon master expiration_date if personalized or extended for this customer.

attributes.name: issue_channel
attributes.description: Distribution channel through which this coupon was issued to this customer. Tracks the specific touchpoint used for this issuance event.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific coupon was issued to this specific customer. Tracks the per-customer issuance event, distinct from the coupon's general availability date.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this issuance record was last updated.

attributes.name: personalization_discount_override
attributes.description: Customer-specific discount value that overrides the coupon's standard face_value. Used for personalized promotional offers based on customer segment, loyalty tier, or campaign targeting.

attributes.name: redemption_date
attributes.description: Date when this customer redeemed this coupon. Null if not yet redeemed. Tracks the per-customer redemption event.

attributes.name: redemption_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this coupon issuance. Tracks whether the customer has redeemed, let expire, or still has the coupon available.

products.name: targeting
products.description: This association product represents the targeting relationship between customer segments and marketing campaigns. It captures the operational activation of specific customer segments within campaign execution, tracking targeting priority, budget allocation, reach metrics, and performance outcomes for each segment-campaign combination. Each record links one customer segment to one marketing campaign with attributes that exist only in the context of this targeted activation.. Existence Justification: In retail marketing operations, campaigns routinely target multiple customer segments simultaneously (e.g., a seasonal promotion targeting VIP Gold, Geographic Region A, and High-Value Lapsed segments), and customer segments participate in multiple concurrent campaigns (e.g., VIP Gold segment is targeted by loyalty rewards campaign, seasonal sale, and category-specific promotion). The business actively manages segment targeting as an operational entity, allocating budget per segment, setting targeting priorities, and measuring segment-specific performance metrics (response rates, conversion rates, reach) for campaign optimization and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: targeting_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this segment-campaign targeting record. Primary key.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the marketing campaign that is targeting this segment

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer segment being targeted in this campaign

attributes.name: activation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment was activated for targeting within the campaign. May differ from campaign start date if segments are activated in waves.

attributes.name: actual_reached_count
attributes.description: Actual number of customers from this segment who were successfully reached by campaign communications (emails delivered, ads served, SMS sent, etc.).

attributes.name: budget_allocation_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the campaign budget allocated specifically to reaching this customer segment. Sum of all segment allocations should equal or be less than total campaign budget.

attributes.name: conversion_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of reached customers from this segment who completed the desired campaign conversion action (purchase, sign-up, etc.). Calculated as (converters / actual_reached_count) * 100.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this targeting record was created in the system. Audit field.

attributes.name: deactivation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment targeting was deactivated or completed. Null for currently active targeting.

attributes.name: estimated_reach
attributes.description: Estimated number of customers from this segment expected to be reached by the campaign based on segment membership count and channel penetration rates.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this targeting record was last updated. Audit field.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this segment within the campaign's targeting strategy. Primary: main target audience; Secondary: secondary audience for expansion; Tertiary: opportunistic reach; Excluded: explicitly excluded from campaign.

attributes.name: response_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of reached customers from this segment who responded to the campaign (clicked, opened, visited store, etc.). Calculated as (responders / actual_reached_count) * 100.

attributes.name: targeting_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this segment targeting within the campaign. Planned: scheduled but not yet active; Active: currently being executed; Paused: temporarily suspended; Completed: execution finished; Cancelled: targeting cancelled before completion.

products.name: segment_banner_targeting
products.description: This association product represents the targeting relationship between customer segments and promotional banners in digital marketing campaigns. It captures campaign performance metrics specific to each segment-banner combination, enabling marketing attribution analysis, segment ROI measurement, and campaign optimization. Each record links one customer segment to one promotional banner with performance metrics and display scheduling that exist only in the context of this targeted marketing relationship.. Existence Justification: In retail digital marketing operations, promotional banners are actively targeted to multiple customer segments simultaneously through campaign management systems (e.g., VIP Gold sees Banner A, Lapsed Customers see Banner B, but both segments may also see Banner C in different placements or time windows). Each segment-banner combination generates its own performance metrics (impressions, clicks, conversions, attributed revenue) that marketing teams use for attribution analysis, segment ROI measurement, and campaign optimization. This is an operational marketing execution relationship that humans actively configure, monitor, and optimize.

attributes.name: segment_banner_targeting_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this segment-banner targeting relationship. Primary key.

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Segment Banner Targeting - Customer Segment Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer segment being targeted by this banner placement

attributes.name: promotion_banner_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Segment Banner Targeting - Promotion Banner Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the promotional banner being displayed to this segment

attributes.name: attributed_revenue
attributes.description: Total revenue generated by customers in this segment attributed to this banner through click-through and conversion tracking. Enables segment-level ROI analysis.

attributes.name: click_count
attributes.description: Total number of times customers in this segment have clicked on this banner. Used to calculate segment-specific CTR and engagement.

attributes.name: conversion_count
attributes.description: Total number of conversions (orders placed) by customers in this segment attributed to this banner through click-through tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment targeting relationship was first configured in the campaign management system.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this banner stopped being targeted to this specific segment. May differ from the banner's overall end_date if segment targeting is phased or A/B tested.

attributes.name: impression_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this banner has been displayed to customers in this segment. Used to calculate segment-specific reach and CTR.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment targeting configuration was last updated (status change, date adjustment, etc.).

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when this banner began being targeted to this specific segment. May differ from the banner's overall start_date if segment targeting is phased.

attributes.name: targeting_status
attributes.description: Current status of this segment targeting configuration. Active: currently displaying to segment; Paused: temporarily disabled; Completed: ended normally; Cancelled: ended early.

products.name: client_relationship
products.description: This association product represents the assignment relationship between high-value customers and dedicated retail associates (personal shoppers, stylists, relationship managers). It captures the formal assignment of associates to VIP/corporate clients for personalized service delivery. Each record links one customer profile to one associate with relationship metadata including type, dates, primary contact designation, and communication preferences that exist only in the context of this service relationship.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, high-value customers (VIP, corporate executives) are assigned multiple specialized associates simultaneously - a customer may work with a personal stylist, a registry consultant, and a business account representative across different departments. Conversely, each associate (stylist, relationship manager) manages a portfolio of multiple VIP clients. The business actively manages these assignments with specific relationship types, dates, primary contact designations, and communication preferences.

attributes.name: client_relationship_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this client-associate relationship assignment. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the associate providing personalized service

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer profile receiving personalized service

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this relationship assignment. ACTIVE indicates ongoing service relationship, INACTIVE indicates ended relationship, SUSPENDED indicates temporary pause (e.g., associate leave), TRANSFERRED indicates customer reassigned to different associate.

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: Preferred communication channel for this specific associate-customer relationship. May differ from customer's general communication preference based on relationship type (e.g., stylist prefers in-person consultations, business rep prefers email).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this relationship assignment record was created in the system.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this associate-customer relationship ended. Null for active relationships. Used for turnover analysis and reassignment tracking.

attributes.name: primary_contact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this associate is the primary/lead contact for this customer when multiple associates serve the same customer across departments. True indicates primary relationship manager, false indicates supporting specialist.

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Classification of the service relationship type defining the nature of personalized service provided. Examples: PERSONAL_SHOPPER for general shopping assistance, STYLIST for fashion/wardrobe consulting, REGISTRY_CONSULTANT for wedding/baby registry management, BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_REP for B2B corporate buyers, VIP_CONCIERGE for high-CLTV customers, DEPARTMENT_SPECIALIST for category-specific expertise.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when this associate was assigned to this customer for personalized service. Used for relationship tenure tracking and service continuity metrics.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this relationship assignment record.

products.name: b2b_contract

attributes.description: Primary key for b2b_contract

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: discount_percentage

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: minimum_order_value

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments about the contract for internal reference.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Description of payment conditions including timing, method, and any special arrangements (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, advance payment).

attributes.name: penalty_terms

attributes.name: pricing_tier
attributes.description: Pricing level or tier assigned to this contract, determining applicable rates and discounts.

attributes.name: service_level_agreement

attributes.name: volume_commitment

domains.name: product
domains.description: Authoritative catalog of all merchandise including SKUs, UPCs, GTINs, EANs, product hierarchies (department, category, subcategory), attributes, descriptions, images, private label vs. national brands, and assortment depth and breadth classifications. Managed via PIM (Product Information Management) and MDM systems. Supports category management, new item setup, and product lifecycle from introduction to discontinuation.

products.name: sku
products.description: Authoritative master record for every Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) in the retail assortment. This is the SSOT for all SKU-level product identity and physical characteristics across the enterprise. Captures the unique sellable unit identity including UPC, EAN, GTIN, internal item number, SKU description, brand reference, unit of measure, pack size, weight, dimensions (gross/net weight, length, width, height, volume, cube), ti-hi pallet configuration, temperature requirement, stackability, country of origin, hazmat flag, age-restriction flag, shelf life, product lifecycle status (active, discontinued, seasonal, clearance, pending setup), and creation/modification timestamps. Aligned with GS1 GDSN Trade Item standard. Sourced from Informatica MDM and Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS). Central hub entity — all other product domain entities reference this record.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Stock Keeping Unit. Primary key for the SKU master record.

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_hierarchy. Business justification: sku has department_code, category_code, subcategory_code (all STRING) which should be normalized to a single FK to item_hierarchy. The hierarchy table is the authoritative source for merchandise taxon

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_location. Business justification: Store-level assortment planning and authorization. Retail assortment systems maintain store-SKU authorization matrices determining which items each store is authorized to carry. Critical for planogram

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.marketing_brand. Business justification: Retail marketing operations require linking SKUs to marketing brand entities for campaign planning, brand performance analysis, and marketing attribution reporting. Distinct from product_brand (supply

attributes.name: uom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.uom. Business justification: sku.unit_of_measure (STRING) should be normalized to a proper FK to uom reference table. UOM is the authoritative master for all units of measure with conversion factors and standards compliance (GS1,

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary supplier or vendor who provides this SKU to the retailer. Links to the supplier master data.

attributes.name: age_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU has age restrictions for purchase (e.g., alcohol, tobacco, mature-rated products). True if age-restricted, False if not.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the product was manufactured or produced. Required for customs and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SKU record was first created in the master data system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: cube
attributes.description: Cubic volume of the SKU package calculated as length × width × height. Used for warehouse space planning and transportation optimization. Measured in cubic feet or cubic meters.

attributes.name: dimension_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for length, width, and height fields. IN (Inch), CM (Centimeter), FT (Foot), M (Meter).

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU will be or was discontinued and removed from the active assortment. Null if the SKU is not planned for discontinuation. Follows format yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: ean
attributes.description: 13-digit European Article Number used for product identification globally. International barcode standard.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU becomes active and available for sale. Used for new product launches and seasonal assortment planning. Follows format yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: gross_weight
attributes.description: Total weight of the SKU including packaging, measured in the unit specified by weight_unit_of_measure. Used for shipping and logistics calculations.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number that uniquely identifies trade items worldwide. Can be 8, 12, 13, or 14 digits. Umbrella term encompassing UPC, EAN, and other GS1 identifiers.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is classified as hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, and transportation procedures. True if hazmat, False if not.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height dimension of the SKU package, measured in the unit specified by dimension_unit_of_measure. Used for space planning and logistics.

attributes.name: hi
attributes.description: Number of layers (tiers) that can be stacked on a pallet. Part of the Ti-Hi pallet configuration used in warehouse and distribution center operations.

attributes.name: image_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the primary product image. Used for e-commerce, mobile apps, and digital signage.

attributes.name: internal_item_number
attributes.description: Retailer-specific internal product identifier used in legacy systems and internal operations. May differ from external GTIN/UPC.

attributes.name: length
attributes.description: Length dimension of the SKU package, measured in the unit specified by dimension_unit_of_measure. Used for space planning and logistics.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SKU in the product assortment. ACTIVE (currently sold), DISCONTINUED (no longer ordered), SEASONAL (sold during specific periods), CLEARANCE (being phased out), PENDING_SETUP (not yet available for sale), INACTIVE (temporarily unavailable).

attributes.name: minimum_age_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum age in years required to purchase this SKU. Null if no age restriction applies. Typically 18 or 21 for restricted products.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SKU record was last modified in the master data system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: net_weight
attributes.description: Weight of the product contents excluding packaging, measured in the unit specified by weight_unit_of_measure. Used for regulatory compliance and consumer information.

attributes.name: pack_size
attributes.description: Number of consumer units contained in a single sellable pack. For example, a 6-pack of soda has pack_size = 6.

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is a private label (store brand) product or a national brand. True for private label, False for national brand.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days the product remains sellable and safe for consumption from the date of manufacture or receipt. Critical for perishable goods and inventory rotation.

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Abbreviated product description for use in constrained display contexts such as receipts, labels, and mobile interfaces. Typically 40-60 characters.

attributes.name: sku_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the SKU including key product attributes, features, and specifications. Used for product information management and customer-facing displays.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU can be safely stacked during storage and transportation. True if stackable, False if not.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement

attributes.name: ti

attributes.name: upc
