attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Price lists are managed by merchandising cost centers for budget tracking and P&L accountability. Retail business process: departmental pricing authority and expense allocation for pricing strategy ex

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.loyalty_program. Business justification: Price lists are frequently program-specific (e.g., 'Rewards Plus Member Pricing', 'Coalition Partner Pricing'). Existing loyalty_tier_code is insufficient for program-level assignment. Supports progra

attributes.name: price_strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_strategy. Business justification: Price lists implement a pricing strategy (e.g., EDLP base list, Hi-Lo promotional list). Adding price_strategy_id FK links list to strategy. Removes pricing_strategy STRING column as redundant.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval state of the price list within Oracle RPM's pricing governance process. PENDING = submitted for approval; APPROVED = authorized for activation; REJECTED = returned for revision; UNDER_REVIEW = in active review by pricing committee. Price lists must be APPROVED before transitioning to ACTIVE status.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 9001 Quality Management; NRF Pricing Governance

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the pricing manager or director who approved this price list for activation. Supports audit trail requirements for pricing governance and SOX compliance. Sourced from Oracle RPM workflow approval records.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 27001 Information Security; FASB SOX Compliance

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the price list was formally approved by the pricing authority in Oracle RPM. Part of the price change audit trail required for pricing governance and regulatory compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606; ISO 27001

attributes.name: base_margin_pct
attributes.description: Target gross margin percentage applied as the baseline for cost-plus pricing calculations within this price list. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 35.00 = 35%). Used in GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) analysis and OTB (Open to Buy) planning. Confidential as it reveals internal margin strategy.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606; NRF GMROI Standards

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The retail channel(s) to which this price list applies. IN_STORE = physical POS; ECOMMERCE = Salesforce Commerce Cloud digital storefront; MOBILE = mobile app; BOPIS = Buy Online Pick Up In Store; CATALOG = print/digital catalog; ALL = omnichannel. Drives channel-specific price resolution logic.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: competitive_index
attributes.description: Ratio of this price list's average price level relative to key competitors, expressed as an index (e.g., 100.00 = price parity; 95.00 = 5% below market; 105.00 = 5% above market). Used in competitive pricing strategy analysis and EDLP positioning validation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency; NRF Competitive Intelligence Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country in which this price list is applicable (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Supports international retail operations and country-specific pricing compliance requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GS1 Global Standards; FTC Consumer Protection

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this price list record was first created in the system of record (Oracle RPM or Informatica MDM). Part of the mandatory audit trail for pricing governance and SOX compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 27001; FASB SOX Compliance

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all prices within this price list are denominated (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP, EUR). Ensures correct monetary interpretation at POS and in financial reporting under FASB ASC 606.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 606; FTC Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Merchandise department code within the retail hierarchy to which this price list is scoped, as defined in Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS). Enables department-level pricing governance and category management alignment.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Category Management Standards

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the retail division or business unit (e.g., GROCERY, APPAREL, ELECTRONICS, HOUSEHOLD) to which this price list is scoped. Enables division-specific pricing governance and GMROI tracking by merchandise division.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA CO; NRF Merchandise Hierarchy Standards

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date after which this price list is no longer active for price resolution. Nullable for open-ended price lists (e.g., permanent EDLP base). When populated, the price list expires at end of this date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this price list becomes active and eligible for price resolution at POS and e-commerce checkout. Aligns with Oracle RPM effective dating and SAP S/4HANA SD pricing condition validity. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: The price list identifier as it exists in the originating source system (e.g., Oracle RPM price list ID, SAP SD pricing condition group). Enables cross-system reconciliation and EDI integration with supplier systems.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM; GS1 EDI Standards; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price list serves as the default fallback price list when no other price list matches the resolution criteria at POS or e-commerce checkout. Only one price list per channel and price zone should be flagged as default. True = default; False = non-default.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing

attributes.name: is_taxable
attributes.description: Indicates whether prices in this price list are tax-inclusive (True) or tax-exclusive (False). Tax-inclusive pricing is common in international markets; tax-exclusive is standard in US retail. Drives tax calculation logic at POS and e-commerce checkout.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency; FDA Food Labeling (for grocery)

attributes.name: list_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing strategy this list represents. EDLP = Everyday Low Price stable baseline; HI_LO = High-Low promotional cadence; PROMOTIONAL = time-limited campaign price; CLEARANCE = markdown/end-of-life pricing; CLUB_MEMBER = loyalty or membership tier pricing; COMPETITIVE = market-response pricing. Drives price resolution logic at POS and e-commerce checkout. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EDLP|HI_LO|PROMOTIONAL|CLEARANCE|CLUB_MEMBER|COMPETITIVE|COST_PLUS|DYNAMIC — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Pricing Standards

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the customer loyalty tier (e.g., GOLD, PLATINUM, CLUB_MEMBER) for which this price list is exclusively applicable. Null for price lists that apply to all customers regardless of loyalty status. Links to the CRM loyalty program configuration for member-specific pricing.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Informatica MDM; NRF Loyalty Program Standards

attributes.name: markdown_pct
attributes.description: Default markdown percentage applied to AUR (Average Unit Retail) for clearance or promotional price lists. Expressed as a percentage reduction from the regular retail price (e.g., 20.00 = 20% off). Drives markdown optimization and end-of-season clearance planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Markdown Optimization Standards

attributes.name: max_selling_price
attributes.description: Ceiling price above which no SKU within this price list may be sold, ensuring competitive positioning and consumer protection compliance. Expressed in the price list's currency. Used in dynamic pricing guardrails to prevent price gouging.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Consumer Protection; CPSC Pricing Standards

attributes.name: min_selling_price
attributes.description: Floor price below which no SKU within this price list may be sold, protecting minimum margin thresholds and preventing below-cost selling. Enforced at POS and e-commerce checkout via Oracle RPM price guardrails. Expressed in the price list's currency.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next pricing review of this price list by the category management or pricing team. Used to trigger review workflows in Oracle RPM and ensure timely price updates aligned with market conditions and promotional calendars.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional business context, pricing committee decisions, exceptions, or operational notes associated with this price list. Captured in Oracle RPM and surfaced for pricing analysts and category managers.

attributes.name: price_list_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the price list within Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) and SAP S/4HANA SD module. Used as the business key in EDI transactions, POS price resolution, and e-commerce checkout. Examples: EDLP_BASE, HILO_PROMO_Q4, ECOM_MEMBER.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); GS1 Global Data Standards

attributes.name: price_list_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the price list's purpose, scope, and intended use. Captures the pricing strategy rationale (e.g., EDLP everyday low price baseline, Hi-Lo promotional cadence, competitive response pricing).

attributes.name: price_list_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the price list as displayed in Oracle RPM and merchandising systems. Examples: 'EDLP Base Price List', 'Hi-Lo Promotional Q4 2024', 'E-Commerce Club Member Pricing'.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Retail Data Standards

attributes.name: price_list_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the price list within Oracle RPM. DRAFT = under construction, not yet approved; ACTIVE = currently in use for price resolution; SUSPENDED = temporarily deactivated; EXPIRED = past effective end date; ARCHIVED = retired and no longer available for assignment.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank determining the order of precedence when multiple price lists are applicable to a single SKU at POS or e-commerce checkout. Lower values indicate higher priority (e.g., 1 = highest priority). Critical for price resolution logic in omnichannel environments where EDLP, promotional, and member prices may overlap.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled cadence at which this price list is reviewed and potentially updated by the pricing team. Drives pricing governance workflows in Oracle RPM. DAILY is typical for dynamic pricing; WEEKLY for Hi-Lo promotional; QUARTERLY for EDLP base reviews. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DAILY|WEEKLY|BIWEEKLY|MONTHLY|QUARTERLY|ANNUALLY|AD_HOC — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Pricing Governance Standards

attributes.name: rounding_rule
attributes.description: Rule applied to computed prices within this price list to produce consumer-facing shelf prices. NEAREST_CENT = standard rounding; ROUND_UP = always round up; ROUND_DOWN = always round down; CHARM_PRICING = round to nearest .99 or .95 (psychological pricing); NONE = no rounding applied. Configured in Oracle RPM price calculation engine.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Pricing Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this price list record originated. RPM = Oracle Retail Price Management; SAP_SD = SAP S/4HANA Sales & Distribution; SFCC = Salesforce Commerce Cloud; ORMS = Oracle Retail Merchandising System; MANUAL = manually created. Supports data lineage and MDM reconciliation.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this price list record was most recently modified. Tracks the last change event for audit trail purposes and supports incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 27001; Informatica MDM

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically increasing version counter tracking revisions to this price list. Incremented each time the price list is modified and re-approved. Supports price change audit trail requirements and enables rollback to prior pricing versions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 27001 Audit Trail; FASB SOX Compliance

products.name: price_zone
products.description: Defines geographic or store-cluster pricing zones used to differentiate retail prices by market, region, or competitive environment. Each zone groups stores or fulfillment nodes sharing the same pricing strategy. Includes zone code, name, type (regional, competitive, urban/rural), effective dates, and zone-to-store/node membership assignments with assignment effective dates, expiry dates, assignment reasons, override flags, and historical tracking of zone reassignments.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a price zone record in the Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) system. Serves as the primary key for all zone-level pricing governance and store cluster assignments.

attributes.name: parent_zone_price_zone_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to a parent price zone in a zone hierarchy. Enables multi-tier zone structures (e.g., a national zone containing regional sub-zones). Null for top-level zones with no parent. Used in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) zone inheritance for pricing rule cascades.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Price zones map directly to profit centers (stores, regions, channels) for P&L reporting. Core retail finance process: zone-level profitability analysis and financial performance measurement by geogra

attributes.name: base_price_multiplier
attributes.description: Zone-level multiplier applied to the national base price to derive the zone-specific retail price. A value of 1.0000 means no adjustment; 0.9500 means a 5% reduction; 1.0500 means a 5% premium. Used in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) zone pricing calculations to support Hi-Lo and EDLP strategies.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Defines which retail channels this price zone governs. 'in_store' applies only to physical POS (Point of Sale) transactions; 'ecommerce' applies to Salesforce Commerce Cloud digital orders; 'omnichannel' applies uniformly across all channels supporting BOPIS and ROPIS (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store); 'wholesale' applies to B2B pricing.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Salesforce Commerce Cloud; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: competitive_index
attributes.description: Numeric index (0.00–999.99) representing the relative competitive pricing intensity of this zone compared to the baseline zone (index = 100.00). Values above 100 indicate a more price-competitive market requiring lower AUR (Average Unit Retail). Sourced from competitive intelligence feeds integrated with Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the primary country of operation for this price zone. Supports multi-country retail operations and regulatory compliance with FTC pricing transparency requirements. Example: 'USA', 'CAN', 'GBR'.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price zone record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer, sourced from Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) or Informatica MDM. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and GDPR/CCPA data governance requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code governing all price points within this zone. Ensures consistent monetary representation across SAP S/4HANA FI/CO and Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM). Example: 'USD', 'CAD', 'GBP'.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this price zone expires and ceases to govern pricing for assigned stores. Null indicates an open-ended zone with no planned expiry. Used in zone reassignment workflows and markdown audit trails.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this price zone becomes active and its pricing rules begin governing assigned stores or fulfillment nodes. Used in Open-to-Buy (OTB) planning and markdown optimization scheduling.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_count
attributes.description: Current number of e-commerce fulfillment nodes (dark stores, micro-fulfillment centers, distribution centers) assigned to this price zone. Supports omnichannel pricing governance for BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) and Ship-from-Store (SFS) operations.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: is_competitive_zone
attributes.description: Indicates whether this zone is subject to active competitive price monitoring and response rules. When True, Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) applies competitive pricing overrides based on competitor intelligence feeds, enabling dynamic Hi-Lo or EDLP adjustments.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: is_default_zone
attributes.description: Indicates whether this zone serves as the fallback default pricing zone when a store or fulfillment node has no explicit zone assignment. Only one zone per country should carry this flag as True. Prevents pricing gaps in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM).

attributes.name: is_ecommerce_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price zone's pricing rules are applied to digital commerce channels via Salesforce Commerce Cloud. When True, zone prices are broadcast to the e-commerce storefront and govern online GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) pricing.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The most recent calendar date on which this price zone's strategy, competitive index, and store assignments were formally reviewed and validated by the pricing governance team. Supports audit trail requirements and zone maintenance SLA (Service Level Agreement) tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: market_tier
attributes.description: Market size and competitive intensity classification for the zone. Tier 1 represents major metropolitan markets with high competitive density; Tier 4 represents rural or low-competition markets. Drives GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) targets and markdown depth thresholds per zone.
attributes.references: NRF Market Classification Standards; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: max_markdown_pct
attributes.description: The maximum allowable markdown depth (as a percentage of the original retail price) permitted for any SKU within this zone. Governs markdown optimization rules in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) to protect zone-level profitability and prevent excessive sell-through distortion.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Markdown Optimization Standards

attributes.name: min_margin_pct
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable gross margin percentage (COGS-based) enforced for all SKUs priced within this zone. Prevents markdown rules from eroding profitability below the zone's GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) floor. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 18.50 = 18.5%).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606; NRF Margin Management

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled calendar date for the next formal review of this price zone's strategy and assignments. Calculated from last_review_date and review_frequency. Used to trigger pricing governance workflow tasks in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: override_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether store managers or regional pricing teams are permitted to apply local price overrides beyond the zone's standard pricing rules. When False, all prices are centrally governed with no local deviation permitted. Supports pricing compliance and FTC advertising standards.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines

attributes.name: price_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether price changes within this zone require explicit managerial approval before activation in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM). Supports pricing governance workflows and audit trail requirements for high-sensitivity competitive or promotional zones.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: price_change_lead_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of calendar days required between a price change approval and its effective implementation at POS (Point of Sale) for stores in this zone. Accounts for shelf label reprinting, planogram updates, and EDI broadcast lead times to store systems.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: pricing_strategy
attributes.description: The primary pricing strategy governing all SKUs within this zone. EDLP (Everyday Low Price) maintains stable low prices; Hi-Lo (High-Low) uses promotional spikes and markdowns; cost_plus applies a fixed margin over COGS; competitive mirrors or undercuts competitor prices; dynamic adjusts prices algorithmically based on demand signals from SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Pricing Best Practices

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Internal geographic region code used to group price zones for regional merchandise planning and Comp Sales (Comparable Store Sales) reporting. Aligns with Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) regional hierarchy. Example: 'NE', 'SE', 'MW', 'WEST'.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Regional Standards

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which this price zone's pricing strategy, competitive index, and store assignments are reviewed and potentially updated. Drives Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) workflow scheduling and category management calendar alignment.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Category Management Standards

attributes.name: rpm_zone_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) Zone ID
attributes.description: Native zone identifier from Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) source system. Preserved for cross-system reconciliation, EDI integration, and audit trail linkage back to the operational pricing system of record.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: sap_pricing_condition_group
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA SD module pricing condition group code associated with this price zone. Used to apply zone-specific pricing conditions (VK11/VK12) in SAP for sales order pricing, ensuring consistency between Oracle RPM zone definitions and SAP transactional pricing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this price zone record originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer and Informatica MDM master data reconciliation. Values correspond to known operational systems: RPM (Oracle Retail Price Management), SAP_S4HANA, ORMS (Oracle Retail Merchandising System), INFORMATICA_MDM.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM; ISO 27001 Information Security; NRF Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: store_count
attributes.description: Current number of physical store locations assigned to this price zone. Used in zone-level Comp Sales (Comparable Store Sales) and SSS (Same-Store Sales) reporting. Updated automatically when store-to-zone assignments change.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Store Operations Standards

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction applicable to this price zone for sales tax calculation and FTC pricing transparency compliance. Maps to SAP S/4HANA FI/CO tax condition records. Example: 'US_NY_NYC', 'US_CA_LA'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Federal Trade Commission (FTC); ISO 3166-2

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price zone record was most recently modified. Tracks zone attribute changes including strategy updates, multiplier adjustments, and status transitions. Essential for price change audit trail compliance and Informatica MDM golden record synchronization.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5; CCPA; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the price zone within Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) and SAP S/4HANA. Used in EDI transactions, pricing rule references, and cross-system integrations. Example: 'PZ_NORTHEAST_01', 'COMP_URBAN_W'.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); GS1 Global Location Standards

attributes.name: zone_description
attributes.description: Free-text business description of the price zone's purpose, geographic scope, competitive rationale, and any special pricing governance rules. Used by category management and merchandise planning teams for zone strategy documentation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Category Management Standards

attributes.name: zone_hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of this zone within the price zone hierarchy (1 = top-level national zone, 2 = regional zone, 3 = sub-regional or competitive cluster). Used to resolve pricing rule inheritance and override precedence in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM).

attributes.name: zone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable business name for the price zone used in reporting, planogram management, and pricing governance communications. Example: 'Northeast Competitive Urban Zone', 'Rural EDLP Cluster South'.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); National Retail Federation (NRF)

attributes.name: zone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the price zone within Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM). 'active' zones are live and applied to store pricing; 'pending' zones are approved but not yet effective; 'inactive' zones are suspended; 'archived' zones are retained for historical audit and markdown optimization analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: zone_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the price zone indicating the market segmentation strategy applied. 'regional' zones group stores by geography; 'competitive' zones respond to local competitor pricing; 'urban'/'rural' zones reflect demographic cost structures; 'omnichannel' zones unify in-store and digital pricing; 'ecommerce' zones apply exclusively to digital fulfillment nodes.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Pricing Standards

products.name: sku_price
products.description: Authoritative current and historical retail price for each SKU resolved by price list, price zone, and channel. Captures regular retail price (AUR), cost reference, initial markup (IMU), gross margin percentage, price type (EDLP, Hi-Lo, clearance, competitive match), channel type (in-store, e-commerce, mobile app, marketplace, BOPIS), channel price variance and justification, effective date range, priority for multi-list resolution, and approval status. This is the single source of truth for what a customer pays for any SKU in any pricing context — the granular SKU-to-price-list-to-zone-to-channel binding that drives price resolution at POS and across all digital channels.

attributes.name: sku_price_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each SKU-to-price-list-to-zone-to-channel binding record. Primary key of the sku_price data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM — Golden Record Key Convention

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: SKU retail prices are based on cost prices for margin calculation. Adding cost_price_id FK links retail price to authoritative cost record. Removes cost_price DECIMAL as redundant with cost_price.land

attributes.name: food_safety_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.food_safety_plan. Business justification: Food SKU pricing in stores/DCs with food safety plans must comply with plan requirements (temperature-controlled storage costs, HACCP-compliant handling). Prices reference applicable food safety plan.

attributes.name: license_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.license_permit. Business justification: Regulated SKUs (alcohol, tobacco, pharmacy) require valid licenses to price/sell. Pricing systems validate license status before activating prices; expired licenses block price changes.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Reference to the price list under which this SKU price is governed. Supports multi-list resolution priority for EDLP, Hi-Lo, promotional, and clearance price lists.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Price List Entity

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic or competitive price zone in which this price applies. Price zones enable regional pricing differentiation across store clusters and markets.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Price Zone Entity

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: SKU prices are tracked by profit center for item-level profitability analysis and revenue recognition. Business process: margin analysis and financial performance reporting at store/channel level for

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: Promotional offers define temporary price adjustments at SKU level. Retailers must link offer mechanics to SKU price records to calculate promotional pricing, validate discount limits, and reconcile v

attributes.name: rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.pricing_rule. Business justification: SKU prices may be calculated or adjusted by pricing rules (e.g., dynamic pricing rules, competitive response rules). Adding pricing_rule_id FK tracks which rule generated or last adjusted the price.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product SKU for which this price record applies. Resolves to the canonical product master in the Product domain.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) — Item Master; GS1 GTIN Standard

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status of this price record within the Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) pricing governance process. Only records in 'approved' status are eligible for price resolution at POS and digital channels.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Price Event Status; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the pricing manager who approved this price record in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM). Required for price change audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Approved By; ISO 27001 Access Control; FASB SOX Compliance

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this price record was approved by the pricing manager. Part of the price change audit trail required for regulatory compliance and pricing governance.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Approval Timestamp; ISO 27001; FASB SOX Compliance

attributes.name: channel_price_variance
attributes.description: The absolute price difference between this channel-specific price and the base in-store retail price for the same SKU, price list, and zone. Quantifies omnichannel price differentiation (e.g., e-commerce price vs. in-store price).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Channel Price Variance; FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines

attributes.name: channel_price_variance_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for any price variance between this channel price and the base retail price. Required for compliance with FTC pricing transparency guidelines and internal pricing governance. Examples: 'Online-only promotion', 'Marketplace fee offset', 'BOPIS incentive'.
attributes.references: FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Price Event Notes

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: The retail channel for which this price applies. Supports omnichannel price resolution across in-store Point of Sale (POS), e-commerce, mobile app, marketplace, and Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) channels.
attributes.references: NRF Omnichannel Retail Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Channel Configuration

attributes.name: competitive_price_ref
attributes.description: The competitor's observed price for this SKU that triggered a competitive match pricing action. Captured when price_type = 'competitive_match'. Supports competitive pricing analytics and price index reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Competitive Price; FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines

attributes.name: competitor_name
attributes.description: Name of the competitor whose price was used as the reference for a competitive match pricing action. Populated when price_type = 'competitive_match'. Used in competitive pricing intelligence reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Competitor Reference; FTC Advertising Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this SKU price record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Part of the price change audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; FASB SOX Compliance

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary price fields in this record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency retail operations across international markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this SKU price becomes active and valid for use at Point of Sale (POS) and digital channels. Supports bi-temporal price management and scheduled price changes.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Effective Date; FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this SKU price record expires and is no longer valid. Null indicates an open-ended price with no scheduled expiry. Used for Hi-Lo promotional price windows and clearance event management.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — End Date; NRF Promotional Pricing Standards

attributes.name: gross_margin_pct
attributes.description: Current gross margin percentage for this SKU at the current retail price, accounting for any markdowns applied. Calculated as (retail_price - cost_price) / retail_price * 100. Drives GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Margin%; FASB ASC 606; NRF GMROI Standards

attributes.name: initial_markup_pct
attributes.description: The Initial Markup (IMU) percentage calculated as (retail_price - cost_price) / retail_price * 100. Represents the planned gross margin at the time of price setting before any markdowns.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — IMU%; NRF Retail Margin Standards

attributes.name: is_dynamic_pricing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether dynamic pricing rules are active for this SKU in this price list, zone, and channel context. When True, the price may be algorithmically adjusted within price_floor and price_ceiling bounds based on demand signals from SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Dynamic Pricing Flag; NRF Dynamic Pricing Standards

attributes.name: is_price_locked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price record is locked and protected from automated price changes or markdown optimization algorithms. When True, the price can only be changed through a manual approval workflow in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Price Lock Flag; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: markdown_amount
attributes.description: The absolute currency amount by which the original retail price has been reduced (markdown). Markdown = original_retail_price - retail_price. Used for markdown optimization and P&L (Profit and Loss) reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Markdown Amount; NRF Markdown Management Standards

attributes.name: markdown_pct
attributes.description: The percentage reduction from the original retail price to the current retail price. Markdown% = (original_retail_price - retail_price) / original_retail_price * 100. Supports markdown depth analysis and clearance optimization.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Markdown%; NRF Pricing Standards

attributes.name: min_advertised_price
attributes.description: The Minimum Advertised Price (MAP) floor set by the supplier or brand for this SKU. The retail_price must not be advertised below this threshold. Enforced for compliance with supplier MAP agreements and FTC advertising standards.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising Standards — MAP Policy; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Price Floor

attributes.name: original_retail_price
attributes.description: The initial retail price at which the SKU was first offered for sale in this zone and channel, prior to any markdowns or price changes. Used for markdown optimization and sell-through rate analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Original Retail; FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines

attributes.name: price_ceiling
attributes.description: The maximum allowable retail price for this SKU in this zone and channel. Prevents price gouging and ensures compliance with consumer protection regulations. Used in dynamic pricing guardrails.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Price Ceiling; FTC Consumer Protection; CPSC Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: price_change_reason
attributes.description: Business reason code or description explaining why this price was set or changed. Examples: 'Competitive match', 'Seasonal markdown', 'Clearance', 'Cost increase', 'Promotional event'. Supports price change audit trail and markdown optimization analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Price Change Reason; FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines

attributes.name: price_floor
attributes.description: The minimum allowable retail price for this SKU in this zone and channel, below which the price cannot be set without executive override. Protects gross margin and prevents below-cost selling. Distinct from MAP which is a supplier-imposed advertising constraint.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Price Floor; FASB ASC 330 Inventory Valuation

attributes.name: price_per_unit_display
attributes.description: The normalized price per standard unit (e.g., price per 100g, price per litre) used for shelf-edge price comparison display. Required by consumer protection regulations for grocery and FMCG categories to enable fair price comparison.
attributes.references: FTC Unit Pricing Regulations; FDA Food Labeling Requirements; NRF Shelf Pricing Standards

attributes.name: price_per_unit_uom
attributes.business_glossary_term: Price Per Unit Unit of Measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure denominator for the price_per_unit_display field (e.g., '100G', '1L', '1OZ'). Required alongside price_per_unit_display for regulatory shelf-edge unit pricing compliance.
attributes.references: FTC Unit Pricing Regulations; FDA Food Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: price_resolution_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank used by the price resolution engine to determine which price list takes precedence when multiple price lists apply to the same SKU-zone-channel combination. Lower integer = higher priority. Drives POS and digital channel price resolution logic.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Price List Priority; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) — Price Resolution

attributes.name: price_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing strategy applied to this SKU-price-list-zone-channel binding. Supports EDLP (Everyday Low Price), Hi-Lo (High-Low Pricing Strategy), clearance, competitive match, markdown, and promotional pricing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: edlp|hi_lo|clearance|competitive_match|markdown|promotional — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Price Event Type; NRF Pricing Standards

attributes.name: retail_price
attributes.description: The current regular retail selling price for the SKU in this price list, zone, and channel context. Represents the Average Unit Retail (AUR) — the price a customer pays before any promotional discount or markdown is applied.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Retail Price; FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this price record originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer. Values: RPM = Oracle Retail Price Management, SAP = SAP S/4HANA, ORMS = Oracle Retail Merchandising System, SFCC = Salesforce Commerce Cloud, CAR = SAP Customer Activity Repository.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM — Source System Lineage; ISO 27001 Data Governance

attributes.name: source_system_price_code
attributes.description: The native price record identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., Oracle RPM Price Event ID, SAP condition record number). Enables bi-directional traceability between the Silver Layer and the system of record for audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Price Event ID; SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Record; Informatica MDM

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code applied to this SKU for VAT, GST, or sales tax calculation at Point of Sale (POS). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI/CO tax configuration. Determines the applicable tax rate for price display and checkout.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Tax Code; FDA Food Labeling (tax-exempt grocery items); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: uom_code
attributes.description: The unit of measure for which the retail_price applies (e.g., EA = Each, KG = Kilogram, LB = Pound, L = Litre). Critical for price-per-unit display compliance and weight-based pricing at POS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|LB|L|ML|M|FT|OZ|PK|CS — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) — UOM; FDA Food Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this SKU price record was last modified in the Silver Layer data product. Tracks price change events and supports audit trail requirements for pricing governance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; FASB SOX Compliance

products.name: price_change
products.description: Transactional record of every approved price or cost change event for a SKU. Captures before/after values, change category (retail price change, supplier cost change, landed cost adjustment, freight surcharge), reason code (competitive response, cost increase, seasonal adjustment, clearance initiation, tariff change, contract renegotiation, raw material increase), change type (permanent, temporary, markdown, automated/algorithm-driven), execution mode (manual, batch, real-time), effective/expiry dates, approver, supplier reference (for cost changes), cost change percentage, margin impact assessment, and trigger signal (for automated changes). Provides the single unified audit trail for ALL pricing-relevant changes — retail and cost-side — supporting governance, GMROI analysis, margin recalculation triggers, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: price_change_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each price change event record in the pricing audit trail. Primary key for the price_change data product.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: The employee identifier of the pricing manager or authorized personnel who approved this price change. For automated approvals, this may reference a system service account. Supports pricing governance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 9001 Quality Management; OSHA Workplace Accountability

attributes.name: audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit_finding. Business justification: Audit findings (margin breaches, unauthorized discounts, approval control failures) cite specific price change transactions as evidence. Auditors link findings to transaction-level proof.

attributes.name: buyer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.buyer. Business justification: Buyers initiate and approve price changes for their categories. Price change workflows route to buyers for authorization when changes exceed thresholds or impact margin targets. Buyer accountability f

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Price changes are initiated by buying/merchandising cost centers for budget accountability. Business process: pricing decision authority tracking and cost center expense allocation for pricing managem

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: Price changes triggered by cost changes should reference the authoritative cost record. Adding cost_price_id FK links to cost_price. Keeps prior_cost/new_cost as point-in-time snapshots for audit trai

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific store or location where the price change applies. Null when the change applies enterprise-wide or to a price zone rather than a single store.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP S/4HANA Retail SD Module

attributes.name: markdown_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.markdown. Business justification: Price changes are frequently triggered by markdown events. Adding markdown_id FK allows tracking which markdown event caused a price change. Removes markdown_type as it can be retrieved from markdown.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Price changes must comply with pricing policies (approval requirements, margin floors, competitive response protocols). Changes reference applicable policy section governing the change type.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Price changes are often scoped to specific price lists (e.g., updating the promotional price list vs. base price list). Adding price_list_id FK tracks which price list is being modified.

attributes.name: price_rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pricing rule or pricing strategy definition in Oracle RPM that generated or governs this price change event. Links to the EDLP, Hi-Lo, cost-plus, or competitive pricing rule configuration.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic or competitive price zone to which this price change applies. Price zones group stores with similar competitive environments for unified pricing governance.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Price changes are frequently triggered by promotional campaigns (weekly ads, seasonal events). Linking campaign to price change enables promotional effectiveness analysis, margin impact tracking, vend

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotion or promotional event that triggered this temporary price change. Null for non-promotional price changes. Links the price change audit trail to the promotions management domain.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: replenishment_plan_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) Event ID
attributes.description: The externally-known price event identifier assigned by Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit traceability back to the source pricing system.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which the price or cost change is being recorded. Links to the product master.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); GS1 Global Product Classification

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier associated with a cost-side change event (e.g., supplier cost increase, contract renegotiation, tariff change). Null for retail-only price changes with no supplier involvement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: violation_notice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.violation_notice. Business justification: Regulatory price violations (unit pricing laws, MAP violations, predatory pricing below cost) trigger violation notices citing specific price change events. Common in alcohol/tobacco retail enforcemen

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the price change event: pending (awaiting approval), approved (authorized and scheduled), rejected (denied by approver), cancelled (withdrawn before execution), or superseded (overridden by a subsequent change).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the price change was formally approved by an authorized pricing manager or automated approval workflow. Null if not yet approved or if approval is not required for the execution mode.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: change_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the change event: retail_price_change (consumer-facing price), supplier_cost_change (vendor invoice cost), landed_cost_adjustment (total delivered cost including duties/tariffs), or freight_surcharge (transportation cost component).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: Nature of the price change: permanent (indefinite retail price reset), temporary (time-bounded promotional price), markdown (clearance or end-of-season price reduction), or automated (algorithm-driven dynamic pricing adjustment).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Retail Pricing Standards

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The retail channel to which this price change applies: in_store (physical POS), online (e-commerce/digital), omnichannel (unified price across all channels), or wholesale. Supports omnichannel pricing governance and channel-specific margin analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Salesforce Commerce Cloud; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: competitive_reference_price
attributes.description: The competitor's observed price that triggered or informed a competitive_response price change. Captured for competitive pricing analysis, price matching governance, and FTC pricing transparency compliance. Null for non-competitive change reasons.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency Standards

attributes.name: competitor_name
attributes.description: Name of the competitor whose price was used as the reference for a competitive_response price change. Used for competitive intelligence reporting and pricing strategy analysis. Null for non-competitive change reasons.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency Standards

attributes.name: cost_change_pct
attributes.description: Percentage change in supplier or landed cost relative to the prior cost. Calculated as ((new_cost - prior_cost) / prior_cost) * 100. Key metric for supplier negotiation analysis and tariff impact assessment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price change record was first created and persisted in the data platform. System audit timestamp for data lineage and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts in this price change record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD). Supports multi-currency retail operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the new price or cost becomes active at the point of sale or in procurement systems. Drives POS price activation, e-commerce price display, and purchase order cost updates.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP S/4HANA Retail SD Module

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the price change event was triggered or submitted in the source pricing system (Oracle RPM or SAP). Represents the real-world business event time, distinct from system audit timestamps.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 8601 Date/Time Standard

attributes.name: execution_mode
attributes.description: Method by which the price change was executed: manual (user-initiated via RPM UI), batch (scheduled overnight or periodic bulk update), or real_time (event-driven immediate execution, e.g., dynamic pricing engine).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP S/4HANA Retail SD Module

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which a temporary price change or promotional price expires and the price reverts to the prior or standard price. Null for permanent price changes with no defined end date.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency Standards

attributes.name: is_cost_change
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price change event includes a supplier or landed cost change component (True) or is a retail-price-only change (False). Enables efficient filtering for COGS recalculation and GMROI impact workflows.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: is_margin_breach
attributes.description: Indicates whether the new_margin_pct resulting from this change falls below the category or SKU-level minimum margin threshold defined in pricing governance rules (True) or remains within acceptable bounds (False). Triggers escalation workflows in Oracle RPM.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: new_cost
attributes.description: The supplier or landed cost of the SKU after this change event is applied. Drives COGS recalculation, margin impact assessment, and GMROI analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: new_margin_pct
attributes.description: Projected gross margin percentage on the SKU after this change event is applied, calculated as ((new_retail_price - new_cost) / new_retail_price) * 100. Used for margin impact assessment, GMROI recalculation triggers, and pricing governance.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: new_retail_price
attributes.description: The consumer-facing retail selling price of the SKU after this change event is applied. Expressed in local currency. Drives POS (Point of Sale) pricing, e-commerce display price, and AUR calculations.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, justification, or commentary provided by the pricing analyst or approver regarding this price change event. Supports audit trail completeness and regulatory compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: pricing_strategy
attributes.description: The overarching pricing strategy under which this change was made: EDLP (Everyday Low Price), hi_lo (High-Low promotional pricing), cost_plus (margin-based pricing), competitive (market-responsive pricing), dynamic (algorithm-driven real-time pricing), or clearance (end-of-lifecycle markdown).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Retail Pricing Standards

attributes.name: prior_cost
attributes.description: The supplier or landed cost of the SKU immediately before this change event. Used for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) baseline and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) impact assessment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: prior_margin_pct
attributes.description: Gross margin percentage on the SKU immediately before this change event, calculated as ((prior_retail_price - prior_cost) / prior_retail_price) * 100. Baseline for margin impact assessment and GMROI analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: prior_retail_price
attributes.description: The consumer-facing retail selling price of the SKU immediately before this change event. Expressed in local currency. Used for before/after comparison, markdown depth analysis, and AUR (Average Unit Retail) tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Business reason driving the price or cost change. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: competitive_response|cost_increase|seasonal_adjustment|clearance_initiation|tariff_change|contract_renegotiation|raw_material_increase|promotional_event|regulatory_compliance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency Standards

attributes.name: retail_price_change_amount
attributes.description: Absolute monetary difference between new_retail_price and prior_retail_price. Negative values indicate a price decrease (markdown); positive values indicate a price increase. Used for markdown optimization and pricing governance reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Retail Pricing Standards

attributes.name: retail_price_change_pct
attributes.description: Percentage change in retail price relative to the prior retail price. Calculated as ((new_retail_price - prior_retail_price) / prior_retail_price) * 100. Used for markdown depth analysis and Hi-Lo pricing strategy reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Retail Pricing Standards

attributes.name: supplier_reference_number
attributes.description: The supplier-provided reference number associated with a cost change event, such as a vendor cost notification letter number, EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) transaction reference, or contract amendment identifier. Null for retail-only price changes.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: trigger_signal
attributes.description: The specific signal or event that initiated an automated or algorithm-driven price change. Examples include competitive_price_match, demand_surge, inventory_clearance_threshold, cost_feed_update, or promotional_calendar_event. Null for manually initiated changes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: competitive_price_match|demand_surge|inventory_clearance_threshold|cost_feed_update|promotional_calendar_event|replenishment_signal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price change record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental data processing, change data capture, and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

products.name: markdown
products.description: Manages the full lifecycle of planned and unplanned markdowns and clearance events at the SKU, category, and location level. Captures markdown type (permanent, POS, clearance, end-of-season, end-of-life, dead stock), markdown amount (percentage or absolute), original and marked-down retail price, clearance stage progression (first/second/final reduction with price and sell-through at each stage), sell-through targets and actuals, disposition method (in-store clearance, online clearance, RTV, liquidation), planned and actual exit dates, markdown ROI, clearance initiation and closure dates, and dead stock elimination tracking. Tracks the complete reduction lifecycle from initial markdown through final clearance disposition and exit.

attributes.name: markdown_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each markdown event record. Primary key for the markdown data product in the pricing domain.

attributes.name: audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit_finding. Business justification: Audit findings for markdown policy violations, clearance control failures, or margin breaches reference specific markdown events as evidence. Auditors trace findings to markdown transactions.

attributes.name: buyer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.buyer. Business justification: Buyers approve and manage markdown events within their category portfolios. Markdown decisions require buyer authorization because they impact margin targets, inventory turn goals, and OTB budget util

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise category associated with this markdown. Enables category-level markdown analysis and assortment management reporting.

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: Markdown decisions consider cost price to avoid selling below cost. Adding cost_price_id FK links to authoritative cost record. Removes cost_price DECIMAL as redundant with cost_price.landed_cost.

attributes.name: license_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.license_permit. Business justification: Clearance/markdown of regulated goods (alcohol, tobacco, pharmacy) must comply with license terms. Some permits restrict below-cost selling; markdown systems check license conditions.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store, zone, or distribution center where the markdown is applied. Supports price zone and location-level markdown governance.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP S/4HANA Retail (SD module)

attributes.name: price_strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_strategy. Business justification: Markdowns should align with the pricing strategy for that category/department (e.g., Hi-Lo strategy has planned markdown cycles, EDLP has minimal markdowns). Links markdown decisions to governing stra

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Reference to the price zone grouping under which this markdown is governed. Price zones aggregate locations with identical pricing strategies for enterprise-wide markdown management.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Markdowns directly impact profit center P&L and are tracked for performance measurement. Core retail process: clearance impact on store/channel profitability, markdown budget tracking, and financial v

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Markdowns are coordinated with promotional campaigns (clearance events, end-of-season sales). Retailers track which campaign drove markdown decisions for vendor funding claims, promotional markdown bu

attributes.name: rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.pricing_rule. Business justification: Markdowns may be triggered by pricing rules (e.g., automated clearance rules based on weeks of supply, sell-through targets). Adding pricing_rule_id FK distinguishes rule-driven markdowns from manual

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: Markdowns are seasonal lifecycle events (end-of-season clearance, holiday exit). Linking markdown to season enables seasonal markdown budget tracking, clearance calendar management, and sell-through r

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) subject to the markdown event. Links to the product master for item-level markdown tracking.

attributes.name: actual_exit_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which all inventory units subject to this markdown were fully cleared, returned, or liquidated. Compared against planned_exit_date to measure markdown execution efficiency.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The absolute monetary reduction applied to the original retail price (original_retail_price minus marked_down_price). Used for financial reporting, P&L impact analysis, and markdown budget tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or employee identifier of the merchandising or pricing manager who authorized the markdown event. Required for markdown audit trail compliance and governance under Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) approval workflows.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 27001; NRF

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the markdown event was formally approved by the authorized pricing or merchandising manager. Part of the price change audit trail required for pricing governance and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 27001; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The retail channel(s) through which the markdown is applied. In-Store: physical store POS only; Online: e-commerce platform only; Omnichannel: applied across all channels simultaneously; BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store): applied for click-and-collect transactions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Salesforce Commerce Cloud; NRF

attributes.name: clearance_closure_date
attributes.description: The date on which the clearance event was formally closed, indicating all inventory has been disposed of or the clearance program has ended. Used for clearance lifecycle reporting and dead stock elimination tracking.

attributes.name: clearance_initiation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the clearance event was formally initiated for this SKU and location. Marks the start of the clearance lifecycle, distinct from the markdown effective start date which may precede formal clearance designation.

attributes.name: clearance_stage
attributes.description: Indicates the progression stage within a clearance event lifecycle. Not applicable for non-clearance markdowns. First Reduction: initial clearance price cut; Second Reduction: intermediate further reduction; Final Reduction: last price before disposition or liquidation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this markdown record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this markdown record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD). Supports multi-currency retail operations across international markets.

attributes.name: disposition_method
attributes.description: The planned or actual method for final inventory disposition after markdown. In-Store Clearance: sold through physical store; Online Clearance: sold through e-commerce channel; RTV (Return to Vendor): returned to supplier; Liquidation: sold to third-party liquidator; Donation: donated to charity.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the markdown price expires and the item reverts to regular pricing or transitions to the next clearance stage. Null for permanent markdowns with no planned end date.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC pricing transparency standards

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the markdown price becomes effective and is applied at POS (Point of Sale) and digital channels. Represents the planned or actual activation date of the markdown event.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC pricing transparency standards

attributes.name: is_competitive_response
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this markdown was triggered by a competitive pricing event (e.g., a competitor price reduction requiring a matching response). Supports competitive pricing analytics and FTC pricing transparency compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC consumer protection standards

attributes.name: is_dead_stock
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this markdown is specifically targeting dead stock (unsold obsolete inventory with no expected organic demand). Dead stock markdowns typically require aggressive pricing or liquidation disposition to eliminate carrying costs.

attributes.name: markdown_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the markdown event, used in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) and cross-system references. Follows the enterprise markdown numbering convention (e.g., MD-202400012345).

attributes.name: markdown_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the markdown event. Tracks progression from planning through execution and closure: draft (being planned), approved (authorized), active (currently applied at POS), completed (sell-through achieved or exit date passed), cancelled (voided before activation).

attributes.name: markdown_type
attributes.description: Classification of the markdown by business purpose. Permanent: lasting price reduction; POS (Point of Sale): temporary promotional reduction applied at checkout; Clearance: inventory liquidation; End-of-Season: seasonal assortment exit; End-of-Life: product discontinuation; Dead Stock: elimination of unsold obsolete inventory.

attributes.name: marked_down_price
attributes.description: The new retail price after the markdown is applied. This is the price presented to customers at POS (Point of Sale) or on the e-commerce platform during the markdown event.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606; FTC pricing transparency standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional business context, merchandising rationale, or operational notes associated with the markdown event. Used by category managers and pricing analysts to document non-standard markdown decisions.

attributes.name: on_hand_units_at_initiation
attributes.description: The number of inventory units on hand at the time the markdown was initiated. Establishes the baseline inventory position for sell-through rate calculation and markdown ROI assessment.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: original_retail_price
attributes.description: The full regular retail price of the SKU before any markdown is applied. Represents the AUR (Average Unit Retail) baseline used to calculate markdown depth and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) impact.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: percent
attributes.description: The markdown expressed as a percentage of the original retail price (markdown_amount / original_retail_price * 100). Used for category management reporting, markdown depth analysis, and sell-through optimization.

attributes.name: planned_exit_date
attributes.description: The target date by which all inventory units subject to this markdown are expected to be sold, returned, or otherwise disposed of. Used for OTB (Open to Buy) planning and clearance lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining the business driver for the markdown (e.g., SLOW_MOVER, COMPETITIVE_RESPONSE, SEASONAL_EXIT, DAMAGE, OVERSTOCK, STYLE_DISCONTINUATION). Sourced from Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) reason code table. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SLOW_MOVER|COMPETITIVE_RESPONSE|SEASONAL_EXIT|DAMAGE|OVERSTOCK|STYLE_DISCONTINUATION|VENDOR_ALLOWANCE — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sell_through_actual_pct
attributes.description: The actual sell-through rate achieved as of the most recent data refresh (units sold / on_hand_units_at_initiation * 100). Compared against sell_through_target_pct to determine if further markdown action is required.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF

attributes.name: sell_through_target_pct
attributes.description: The planned sell-through rate (percentage of on-hand inventory expected to be sold) by the effective end date or planned exit date. Used as the primary KPI for markdown performance evaluation and clearance stage progression decisions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Blue Yonder Demand Planning; NRF

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this markdown record originated. RPM: Oracle Retail Price Management; ORMS: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; SAP: SAP S/4HANA Retail; SFCC: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; MANUAL: manually entered override.

attributes.name: units_remaining
attributes.description: The current number of unsold inventory units still subject to this markdown event. Calculated as on_hand_units_at_initiation minus units_sold. Drives replenishment suppression and dead stock elimination decisions.
