attributes.references: ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: markdown_budget_consumed
attributes.description: Actual markdown dollars consumed against the total markdown budget as of the last refresh. Tracks cumulative markdown spend to date within the planning period, enabling real-time budget utilization monitoring.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP S/4HANA CO Module; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: markdown_budget_remaining
attributes.description: Remaining markdown budget available for the planning period, calculated as total markdown budget minus consumed markdown budget. Provides planners with real-time visibility into available markdown capacity.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF OTB Planning Standards

attributes.name: markdown_budget_total
attributes.description: Total planned markdown budget in currency units allocated for the planning period, equivalent to the Open-to-Buy (OTB) markdown dollars. Represents the maximum allowable markdown spend to achieve sell-through targets without breaching margin floors.
attributes.references: NRF OTB Planning Standards; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: markdown_optimization_strategy
attributes.description: The pricing and markdown strategy governing how markdowns are applied within this margin target. 'edlp' = Everyday Low Price (EDLP); 'hi_lo' = High-Low promotional pricing; 'clearance' = end-of-season clearance markdown; 'dynamic' = algorithmic dynamic pricing; 'cost_plus' = cost-plus margin-based pricing.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Pricing Standards; FTC Pricing Transparency Standards

attributes.name: minimum_margin_floor_pct
attributes.description: The absolute minimum acceptable gross margin percentage below which pricing decisions must not fall, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2500 = 25.00%). Acts as a hard pricing guardrail to prevent margin erosion during markdowns or promotional events.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Pricing Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for category managers or merchandise planners to capture contextual notes, assumptions, or exceptions related to this margin target, such as competitive market conditions, supplier cost changes, or seasonal demand anomalies.
attributes.references: NRF Merchandise Planning Standards; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: planning_period_label
attributes.description: Business label identifying the specific planning period, such as 'Spring 2025', 'Q3 FY2025', 'October 2025', or 'FY2025'. Used for display and reporting in merchandise planning and financial P&L reviews.
attributes.references: NRF Retail Financial Planning Standards; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: planning_period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the planning horizon for this margin target. Determines whether the target applies to a retail season (e.g., Spring/Summer), fiscal quarter, calendar month, week, or full fiscal year. Aligns with Open-to-Buy (OTB) planning cycles.
attributes.references: NRF Retail Financial Planning Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: private_label_margin_premium_pct
attributes.description: The incremental gross margin percentage premium targeted for private label (store brand) products over national brand equivalents, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0800 = 8.00% premium). Supports private label vs. national brand differential margin strategy.
attributes.references: NRF Private Label Standards; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision counter tracking how many times this margin target record has been revised or updated. Revision 0 represents the original plan; each subsequent revision increments by 1. Supports budget revision history and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; Internal Audit Standards; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business reason for the most recent revision to this margin target, such as 'Competitive price response', 'Seasonal demand shift', or 'Inventory clearance event'. Supports audit trail and governance documentation.
attributes.references: Internal Audit Standards; FASB ASC 606; FTC Pricing Transparency Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this margin target originated. 'RPM' = Oracle Retail Price Management; 'ORMS' = Oracle Retail Merchandising System; 'SAP' = SAP S/4HANA; 'MANUAL' = manually entered by a planner.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: source_system_ref_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this margin target record in the originating operational system (e.g., Oracle RPM plan ID, SAP cost center plan number). Enables cross-system traceability and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: target_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the margin target record, used in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) and SAP S/4HANA for cross-system reference and audit trail linkage.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); GS1 Data Standards

attributes.name: target_gross_margin_pct
attributes.description: Planned gross margin percentage for the defined scope and planning period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.4200 = 42.00%). Calculated as (Net Sales - COGS) / Net Sales. Serves as the primary pricing guardrail for category managers and merchandise planners.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; NRF Financial Planning Standards; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: target_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the margin target plan, such as 'Q2 FY2025 Electronics Gross Margin Target' or 'Holiday Season Apparel Markdown Budget'. Used by category managers and merchandise planners for identification.

attributes.name: target_sell_through_rate_pct
attributes.description: Planned sell-through rate (percentage of inventory sold) for the planning period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8500 = 85.00%). Used in conjunction with markdown budget to optimize markdown timing and depth to achieve margin targets.
attributes.references: NRF Inventory Planning Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: target_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the margin target record. 'draft' indicates under construction; 'active' means currently governing pricing decisions; 'approved' means signed off by finance/merchandising leadership; 'superseded' means replaced by a revised target; 'closed' means the planning period has ended; 'cancelled' means the target was voided.
attributes.references: NRF Retail Merchandise Planning Standards; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: target_weeks_of_supply
attributes.description: Planned Weeks of Supply (WOS) — the number of weeks of inventory coverage targeted at the end of the planning period. Used alongside margin targets to balance inventory investment and markdown risk.
attributes.references: NRF Inventory Planning Standards; Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

products.name: price_override
products.description: Records point-of-sale and e-commerce price overrides applied at the transaction level. Captures override type (manager discount, price match, damaged goods, loyalty benefit, error correction), original price, override price, override amount or percentage, reason code, authorizing employee, store or channel, and transaction reference. Supports shrinkage monitoring, discount abuse detection, and override variance analysis.

attributes.name: price_override_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each price override record applied at the point-of-sale or e-commerce transaction level. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee (typically a store manager or supervisor) who authorized the price override. Critical for discount abuse detection and audit trail compliance. References Workday HCM workforce records.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; OSHA; Internal Audit Policy

attributes.name: audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit_finding. Business justification: Audit findings for POS control failures, override abuse, or shrinkage cite specific price override transactions. Auditors link findings to override events exceeding thresholds.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Price overrides are tracked by cost center for shrink analysis and policy compliance. Business process: override accountability by department, margin impact tracking, and internal controls for pricing

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical store or fulfillment location where the price override was applied. Used for store-level override variance analysis and shrinkage monitoring.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA Retail

attributes.name: loyalty_membership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.membership. Business justification: Price overrides are frequently granted based on membership status/tier (VIP price matching, tier-based discretionary discounts). Existing profile_id lacks tier/status context. Supports member-specific

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer loyalty program under which the price override benefit was granted, applicable when override_type is 'loyalty_benefit'. Links to the loyalty program master for Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) and Recency Frequency Monetary (RFM) analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Informatica MDM; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: pos_terminal_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the Point of Sale (POS) terminal or register where the override was applied. Used for terminal-level override frequency analysis and shrinkage monitoring. Populated for in-store channel overrides; null for e-commerce.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); PCI DSS; NRF

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Point of Sale (POS) or e-commerce transaction in which this price override was applied. Links the override to its originating sales event in SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) or Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the pricing zone associated with the store or channel where the override occurred. Used to contextualize the override against the applicable zone-level pricing strategy in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM).

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who received the price override benefit, if applicable. Populated for loyalty benefit overrides, price match requests, and personalized discount events. May be null for anonymous transactions.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Informatica MDM; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the promotional event or campaign that authorized or triggered the price override, if applicable. Links to the promotion master for markdown optimization and promotional Return on Investment (ROI) analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Salesforce Commerce Cloud; NRF

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product (Stock Keeping Unit / SKU) whose price was overridden. Links to the product master in Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) or Informatica MDM.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Informatica MDM; GS1

attributes.name: training_completion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.training_completion. Business justification: Associates authorized to override prices must complete POS compliance training. System checks training completion status before granting override privileges; expired training blocks overrides.

attributes.name: violation_notice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.violation_notice. Business justification: POS price overrides violating regulatory pricing rules (below-cost laws, MAP enforcement, alcohol minimum pricing) generate violation notices. Enforcement agencies cite specific override transactions.

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this override type or amount threshold required explicit manager authorization before being applied at the Point of Sale (POS). Drives workflow routing in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) and supports discount abuse detection controls.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Internal Audit Policy; NRF

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the authorizing employee approved the price override. Null if approval was not required or if the override is still pending. Used for approval latency analysis and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 8601; Internal Audit Policy

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The retail channel through which the price override was applied. Supports omnichannel override analysis across physical stores, e-commerce (Salesforce Commerce Cloud), mobile, Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), and other touchpoints.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); NRF

attributes.name: competitor_name
attributes.description: Name of the competing retailer whose price was matched, applicable when override_type is 'price_match'. Supports competitive pricing intelligence and price match policy compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency Standards; NRF

attributes.name: competitor_price
attributes.description: The price offered by the competing retailer that was matched, applicable when override_type is 'price_match'. Used to validate price match eligibility and support competitive pricing analytics in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this price override record was first created and persisted in the Silver Layer of the Databricks Lakehouse. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; ISO 27001; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this override record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency retail operations and financial reporting.

attributes.name: exceeds_threshold
attributes.description: Indicates whether the override amount or percentage exceeded the authorizing employee's configured override limit threshold. True triggers escalation workflow and flags the record for discount abuse review.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Internal Audit Policy; NRF

attributes.name: original_price
attributes.description: The regular or shelf price of the item before the override was applied, as defined in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM). Represents the Average Unit Retail (AUR) or Everyday Low Price (EDLP) baseline used to calculate override variance and markdown impact.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606; FTC Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: override_amount
attributes.description: The absolute monetary value of the price reduction applied by the override, calculated as original_price minus override_price. Used for markdown optimization, shrinkage monitoring, and Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) impact analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606; NRF

attributes.name: override_limit_threshold
attributes.description: The maximum monetary amount or percentage discount that the authorizing employee's role is permitted to apply without escalation, as configured in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM). Used to flag overrides that exceeded authorization limits for discount abuse detection.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Internal Audit Policy; NRF

attributes.name: override_percentage
attributes.description: The price override expressed as a percentage discount relative to the original price (override_amount / original_price * 100). Used for threshold-based discount abuse detection rules and override variance reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF; Internal Audit Policy

attributes.name: override_price
attributes.description: The final selling price applied to the item after the override, as recorded at the Point of Sale (POS) or e-commerce checkout. This is the price the customer was charged and the value recognized for revenue reporting under FASB ASC 606.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606; FTC Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: override_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric reference number assigned to this price override event, used for audit trail tracking, customer receipts, and reconciliation with Point of Sale (POS) systems and Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); NRF

attributes.name: override_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the price override record. 'applied' indicates the override was executed at POS; 'pending_approval' indicates it awaits manager authorization; 'rejected' indicates it was denied; 'voided' indicates it was cancelled before completion; 'reversed' indicates a post-transaction correction was made.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF; Internal Audit Policy

attributes.name: override_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the price override was applied at the Point of Sale (POS) terminal or e-commerce checkout. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transaction record, recorded in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); ISO 8601; NRF

attributes.name: override_type
attributes.description: Classification of the business reason driving the price override. 'manager_discount' is a discretionary reduction authorized by a supervisor; 'price_match' is a competitive price adjustment; 'damaged_goods' is a markdown for defective or impaired merchandise; 'loyalty_benefit' is a discount applied via a customer loyalty program; 'error_correction' is a fix for a pricing system error.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF; FTC Pricing Transparency Standards

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The number of units of the item to which the price override was applied within the transaction. Used to calculate total override impact and Units Per Transaction (UPT) analysis.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code from the Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) reason code table that identifies the specific business justification for the price override. Enables granular override variance analysis and discount abuse detection reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF; FTC

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description entered by the authorizing employee to explain the business justification for the price override. Supplements the structured reason code with contextual detail for audit and investigation purposes.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Internal Audit Policy

attributes.name: shrinkage_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price override is associated with a shrinkage event (e.g., damaged goods markdown, theft-related adjustment). Used for inventory shrinkage monitoring and loss prevention analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF; Internal Loss Prevention Policy

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: The retailer-assigned Stock Keeping Unit code identifying the specific product variant (size, color, style) subject to the price override. Aligns with the GS1 product identification standard and Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) item master.
attributes.references: GS1; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this price override record. Supports data lineage tracking across SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR), Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM), Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC), and other integrated systems.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM; ISO 27001; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: source_system_override_code
attributes.description: The native identifier assigned to this price override record in the originating operational system (e.g., SAP CAR document number, RPM override ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Informatica MDM

attributes.name: total_override_impact
attributes.description: The total monetary impact of the price override across all units in the transaction line, calculated as override_amount multiplied by quantity. Represents the gross markdown exposure for financial reporting and Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606; NRF

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: The 12-digit Universal Product Code barcode identifier for the item subject to the price override, as scanned at the Point of Sale (POS) terminal. Conforms to GS1 UPC-A standard.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this price override record, such as a status change, approval, reversal, or correction. Supports audit trail and change data capture (CDC) processing.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; ISO 27001; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded explanation for why the price override was voided or reversed. Supports audit trail completeness and post-transaction correction analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Internal Audit Policy

attributes.name: void_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the price override was voided or reversed, if applicable. Null for active or applied overrides. Used for override lifecycle tracking and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606; ISO 8601

products.name: price_strategy
products.description: High-level pricing strategy configuration for a department, category, or subcategory. Specifies primary strategy type (EDLP, Hi-Lo, cost-plus, competitive index, value-based), target margin range, competitive index target, Hi-Lo swing frequency and depth parameters, and private label vs. national brand pricing differential policy. Serves as the strategic configuration layer that pricing rules implement.

attributes.name: price_strategy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a pricing strategy configuration record. Primary key for the price_strategy data product in the Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) silver layer.

attributes.name: buyer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.buyer. Business justification: Buyers own pricing strategies for their categories. Strategy definition (EDLP vs. Hi-Lo, premium positioning, competitive matching) is a buyer responsibility aligned with category role and assortment

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise category within the department to which this pricing strategy applies. Enables category-level pricing governance per Oracle RPM hierarchy. Nullable when strategy is scoped at department level only.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC)

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise department (e.g., Grocery, Apparel, Electronics) to which this pricing strategy is scoped. Aligns with Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) department hierarchy.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); GS1 Product Classification

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic price zone (cluster of stores with homogeneous competitive and cost conditions) to which this strategy applies. Supports zone-based pricing governance in Oracle RPM.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines

attributes.name: primary_price_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pricing analyst or category manager who owns and is accountable for this pricing strategy configuration. Supports workflow routing and audit trail in Oracle RPM.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 27001 Information Security; Workday HCM

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Price strategies are defined per profit center to align with local market conditions and P&L goals. Business process: profit center-specific pricing strategy execution, financial target alignment, and

attributes.name: subcategory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise subcategory to which this pricing strategy applies. Most granular merchandise hierarchy scope for a strategy. Nullable when strategy is scoped at category or department level.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC)

attributes.name: approval_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Percentage change in price above which manual approval is required, regardless of the price_change_approval_required flag. Price changes below this threshold may be auto-approved. Null if all changes require approval.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pricing strategy was formally approved for activation by the designated pricing authority. Null if not yet approved. Part of the price change audit trail required for pricing governance.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: aur_floor
attributes.description: Minimum AUR (Average Unit Retail) price point allowed for any SKU governed by this strategy. Prevents pricing below a defined floor that would erode brand equity or violate supplier MAP (Minimum Advertised Price) agreements.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines; GS1

attributes.name: channel_scope
attributes.description: Retail channel(s) to which this pricing strategy applies. ALL covers omnichannel; IN_STORE applies to physical POS (Point of Sale) transactions; ECOMMERCE applies to Salesforce Commerce Cloud digital storefront; BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) covers click-and-collect; MARKETPLACE covers third-party platform listings.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Salesforce Commerce Cloud; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: competitive_index_target
attributes.description: Target price index relative to the primary competitor set (e.g., 0.980 means 2% below market average). Used for COMPETITIVE_INDEX strategy type. Drives automated price rule generation in Oracle RPM competitive pricing module.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines; NRF Competitive Pricing Standards

attributes.name: competitor_benchmark_set
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of competitor retailer identifiers or names used as the reference set for competitive index pricing calculations. Defines which competitors are monitored for price intelligence feeds in Oracle RPM.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines

attributes.name: cost_plus_markup_pct
attributes.description: Fixed percentage markup applied over COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) to derive the retail price when strategy_type is COST_PLUS. Null for non-cost-plus strategies. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA CO module standard cost calculations.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pricing strategy record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and pricing governance requirements.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary price parameters of this strategy are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, CAD). Supports multi-currency retail operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GS1 Global Standards; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: dynamic_pricing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time algorithmic dynamic pricing rules are active for this strategy. When True, prices may be adjusted intraday based on demand signals from SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) and competitive data feeds.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this pricing strategy ceases to govern price rules. Nullable for open-ended strategies. When populated, triggers strategy expiry workflow in Oracle RPM.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this pricing strategy becomes operative and begins governing price rules for the assigned merchandise scope. Aligns with Oracle RPM strategy activation date.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Retail fiscal year (e.g., 2025) to which this pricing strategy belongs. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA FI/CO fiscal calendar for financial planning and P&L (Profit and Loss) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; FASB ASC 606; NRF Retail Fiscal Calendar

attributes.name: gmroi_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) Target
attributes.description: Target GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) ratio for merchandise governed by this strategy. GMROI = Gross Margin / Average Inventory Cost. Used as a KPI guardrail to ensure pricing strategy delivers adequate return on inventory investment.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Financial KPI Standards; FASB

attributes.name: hilo_promo_depth_pct
attributes.description: For HI_LO strategy type: the average percentage discount depth applied during promotional price events (e.g., 25.00 means 25% off regular price). Governs markdown depth parameters in Oracle RPM. Null for non-Hi-Lo strategies.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Markdown Optimization Standards

attributes.name: hilo_swing_frequency_days
attributes.description: For HI_LO strategy type: the number of days between promotional price events (the cadence of the high-to-low price swing cycle). Governs how frequently items cycle between regular and promotional price points. Null for non-Hi-Lo strategies.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Hi-Lo Pricing Best Practices

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pricing strategy record was most recently updated. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer pipeline and pricing audit trail.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: map_enforcement_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Advertised Price (MAP) Enforcement Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Minimum Advertised Price (MAP) supplier agreements are enforced as a hard floor within this pricing strategy. When True, Oracle RPM prevents any price rule from setting a price below the supplier-defined MAP.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines; NRF Supplier Compliance Standards

attributes.name: markdown_optimization_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated markdown optimization (via Blue Yonder Demand Planning or Oracle RPM markdown module) is active for merchandise governed by this strategy. When True, system-generated markdown recommendations are applied automatically.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Blue Yonder Demand Planning; NRF Markdown Optimization Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Supplementary free-text notes capturing exceptions, special conditions, or historical context for this pricing strategy. Supports pricing governance documentation and audit trail.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: price_change_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether price changes generated under this strategy require manual approval by a pricing manager before activation. Supports governance and audit trail requirements in Oracle RPM workflow.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); ISO 9001 Quality Management; NRF Pricing Governance

attributes.name: price_review_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which pricing analysts review and potentially update prices governed by this strategy. Drives workflow scheduling in Oracle RPM and aligns with category management review cycles.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Category Management Standards

attributes.name: price_strategy_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the business rationale, objectives, and scope of this pricing strategy. Used by pricing analysts and category managers for context and documentation within Oracle RPM.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Category Management Standards

attributes.name: price_strategy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pricing strategy. DRAFT indicates the strategy is under configuration; ACTIVE means it is governing live pricing rules; SUSPENDED means temporarily paused; EXPIRED means the effective period has lapsed; ARCHIVED means retired from use.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: private_label_differential_pct
attributes.description: Configured percentage by which private label (store brand) products are priced below national brand equivalents within this strategy scope (e.g., -15.00 means 15% below national brand AUR). Supports private label vs. national brand pricing differential policy.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Private Label Standards; FTC Advertising Standards

attributes.name: rpm_strategy_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) Strategy ID
attributes.description: Native strategy identifier from Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) source system. Enables lineage tracing and reconciliation between the silver layer lakehouse record and the RPM operational system of record.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Informatica MDM

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Retail season identifier (e.g., SPRING25, FALL24, HOLIDAY24) to which this pricing strategy is aligned. Supports seasonal pricing governance and OTB (Open to Buy) planning integration with Oracle Retail Merchandising System.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Retail Calendar Standards

attributes.name: sell_through_rate_target_pct
attributes.description: Target sell-through rate (percentage of inventory sold within a defined period) that this pricing strategy is designed to achieve. Used to calibrate markdown depth and timing in markdown optimization workflows.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Blue Yonder Demand Planning; NRF Inventory KPI Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this pricing strategy record originated. RPM = Oracle Retail Price Management; SAP_SD = SAP S/4HANA Sales & Distribution; ORMS = Oracle Retail Merchandising System; MANUAL = manually entered in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: strategy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this pricing strategy within Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) and SAP S/4HANA SD module. Used for cross-system reference and EDI integration.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); GS1 Global Data Standards

attributes.name: strategy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the pricing strategy (e.g., 'Grocery EDLP FY2025', 'Apparel Hi-Lo Seasonal'). Used in reporting dashboards and pricing governance workflows.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); National Retail Federation (NRF)

attributes.name: strategy_type
attributes.description: Primary pricing strategy classification applied to the scoped merchandise hierarchy. EDLP (Everyday Low Price) maintains stable low prices; HI_LO (High-Low) cycles between regular and promotional prices; COST_PLUS applies a fixed margin over COGS; COMPETITIVE_INDEX tracks competitor price positions; VALUE_BASED prices to perceived customer value; DYNAMIC adjusts prices algorithmically in real time.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Pricing Standards; FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines

attributes.name: target_margin_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable gross margin percentage for merchandise governed by this strategy. Acts as a pricing ceiling guardrail to prevent consumer price gouging and maintain competitive positioning. Monitored against FTC pricing transparency standards.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC Pricing Transparency Guidelines; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: target_margin_min_pct
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable gross margin percentage (as a percentage of net sales) for merchandise governed by this strategy. Acts as a pricing floor guardrail. Used in GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) monitoring and markdown optimization.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606; NRF Financial KPI Standards

products.name: price_sensitivity
products.description: Captures price elasticity and sensitivity metrics by SKU, category, and customer segment to inform dynamic pricing and markdown optimization decisions. Records elasticity coefficient, cross-price elasticity, demand curve parameters, and competitive response factors.

attributes.name: price_sensitivity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the price sensitivity record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user (pricing analyst or manager) who approved this price sensitivity analysis for operational use.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the product category to which this price sensitivity analysis applies.

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the customer segment for which price sensitivity is measured. Enables segment-specific pricing strategies.

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: Price elasticity analysis is routinely segmented by loyalty tier (high-value members less price-sensitive, entry-tier more elastic). Supports tier-specific pricing optimization, dynamic pricing strate

attributes.name: price_strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_strategy. Business justification: Price sensitivity analysis (elasticity, optimal price points) directly informs pricing strategy decisions. Adding price_strategy_id FK links elasticity analysis to the strategy it supports.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the geographic or market price zone where this sensitivity analysis applies.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) Zone Configuration

attributes.name: primary_price_sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the SKU being analyzed for price sensitivity. Links to the product master.

attributes.name: privacy_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_assessment. Business justification: Price sensitivity analysis using customer purchase data requires privacy impact assessments when processing personal data for pricing decisions. GDPR/CCPA mandate assessments for automated pricing.

attributes.name: analysis_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, assumptions, or observations about the price sensitivity analysis and its business implications.

attributes.name: analysis_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period over which price sensitivity was measured and calculated.

attributes.name: analysis_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period over which price sensitivity was measured and calculated.

attributes.name: analysis_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the price sensitivity analysis record (draft, validated, approved for use, active in pricing systems, or archived).

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this price sensitivity analysis was approved for use in pricing decisions.

attributes.name: baseline_demand_units
attributes.description: The observed or forecasted demand in units at the current retail price, serving as the reference point for elasticity calculations.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The sales channel for which this price sensitivity analysis applies (store, e-commerce, mobile app, marketplace, or omnichannel).

attributes.name: competitive_response_factor
attributes.description: A coefficient representing the expected competitive pricing response to this SKU's price changes, used in dynamic pricing algorithms.

attributes.name: confidence_level_pct
attributes.description: The statistical confidence level of the elasticity estimate, typically 90%, 95%, or 99%, indicating the reliability of the analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this price sensitivity record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cross_price_elasticity
attributes.description: Measures the responsiveness of demand for this SKU to price changes in related SKUs (substitutes or complements). Positive values indicate substitutes, negative values indicate complements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this record.

attributes.name: current_retail_price
attributes.description: The current retail price of the SKU at the time of analysis, used as a baseline for sensitivity calculations.

attributes.name: demand_curve_intercept
attributes.description: The intercept parameter of the linear demand curve model (quantity = intercept + slope * price), representing theoretical demand at zero price.

attributes.name: demand_curve_slope
attributes.description: The slope parameter of the linear demand curve model, representing the rate of change in quantity demanded per unit change in price.

attributes.name: elasticity_classification
attributes.description: Categorical classification of price elasticity: elastic (>1), inelastic (<1), unitary (=1), perfectly elastic (infinite), or perfectly inelastic (0).

attributes.name: elasticity_coefficient
attributes.description: The price elasticity of demand coefficient, representing the percentage change in quantity demanded for a 1% change in price. Negative values indicate normal demand behavior (price increase reduces demand).

attributes.name: markdown_sensitivity_score
attributes.description: A normalized score (0-1) indicating how responsive demand is to markdown pricing, used for clearance and markdown optimization strategies.

attributes.name: model_type
attributes.description: The type of statistical or machine learning model used to estimate price sensitivity (linear regression, log-linear, exponential, polynomial, or ML-based).

attributes.name: optimal_price_point
attributes.description: The calculated optimal retail price that maximizes revenue or profit based on the elasticity model and cost structure.

attributes.name: price_change_threshold_pct
attributes.description: The minimum percentage price change required to trigger a measurable demand response, representing the threshold of consumer price awareness.

attributes.name: profit_maximizing_price
attributes.description: The price point that maximizes gross profit (revenue minus cost of goods sold) based on the demand curve and cost structure.

attributes.name: promotional_elasticity
attributes.description: The elasticity coefficient specifically measured during promotional periods, often higher than regular elasticity due to increased price awareness.

attributes.name: r_squared
attributes.description: The coefficient of determination (R²) indicating the proportion of variance in demand explained by price changes, measuring model fit quality (0-1 scale).

attributes.name: revenue_maximizing_price
attributes.description: The price point that maximizes total revenue (price × quantity) based on the demand curve, ignoring cost considerations.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: The number of observations (transactions, price points, or time periods) used to calculate the price sensitivity metrics.

attributes.name: seasonality_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: A multiplier applied to elasticity calculations to account for seasonal variations in price sensitivity (e.g., holiday periods, back-to-school).
attributes.references: Retail Calendar and Seasonal Planning Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system or analytical platform that generated this price sensitivity analysis (e.g., RPM, Blue Yonder, custom analytics).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this price sensitivity record was last modified.

attributes.name: prior_price_sensitivity_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on price_sensitivity (prior_price_sensitivity_id)

products.name: price_audit_log
products.description: Immutable audit trail of all price change approvals, overrides, and system-generated price adjustments for compliance and governance. Captures actor, timestamp, before/after values, approval chain, and business justification.

attributes.name: price_audit_log_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the price audit log entry. Primary key for immutable audit trail of all price change approvals, overrides, and system-generated price adjustments.

attributes.name: approver_user_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the user who approved the price change, if approval was required. Null for auto-approved or system-generated changes.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the user who initiated or approved the price change. Null for system-generated changes.

attributes.name: audit_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit_event. Business justification: Price audit logs are reviewed during compliance audits (SOX, internal controls, pricing policy). Audit events reference specific price audit log entries as evidence of control effectiveness.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Audit logs track pricing actions by cost center for SOX compliance and internal controls. Business process: pricing governance, audit trail by department, and financial controls for pricing change acc

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific store location where the price change was applied, if applicable. Null for zone-wide or system-wide changes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail - Store Master Data

attributes.name: markdown_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.markdown. Business justification: Audit log should track which markdown event triggered a price change for complete audit trail. Audit logs typically preserve denormalized data for immutability, so no columns removed.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Price audit logs track compliance with pricing policies (approval thresholds, override limits, markdown authority). Log entries reference governing policy for compliance verification.

attributes.name: price_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_approval. Business justification: Audit log should track approval decisions for complete audit trail. Adding price_approval_id FK links audit events to approval workflow. Audit logs preserve denormalized data (approver_user_id, approv

attributes.name: price_change_id
attributes.description: Reference to the price change event that triggered this audit log entry. Links to the price_change product for full change details.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) - Change Event Tracking

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Audit log should track which price list was modified for complete audit trail. Adding price_list_id FK. Audit logs preserve denormalized data for immutability.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the price zone where the price change was applied. Links to price_zone for geographic and market tier context.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) - Zone Management

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Audit trails for promotional price changes require campaign attribution for compliance reporting, vendor chargeback validation, and forensic analysis. Retailers must trace every promotional price chan

attributes.name: rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.pricing_rule. Business justification: Audit log should track which pricing rule triggered the price change for complete audit trail. Adding pricing_rule_id FK. Audit logs preserve denormalized data for immutability.

attributes.name: sku_id

products.name: rule_application
products.description: This association product represents the application of a pricing rule to a promotional offer. It captures the orchestration logic that governs how pricing rules interact with promotional offers during checkout execution. Each record links one pricing rule to one promo offer with execution priority, stacking behavior, and adjustment sequencing that exist only in the context of this relationship. This is the operational record that POS and e-commerce checkout engines use to determine which pricing rules fire for which promotional offers and in what order.. Existence Justification: In retail promotional pricing operations, a single promotional offer can trigger multiple pricing rules (e.g., base discount + loyalty multiplier + payment method discount), and a single pricing rule can apply to multiple promotional offers (e.g., a markdown optimization rule applies to all clearance promotions). Retailers actively manage these rule-offer associations with execution priority, stacking behavior, and adjustment mechanics to orchestrate complex promotional pricing scenarios at POS and e-commerce checkout.

products.name: zone_price_list_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of a price list to a price zone within Oracle Retail Price Management. It captures the operational deployment of pricing strategies across geographic markets. Each record links one price list to one price zone with effective dates, priority rules, and zone-specific overrides that govern price resolution at POS and e-commerce checkout. This is a core pricing management entity that pricing analysts actively create, modify, and retire as market conditions and competitive dynamics evolve.. Existence Justification: In retail pricing operations, price lists are deployed across multiple price zones simultaneously (one list can serve multiple geographic markets), and each zone uses multiple price lists with priority-based resolution rules (e.g., promotional list overrides base EDLP list). Pricing analysts actively manage these assignments with effective dates, priority ranks, and zone-specific override rules. This is a core operational entity in Oracle RPM and SAP Retail pricing systems, not a derived analytical relationship.

attributes.name: final_price
attributes.description: The post-discount price after this promotion was applied. May differ from transaction final price if multiple promotions were stacked.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Risk score assigned by fraud detection algorithms to assess the likelihood of fraudulent coupon use or promotion abuse. Higher scores indicate higher risk. Scale 0-100.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: The number of loyalty program points awarded to the customer as part of this promotion redemption. Null if the promotion does not include a points component.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: The number of loyalty program points the customer spent to activate or qualify for this promotion. Null if no points were used.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this redemption record was last updated. Tracks changes to status, chargeback processing, or validation outcomes.

attributes.name: original_price
attributes.description: The pre-discount price of the item or basket to which the promotion was applied. Used to calculate discount percentage and promotional lift.

attributes.name: processing_system
attributes.description: The system or platform that processed and validated the promotion redemption. Identifies the source system for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: promotion_tier
attributes.description: The tier or level of the promotion when tiered discount structures are used (e.g., spend $50 get 10% off, spend $100 get 20% off). Indicates which threshold was achieved.

attributes.name: quantity_redeemed
attributes.description: The number of units or items to which the promotion was applied. For BOGO offers, represents the number of qualifying item sets. For single-item discounts, typically 1.

attributes.name: redemption_channel
attributes.description: The sales channel through which the promotion was redeemed. Distinguishes between in-store POS, e-commerce platforms, mobile apps, and other customer touchpoints.

attributes.name: redemption_limit_type
attributes.description: The scope of redemption limits enforced for this promotion. Indicates whether limits apply per customer, per transaction, per day, or across the entire campaign period.

attributes.name: redemption_mechanism
attributes.description: Method by which the promotion was applied to the transaction. Indicates whether the discount was automatically triggered by system rules, manually entered via coupon code, applied through loyalty program, or activated through other channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automatic_system_triggered|coupon_code_entry|loyalty_auto_apply|cart_rule|manual_cashier_apply|mobile_app_clip|digital_wallet — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: redemption_sequence_number
attributes.description: The sequential count of this redemption within the applicable limit scope. For example, if limit is per_customer, this tracks which redemption number this is for that customer (1st, 2nd, 3rd, etc.).

attributes.name: redemption_status
attributes.description: Validation status of the promotion redemption. Indicates whether the redemption was successfully processed or rejected due to expiration, duplicate use, limit violations, or fraud detection.

attributes.name: redemption_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the promotion was applied to the transaction. Represents the business event time of redemption, distinct from record creation time.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: The specific product SKU to which the promotion was applied. Populated for item-level promotions. Null for transaction-level or basket-level promotions.

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this redemption record in the source operational system. Enables traceability back to the system of record.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating operational system that created this redemption record. Used for data lineage and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: stack_sequence
attributes.description: The order in which this promotion was applied within a stacked promotion scenario. Determines calculation precedence when multiple discounts are layered.

attributes.name: validation_error_code
attributes.description: System error code returned when a redemption attempt fails validation. Provides technical detail for troubleshooting invalid redemptions. Null for successful redemptions.

attributes.name: validation_error_message
attributes.description: Human-readable error message explaining why a redemption was rejected. Displayed to customers or cashiers. Null for successful redemptions.

attributes.name: vendor_funded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion discount is funded by a vendor/supplier through a trade promotion agreement. True when the cost is charged back to the vendor; false when retailer-funded.

products.name: promo_performance
products.description: Operational record capturing the measured performance of a promotional offer or campaign at the offer-store-week grain. Stores actual units sold, revenue generated, discount dollars given, incremental units vs. baseline, redemption count, sell-through rate, promotional ROI, margin impact, and cannibalization estimate. Written by SAP CAR demand signal repository and Blue Yonder systems during and after promotion execution. This is an operational performance record — not an analytics aggregate — used for vendor settlement evidence, markdown planning decisions, and post-promotion review. Supports comparison against promo_forecast for forecast accuracy measurement.

attributes.name: promo_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotion performance record. Primary key for this operational performance measurement entity.

attributes.name: assortment_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.assortment_plan. Business justification: Promotional performance directly impacts assortment decisions. Merchandising evaluates which promoted items to continue, expand, or discontinue based on promotional lift, margin impact, and sell-throu

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.category. Business justification: Performance metrics must roll up to category level for merchandising review. Category managers evaluate promotional ROI, incremental margin, and sell-through rates to inform future assortment and prom

attributes.name: kpi_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.kpi_definition. Business justification: Performance records explicitly measure campaigns against defined KPIs. Weekly performance snapshots calculate specific KPI values (sell-through rate, promotional ROI, incremental units). Merchandising

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store location where this promotion performance was measured. Supports store-level promotion analysis.

attributes.name: marketing_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Promotional performance metrics roll up to marketing campaign level for holistic reporting. Retailers need to see how promotional tactics performed within broader marketing initiatives to measure inte

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Promotional performance can be measured at both campaign level and offer level. While promo_performance already has promo_offer_id (offer-level measurement), adding promo_campaign_id enables direct ca

attributes.description: Reference to the specific promotional offer or campaign being measured. Links to the promotion master definition.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Performance tracking measures promotional lift by SKU. Required for calculating incremental units, ROI, cannibalization analysis, and feeding promotional forecasts. Unlinked sku column exists but need

attributes.name: stock_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_ledger. Business justification: Post-promotion ROI analysis requires matching promotional sales performance against actual inventory movements to calculate true incremental lift, validate COGS, identify shrinkage during events, and

attributes.name: average_transaction_value
attributes.description: Average basket value for transactions that included this promoted item. Measures promotion impact on overall basket size.

attributes.name: baseline_units
attributes.description: Estimated units that would have sold without the promotion, based on historical trends. Used to calculate incremental lift.

attributes.name: cannibalization_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated units of related non-promoted products that lost sales due to this promotion. Measures negative cross-product impact.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the promoted product was sold. Supports omnichannel promotion performance analysis.

attributes.name: cogs
attributes.description: Total cost of goods sold during the promotion period. Used to calculate gross margin and promotional ROI.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this performance record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record. Typically matches store local currency.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system that generated or last updated this performance record. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar value of discounts given during the promotion period. Represents the promotional investment at retail price level.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Accuracy of the promotional forecast compared to actual performance. Calculated as 100 minus absolute percentage error. Used to improve future forecasting.

attributes.name: gross_margin
attributes.description: Gross profit generated during the promotion. Calculated as net_revenue minus COGS. Critical for assessing promotion profitability.

attributes.name: gross_margin_percent
attributes.description: Gross margin as a percentage of net revenue. Expressed as a percentage value (e.g., 25.50 for 25.5%). Measures promotion profitability rate.

attributes.name: gross_revenue
attributes.description: Total revenue generated from units sold at regular price before promotional discounts. Denominated in local store currency.

attributes.name: incremental_units
attributes.description: Additional units sold above baseline due to the promotion. Calculated as units_sold minus baseline_units. Key measure of promotion effectiveness.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this performance record was last modified. Audit trail for record changes during adjustments or settlement.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this performance measurement was calculated and recorded. Represents the business event time for this operational record.

attributes.name: net_revenue
attributes.description: Revenue after promotional discounts. Calculated as gross_revenue minus discount_amount. Actual revenue realized from the promotion.

attributes.name: new_customer_count
attributes.description: Number of customers who purchased this SKU for the first time during the promotion. Measures customer acquisition effectiveness.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing exceptional circumstances, adjustments, or explanations for performance anomalies. Used for post-promotion review and vendor settlement discussions.

attributes.name: out_of_stock_days
attributes.description: Number of days during the promotion period when the SKU was out of stock at this store. Indicates lost sales opportunity.

attributes.name: performance_status
attributes.description: Current status of this performance record. Preliminary during promotion execution, final after close, adjusted if corrections made, settled after vendor payment.

attributes.name: performance_week_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the week for which this promotion performance is measured. Defines the weekly measurement window.

attributes.name: performance_week_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the week for which this promotion performance is measured. Promotion performance is captured at weekly grain for trend analysis.

attributes.name: promotional_roi
attributes.description: Return on investment for the promotion, calculated as incremental gross margin divided by promotional investment. Expressed as ratio (e.g., 2.50 means $2.50 return per $1 invested).

attributes.name: redemption_count
attributes.description: Number of times the promotion was redeemed (coupon scans, digital offer applications, BOGO transactions). Measures customer engagement with the offer.

attributes.name: repeat_customer_count
attributes.description: Number of customers who had previously purchased this SKU and bought again during the promotion. Measures loyalty reinforcement.

attributes.name: retailer_funded_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount funded by the retailer for this promotion. Combined with vendor_funded_amount gives total promotional investment.

attributes.name: sell_through_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of promotional inventory sold during the promotion period. Expressed as percentage (e.g., 85.50 for 85.5%). Indicates inventory velocity.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: The specific product SKU included in this promotion performance measurement. Enables product-level promotion effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: unique_customer_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct customers who purchased the promoted item during the period. Measures promotion reach.

attributes.name: units_per_transaction
attributes.description: Average number of units of the promoted SKU purchased per transaction. Indicates promotion-driven purchase intensity.

attributes.name: units_sold
attributes.description: Total number of units sold during the promotion period for this SKU at this store. Core volume metric for promotion effectiveness.

attributes.name: vendor_funded_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount funded by the vendor/supplier as part of co-op or trade promotion agreement. Used for vendor settlement and chargeback processing.

products.name: promo_budget
products.description: Master record for the promotional budget allocated to a campaign, promotional event, or category-level promotional plan. Captures total budget amount, budget type (internal marketing, vendor co-op, markdown allowance, clearance reserve), budget owner (department, category, or brand team), planned spend by channel, actual spend to date, committed but unspent amount, remaining budget, budget approval status, fiscal period, and variance threshold for alerts. Supports OTB (Open to Buy) integration, promotional P&L management, and real-time budget consumption monitoring. Distinct from finance domain general ledger — this is the operational promotional spend plan that feeds GL accruals.

attributes.name: promo_budget_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotional budget record. Primary key for the promotional budget master data.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific organizational unit or team responsible for this promotional budget, corresponding to the budget owner type (e.g., department code, category code, brand code, channel identifier).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Organizational Master Data

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.marketing_budget. Business justification: Promotional budgets are sub-allocations of marketing budgets. Finance and marketing teams reconcile promotional spend against marketing budget envelopes for variance reporting, budget management, and

attributes.name: merch_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.merch_plan. Business justification: Promotional budgets are coordinated with merchandise plans. Total category investment includes both promotional spend and OTB. Buyers need integrated view of promotional and inventory investment to ma

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_calendar. Business justification: Promotional budgets are planned and allocated against promotional calendar periods (fiscal year, fiscal quarter, seasonal events). The promo_budget table has fiscal_year and fiscal_period as standalon

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Promotional budgets are allocated to specific promotional campaigns. The promo_budget table tracks budget_owner_type and budget_owner_id as generic strings, but needs a structured FK to promo_campaign

attributes.name: report_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.report_definition. Business justification: Budget tracking requires standardized financial reports for variance analysis. Finance teams assign each budget to a standard report template (monthly budget vs actual, promotional spend by category).

attributes.name: actual_spend_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative actual spend to date against this promotional budget, including all posted promotional costs, markdowns, vendor co-op claims, and advertising expenses. Updated in real-time as promotional transactions are processed.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this promotional budget was formally approved by authorized management. Marks the transition from pending to approved status.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the budget amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD). All budget amounts and spend tracking for this budget are denominated in this currency.

attributes.name: budget_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the promotional budget plan, typically indicating the campaign, event, or category scope (e.g., 'Q4 Holiday Electronics Promotion', 'Spring Apparel Clearance').
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) - Budget Management Module

attributes.name: budget_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the promotional budget, typically following format PB-YYYYNNNN where YYYY is fiscal year and NNNN is sequence number.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) - Budget Management Module

attributes.name: budget_owner_type
attributes.description: Classification of the organizational unit responsible for managing and executing this promotional budget. Department indicates merchandising department ownership; category indicates product category team ownership; brand indicates brand management team ownership; channel indicates channel-specific ownership (e-commerce, stores); region indicates geographic region ownership; store cluster indicates store group ownership.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Organizational Hierarchy

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the promotional budget. Draft indicates initial planning stage; pending approval indicates submitted for management review; approved indicates authorized but not yet active; active indicates currently in use for promotional spend; suspended indicates temporarily paused; closed indicates completed and finalized; cancelled indicates terminated before completion. attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) - Budget Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotional budget source and purpose. Internal marketing budgets are company-funded campaigns; vendor co-op budgets are supplier-funded promotional agreements; markdown allowance budgets cover planned price reductions; clearance reserve budgets are set aside for end-of-season inventory liquidation; trade promotion budgets support B2B channel incentives; digital advertising budgets fund online and mobile promotional campaigns.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) - Budget Type Classification

attributes.name: circular_ad_allocation

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this promotional budget expires and is no longer available for new promotional spend allocation. Any uncommitted budget remaining after this date typically rolls back to the general promotional fund or is reallocated.

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: fiscal_period

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail FI/CO - Fiscal Calendar

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year for which this promotional budget is allocated, typically a four-digit year (e.g., 2024). Aligns with the company's financial planning and reporting calendar.

attributes.name: gl_account_code

attributes.name: pos_channel_allocation

attributes.description: Available budget remaining for new promotional activities, calculated as total budget amount minus actual spend amount minus committed amount. Represents the unallocated budget available for additional promotional planning.

attributes.description: Total allocated budget amount for the promotional plan in the budget currency. Represents the maximum authorized spend for this promotional budget across all channels and activities.

attributes.name: variance_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Absolute amount threshold for budget variance alerts. When actual spend deviates from planned spend by more than this amount, automated alerts are triggered to budget owners and finance teams. Used in conjunction with or as an alternative to percentage-based thresholds.

products.name: promo_calendar
products.description: Master record for the retail promotional calendar defining planned promotional periods, key retail events, blackout dates, and competitive response windows for a fiscal year. Captures period name, period type (weekly ad cycle, seasonal event, holiday, clearance window, competitive response), start/end dates, fiscal week/month/quarter alignment, priority tier, planning lock date, planning status (draft, locked, active, archived), and banner/market applicability for multi-banner retailers. Used by merchandising, marketing, and supply chain teams to coordinate promotional activity, inventory positioning, and circular production timelines. Serves as the shared planning backbone that prevents promotional conflicts and ensures adequate lead time for vendor negotiations and inventory builds. Supports multi-banner coordination by allowing banner-specific or enterprise-wide calendar periods.

products.name: circular_ad_category_feature
products.description: This association product represents the featured placement of a merchandise category within a specific circular advertisement. It captures the promotional strategy of allocating page space, prominence, and sales targets to categories within each circular. Each record links one circular_ad to one category with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific feature placement, including page location, visual prominence, space allocation, and category-specific performance targets for that circular edition.. Existence Justification: In retail circular planning, a single circular advertisement features multiple merchandise categories across different pages (e.g., Grocery on page 2, Apparel on page 5, Electronics on page 8), and each category appears in multiple circulars throughout the year (weekly, seasonal, holiday editions). Circular planning teams actively manage this many-to-many relationship by allocating page space, setting feature prominence, assigning category-specific sales targets, and tracking performance for each category within each circular edition. This is an operational business process with relationship-specific data.
