products.name: coupon_distribution
products.description: This association product represents the distribution event between coupon and audience_segment. It captures the operational record of which coupons were distributed to which marketing segments, when, through which channels, and the resulting redemption performance. Each record links one coupon to one audience_segment with attributes that exist only in the context of this distribution relationship.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, coupons are strategically distributed to multiple audience segments as part of targeted promotional campaigns (e.g., a 20% off coupon might be sent to loyalty members via email, lapsed customers via direct mail, and high-value prospects via app notification). Each segment receives multiple different coupons over time as part of ongoing promotional strategy. Retailers actively manage these distribution events, tracking which coupons went to which segments, through which channels, and measuring redemption performance by segment to optimize future targeting decisions.

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of sales channels where this promotion stack is valid (e.g., in_store, online, mobile_app, call_center).

attributes.name: combinable_with_clearance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion stack can be combined with clearance-priced items.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotion stack record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Target customer segment or segments eligible for this promotion stack (e.g., all_customers, loyalty_members, new_customers, vip_tier).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the promotion stack expires and is no longer available for redemption. Nullable for open-ended promotions.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the promotion stack becomes active and eligible for customer redemption.

attributes.name: exclude_sale_items
attributes.description: Indicates whether items already on sale are excluded from this promotion stack.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Entity responsible for funding the promotional discount: retailer-funded, vendor-funded, co-funded partnership, or manufacturer-funded.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic regions or store locations where the promotion stack is valid. May include country codes, state/province codes, or store identifiers.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion stack is currently active and available for redemption based on status and effective dates.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the business user who last modified this promotion stack record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotion stack record was last updated.

attributes.name: maximum_discount_amount
attributes.description: Maximum total discount amount that can be applied from this promotion stack in a single transaction. Nullable if no cap applies.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_amount
attributes.description: Minimum transaction subtotal required to qualify for the promotion stack. Nullable if no minimum applies.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking used to determine precedence when multiple promotion stacks are eligible for the same transaction. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: promotional_message
attributes.description: Customer-facing marketing message or tagline displayed for this promotion stack across channels.

attributes.name: redemption_limit_per_customer
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a single customer can redeem this promotion stack during its validity period. Nullable for unlimited redemptions.

attributes.name: requires_coupon
attributes.description: Indicates whether a coupon code or digital coupon is required to activate this promotion stack.

attributes.name: stack_code
attributes.description: Business-facing unique code for the promotion stack used in operational systems and reporting.

attributes.name: stack_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the promotion stack including its business objectives, target audience, and promotional strategy.

attributes.name: stack_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the promotion stack describing its purpose or campaign theme.

attributes.name: stack_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the promotion stack indicating its operational state.

attributes.name: stack_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotion stack structure indicating whether it contains a single offer, multiple stacked offers, tiered discounts, bundled deals, cross-category promotions, or loyalty-exclusive offers.

attributes.name: stacking_rule
attributes.description: Rule governing how this promotion stack interacts with other promotions: exclusive (cannot combine), stackable (can combine with others), conditional (stacks under specific conditions), or best_deal (system selects best offer).

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions
attributes.description: Legal terms, conditions, and restrictions governing the use and redemption of this promotion stack.

attributes.name: total_redemption_limit
attributes.description: Maximum total number of redemptions allowed across all customers for this promotion stack. Nullable for unlimited redemptions.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the business user who created this promotion stack record.

attributes.name: parent_promotion_stack_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on promotion_stack (parent_promotion_stack_id)

domains.name: supplier
domains.description: Authoritative source for supplier and vendor master data including contact information, contracts, compliance certifications, performance scorecards, chargebacks (vendor compliance penalties), RTV (Return to Vendor) processes, EDI integration, MOQ and lead time agreements, and VMI configurations. Manages supplier onboarding, qualification, risk assessment, and ongoing relationship management for national brands, private label manufacturers, and DSD vendors.

products.name: vendor
products.description: Master record for all suppliers and vendors including national brand manufacturers, private label producers, DSD vendors, and 3PL partners. Serves as the authoritative golden record for vendor identity, classification, tax identifiers (W-9/W-8), remittance details, business type, ownership structure, diversity certifications, DUNS number, and onboarding status. Contains embedded contact persons (account managers, EDI coordinators, compliance contacts, executive sponsors) with role types, communication preferences, and escalation paths. Contains embedded multi-address records (headquarters, remittance, ship-from, RTV addresses) with geo-coordinates, address validation status, and address type classification. Sourced from Informatica MDM and SAP S/4HANA MM vendor master.
products.reference: SAP Vendor Master (LFA1/LFB1), Informatica MDM Supplier Golden Record

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor. Primary key for the vendor master record.

attributes.name: contract_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the current master supply agreement or contract with this vendor. Used for contract renewal planning and vendor relationship management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor master record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the vendor's preferred currency for invoicing and payment (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD).

attributes.name: diversity_certification
attributes.description: Diversity certification status of the vendor for supplier diversity programs. MBE (Minority Business Enterprise), WBE (Women Business Enterprise), DBE (Disadvantaged Business Enterprise), VBE (Veteran Business Enterprise), LGBTBE (LGBT Business Enterprise), SDVOSB (Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business), or none if not certified. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mbe|wbe|dbe|vbe|lgbtbe|sdvosb|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: National Minority Supplier Development Council (NMSDC), Women's Business Enterprise National Council (WBENC)

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit unique identifier assigned by Dun & Bradstreet to identify business entities globally. Used for vendor qualification, credit assessment, and supplier risk management.

attributes.name: edi_capable_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the vendor supports EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) for automated exchange of purchase orders, advance ship notices, invoices, and other business documents. True indicates EDI capability is enabled.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards, SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - EDI Configuration

attributes.name: edi_identifier
attributes.description: Unique EDI identifier or interchange ID used to route electronic documents to this vendor in EDI transactions (e.g., ISA ID, GS1 GLN).
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards, ANSI X12 Standards

attributes.name: fill_rate_pct
attributes.description: Vendor performance metric representing the percentage of ordered quantity that the vendor successfully delivers (order completion percentage). A fill rate of 100% indicates all ordered items were delivered in full.
attributes.references: Vendor Scorecard KPI - Supply Chain Performance

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the vendor's general liability and product liability insurance certificate. Used to ensure vendors maintain required insurance coverage as per contract terms.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor master record was last updated or modified. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: last_purchase_order_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent purchase order issued to this vendor. Used to identify inactive vendors and support vendor rationalization initiatives.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order History

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days from purchase order placement to delivery at the distribution center or store. Used for replenishment planning and inventory management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - LFM1.PLIFZ

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this vendor record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: moq_units
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) in units that must be ordered from this vendor per purchase order or per SKU (Stock Keeping Unit). Used in procurement planning and order optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - Purchasing Data

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate_pct
attributes.description: Vendor performance metric representing the percentage of orders delivered on or before the requested delivery date. Used in vendor scorecards and supplier performance management.
attributes.references: Vendor Scorecard KPI - Supply Chain Performance

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor was officially onboarded and approved for transactions in the vendor master system. Represents the start of the vendor relationship.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM - Vendor Master Audit Trail

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred method for remitting payment to the vendor. ACH (Automated Clearing House) for electronic bank transfers, wire transfer for same-day transfers, check for paper checks, EFT (Electronic Funds Transfer) for direct deposit, credit card for card-based payments, and virtual card for single-use card numbers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Master - LFB1.ZWELS

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code defining the payment schedule and discount conditions for this vendor (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30, Net 60). Determines when payment is due and any early payment discounts available.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - LFM1.ZTERM

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person for operational communication, order management, and issue resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - ADR6.SMTP_ADDR

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the vendor organization, typically the account manager or sales representative responsible for the business relationship.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - Contact Person

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the vendor contact person, including country code and extension if applicable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - ADR2.TEL_NUMBER

attributes.name: quality_acceptance_rate_pct
attributes.description: Vendor performance metric representing the percentage of received goods that pass quality inspection and are accepted into inventory without rejection or return. Used to monitor product quality and vendor compliance.

attributes.name: remittance_email
attributes.description: Email address for sending payment remittance advice and electronic payment notifications to the vendor's accounts receivable department.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Master - ADR6.SMTP_ADDR

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk assessment rating for the vendor based on financial stability, operational performance, compliance history, and supply chain risk factors. Low indicates minimal risk, medium indicates moderate risk requiring monitoring, high indicates elevated risk requiring mitigation plans, and critical indicates severe risk requiring immediate action or alternative sourcing.

attributes.name: sustainability_certified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the vendor holds recognized sustainability or environmental certifications (e.g., ISO 14001, B Corp, Fair Trade, Rainforest Alliance). True indicates the vendor has sustainability credentials.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management, B Corporation Certification

attributes.name: tax_classification
attributes.description: Tax classification of the vendor for withholding and reporting purposes. W-9 US person indicates a domestic US entity, W-8 foreign entity indicates a non-US entity subject to withholding, exempt organization indicates tax-exempt status, and government entity indicates a governmental body.

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: The vendor's tax identification number (TIN) or Employer Identification Number (EIN) used for tax reporting and compliance. Format varies by jurisdiction (e.g., EIN in USA, VAT number in EU).
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9 / W-8, SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - LFA1.STCD1

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the vendor or supplier as registered with governing authorities. Used for contracts, purchase orders, and legal documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - LFA1.NAME1

attributes.name: vendor_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the vendor in the vendor lifecycle. Active vendors are approved for transactions, inactive vendors are not currently used but remain in the system, suspended vendors are temporarily blocked due to performance or compliance issues, pending approval vendors are undergoing onboarding qualification, blocked vendors cannot transact due to critical issues, and terminated vendors have ended their relationship with the business.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - LFA1.SPERR

attributes.name: vendor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor based on the type of goods or services provided. National brand manufacturers supply branded products, private label producers manufacture store-brand products, DSD (Direct Store Delivery) vendors deliver directly to stores bypassing distribution centers, 3PL (Third-Party Logistics) partners provide logistics and fulfillment services, service providers offer non-product services, and raw material suppliers provide ingredients or components for private label manufacturing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master - LFA1.KTOKK

attributes.name: vmi_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this vendor participates in Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) programs where the vendor monitors inventory levels and initiates replenishment orders. True indicates VMI is active for this vendor.

products.name: vendor_contact
products.description: Contact persons associated with a vendor including account managers, EDI coordinators, compliance contacts, and executive sponsors. Tracks name, title, role type, phone, email, preferred communication channel, and active status. Supports relationship management and escalation workflows.
products.reference: SAP Vendor Contact (KNVK), Salesforce Service Cloud Contact

attributes.name: vendor_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor contact person. Primary key.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent vendor organization this contact represents. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: First line of the business address for the vendor contact's office location. Typically includes street number and name.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Second line of the business address for additional location details such as suite, floor, or building number.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the vendor contact's office is located.

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor contact. Inactive or terminated contacts should not receive communications.

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: The functional role or responsibility area of this contact within the vendor organization. Determines escalation paths and communication routing.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) - Supplier Relationship Management Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the vendor contact's office location. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|CAN|MEX|GBR|DEU|FRA|CHN|JPN — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this vendor contact record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The department or business unit within the vendor organization where this contact works (e.g., Sales, Logistics, Quality Assurance, Finance).
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) - Supplier Relationship Management Standards

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this vendor contact ceased to be active. Null for currently active contacts. Used for historical tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this vendor contact became active and available for business communications. Supports temporal tracking of contact relationships.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary business email address for the vendor contact. Used for official communications, purchase orders, and compliance notifications.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the vendor contact, if still used for formal document transmission.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: The given name of the vendor contact person.

attributes.name: is_escalation_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact should be included in escalation workflows for critical issues such as compliance violations, quality failures, or delivery delays.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) - Supplier Relationship Management Standards

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the primary point of contact for the vendor. Used for default routing of communications and escalations.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) - Supplier Relationship Management Standards

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The official job title or position of the contact within the vendor organization (e.g., Account Manager, Supply Chain Director, Compliance Officer).
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) - Supplier Relationship Management Standards

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Preferred language for business communications with this contact. Uses ISO 639-2 three-letter language codes.

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: The most recent date when this vendor contact was engaged in business communication. Used for relationship health monitoring and engagement tracking.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) - Supplier Relationship Management Standards

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: The family name or surname of the vendor contact person.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this vendor contact record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: The middle name or initial of the vendor contact person, if applicable.

attributes.name: mobile_number
attributes.description: Mobile phone number for the vendor contact. Used for urgent escalations and time-sensitive communications.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional information about the vendor contact, such as special instructions, preferences, or relationship history.

attributes.name: office_location
attributes.description: The physical office location or site where this contact is based (e.g., headquarters, regional office, manufacturing plant).
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) - Supplier Relationship Management Standards

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary business phone number for the vendor contact. Includes country code and extension if applicable.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the vendor contact's office location.

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: The contact's preferred method for receiving business communications. Supports personalized engagement and improved response rates.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) - Supplier Relationship Management Standards

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region where the vendor contact's office is located.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: The time zone where the vendor contact is located. Used for scheduling meetings and understanding business hours. Format follows IANA Time Zone Database (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London).

products.name: vendor_address
products.description: Physical and mailing addresses for vendors including headquarters, remittance, ship-from, and returns (RTV) addresses. Tracks address type, street, city, state, postal code, country, geo-coordinates, and validation status. Supports procurement, logistics routing, and RTV processing.
products.reference: SAP Vendor Address (ADRC), GS1 Location Number (GLN)

attributes.name: vendor_address_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor address record. Primary key.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor to whom this address belongs. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including street number, street name, and building identifier. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, floor, department, or additional location details. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line_3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line for complex addresses requiring additional location specification. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or label for the address location (e.g., 'Main Distribution Center', 'Corporate HQ', 'Returns Processing Facility').

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address: active (in use), inactive (no longer used), pending_validation (awaiting verification), invalid (failed validation), temporary (short-term use).

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the address purpose: headquarters (corporate office), remittance (payment processing), ship_from (origin for DSD or shipments), returns (RTV processing location), billing (invoice address), warehouse (distribution or storage facility).

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality name where the vendor address is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the country of the address (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS number for the location, used for business identity verification, credit assessment, and supplier risk management. 9-digit numeric identifier.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this address is no longer valid or was deactivated. Null indicates the address is currently active. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this address became active and valid for use in procurement, logistics, and vendor transactions. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email contact for the address location, used for logistics coordination, RTV notifications, and operational communication. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the address location, used for EDI transmission or document exchange with vendors. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: gln
attributes.description: GS1 Global Location Number uniquely identifying the physical location for EDI transactions, logistics routing, and supply chain integration. 13-digit numeric identifier.

attributes.name: is_dsd_location
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this address is a DSD (Direct Store Delivery) origin location where vendors deliver directly to retail stores bypassing distribution centers. True if DSD location, False otherwise.

attributes.name: is_primary_address
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the primary or default address for the vendor. True if primary, False otherwise.

attributes.name: is_remittance_address
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this address is used for payment remittance and accounts payable processing. True if remittance address, False otherwise.

attributes.name: is_rtv_address
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this address is designated for RTV (Return to Vendor) processing and merchandise returns. True if RTV address, False otherwise. Critical for reverse logistics and vendor compliance.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was last modified or updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees for geospatial routing, logistics optimization, and mapping. Supports last-mile delivery planning and ship-from-store calculations.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees for geospatial routing, logistics optimization, and mapping. Supports last-mile delivery planning and ship-from-store calculations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional address-specific information, special delivery instructions, access requirements, or operational notes for logistics and procurement teams.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the address location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for mail delivery routing. Format varies by country (e.g., 5-digit ZIP in USA, alphanumeric in Canada). Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or regional subdivision where the address is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction or district code applicable to this address location, used for sales tax calculation, VAT compliance, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York, America/Chicago, Europe/London). Supports scheduling, delivery windows, and cross-timezone coordination.

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date when the address was last validated against postal authority or third-party address verification services. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: validation_source
attributes.description: Name of the service or system used to validate the address (e.g., USPS Address Validation API, Canada Post AddressComplete, UPS Address Validation, manual verification).

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has been verified against postal authority databases or third-party address validation services: validated (confirmed accurate), unvalidated (not yet checked), failed (does not match postal records), partial (some fields validated).

products.name: vendor_contract
products.description: Supplier trading agreements and master vendor contracts including terms and conditions, payment terms, discount structures, exclusivity clauses, private label agreements, and contract validity periods. Tracks contract type (national brand, private label, DSD), effective and expiry dates, auto-renewal flags, and signatory details. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD/MM contract management.
products.reference: SAP Outline Agreement (EKKO/EKPO), Oracle ORMS Vendor Agreement

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor contract. Primary key for the vendor contract entity.

attributes.name: buyer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.buyer. Business justification: Vendor contracts are negotiated, approved, and managed by the buyer responsible for that vendor relationship. Contract approval workflows route to the assigned buyer, and buyers are accountable for co

attributes.name: signatory_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Contract management requires tracking which retail associate has signing authority for legal compliance, delegation of authority verification, and audit trails. Replaces denormalized signatory_name/ti

attributes.name: supply_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.purchase_order. Business justification: Retail procurement validates every PO against active contract terms (pricing, payment terms, MOQ, lead time). Buyers and AP teams enforce contract compliance per PO; audit trails require PO-to-contrac

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier or vendor party to this contract. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract automatically renews at expiration. True if the contract extends for another term unless either party provides termination notice. False if the contract expires without action.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Renewal Configuration

attributes.name: chargeback_terms
attributes.description: Description of vendor compliance penalties and chargeback conditions. Defines scenarios where the buyer may deduct fees from vendor payments for non-compliance (late delivery, incorrect labeling, missing ASN, pallet configuration errors).

attributes.name: compliance_certifications_required
attributes.description: List of regulatory and industry certifications the vendor must maintain to fulfill this contract. Examples include FDA registration for food suppliers, CPSC compliance for consumer products, organic certifications, fair trade certifications, and safety standards.

attributes.name: contract_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the contract value and payment terms. All financial terms in this contract are denominated in this currency.

attributes.name: contract_document_url
attributes.description: Uniform Resource Locator pointing to the digitally stored contract document. Links to the document management system or secure file repository where the full contract PDF or scanned image is stored.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the vendor contract. Used in procurement documents, purchase orders, and vendor communications.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the vendor contract. Draft contracts are under negotiation. Pending approval contracts await internal sign-off. Active contracts are in force. Suspended contracts are temporarily paused. Terminated contracts are ended before expiry. Expired contracts have passed their end date. Renewed contracts have been extended. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|active|suspended|terminated|expired|renewed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor contract. National brand contracts cover branded merchandise from manufacturers. Private label contracts govern store-brand product manufacturing. DSD (Direct Store Delivery) contracts define vendor-managed delivery terms. Master service agreements cover ongoing services. Blanket orders establish terms for recurring purchases. Framework agreements set umbrella terms for multiple purchase orders.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Type Configuration

attributes.name: contract_value_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value committed under this vendor contract. Represents the aggregate purchase commitment or spending cap over the contract term. Used for budget planning and vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this vendor contract record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Standard discount rate applied to purchases under this contract. Expressed as a percentage off list price. Used for volume discounts, early payment discounts, or negotiated pricing agreements.

attributes.name: edi_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Electronic Data Interchange is enabled for transactions under this contract. True if purchase orders, invoices, and shipping notices are exchanged via EDI. False for manual or email-based document exchange.

attributes.name: edi_identifier
attributes.description: Vendor EDI interchange identifier corresponding to the EDI qualifier. Used in EDI message headers to identify the sender and receiver.

attributes.name: edi_qualifier
attributes.description: EDI interchange identifier qualifier for the vendor. Examples include 01 (DUNS number), 12 (phone number), 14 (UPC), ZZ (mutually defined). Used to route EDI messages to the correct vendor system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor contract terms expire. Nullable for open-ended contracts. Procurement transactions must occur before this date unless the contract is renewed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Validity Period

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor contract terms become binding and enforceable. Procurement transactions referencing this contract must occur on or after this date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Validity Period

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract grants the vendor exclusive rights to supply specific products or categories. True if the buyer commits to purchasing exclusively from this vendor for the covered scope. False for non-exclusive agreements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Terms and Conditions

attributes.name: exclusivity_scope
attributes.description: Description of the product categories, geographic regions, or channels covered by the exclusivity clause. Applicable only when exclusivity_flag is true. Defines the boundaries of the exclusive supply arrangement.

products.name: vendor_item
products.description: Vendor-specific item catalog linking vendor part numbers, UPCs, GTINs, and EANs to internal SKUs. Captures vendor item number, vendor pack configuration, case pack quantity, inner pack, pallet TI/HI, unit cost, cost effective date, country of origin, and item status. Includes lead time and MOQ agreements per vendor-item combination: standard lead time (days), expedited lead time, MOQ units, order increment, pack size, inner pack quantity, seasonal lead time adjustments, and category-level defaults. Serves as the cross-reference between vendor catalogs and the internal product master, and feeds Blue Yonder demand planning replenishment parameters and OTB calculations.
products.reference: GS1 GTIN, Oracle ORMS Item-Supplier, SAP Info Record (EINA/EINE)

Tracks assessment date, risk category scores, overall risk tier (low, medium, high, critical), mitigation actions, and reassessment schedule. Supports supply chain resilience planning.

attributes.name: kpi_value_id

attributes.name: risk_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.risk_register. Business justification: Supplier risk assessments (financial stability, geopolitical, ESG, cybersecurity) feed into enterprise risk register for consolidated risk management, board reporting, and regulatory disclosure. Retai

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor being assessed. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk assessment was formally approved and became effective for vendor management decisions.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who approved the risk assessment (e.g., Chief Procurement Officer, Risk Committee Chair, VP Supply Chain).

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk assessment was conducted. Principal business event timestamp for this assessment.

attributes.name: assessment_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this risk assessment expires and is no longer valid for vendor management decisions. Expired assessments require immediate reassessment before continuing business.

attributes.name: assessment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, observations, qualitative risk factors, assessor commentary, or special considerations not captured in structured risk scores.

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the risk assessment, formatted as RA-YYYYMMDD or similar pattern for external reference and audit trails.

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the risk assessment: draft, in progress, under review by risk committee, approved, rejected, or expired requiring reassessment.

attributes.name: assessment_type

attributes.name: compliance_risk_score
attributes.description: Score evaluating vendor's adherence to regulatory requirements, industry standards, contractual obligations, and history of chargebacks (vendor compliance penalties), RTV (Return to Vendor) incidents, and audit findings.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: cybersecurity_risk_score

attributes.name: data_sources
attributes.description: List or description of data sources used for the assessment (e.g., Dun & Bradstreet financial reports, vendor self-assessment questionnaire, third-party ESG ratings, internal performance scorecards, audit reports).

attributes.name: esg_risk_score
attributes.description: Composite score assessing vendor's environmental practices, social responsibility, labor standards, ethical governance, and sustainability certifications. Evaluates ESG compliance and reputational risk.
attributes.references: GRI Standards - Global Reporting Initiative, ISO 26000 Social Responsibility

attributes.name: financial_stability_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score evaluating the vendor's financial health, creditworthiness, liquidity ratios, and solvency. Typically scored 0-100 or 0-10 scale based on financial statement analysis and credit ratings.

attributes.name: geopolitical_risk_score
attributes.description: Score assessing exposure to geopolitical instability, trade restrictions, sanctions, tariffs, political unrest, or regulatory changes in vendor's operating regions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk assessment record was last updated. Audit trail for record modification.

attributes.name: mitigation_actions_required
attributes.description: Detailed description of risk mitigation actions, controls, or remediation steps required to reduce identified risks to acceptable levels. May include contract amendments, additional insurance, dual sourcing, enhanced monitoring, or capability improvements.

attributes.name: mitigation_due_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for mitigation actions. Used to track remediation progress and escalate overdue items.

attributes.name: mitigation_owner
attributes.description: Name or role of the individual or team responsible for executing and tracking mitigation actions (e.g., Category Manager, Supplier Quality Engineer, Procurement Director).

attributes.name: mitigation_status
attributes.description: Current status of mitigation action execution: not started, in progress, completed, on hold pending vendor response, or cancelled if risk is accepted or vendor relationship terminated.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who last modified the risk assessment record. Audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: next_assessment_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic risk assessment. Calculated based on reassessment schedule and current assessment date.

attributes.name: overall_risk_score
attributes.description: Composite quantitative risk score calculated from weighted individual risk category scores. Used to rank vendors and prioritize risk mitigation efforts.

attributes.name: overall_risk_tier
attributes.description: Aggregated risk classification tier derived from individual risk category scores. Determines vendor management intensity, monitoring frequency, and escalation protocols: low (minimal oversight), medium (standard monitoring), high (enhanced controls), critical (executive attention and mitigation required).

attributes.name: quality_risk_score
attributes.description: Score assessing product quality consistency, defect rates, recall history, quality acceptance rate percentage, and adherence to quality management standards such as ISO 9001.

attributes.name: reassessment_schedule
attributes.description: Frequency at which this vendor must be reassessed based on risk tier. Critical and high-risk vendors typically require quarterly or semi-annual reassessment; low-risk vendors may be assessed annually or biennially.

attributes.name: risk_appetite_threshold
attributes.description: Enterprise-defined risk appetite threshold score for this vendor category or spend tier. Vendors scoring above this threshold require executive approval or enhanced mitigation before continuing business.

attributes.name: risk_scoring_methodology
attributes.description: Name or version of the risk scoring framework, algorithm, or methodology applied (e.g., weighted average, Monte Carlo simulation, proprietary enterprise risk model version 2.1).

attributes.name: single_source_dependency_score
attributes.description: Risk score evaluating the business impact if this vendor is the sole or primary source for critical SKUs (Stock Keeping Units), categories, or services. Higher score indicates higher dependency risk.

attributes.name: supply_continuity_risk_score
attributes.description: Score assessing the vendor's ability to maintain continuous supply, including manufacturing capacity, inventory buffers, lead time (supplier delivery duration) reliability, disaster recovery plans, and business continuity preparedness.

attributes.name: third_party_assessment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a third-party risk assessment firm or auditor was engaged to conduct or validate the assessment. True if external assessment was performed, False if internal only.

attributes.name: third_party_assessor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external firm or auditor that conducted the third-party risk assessment, if applicable (e.g., Deloitte, EcoVadis, Dun & Bradstreet).

products.name: vendor_category_sourcing
products.description: This association product represents the sourcing relationship between a vendor and a merchandise category. It captures vendor-category specific sourcing terms, performance targets, and spend allocation strategies managed by buyers and category managers. Each record links one vendor to one category with attributes that exist only in the context of this vendor-category sourcing relationship, including preferred vendor rankings, category-specific lead times, fill rate SLAs, and spend allocation percentages that drive OTB planning and assortment decisions.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, vendors supply multiple merchandise categories (e.g., Procter & Gamble supplies health & beauty, household cleaning, baby care), and each category is sourced from multiple vendors to ensure supply chain resilience, competitive pricing, and assortment diversity. Buyers and category managers actively manage vendor-category sourcing relationships as operational entities, setting preferred vendor rankings, spend allocation targets, category-specific lead times, and fill rate SLAs for each vendor-category pair. This is not an analytical correlation but an operational business process where sourcing strategies, OTB budget allocation, and assortment planning depend on managing these vendor-category relationships as distinct business entities.
