attributes.description: Dedicated customer service phone number for loyalty program member inquiries, support, and issue resolution.

attributes.name: ecommerce_integration_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loyalty program is integrated with the retailers e-commerce platform for online member identification, points accrual, and redemption during digital checkout.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the loyalty program is scheduled to end or was retired. Null for ongoing programs.

attributes.name: enrollment_eligibility_rule
attributes.description: Business rule defining who can enroll in the program (e.g., age 18+, US residents only, minimum purchase requirement, invitation only). Free-text description of eligibility criteria.
attributes.references: FTC - Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Compliance

attributes.name: enrollment_fee_amount
attributes.description: One-time fee charged to enroll in the loyalty program. Zero for free programs.

attributes.name: gamification_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loyalty program incorporates gamification elements such as challenges, badges, leaderboards, or bonus point events to drive engagement.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this loyalty program record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date when the loyalty program was officially launched and made available to customers for enrollment.

attributes.name: mobile_app_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loyalty program has a dedicated mobile application or is accessible through the retailers mobile app for member self-service, digital card, and personalized offers.

attributes.name: omnichannel_recognition_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether loyalty program benefits and points accrual are recognized across all customer touchpoints (in-store POS, e-commerce, mobile app, call center). True for unified omnichannel programs.

attributes.name: partner_coalition_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this loyalty program participates in a coalition with external partners (e.g., airlines, hotels, other retailers) allowing members to earn and redeem across multiple brands.

attributes.name: personalization_engine_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loyalty program leverages AI/ML-driven personalization to deliver individualized offers, recommendations, and communications to members based on purchase history and behavior.

attributes.name: points_currency_name
attributes.description: Name of the points currency used in this program (e.g., Rewards Points, Stars, Miles, Cash Back Dollars). Null for non-points programs.

attributes.name: points_earn_rate
attributes.description: Base rate at which members earn points per unit of spend (e.g., 1.0 = 1 point per dollar, 0.5 = 1 point per 2 dollars). Null for non-points programs.

attributes.name: points_expiry_duration_months
attributes.description: Number of months until points expire, applicable when points_expiry_policy is rolling_months or activity_based. Null for non-expiring programs.

attributes.name: points_expiry_policy
attributes.description: Policy governing when earned points expire: never (no expiration), rolling_months (expire N months after earn date), calendar_year (expire end of year), fixed_date (expire on specific date), activity_based (expire if no activity for N months).

attributes.name: points_redemption_rate
attributes.description: Base rate at which points convert to monetary value for redemption (e.g., 0.01 = 1 point = $0.01, 100 points = $1). Null for non-points programs.

attributes.name: pos_integration_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Point of Sale (POS) Integration Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loyalty program is integrated with in-store POS systems for real-time member identification, points accrual, and redemption at checkout.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: privacy_policy_url
attributes.description: URL to the privacy policy specific to the loyalty program, detailing how member data is collected, used, and protected.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13 - Information to be Provided, CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the loyalty program (e.g., REWARDS_PLUS, GOLD_CLUB). Used in operational systems, customer communications, and integrations.

attributes.name: program_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the loyalty programs value proposition, benefits, and key features. Used for internal reference and customer-facing communications.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Human-readable marketing name of the loyalty program displayed to customers (e.g., Rewards Plus, Gold Member Club, Everyday Savings).
attributes.references: NRF - National Retail Federation Loyalty Standards

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the loyalty program: active (accepting enrollments and accruals), inactive (temporarily paused), suspended (enrollment closed but existing members active), planned (designed but not launched), retired (permanently closed).

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the loyalty program structure: tiered (multiple membership levels with escalating benefits), points_based (earn and redeem points), cashback (percentage rebate), coalition (multi-retailer partnership), co_branded_card (linked to credit card), subscription (paid membership with benefits).

attributes.name: referral_program_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loyalty program includes a member-get-member referral component where existing members earn rewards for referring new enrollees.

attributes.name: target_customer_segment
attributes.description: Primary customer demographic or behavioral segment this loyalty program is designed to attract and retain (e.g., high-value shoppers, frequent buyers, millennials, grocery-focused).

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url
attributes.description: URL to the official terms and conditions document governing the loyalty program, including member rights, obligations, and program rules.

attributes.name: tier_evaluation_period
attributes.description: Time window over which tier qualification is evaluated: calendar_year (Jan-Dec), rolling_12_months (trailing 12 months), program_year (anniversary-based), lifetime (cumulative since enrollment). Null for non-tiered programs.
attributes.references: NRF - Loyalty Tier Management Best Practices

attributes.name: tier_qualification_metric
attributes.description: Primary metric used to qualify members for tier advancement: annual_spend (total dollars spent), points_earned (total points accumulated), transaction_count (number of purchases), hybrid (combination of metrics). Null for non-tiered programs.
attributes.references: NRF - Loyalty Tier Management Best Practices

attributes.name: tier_structure_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this loyalty program has a tiered membership structure with multiple levels (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum). True for tiered programs, false for flat programs.

products.name: loyalty_membership
products.description: Represents an individual customer's active enrollment in a loyalty program. Captures member number, enrollment date, enrollment channel (in-store, online, mobile, referral), current tier, tier qualification date, tier expiry date, previous tier (for downgrade tracking), membership status (active, suspended, lapsed, closed), opt-in preferences, linked customer reference, lifetime points earned, lifetime points redeemed, and tier change history summary. One customer may have memberships across multiple programs. Serves as the anchor entity for all member-level activity — points, redemptions, offers, interactions, and referrals link back here.

attributes.name: loyalty_membership_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty program membership. Primary key.

attributes.name: current_tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: Critical normalization opportunity. membership.current_tier is currently a STRING field (likely storing tier code or name). This should be normalized to a FK to tier.tier_id. The tier table is the aut

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program this membership belongs to. Supports multiple program structures.

attributes.name: primary_loyalty_location_id
attributes.description: Store location where the customer enrolled, if enrollment occurred in-store. Null for digital enrollments.

attributes.name: primary_storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.storefront. Business justification: Members enroll and transact through specific digital storefronts; tracking primary storefront enables channel-specific loyalty offers, omnichannel recognition, and storefront-level member segmentation

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who holds this membership. Links to the customer domain for unified customer view.

attributes.name: referred_by_member_loyalty_membership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the member who referred this customer to the loyalty program. Null if not a referral enrollment.

attributes.name: anniversary_date
attributes.description: Annual anniversary date of membership enrollment. Used for anniversary campaigns and special offers.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the membership was permanently closed or terminated. Null for active, suspended, or lapsed memberships.

attributes.name: closed_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for membership closure. Examples: customer_request, fraud, terms_violation, duplicate_account, deceased.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the membership record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency in which points value and spend amounts are tracked for this membership. Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|EUR|GBP|CAD|AUD|JPY|CNY|INR|BRL|MXN — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: current_points_balance
attributes.description: Current available points balance that can be redeemed. Calculated as lifetime earned minus lifetime redeemed minus expired points.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the customer enrolled in the loyalty program. Supports omnichannel enrollment tracking and channel effectiveness analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: in_store|online|mobile_app|call_center|referral|partner|social_media — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer enrolled in the loyalty program. Used for tenure analysis and anniversary campaigns.

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the membership has been flagged for suspected fraudulent activity. Used for risk management and account review.
attributes.references: FTC (Federal Trade Commission) Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Preferred language for loyalty program communications. Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ENG|SPA|FRA|GER|CHI|JPN|KOR|ARA|POR|RUS — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent member activity (purchase, points redemption, offer engagement, or interaction). Used for lapse risk scoring and reactivation targeting.

attributes.name: last_purchase_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent purchase transaction by the member. Used for recency analysis and churn prediction.

attributes.name: last_redemption_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent points redemption by the member. Used for engagement analysis and redemption behavior tracking.

attributes.name: lifetime_points_earned
attributes.description: Total points earned by the member since enrollment. Includes base points, bonus points, and promotional points. Used for tier qualification and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) analysis.

attributes.name: lifetime_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Total points redeemed by the member since enrollment. Used for engagement analysis and points liability tracking.

attributes.name: member_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique member identifier used for program recognition across all touchpoints (POS, e-commerce, mobile app). Customer-facing identifier.

attributes.name: membership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the membership. Active members can earn and redeem points; suspended members are temporarily blocked; lapsed members have not engaged within retention window; closed memberships are permanently terminated.

attributes.name: next_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the next batch of points will expire. Null if no points are set to expire.

attributes.name: opt_in_direct_mail
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted in to receive loyalty program communications via postal mail.

attributes.name: opt_in_email
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted in to receive loyalty program communications via email.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7, CCPA Section 1798.120, CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: opt_in_push
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted in to receive loyalty program push notifications via mobile app.

attributes.name: opt_in_sms
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted in to receive loyalty program communications via SMS text messages.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7, CCPA Section 1798.120, TCPA Compliance

attributes.name: points_expiring_soon
attributes.description: Points balance that will expire within the next 90 days. Used for expiration reminder campaigns and urgency messaging.

attributes.name: referral_code
attributes.description: Unique referral code assigned to this member for referring new customers to the loyalty program. Used in member-get-member campaigns.

attributes.name: status_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current membership status became effective. Used for status duration analysis and reactivation campaigns.

attributes.name: status_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for the current membership status. Examples: fraud_detected, customer_request, inactivity, terms_violation.

attributes.name: tier_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current tier status expires and re-qualification is required. Null for lifetime tiers.

attributes.name: tier_qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the member qualified for their current tier. Used for tier tenure tracking and re-qualification calculations.

attributes.name: total_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of all purchases by the member since enrollment. Used for monetary analysis, tier qualification, and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) calculation.
attributes.references: RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary) Analysis Standards, FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: total_transactions
attributes.description: Total number of purchase transactions completed by the member since enrollment. Used for frequency analysis and tier qualification.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the membership record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: vip_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is designated as a VIP for special treatment, exclusive access, and personalized service (clienteling).

products.name: tier
products.description: Reference master defining the qualification tiers within a loyalty program (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond). Captures tier name, tier rank/order, qualification threshold (spend or points), maintenance threshold, tier benefits summary, tier badge color, upgrade rules, downgrade rules, and tier validity period. Owned by the loyalty domain as the authoritative tier taxonomy.

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty program tier. Primary key.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent loyalty program to which this tier belongs. A loyalty program may have multiple tiers (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum).

attributes.name: badge_color
attributes.description: Hex color code or color name for the tier badge displayed in digital channels and physical membership cards (e.g., #C0C0C0 for Silver, #FFD700 for Gold, #E5E4E2 for Platinum, #B9F2FF for Diamond).
attributes.references: Internal Brand and Visual Identity Standards

attributes.name: badge_icon_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tier Badge Icon URL (Uniform Resource Locator)
attributes.description: URL to the digital asset (icon or badge image) representing this tier in mobile apps, websites, and digital communications.

attributes.name: benefits_summary
attributes.description: Textual summary of key benefits and privileges associated with this tier (e.g., free shipping, priority customer service, exclusive access to sales, birthday rewards, concierge service). Used for customer communication and marketing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tier record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Sequence number controlling the display order of tiers in customer-facing interfaces (websites, mobile apps, marketing materials). Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: downgrade_rule_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the rules and conditions under which a customer is downgraded from this tier (e.g., automatic if maintenance threshold not met, grace period of 3 months, no downgrades for lifetime tiers).
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Program Rules and Policies

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this tier definition is no longer active for new qualifications. Null indicates the tier is currently active with no planned end date. Existing members may retain status beyond this date per program rules.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this tier definition becomes active and available for customer qualification. Used for managing tier launches and program changes.

attributes.name: grace_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months a customer retains tier status after failing to meet maintenance threshold before being downgraded. Null if no grace period is offered.
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Program Rules and Policies

attributes.name: invitation_only_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tier is available only by invitation from the company (True) or can be achieved through standard qualification rules (False). Typically used for ultra-premium or VIP tiers.
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Program Rules and Policies

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tier record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: lifetime_tier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tier, once achieved, is retained for the customer's lifetime regardless of future activity (True) or is subject to periodic review and potential downgrade (False).
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Program Rules and Policies

attributes.name: maintenance_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months over which the maintenance threshold must be met to retain tier status (e.g., 12 for annual review). Null if no maintenance requirement.
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Program Rules and Policies

attributes.name: maintenance_threshold_value
attributes.description: Numeric value a customer must achieve to maintain this tier after initial qualification. Often lower than qualification threshold to encourage retention. Null if maintenance equals qualification.
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Program Rules and Policies

attributes.name: marketing_description
attributes.description: Extended marketing copy describing the tier's value proposition, benefits, and aspirational messaging. Used in promotional materials, program brochures, and enrollment campaigns.

attributes.name: points_earning_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base points earning rate for members of this tier (e.g., 1.0 for base tier, 1.5 for Gold, 2.0 for Platinum). Higher tiers earn points faster.
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Program Rules and Policies

attributes.name: points_redemption_discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to points required for redemption rewards for this tier (e.g., 0 for base tier, 10 for Gold means 10% fewer points needed, 20 for Platinum). Enhances redemption value for premium tiers.
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Program Rules and Policies

attributes.name: qualification_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months over which the qualification threshold must be met (e.g., 12 for annual qualification, 3 for quarterly). Null indicates lifetime qualification.
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Program Rules and Policies

attributes.name: qualification_threshold_type
attributes.description: The metric used to determine tier qualification: spend (total monetary spend), points (loyalty points earned), transactions (number of purchases), or hybrid (combination of multiple metrics).
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Program Rules and Policies

attributes.name: qualification_threshold_value
attributes.description: Numeric value a customer must achieve to qualify for this tier (e.g., $5000 annual spend, 10000 points earned, 50 transactions). Interpretation depends on qualification_threshold_type.
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Program Rules and Policies

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Terms and Conditions URL (Uniform Resource Locator)
attributes.description: URL to the legal terms and conditions document governing this tier's benefits, qualification rules, and member obligations.

attributes.name: tier_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the tier within the program (e.g., SILVER, GOLD, PLAT, DIAM). Used for system integration and reporting.

attributes.name: tier_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the loyalty tier displayed to customers (e.g., Silver Member, Gold Member, Platinum Elite, Diamond VIP).

attributes.name: tier_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal ranking of the tier within the loyalty program hierarchy. Lower numbers indicate entry-level tiers; higher numbers indicate premium tiers (e.g., 1=Silver, 2=Gold, 3=Platinum, 4=Diamond).

attributes.name: tier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tier. Active tiers are available for customer enrollment and qualification; inactive tiers are no longer offered but may have legacy members; deprecated tiers are being phased out; planned tiers are under development.
attributes.references: Internal Master Data Lifecycle Management Standards

attributes.name: upgrade_rule_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the rules and conditions under which a customer is upgraded to this tier (e.g., automatic upon reaching threshold, manual review required, invitation-only for top tier).
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Program Rules and Policies

products.name: points_ledger
products.description: Immutable append-only ledger recording every points movement for a loyalty membership, including tier-change qualification events. Each entry captures transaction type (earn, redeem, expire, adjust, bonus, transfer, reversal, tier_qualify), signed points amount, source reference (POS transaction, order, promotion, partner, tier evaluation), channel, location, timestamp, running balance, and optional tier-change metadata (previous tier, new tier, qualifying period). Serves as the financial-grade audit trail for points liability management, ASC 606 compliance evidence, tier history reporting, and CLTV calculation. No updates or deletes — corrections are posted as reversal entries. Tier qualification events include the qualifying spend/points amount and evaluation period for complete audit trail.

attributes.name: points_ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each points ledger entry. Primary key for the immutable append-only ledger.

attributes.name: accrual_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.accrual_rule. Business justification: Points ledger entries of type 'earn' should reference which accrual rule generated the points. This is critical for audit trail, analytics (which rules drive the most engagement), and dispute resoluti

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who processed the transaction or manual adjustment. Null for automated system transactions. Used for customer service audit and clienteling attribution.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the targeted engagement or marketing campaign that triggered this points transaction. Null for organic transactions. Enables campaign effectiveness measurement.

attributes.name: cart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.cart. Business justification: Points redemption can occur at cart level before order placement; tracking cart enables pre-order points reservation, cart abandonment recovery with points incentives, and real-time points balance upd

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the e-commerce or omnichannel order that generated this points transaction. Null for in-store POS transactions not linked to an order. Enables order-to-loyalty reconciliation.

attributes.name: liability_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Points accrual creates financial liability that must be recorded in specific GL accounts (typically deferred revenue or loyalty liability accounts). Every points transaction requires GL account mappin

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical store location where the transaction occurred. Null for online, mobile, or partner channels. Used for store-level loyalty performance reporting.

attributes.name: loyalty_membership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty membership account for which this points transaction was recorded.

attributes.name: membership_id
attributes.description: FK to loyalty.membership.membership_id — Points ledger to membership is the core loyalty accounting join. Every points balance inquiry, tier qualification check, and loyalty statement requires this link.

attributes.name: partner_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.partner_transaction. Business justification: Points earned or redeemed through coalition partners should reference the partner_transaction record. Currently points_ledger has a generic partner_id field, but linking to the specific partner_transa

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.pos_transaction. Business justification: Majority of loyalty points are earned at POS; direct link enables real-time posting, receipt printing with earned points, POS-loyalty reconciliation, and audit trail for in-store transactions.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing promotion or campaign that triggered bonus points or special earn rate. Null for standard earn transactions. Supports promotion ROI analysis.

attributes.name: redemption_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.redemption. Business justification: Critical reconciliation link. When a redemption occurs, it generates a points_ledger entry (debit). The ledger should reference the redemption transaction for full traceability. Currently points_ledge

attributes.name: redemption_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.redemption_rule. Business justification: Points ledger entries of type 'redeem' should reference which redemption rule was applied. Parallel to accrual_rule_id, this enables audit trail for rule enforcement, compliance reporting, and analyti

attributes.name: reversal_reference_points_ledger_id
attributes.description: Points ledger ID of the original transaction being reversed. Populated only for transaction_type = reversal. Creates audit trail linking correction to original entry.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for manual points adjustments. Populated only for transaction_type = adjust. Provides business context for non-standard transactions requiring audit trail.

attributes.name: base_currency_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value in base currency (USD, EUR, etc.) that generated the points earn. Used to calculate points-per-dollar ratio and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV). Null for non-purchase transactions.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Identifier for bulk processing batch if this transaction was part of a batch operation (e.g., monthly expiration run, partner file import). Null for real-time individual transactions.

attributes.name: breakage_rate
attributes.description: Expected percentage of points that will never be redeemed (expire or go unused). Applied at transaction time for liability calculation. Expressed as decimal (e.g., 0.15 for 15% breakage).

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the points transaction was initiated: store (physical retail location), online (e-commerce website), mobile_app (branded mobile application), call_center (customer service phone interaction), partner (third-party loyalty partner), kiosk (self-service terminal).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this ledger entry was created in the data platform. Distinct from transaction_timestamp which reflects the business event time. Used for data lineage and audit.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the base currency amount. Null if no monetary value is associated with the transaction.

attributes.name: earn_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base earn rate for this transaction. Standard earn is 1.0, promotional or tier-based accelerators may be 2.0, 3.0, etc. Null for non-earn transactions.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the points from this earn transaction will expire if not redeemed. Null for transactions that do not generate expiring points (redemptions, adjustments). Critical for points liability forecasting.

attributes.name: is_promotional
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this points transaction was part of a promotional or bonus program (True) or standard program rules (False). Used to segment promotional vs. organic points activity.

attributes.name: new_tier
attributes.description: Loyalty membership tier after this transaction. Populated only for transaction_type = tier_qualify. Records the tier achieved through qualification event.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Optional free-text notes providing additional context for the transaction. Used for customer service annotations, special handling instructions, or audit clarifications.

attributes.name: points_amount
attributes.description: Signed points value for this transaction. Positive for earn/bonus/transfer-in, negative for redeem/expire/transfer-out. Supports fractional points for partner conversions.

attributes.name: points_liability_amount
attributes.description: Estimated monetary liability (in base currency) associated with the points in this transaction. Calculated using breakage-adjusted redemption value. Critical for ASC 606 deferred revenue accounting.

attributes.name: previous_tier
attributes.description: Loyalty membership tier before this transaction. Populated only for transaction_type = tier_qualify. Captures tier transition history for member journey analysis.

attributes.name: qualification_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the evaluation period used to assess tier qualification. Populated only for transaction_type = tier_qualify. Completes the qualification window definition.

attributes.name: qualification_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the evaluation period used to assess tier qualification. Populated only for transaction_type = tier_qualify. Defines the rolling window or calendar period for tier assessment.

attributes.name: qualifying_points_amount
attributes.description: Total points earned that qualified the member for tier change. Populated only for transaction_type = tier_qualify. Alternative or complementary qualification metric to spend.

attributes.name: qualifying_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total spend amount that qualified the member for tier change. Populated only for transaction_type = tier_qualify. Provides evidence for tier qualification audit.

attributes.name: redemption_value_per_point
attributes.description: Estimated monetary value (in base currency) of one loyalty point at time of transaction. Used to calculate points liability. May vary by tier, promotion, or partner agreement.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for reversing a prior points transaction: return (product returned), cancellation (order cancelled), fraud (fraudulent activity detected), system_error (technical issue correction), customer_service (goodwill adjustment). Populated only for reversal transactions.
attributes.references: Customer Service and Fraud Prevention Standard

attributes.name: running_balance
attributes.description: Cumulative points balance for the membership after this transaction is applied. Provides snapshot of available points at this moment in time.

attributes.name: source_reference_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating transaction or event in the source system. Links back to POS transaction ID, order number, promotion code, partner transaction ID, or adjustment ticket number for full audit trail.

attributes.name: source_reference_type
attributes.description: Category of the originating business event that triggered this points transaction: pos_transaction (in-store purchase via Point of Sale), order (e-commerce or omnichannel order), promotion (marketing campaign or offer), partner (third-party loyalty partner activity), tier_evaluation (automated tier qualification assessment), manual_adjustment (customer service or program admin correction), campaign (targeted engagement initiative). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pos_transaction|order|promotion|partner|tier_evaluation|manual_adjustment|campaign — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current status of the points transaction: posted (successfully recorded and balance updated), pending (awaiting confirmation or settlement), reversed (cancelled via reversal entry), failed (transaction rejected by system). Immutable ledger typically contains only posted entries.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the points transaction occurred in the source system. Business event timestamp for the points movement.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of points movement: earn (points accrued from purchase or activity), redeem (points spent on rewards), expire (points lapsed due to inactivity or time limit), adjust (manual correction by program administrator), bonus (promotional or campaign points grant), transfer (points moved between accounts or partners), reversal (correction of a prior transaction), tier_qualify (points milestone triggering tier change). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: earn|redeem|expire|adjust|bonus|transfer|reversal|tier_qualify — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: accrual_rule
products.description: Defines the business rules governing how points are earned by members. Captures rule name, program association, earning rate (points per dollar spent, per unit purchased, per visit), applicable product categories or SKUs, applicable channels (in-store, online, BOPIS), minimum spend threshold, bonus multiplier conditions, rule effective dates, and rule priority for conflict resolution. attributes.name: member_tier_eligibility

attributes.name: minimum_spend_threshold

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: payment_method_restriction

attributes.name: points_per_unit

attributes.name: pricing_strategy_alignment
attributes.description: Indicates which pricing strategy this accrual rule supports: EDLP (Everyday Low Price), Hi-Lo (High-Low promotional pricing), or hybrid.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the accrual rule, used for external reference and system integration.

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the accrual rule, including business rationale, conditions, and examples.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the accrual rule describing its purpose (e.g., 'Base Earn Rate', 'Grocery Bonus', 'BOPIS Double Points').

attributes.name: rule_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for conflict resolution when multiple accrual rules apply to the same transaction. Lower numbers indicate higher priority (1 = highest).

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the accrual rule by its application logic: base earning rate, bonus multiplier, category-specific, SKU-specific, channel-specific, or tier-specific.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or application where this accrual rule was originally defined (e.g., 'Salesforce Commerce Cloud', 'Oracle Retail', 'Custom Loyalty Engine').

attributes.name: stacking_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accrual rule can be combined (stacked) with other accrual rules in the same transaction. True = stacking allowed, False = exclusive rule.

attributes.name: time_of_day_restriction
attributes.description: Specific time windows when this accrual rule applies (e.g., '09:00-12:00', 'happy hour'). Null if rule applies all day.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this accrual rule, incremented with each modification to support change tracking and audit history.

products.name: redemption_rule

Distinct from accrual rules as redemption has its own approval workflow, liability impact, and POS integration requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: liability_impact_category

attributes.name: redemption_currency_code

attributes.name: redemption_rate

attributes.name: redemption_rule_status

attributes.name: requires_approval_flag

attributes.name: rounding_rule

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this redemption rule, incremented with each modification to support change tracking and audit history.

products.name: reward
products.description: Master catalog of all rewards available for redemption within a loyalty program. Captures reward name, reward type (discount voucher, free product, gift card, experience, charitable donation), points cost, monetary value equivalent, reward category, availability dates, quantity limit, channel availability (in-store, online), image URL, terms and conditions, and reward status (active, sold out, discontinued). Analogous to a PIM for the rewards catalog.

attributes.name: reward_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the reward in the loyalty program catalog. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_format. Business justification: Reward eligibility restricted by format (experiential rewards only at flagship, bulk discounts only at warehouse). Retail loyalty catalogs curated per format to match inventory, service capabilities,

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_hierarchy. Business justification: Rewards frequently target categories (e.g., '$5 off grocery', '10% off apparel'). Category-scoped rewards are a fundamental loyalty reward type requiring this link for reward catalog management and re

attributes.name: partner_vendor_id
attributes.description: External identifier for the partner vendor in the vendor management system. Null for internally-fulfilled rewards.

attributes.name: product_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_brand. Business justification: Brand-specific rewards are common (e.g., '$10 off Nike', '20% off private label'). Brand-targeted rewards support vendor partnerships and private label strategy requiring this link for brand-scoped re

attributes.description: Comma-separated list of brand codes this reward applies to or excludes. Null if no brand restriction. Supports brand-sponsored rewards.

attributes.name: category_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product category codes this reward applies to or excludes (e.g., 'ELECTRONICS,APPAREL'). Null if no category restriction.

attributes.name: channel_availability
attributes.description: Channels where this reward can be redeemed: in-store (physical locations), online (e-commerce site), mobile app, call center, or all channels (omnichannel). Supports channel-specific reward strategies.

attributes.name: cost_to_business
attributes.description: Internal cost to the business for fulfilling this reward (e.g., wholesale cost, partner fee). Used for program ROI analysis and points liability valuation. Business-confidential.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this reward record. Part of audit trail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reward record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the monetary value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: description_long

attributes.name: description_short
attributes.description: Brief customer-facing description of the reward (typically 1-2 sentences), used in catalog list views and mobile notifications.

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: For discount voucher rewards, specifies the discount mechanism: percentage (e.g., 20% off), fixed amount (e.g., $10 off), free shipping, buy-one-get-one (BOGO), or tiered (discount varies by spend threshold). Null for non-discount reward types.

attributes.name: discount_value
attributes.description: Numeric value of the discount. For percentage discounts, this is the percentage (e.g., 15.00 for 15%). For fixed amount, this is the currency amount. Null for non-discount rewards.

attributes.name: display_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority for sorting rewards in catalog displays. Lower numbers appear first. Used for merchandising control of reward visibility.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this reward is no longer available for redemption. Null for rewards with no expiration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this reward becomes available for redemption. Part of the rewards availability window.

attributes.name: eligible_member_tiers

attributes.name: geographic_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic codes (country, state, or store codes) where this reward can be redeemed. Null if no geographic restriction. Supports regional reward strategies.

attributes.name: image_url
attributes.description: URL to the primary image asset for this reward, used in customer-facing catalog displays and mobile app.

attributes.name: is_combinable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this reward can be combined with other rewards or promotions in a single transaction. True if combinable, false if exclusive.

attributes.name: is_featured
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this reward is featured in promotional displays and priority catalog positions. True for featured rewards, false otherwise.

attributes.name: margin_percentage
attributes.description: Calculated margin percentage between monetary value and cost to business ((monetary_value - cost_to_business) / monetary_value * 100). Used for reward profitability analysis. Business-confidential.

attributes.name: maximum_discount_amount
attributes.description: Cap on the discount amount for percentage-based rewards (e.g., 20% off up to $50 maximum discount). Null if no cap applies.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_amount
attributes.description: Minimum transaction amount required to redeem this reward. Null if no minimum applies. Used to enforce redemption rules and protect margin.

attributes.name: monetary_value
attributes.description: Approximate monetary value of the reward in the base currency, used for points liability accounting and customer value communication.

attributes.name: points_cost
attributes.description: Number of loyalty points required to redeem this reward. Core pricing mechanism for the loyalty program.

attributes.name: product_sku_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SKU codes this reward applies to or excludes. Used for product-specific rewards (e.g., free product reward for specific SKU). Null if no SKU restriction.

attributes.name: quantity_available
attributes.description: Current inventory count of this reward available for redemption. Null for unlimited digital rewards. Decremented upon redemption.

attributes.name: quantity_limit_per_member
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a single loyalty member can redeem this reward within the validity period. Null for no limit.

attributes.name: redemption_validity_days
attributes.description: Number of days from redemption date that the reward voucher or certificate remains valid for use. Null for instant-use rewards.

attributes.name: reward_category
attributes.description: Business classification grouping for the reward (e.g., 'Grocery', 'Apparel', 'Electronics', 'Travel', 'Dining', 'Wellness'). Used for catalog navigation and reporting.

attributes.name: reward_code
attributes.description: Externally-facing unique alphanumeric code for the reward, used in customer communications and redemption interfaces.

attributes.name: reward_name
attributes.description: Customer-facing display name of the reward (e.g., '$10 Off Next Purchase', 'Free Coffee', 'Premium Gift Card').

attributes.name: reward_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the reward in the catalog. Active: available for redemption. Inactive: temporarily unavailable. Sold out: inventory depleted. Discontinued: permanently removed. Pending approval: awaiting merchandising review.

attributes.name: reward_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reward by its nature: discount voucher (percentage or fixed amount off), free product (complimentary item), gift card (prepaid card), experience (event or service), charitable donation (contribution to cause), cashback (monetary return), or points multiplier (bonus points on future purchases). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: discount_voucher|free_product|gift_card|experience|charitable_donation|cashback|points_multiplier — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: thumbnail_url

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this reward record. Part of audit trail.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reward record was last modified. Part of audit trail for change tracking.

products.name: redemption
products.description: Transactional record of each redemption event by a loyalty member, covering both catalog reward redemptions and personalized offer activations. Drives points liability reduction, reward fulfillment workflows, and offer performance measurement.

attributes.name: member_offer_id

attributes.description: Reference to the third-party partner organization if the redemption was for a partner reward or occurred through a partner channel. Null for internal rewards.

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the POS transaction where the redemption was applied in-store. Null for online or unused redemptions.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.redemption_rule. Business justification: Every redemption should reference which redemption rule allowed it (minimum points threshold, eligible channels, tier requirements, etc.). This is essential for compliance, audit, and analytics. Curre

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.revenue_recognition_event. Business justification: Redemptions trigger revenue recognition events under ASC 606. When customers redeem points for rewards, deferred revenue liability is reduced and revenue is recognized. This link is required for compl

attributes.description: Reference to the reward catalog item redeemed, if redemption type is catalog reward. Null for offer-based redemptions.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp

attributes.name: channel

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: fraud_detection_score

attributes.name: monetary_value

attributes.name: redemption_type

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the redemption was reversed: product return, order cancellation, service failure, system error, fraud reversal, or goodwill gesture.

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: tier_at_redemption
attributes.description: The loyalty program tier level of the member at the time of redemption (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum). Captured for tier-based redemption analysis and benefit tracking.

attributes.name: usage_timestamp

attributes.name: voucher_code

products.name: campaign_storefront_deployment
products.description: This association product represents the deployment of a loyalty engagement campaign to a specific digital storefront. It captures storefront-specific campaign configuration, launch timing, budget allocation, and performance metrics that exist only in the context of this campaign-storefront pairing. Each record links one engagement_campaign to one storefront with attributes tracking how that campaign performs on that specific channel.. Existence Justification: Loyalty engagement campaigns are deployed across multiple digital storefronts simultaneously as part of omnichannel marketing strategies, and each storefront hosts multiple campaigns concurrently. The business actively manages campaign-storefront deployments as operational entities, tracking storefront-specific launch timing, budget allocation, enrollment counts, participation metrics, and conversion rates. This is not an analytical correlation but an operational business process where campaign managers deploy campaigns TO storefronts and monitor performance BY storefront.

domains.name: ecommerce
domains.description: Manages digital commerce operations including online storefronts, product catalogs, shopping carts, checkout flows, digital payment processing, session tracking, CTR (Click-Through Rate), CR (Conversion Rate), AOV (Average Order Value), and GMV (Gross Merchandise Value). Tracks digital customer journeys, abandoned carts, and online-to-offline attribution. Integrates with Salesforce Commerce Cloud for unified digital commerce platform.

products.name: storefront
products.description: Master record for each digital storefront or online channel operated by Retail, including the main e-commerce site, mobile app storefronts, and marketplace presences. Captures storefront identity, locale, currency, domain URL, platform configuration (Salesforce Commerce Cloud site ID, channel-specific settings, feature flags, theme/template references), launch date, status, supported payment methods, and supported fulfillment modes (BOPIS, ship-to-home, drop-ship). SSOT for digital channel identity and configuration within the e-commerce domain. Domain ownership principle: the ecommerce domain owns digital commerce operations from storefront configuration through checkout completion. Customer identity is owned by the customer domain; post-checkout order lifecycle is owned by the order domain; promotional campaign definitions are owned by the promotion domain; product master data is owned by the product domain.

attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the primary transactional currency for this storefront (e.g., 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR'). Governs pricing display, checkout totals, AOV calculations, and GMV reporting. Aligns with Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) currency configuration.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: customer_service_email
attributes.description: The operational customer service email address displayed to customers on this storefront for support inquiries, returns (RMA — Return Merchandise Authorization), and complaints. Routed to Salesforce Service Cloud for case management. Classified confidential as an organizational contact identifier.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13 — Information to be Provided; FTC — Consumer Protection Contact Requirements; Salesforce Service Cloud

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this storefront was or is scheduled to be permanently retired and removed from active digital commerce operations. Nullable for currently active storefronts. Used for channel sunset planning, data retention scheduling, and regulatory compliance archival.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Lifecycle Management; GDPR Article 17 — Right to Erasure

attributes.name: default_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code representing the default display language for this storefront (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'es'). Used when a customer's browser language preference cannot be resolved or when the storefront operates in a single-language mode. Distinct from locale_code which also encodes regional formatting.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 — Language Codes; W3C Internationalization Standards

attributes.name: domain_url
attributes.description: The primary public-facing domain URL for this storefront (e.g., 'https://www.retail.com' or 'https://m.retail.com'). Used for SEO configuration, SSL certificate management, CDN routing, and digital marketing attribution. Classified confidential as it represents proprietary digital infrastructure configuration.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Security Management; PCI DSS — Secure URL and domain management

attributes.name: free_shipping_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum order value (in the storefront's primary currency) at which free standard shipping is automatically applied at checkout. A key lever for AOV (Average Order Value) optimization and customer acquisition. Configured in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) or Salesforce Commerce Cloud promotion rules.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF — Promotions Management Standards; FTC — Advertising and Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront is subject to GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) consent requirements, triggering cookie consent banners, data processing notices, and opt-in workflows for customers in EU/EEA jurisdictions. Drives compliance configuration in Salesforce Commerce Cloud and CRM systems.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 — Conditions for Consent; GDPR Article 13 — Information to be Provided; EU ePrivacy Directive

attributes.name: is_bopis_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports the BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) fulfillment mode, allowing customers to purchase online and collect from a physical store location. Drives fulfillment routing logic in the OMS (Order Management System) and store operations workflows.
attributes.references: NRF — Omnichannel Fulfillment Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — BOPIS Configuration

attributes.name: is_drop_ship_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports drop-ship fulfillment, where vendors ship products directly to customers without passing through Retail's DC (Distribution Center). Relevant for extended assortment and marketplace-style operations. Aligns with supplier management and EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) integration.
attributes.references: NRF — Drop Ship Vendor Standards; GS1 — EDI Standards for Direct-to-Consumer Fulfillment

attributes.name: is_loyalty_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront is integrated with Retail's customer loyalty and engagement program, enabling points accrual, redemption, and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) tracking at the digital channel level. Drives loyalty-specific promotional targeting and RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary) segmentation.
attributes.references: NRF — Customer Loyalty Program Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Loyalty Integration

attributes.name: is_ropis_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS) Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports ROPIS (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store), allowing customers to reserve items online without payment and collect them in-store. Distinct from BOPIS in that no payment transaction occurs at the digital checkout stage.
attributes.references: NRF — Omnichannel Commerce Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — ROPIS Configuration

attributes.name: is_ship_from_store_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports SFS (Ship-from-Store) fulfillment, where physical store locations act as fulfillment centers for online orders. Enables distributed inventory utilization and faster last-mile delivery. Integrates with Manhattan Associates WMS for store-level pick/pack/ship operations.
attributes.references: NRF — Ship-from-Store Operational Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS — Store Fulfillment Module

attributes.name: is_ship_to_home_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports ship-to-home fulfillment, where orders are dispatched from a DC (Distribution Center) or store directly to the customer's delivery address. Governs last-mile delivery eligibility and carrier integration activation for this channel.
attributes.references: NRF — Last Mile Delivery Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS — Fulfillment Mode Configuration

attributes.name: is_tax_inclusive_pricing
attributes.description: Indicates whether product prices displayed on this storefront include taxes (tax-inclusive, common in EU/UK markets) or exclude taxes (tax-exclusive, common in US markets). Governs price display logic at the product listing and checkout stages. Aligns with Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) tax display configuration.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this storefront record was most recently updated in the system of record. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Audit Logging Requirements; GDPR Article 5 — Accountability Principle; Informatica MDM

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this storefront was first made publicly available to customers. Used for channel age analysis, anniversary promotions, and historical performance benchmarking. Represents the effective-from date for the storefront's commercial lifecycle.
attributes.references: NRF — Digital Commerce Channel Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 locale code defining the primary language and regional formatting for this storefront (e.g., 'en_US', 'fr_CA', 'es_MX'). Controls language display, date/number formatting, and content localization within Salesforce Commerce Cloud. Critical for omnichannel customer experience consistency.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47 — Language Tag Standard; ISO 639-1 Language Codes; ISO 3166-1 Country Codes

attributes.name: max_cart_line_items
attributes.description: The maximum number of distinct line items (SKUs) permitted in a single shopping cart session on this storefront. Governs cart capacity limits configured in Salesforce Commerce Cloud to manage checkout performance and order processing capacity. Relevant for B2B or bulk-purchase storefronts.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Cart Configuration; NRF — E-Commerce Operations Standards

attributes.name: min_order_amount
attributes.description: The minimum cart value (in the storefront's primary currency) required for a customer to complete checkout on this storefront. Used to enforce MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) value thresholds, qualify for free shipping promotions, or meet marketplace seller requirements. Configured in Salesforce Commerce Cloud checkout rules.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Checkout Configuration; NRF — Pricing and Promotions Standards

attributes.name: pci_compliance_level
attributes.description: The PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) merchant compliance level assigned to this storefront, determined by annual card transaction volume (Level 1: >6M transactions; Level 2: 1M–6M; Level 3: 20K–1M; Level 4: <20K). Governs the scope of annual security assessments and SAQ (Self-Assessment Questionnaire) requirements. Classified confidential as it reveals security posture.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Merchant Compliance Levels; PCI SSC — Merchant Level Definitions

attributes.name: platform_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) platform release deployed for this storefront (e.g., 'SFCC 23.7', 'B2C Commerce 22.10'). Used for release management, compatibility tracking, and upgrade planning across the digital commerce estate.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Release Management Documentation

attributes.name: robots_indexing_policy
attributes.description: The default robots meta directive applied to this storefront, controlling whether search engine crawlers may index pages and follow links (e.g., 'index_follow' for the main site, 'noindex_nofollow' for staging or dark-store channels). Impacts organic search visibility and SEO strategy.
attributes.references: NRF — Digital Commerce SEO Standards; FTC — Digital Advertising Transparency

attributes.name: seo_meta_title
attributes.description: The default HTML meta title tag content for the storefront's homepage, used by search engines for indexing and SERP (Search Engine Results Page) display. Impacts organic search traffic and digital marketing performance. Managed within Salesforce Commerce Cloud site preferences.
attributes.references: NRF — Digital Commerce SEO Best Practices; FTC — Advertising Standards for Digital Channels

attributes.name: session_timeout_minutes
attributes.description: The number of minutes of customer inactivity after which a shopping session is automatically expired on this storefront. Governs cart abandonment timing, session-based analytics, and security compliance for authenticated customer sessions. Configured in Salesforce Commerce Cloud site security settings.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Session Management Requirements; ISO 27001 — Access Control; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Security Configuration

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique site identifier assigned within Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) for this storefront. Used as the operational reference key across digital commerce platform configurations, API calls, and integration touchpoints. Aligns to the SFCC Site object's siteID field.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Site Management API; GS1 digital channel identification standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this storefront record was sourced or last updated (e.g., 'SFCC' for Salesforce Commerce Cloud, 'MDM' for Informatica MDM, 'MANUAL' for manually entered records). Used for data lineage tracking, reconciliation, and master data governance within the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM — Data Lineage Standards; ISO 27001 — Information Asset Management

attributes.name: storefront_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the digital storefront or online channel (e.g., 'Retail Main Site', 'Retail Mobile App', 'Retail Marketplace — Amazon'). Used in reporting dashboards, operational tooling, and business communications.
attributes.references: NRF — Digital Commerce Channel Naming Standards

attributes.name: storefront_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle state of the storefront. 'active' indicates the storefront is live and accepting customer traffic; 'maintenance' indicates a temporary service window; 'draft' indicates pre-launch configuration; 'decommissioned' indicates the channel has been permanently retired. Governs whether the storefront is eligible for traffic routing, promotional targeting, and digital commerce operations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Site Status management; NRF Digital Operations Standards

attributes.name: supported_payment_methods
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of payment methods accepted at checkout on this storefront (e.g., 'credit_card,debit_card,paypal,apple_pay,google_pay,gift_card,buy_now_pay_later'). Governs payment gateway configuration and PCI DSS compliance scope for this channel. Managed within Salesforce Commerce Cloud payment processor settings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|paypal|apple_pay|google_pay|gift_card|buy_now_pay_later|bank_transfer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard; PCI SSC — Accepted Payment Methods; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Payment Integration

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary tax jurisdiction applicable to this storefront for sales tax, VAT, or GST calculation purposes (e.g., 'US-CA', 'CA-ON', 'GB'). Used by the tax engine integrated with Salesforce Commerce Cloud to apply correct tax rates at checkout. Aligns with FASB ASC 606 revenue recognition and FTC pricing transparency requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; FTC — Pricing Transparency Requirements; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Tax Configuration

attributes.name: theme_code
attributes.description: Identifier referencing the visual theme or template applied to this storefront within Salesforce Commerce Cloud (e.g., 'sfra-retail-v3', 'pwa-kit-2024'). Controls the storefront's UI/UX presentation layer, including layout, typography, and brand styling. Used by digital merchandising and visual merchandising teams for planogram-equivalent digital shelf configuration.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Storefront Reference Architecture (SFRA) Documentation

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the storefront's primary operating time zone (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'America/Los_Angeles'). Used for scheduling promotional campaigns, flash sales, maintenance windows, and business-hours-based SLA calculations. Aligns with Salesforce Commerce Cloud site time zone configuration.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; NRF — Digital Commerce Operations Standards

products.name: digital_catalog
products.description: E-commerce product catalog record representing the published, channel-specific view of merchandise available on a given storefront. Tracks which SKUs are active online, digital content completeness (images, descriptions, rich media), SEO metadata (title, meta description, canonical URL), online availability flags, digital-only pricing overrides, and publication status. This is the digital presentation layer — distinct from the master product catalog in the product domain which owns canonical SKU/UPC definitions and the master merchandise hierarchy.

attributes.name: digital_catalog_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each digital catalog record representing a channel-specific published view of a SKU on a given storefront. Primary key for this entity. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a digital presentation asset managed and published via Salesforce Commerce Cloud.

attributes.name: buyer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.buyer. Business justification: Buyers manage online assortment, pricing strategy, and product content decisions for their assigned categories. Digital catalog accountability and performance reporting require buyer attribution for m

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary digital storefront category (navigation taxonomy node) under which this SKU is merchandised online. May differ from the master merchandise hierarchy in ORMS to reflect digital-specific category management and assortment breadth strategies.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Category Management; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.demand_forecast. Business justification: Merchandising teams use demand forecasts to optimize online pricing, promotional timing, and product visibility. Direct link enables forecast-driven catalog management and dynamic pricing based on pre

attributes.name: inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.inventory_node. Business justification: Online catalog displays store-level availability for BOPIS and ship-from-store fulfillment options. Enables "available at nearby stores" feature and store inventory lookup for omnichannel shoppers.

attributes.name: license_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.license_permit. Business justification: Regulated products (alcohol, tobacco, pharmaceuticals, firearms) require valid licenses to sell. Retail must link catalog SKUs to permits to enforce sales restrictions, prevent unlicensed sales, and p

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_location. Business justification: Products displayed online show store-specific availability and fulfillment options. Real business process: "check store availability" feature, store-specific assortment display, local inventory querie

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Catalog items are assigned to profit centers for gross margin analysis, markdown accounting, channel profitability reporting, and product line P&L in retail management accounting systems.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Product pages display active promotions; linking enables merchandising teams to verify promotional pricing accuracy across catalog, SEO teams to optimize promotional landing pages, and compliance team

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.season. Business justification: Online catalog organized by retail seasons (Spring/Summer, Fall/Winter, Holiday). Seasonal merchandising drives publish/unpublish schedules, promotional calendars, and assortment planning. Critical fo

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Catalog publishing process requires authoritative link to product master for attributes, compliance flags, lifecycle status, vendor data, and pricing rules. Retail operations depend on single source o

attributes.name: sku_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.sku_price. Business justification: Digital catalog product pages must display authoritative online prices from sku_price, which maintains channel-specific and zone-specific pricing. Core business process: e-commerce price display and c

attributes.name: age_restriction
attributes.description: Age-gating requirement for this SKU on the digital storefront, applicable to regulated product categories such as alcohol, tobacco, and certain pharmaceuticals. Drives age verification workflows at checkout. Regulated by FTC and FDA.
attributes.references: FTC — Consumer Protection; FDA — Age-Restricted Product Sales; CPSC — Product Safety

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Consumer-facing brand name associated with this SKU as displayed on the digital storefront. Used for brand-level filtering, faceted navigation, and brand page attribution. Includes private label (store brand) designations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Product Attributes; Informatica MDM — Brand Master

attributes.name: canonical_url
attributes.description: The canonical URL of the product detail page (PDP) used to prevent duplicate content issues across multiple storefront URLs or faceted navigation paths. Declared in the HTML link rel=canonical tag. Managed in Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — SEO Configuration; Google Search Central Guidelines

attributes.name: content_completeness_score
attributes.description: Percentage score (0.00–100.00) measuring how complete the digital content is for this catalog record, based on presence of required fields such as title, description, images, SEO metadata, and rich media. Used to prioritize content enrichment efforts and improve Conversion Rate (CR).
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Content Quality Scoring; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this digital catalog record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and content age analysis. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Security Audit; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the online_price for this digital catalog record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency storefronts in international e-commerce operations.

attributes.name: has_video
attributes.description: Indicates whether at least one product video (e.g., demonstration, unboxing, lifestyle) is published for this SKU on the storefront. Rich media presence is a key driver of Conversion Rate (CR) improvement in digital commerce.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Rich Media Management; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU contains hazardous materials subject to special shipping, handling, or labeling requirements. Affects last-mile delivery eligibility and carrier selection in the Order Management System (OMS). Regulated by CPSC and OSHA.
attributes.references: CPSC — Hazardous Substance Regulations; OSHA — Hazardous Materials Handling

attributes.name: image_count
attributes.description: Total number of product images published for this SKU on the storefront, including hero, alternate angles, lifestyle, and swatch images. Used to measure digital content completeness and identify SKUs requiring additional imagery.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Digital Asset Management; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: is_drop_ship_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is fulfilled via Drop Ship, where the vendor ships directly to the customer without passing through a Distribution Center (DC). Relevant for extended aisle and marketplace assortment strategies.
attributes.references: NRF — Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) and Drop Ship Standards

attributes.name: is_featured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU has been manually designated as a featured product by digital merchandisers, qualifying it for placement in featured product carousels, homepage spotlights, or category hero positions on the storefront.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Merchandising Rules; NRF — Visual Merchandising Standards

attributes.name: is_online_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is currently available for purchase on the digital storefront. Distinct from publication_status — a product may be published but temporarily unavailable due to inventory depletion or fulfillment constraints. Drives add-to-cart eligibility.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Inventory Availability; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: is_private_label
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is a private label (store brand) product owned and sold exclusively by the retailer. Private label products typically carry higher gross margins and are a key strategic differentiator in assortment planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) — Assortment Planning; NRF — Private Label Standards

attributes.name: is_searchable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is indexed and returned in on-site search results on the digital storefront. A product may be published but excluded from search (e.g., exclusive landing page products or clearance items managed via direct URL only).
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Index Configuration

attributes.name: last_published_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when this digital catalog record was most recently published or re-published to the live storefront. Used for content freshness tracking, cache invalidation, and audit trails in Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Publish History; ISO 27001 — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: locale_code
