attributes.description: Reference to the digital storefront (e.g., desktop web, mobile web, mobile app, marketplace) through which the payment was initiated. Supports omnichannel payment analytics and storefront-level Conversion Rate (CR) reporting.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: The alphanumeric authorization code returned by the issuing bank or payment network upon successful authorization of the payment. Required for dispute resolution, chargeback management, and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 3; ISO 8583 — Financial Transaction Message Standard

attributes.name: authorization_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the payment authorization response was received from the issuing bank or payment network. Distinct from the initiated timestamp; used for authorization latency monitoring and SLA (Service Level Agreement) tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8583 — Financial Transaction Message Standard; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: avs_result_code
attributes.description: The Address Verification Service (AVS) result code returned by the issuing bank, indicating whether the billing address provided by the customer matches the address on file. Used for fraud risk assessment and chargeback liability management.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 6.4; ISO 8583 — Financial Transaction Message Standard

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 country code of the customer's billing address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Used for fraud geo-risk scoring, tax jurisdiction determination, and international payment compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 — Country Codes; GDPR Article 4 — Personal Data; FTC — Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal/ZIP code of the customer's billing address. Used for Address Verification Service (AVS) fraud checks, tax jurisdiction determination, and geographic sales analytics.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 3 (AVS Data); GDPR Article 4 — Personal Data

attributes.name: capture_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the authorized payment was captured (settled) from the customer's account. Marks the point of revenue recognition per FASB ASC 606. Null if payment was not captured (e.g., declined or voided).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; ISO 8583 — Financial Transaction Message Standard

attributes.name: card_bin
attributes.description: The Bank Identification Number (BIN), the first 6-8 digits of the payment card number, identifying the issuing bank and card network. Used for fraud analytics, card-type classification, and interchange fee analysis. Not a full PAN — PCI DSS compliant to store.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 3.3 (BIN Retention Allowed); ISO 7812 — Identification Cards

attributes.name: card_expiry_month
attributes.description: The expiration month of the payment card (1–12). Used in conjunction with card_expiry_year for card validity checks and customer payment method management. PCI DSS permits storage of expiry date.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 3.3 (Expiry Date Retention Allowed)

attributes.name: card_expiry_year
attributes.description: The four-digit expiration year of the payment card. Used in conjunction with card_expiry_month for card validity checks and customer payment method management. PCI DSS permits storage of expiry date.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 3.3 (Expiry Date Retention Allowed)

attributes.name: card_last_four
attributes.description: The last four digits of the payment card number. PCI DSS permits storage of the last four digits for customer service, dispute resolution, and payment method recognition. Not a full PAN.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 3.3 (Last Four Digits Retention Allowed)

attributes.name: card_network
attributes.description: The payment card network associated with the transaction (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, UnionPay). Used for interchange fee analysis, network-level fraud monitoring, and tender-mix reporting.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 3; ISO 7812 — Identification Cards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this digital payment record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency e-commerce operations and international financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: cvv_result_code
attributes.description: The Card Verification Value (CVV/CVC) check result code returned by the issuing bank (M=Match, N=No Match, P=Not Processed, S=Issuer Not Certified, U=Unknown). Used for fraud risk assessment. Note: The actual CVV value is NEVER stored per PCI DSS Requirement 3.2.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 3.2 (CVV Must Not Be Stored); ISO 8583

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Numeric fraud risk score assigned by the fraud screening engine, typically on a scale of 0–100 or 0–1000 depending on the provider. Higher scores indicate greater fraud risk. Used for threshold-based decisioning and fraud analytics.
attributes.references: FTC — Consumer Protection and Fraud Prevention; PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 6.4

attributes.name: fraud_screening_result
attributes.description: The outcome of the automated fraud screening check applied to the payment transaction by the fraud detection engine (e.g., Adyen RevenueProtect, Stripe Radar). Values: pass (cleared), review (flagged for manual review), reject (blocked). Drives order hold and manual review workflows.
attributes.references: FTC — Consumer Protection and Fraud Prevention; PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 6.4

attributes.name: gateway_response_code
attributes.description: The raw response code returned by the payment gateway for the transaction (e.g., '00' for approved, '05' for declined). Used for decline reason analysis, gateway troubleshooting, and Conversion Rate (CR) optimization.
attributes.references: ISO 8583 — Financial Transaction Message Standard; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: gateway_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier assigned by the payment gateway (Adyen, Stripe, PayPal) for this payment. Used for cross-system reconciliation, dispute management, and gateway-level reporting.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 3; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Payment Gateway Integration

attributes.name: initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: The real-world timestamp when the customer submitted the payment during online checkout. Principal business event time for the payment transaction. Stored in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: ISO 8601 — Date and Time Representation; FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: installment_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) Installment Count
attributes.description: The number of installment payments agreed upon for Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) transactions. Null or 1 for non-installment payment methods. Supports BNPL provider reconciliation and deferred revenue tracking.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; CFPB — BNPL Regulatory Guidance

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment is part of a recurring or subscription billing arrangement (True) or a one-time transaction (False). Relevant for subscription commerce, loyalty auto-renewal, and recurring revenue reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 6

attributes.name: is_test_transaction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment record is a test or sandbox transaction (True) rather than a live production transaction (False). Ensures test transactions are excluded from financial reporting, GMV calculations, and fraud analytics.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 6; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Sandbox Environment

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net total amount actually charged to the customer after all adjustments (discounts, promotions, taxes). Represents the final settled monetary value of the transaction. Core field for revenue recognition per FASB ASC 606.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 3

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: The gross base payment amount submitted by the customer before any adjustments. Represents the principal monetary value of the digital payment transaction. Used in Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) and Average Order Value (AOV) calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 3; ISO 4217 — Currency Codes

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: The digital channel interface through which the payment was submitted (e.g., web, mobile app, mobile web, marketplace, Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS)). Distinct from payment_method_type. Supports omnichannel attribution and channel-level GMV reporting.
attributes.references: NRF Omnichannel Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Channel Attribution

attributes.name: payment_gateway
attributes.description: The third-party payment gateway provider that processed the digital payment transaction (e.g., Adyen, Stripe, PayPal, Braintree, Worldpay). Used for gateway performance monitoring, fee reconciliation, and failover analysis.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 6; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Payment Gateway Integration

attributes.name: payment_method_type
attributes.description: The payment instrument used by the customer for the digital transaction (e.g., credit card, debit card, PayPal, Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL), gift card, store credit, Apple Pay, Google Pay). Drives tender-mix reporting and payment method preference analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|paypal|bnpl|gift_card|store_credit|apple_pay|google_pay — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 3; NRF Digital Payments Standards

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the digital payment transaction. Tracks the payment workflow from authorization through capture, decline, void, or refund. Drives order fulfillment gating and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 6; ISO 20022 Payment Status Codes

attributes.name: pci_token
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry (PCI) DSS Tokenization Reference
attributes.description: The PCI DSS-compliant tokenization reference that replaces the actual payment card number (PAN) in storage. Ensures cardholder data is never stored in plain text. Issued by the payment gateway tokenization vault.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 3.5 (Tokenization); PCI SSC Token Service Provider Standards

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount refunded to the customer for this payment transaction. Supports partial refund scenarios. Null if no refund has been processed. Used in net revenue and Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; FTC — Consumer Refund Rights

attributes.name: refund_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when a refund or partial refund was initiated for this payment transaction. Null if no refund has been processed. Supports return merchandise authorization (RMA) and customer service workflows.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; Salesforce Service Cloud — Returns Processing

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax component of the payment transaction, representing sales tax, VAT, or GST applied at checkout. Required for financial reporting and tax compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; FTC — Pricing Transparency Requirements

attributes.name: three_ds_status
attributes.description: The result of the 3D Secure (3DS) strong customer authentication challenge applied during checkout. Indicates whether the cardholder was successfully authenticated by their issuing bank. Drives liability shift determination and chargeback risk management.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 6; EMVCo 3DS Specification v2.x; GDPR Article 25 — Privacy by Design

attributes.name: three_ds_version
attributes.description: The version of the 3D Secure protocol used during authentication (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3). Relevant for compliance tracking as 3DS 1.0 is deprecated and 3DS 2.x is the current standard.
attributes.references: EMVCo 3DS Specification v2.x; PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 6

attributes.name: transaction_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known unique transaction reference number assigned by the payment gateway (e.g., Adyen, Stripe, PayPal) at the time of payment initiation. Used for reconciliation, dispute resolution, and cross-system tracing.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 3; GS1 Transaction Reference Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this digital payment record was last modified in the Silver Layer data product. Tracks status changes such as capture, void, or refund events.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: wallet_provider
attributes.description: The digital wallet provider used when payment_method_type is a wallet-based instrument (e.g., Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, PayPal). Null for non-wallet payment methods. Supports digital wallet adoption analytics.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 3; NRF Digital Payments Standards

products.name: product_page_view
products.description: Event record capturing product-level interactions on digital storefronts, including product detail page (PDP) views, recommendation impressions and clicks, search result interactions, and personalization engine responses. Records the SKU/UPC involved, interaction type (organic browse, recommendation served, search result click), storefront, session reference, timestamp, referral source, device type, time-on-page, recommendation algorithm/placement if applicable, click-through flag, and whether the interaction resulted in an add-to-cart action. Supports CTR measurement, recommendation engine performance, product affinity analysis, and digital merchandising effectiveness. High-volume event data — recommend 90-day hot retention with archival to cold storage.

attributes.name: product_page_view_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each product detail page (PDP) view event record. Primary key for this event log table.
attributes.references: GS1 Digital Link; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Event Schema

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Tracking associate product page views measures training effectiveness (which products associates research), supports knowledge base improvements, and enables internal traffic filtering from customer a

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.category. Business justification: Browse behavior and engagement metrics by merchandise category inform assortment planning, category performance analysis, and merchandising strategy. Category-level funnel analysis (views → cart → pur

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.node. Business justification: BOPIS and ship-from-store product pages display node-specific inventory availability; view.fulfillment_node_id tracks which node's inventory was shown, enabling node-level conversion analysis and loca

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authenticated customer who viewed the product detail page. Null for anonymous/guest visitors. Used for personalization, product affinity analysis, and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) attribution.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM Customer Golden Record; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master product record for the item whose detail page was viewed. Links to the Product Information Management (PIM) catalog for full product attributes.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) Product Catalog; Informatica MDM

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital storefront (e.g., main e-commerce site, mobile app storefront, marketplace channel) on which the product page view occurred. Supports multi-storefront and omnichannel analytics.

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: Reference to the web session during which this product page view event occurred. Links the event to the broader digital session context including device, referral, and UTM attribution.

attributes.name: ab_test_variant
attributes.description: The A/B test or multivariate test variant identifier assigned to this product detail page view, if the page was part of an active experiment (e.g., control, variant_a, variant_b). Used to measure the impact of page layout, content, and merchandising experiments on conversion.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud A/B Testing; NRF Digital Merchandising Standards

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The brand name of the product viewed on the detail page. Used for brand-level traffic and conversion analysis, private label vs. national brand performance comparison, and digital merchandising reporting.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM Product Golden Record; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: category_path
attributes.description: The full hierarchical category path of the product at the time of the page view (e.g., Electronics > Televisions > Smart TVs). Supports category-level traffic analysis, assortment breadth reporting, and digital merchandising effectiveness by category.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) Category Hierarchy; NRF Category Management Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this event record was first ingested and persisted in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for data lineage, pipeline auditing, and late-arrival event detection. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Ingestion Standards

attributes.name: data_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the visitor provided valid data processing consent at the time of this product detail page view event, as required under GDPR and CCPA. Events where consent is False must be excluded from personalization and behavioral analytics pipelines.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis); CCPA Section 1798.100; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The category of device used to view the product detail page. Supports device-level conversion analysis, responsive design optimization, and omnichannel customer journey analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Device Detection; IAB Tech Lab Device Taxonomy

attributes.name: displayed_price
attributes.description: The retail selling price displayed to the visitor on the product detail page at the time of the view, in the storefront's operating currency. Captures the price as shown, which may reflect markdowns, promotions, or personalized pricing. Used for Average Unit Retail (AUR) and price sensitivity analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (UTC) when the product detail page view event was recorded. Principal event time used for time-series analysis, session reconstruction, and digital merchandising reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Event Log; ISO 8601

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: The fulfillment option displayed or selected on the product detail page at the time of the view (e.g., ship_to_home, Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS), Ship-from-Store (SFS), Drop Ship). Supports omnichannel fulfillment preference analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Fulfillment Options; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: geo_country_code
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the visitor's geographic location at the time of the product detail page view, derived from IP geolocation. Used for regional product demand analysis and international digital commerce reporting.

attributes.name: interaction_type
attributes.description: Categorizes how the customer arrived at the product detail page. Distinguishes organic browsing from recommendation engine clicks, search result clicks, direct URL access, email campaign links, and promotional links. Critical for Click-Through Rate (CTR) and digital merchandising effectiveness analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: organic_browse|recommendation_click|search_result_click|direct_url|email_link|promotion_link|social_link|paid_ad_click — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Analytics; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: The inventory availability status displayed on the product detail page at the time of the view (e.g., in_stock, low_stock, out_of_stock, backorder, preorder). Captures the stock signal shown to the customer, which influences conversion behavior and demand signals.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Inventory Availability; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: is_add_to_cart
attributes.description: Indicates whether the visitor added the viewed product to their shopping cart during or immediately following this product detail page view. Key metric for Conversion Rate (CR) funnel analysis and product affinity scoring.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Events; NRF E-Commerce Conversion Metrics

attributes.name: is_bot
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product detail page view event was identified as non-human (bot, crawler, or automated traffic) based on user-agent analysis and behavioral signals. Bot-flagged events are excluded from Conversion Rate (CR) and Click-Through Rate (CTR) calculations.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Invalid Traffic (IVT) Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Bot Detection

attributes.name: is_markdown_price
attributes.description: Indicates whether the price displayed on the product detail page at the time of the view was a markdown (reduced) price rather than the regular selling price. Supports markdown effectiveness analysis and Hi-Lo pricing strategy reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Pricing Standards

attributes.name: is_recommendation_clicked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the visitor clicked on a recommended product during this product detail page view. Used to calculate Click-Through Rate (CTR) for recommendation engine performance measurement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Einstein Analytics; NRF CTR Measurement Standards

attributes.name: is_recommendation_served
attributes.description: Indicates whether a product recommendation was served to the visitor during this product detail page view. True when the personalization engine delivered at least one recommendation impression on the page.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Einstein Recommendations; NRF Personalization Standards

attributes.name: is_wishlist_add
attributes.description: Indicates whether the visitor added the viewed product to a wishlist or saved-for-later list during this page view. Supports demand signal analysis, product affinity modeling, and personalized re-engagement campaigns.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Wishlist Feature; NRF Customer Engagement Standards

attributes.name: page_url
attributes.description: The full URL of the product detail page (PDP) that was viewed. Used for SEO analysis, canonical URL tracking, and A/B test variant identification in digital merchandising.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Storefront URL Schema

attributes.name: personalization_segment
attributes.description: The customer or visitor segment identifier assigned by the personalization engine at the time of the product detail page view (e.g., high_value_shopper, new_visitor, deal_seeker). Used to evaluate personalization engine effectiveness and segment-level product affinity.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Einstein Personalization; NRF Customer Segmentation Standards

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: The promotional code or offer identifier active on the product detail page at the time of the view, if a promotion was applied or displayed. Used to attribute page views and add-to-cart actions to specific promotional campaigns.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Promotions Engine; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: recommendation_algorithm
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the recommendation algorithm or model that served product recommendations on this page view (e.g., collaborative_filtering, trending_now, frequently_bought_together, einstein_pdp). Null if no recommendation was served. Supports recommendation engine performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Einstein Product Recommendations

attributes.name: recommendation_placement
attributes.description: The on-page placement zone where the recommendation widget was displayed during this product detail page view (e.g., pdp_carousel, pdp_bottom, pdp_sidebar). Null or 'none' if no recommendation was served. Used to evaluate placement effectiveness for digital merchandising.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Page Designer; NRF Digital Merchandising Standards

attributes.name: referral_source
attributes.description: The originating source that directed the visitor to the product detail page (e.g., google, email_campaign, homepage_banner, category_page, recommendation_widget). Supports digital attribution and marketing channel performance analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Referral Tracking; Google Analytics Attribution Model

attributes.name: search_query
attributes.description: The search term or query string entered by the visitor that led to this product detail page view via a search result click. Null if the interaction type was not a search result click. Used for search relevance optimization and product discoverability analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Search Analytics; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: search_result_rank
attributes.description: The ordinal position of the product in the search results list when the visitor clicked through to the product detail page. Null if the interaction type was not a search result click. Used to evaluate search ranking effectiveness and product discoverability.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Search Ranking; NRF Digital Merchandising Standards

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: The Stock Keeping Unit code of the specific product variant (size, color, configuration) whose detail page was viewed. The SKU is the operational identifier used in Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) and SAP S/4HANA for inventory and sales tracking.
attributes.references: GS1 SKU Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: time_on_page_seconds
attributes.description: The duration in seconds the visitor spent on the product detail page before navigating away or the session ended. Indicates product engagement depth and is used to assess digital merchandising content effectiveness.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Engagement Metrics; NRF Digital Commerce KPIs

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: The 12-digit Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode identifier for the product viewed. Used for cross-system product identification, GS1 compliance, and integration with Point of Sale (POS) and supply chain systems.
attributes.references: GS1 UPC-A Standard; National Retail Federation (NRF)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this event record was last modified in the Silver Layer, for example due to enrichment, correction, or reprocessing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Ingestion Standards

attributes.name: visitor_type
attributes.description: Classifies the visitor viewing the product detail page as an authenticated registered customer, a guest/anonymous visitor, or a loyalty program member. Used to segment product engagement metrics by customer authentication state.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Customer Identity; NRF Customer Loyalty Standards

products.name: search_query
products.description: Captures on-site search queries submitted by visitors on digital storefronts, recording the raw query text, normalized query, storefront, session reference, query timestamp, result count returned, zero-results flag, top result SKU, click-through flag, and whether the search led to an add-to-cart or purchase. Supports search relevance optimization, demand signal capture, and assortment gap identification. High-volume event data — recommend 90-day hot retention with archival to cold storage for seasonal trend analysis.

attributes.name: search_query_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each on-site search query event recorded on the digital storefront. Primary key for the search_query data product.
attributes.references: Internal Data Modeling Standard — Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Associate search behavior on customer-facing or internal sites informs training needs (what products associates are researching), supports knowledge base improvements, and enables employee engagement

attributes.name: buyer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.buyer. Business justification: Search performance reporting by buyer responsibility area enables merchandising teams to identify assortment gaps, optimize search relevance for their categories, and measure discoverability of their

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.demand_forecast. Business justification: Search volume is a leading demand signal used in retail forecasting. Linking queries to forecasts enables real-time forecast adjustment based on search trends and validates forecast accuracy against c

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order placed as a direct result of this search query within the same session. Null if is_purchase is False. Enables search-to-order revenue attribution and AOV (Average Order Value) analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail SD Module — Sales Order; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Object

attributes.name: privacy_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_assessment. Business justification: Search query logging involves personal data requiring privacy assessment under data minimization principles. Retail must document retention periods, assess re-identification risks, and justify busines

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authenticated customer who submitted the search query. Null for anonymous/guest visitors. Enables personalization, RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary) analysis, and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) attribution.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM — Customer Golden Record; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Search queries are attributed to profit centers for search-to-purchase conversion analysis, merchandising effectiveness by channel, and search investment ROI tracking in retail finance systems.

attributes.name: search_category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product category scope within which the search was executed, if the visitor scoped the search to a specific department or category (e.g., Electronics, Apparel). Null for site-wide searches. Supports category management and assortment depth analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) — Category Hierarchy; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Category Search Scope

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital storefront (e.g., main e-commerce site, mobile app storefront, marketplace channel) on which the search query was submitted. Supports multi-storefront and omnichannel analytics.

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: Reference to the web session during which this search query was submitted. Links the search event to the broader digital customer journey tracked in the web_session product.

attributes.name: ab_test_variant
attributes.description: The identifier of the A/B test variant or experiment bucket assigned to this search query event. Used to measure the impact of search algorithm changes, ranking experiments, and UI variations on CTR (Click-Through Rate) and CR (Conversion Rate).
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Experimentation Framework; NRF Digital Commerce Testing Standards

attributes.name: applied_filter_count
attributes.description: The number of facet filters (e.g., brand, size, color, price range, category) applied by the visitor to refine the search results. Zero indicates an unfiltered search. Used to understand search refinement behavior and optimize faceted navigation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Facet Tracking; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: applied_sort_order
attributes.description: The sort order selected by the visitor for the search results (e.g., relevance, price ascending, price descending, newest, best seller, top rated). 'default' indicates no explicit sort was applied by the visitor. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: relevance|price_asc|price_desc|newest|best_seller|top_rated|default — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Sort Configuration; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: clicked_result_position
attributes.description: The rank position (1-based) of the product result that was clicked by the visitor. Null if no click occurred. Used to analyze position bias and optimize search ranking algorithms.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Result Ranking; NRF Search Analytics Best Practices

attributes.name: clicked_sku
attributes.description: The SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) of the first product result clicked by the visitor after this search query. Null if is_click_through is False. Enables search-to-product attribution and relevance analysis.
attributes.references: GS1 — SKU Identification Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Click Event

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this search query record was first ingested and written to the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer. Audit trail timestamp for data lineage and pipeline monitoring. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance — Audit Trail Standards; ISO 27001 Information Security

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The category of device used to submit the search query. Supports device-level CTR (Click-Through Rate) and CR (Conversion Rate) analysis to optimize search experience per device channel.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Device Detection; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: geo_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code representing the geographic location of the visitor at the time of the search query, derived from IP geolocation. Used for regional demand signal analysis and localized assortment planning.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; GDPR Article 4 — Geolocation Data

attributes.name: is_add_to_cart
attributes.description: Indicates whether the search query session resulted in at least one product being added to the shopping cart (True) or not (False). Key metric for measuring search-to-cart conversion and GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) attribution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Cart Event Tracking; NRF Digital Commerce KPI Standards

attributes.name: is_bot
attributes.description: Indicates whether the search query was identified as originating from an automated bot, crawler, or non-human traffic source (True) rather than a genuine human visitor (False). Bot queries should be excluded from demand signal and conversion analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Bot Detection; FTC — Digital Advertising Fraud Standards

attributes.name: is_click_through
attributes.description: Indicates whether the visitor clicked on at least one product result following this search query (True) or viewed results without clicking (False). Core metric for CTR (Click-Through Rate) calculation and search relevance scoring.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Click Tracking; NRF Digital Commerce KPI Standards

attributes.name: is_purchase
attributes.description: Indicates whether the search query ultimately led to a completed purchase within the same session (True) or not (False). Core metric for CR (Conversion Rate) measurement and search-to-revenue attribution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Conversion Tracking; FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: is_redirected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the search query triggered a merchandising redirect rule that sent the visitor to a specific landing page or category page instead of standard search results (True) or not (False).
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Redirect Rules; NRF Merchandising Standards

attributes.name: is_spell_corrected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the search engine applied automatic spell correction to the raw query text before executing the search (True) or not (False). Used to measure spell-correction effectiveness and raw query quality.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Spell Correction Engine

attributes.name: is_synonym_expanded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the search engine applied synonym expansion rules to broaden the query scope (True) or not (False). Used to evaluate synonym dictionary coverage and search recall optimization.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Synonym Management; NRF Search Relevance Standards

attributes.name: is_zero_results
attributes.description: Indicates whether the search query returned zero product results (True) or at least one result (False). Zero-results queries are critical demand signals for assortment gap identification and PIM (Product Information Management) enrichment.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Zero Results Tracking; NRF Assortment Planning Standards

attributes.name: normalized_query_text
attributes.description: The standardized, cleaned version of the search query after lowercasing, stemming, stop-word removal, and spell-correction processing. Used for query clustering, trend analysis, and search index optimization.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Normalization Engine; NRF Search Analytics Best Practices

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: The promotional or coupon code active in the visitor's session at the time of the search query. Used to correlate promotional campaigns with search behavior and measure promotion-driven search demand signals.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Promotion Management; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Promotions

attributes.name: query_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region subtag) detected or inferred for the search query text (e.g., 'en', 'en-US', 'fr', 'es-MX'). Supports multilingual storefront search analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 Country Codes

attributes.name: query_source
attributes.description: The page or context from which the search was initiated. Identifies whether the visitor searched from the main search bar, a category page, the homepage, a Product Detail Page (PDP), cart, checkout, an email deep-link, or an external referral. Supports funnel and CR (Conversion Rate) analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: search_bar|category_page|homepage|pdp|cart|checkout|email_link|external — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Page Context Tracking; NRF Digital Commerce Standards

attributes.name: query_status
attributes.description: The processing status of the search query. 'completed' = results returned successfully; 'timeout' = search engine did not respond within SLA (Service Level Agreement) threshold; 'error' = system error during processing; 'blocked' = query blocked by content moderation or security rules.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search API Status Codes; Internal SLA (Service Level Agreement) Standards

attributes.name: query_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone offset) when the search query was submitted by the visitor. Principal business event timestamp for this record. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Event Log; ISO 8601

attributes.name: query_type
attributes.description: Classification of the search input method used by the visitor. 'keyword' = typed free-text; 'natural_language' = conversational/NLP query; 'barcode_scan' = UPC/EAN/GTIN scan input; 'voice' = voice-activated search; 'autocomplete_selection' = visitor selected a suggestion from the autocomplete dropdown.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Input Classification; GS1 GTIN Standards

attributes.name: raw_query_text
attributes.description: The verbatim, unmodified search string as entered by the visitor before any normalization or spell-correction is applied. Captures true demand signals including misspellings, slang, and natural language patterns for search relevance optimization and assortment gap identification.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Query Object; NRF Search Analytics Best Practices

attributes.name: redirect_url
attributes.description: The destination URL to which the visitor was redirected when a search redirect rule was triggered. Null if is_redirected is False. Used to audit and manage search merchandising redirect configurations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Redirect Rules

attributes.name: response_time_ms
attributes.description: The elapsed time in milliseconds between the search query submission and the return of results to the visitor's browser. Used to monitor search engine SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance and performance optimization.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Performance Monitoring; Internal SLA Standards

attributes.name: result_count
attributes.description: The total number of product results returned by the search engine for this query. A value of zero indicates a zero-results search event. Used to measure search engine effectiveness and identify assortment gaps.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Results API; NRF Search Analytics Best Practices

attributes.name: result_page_number
attributes.description: The page number of search results viewed by the visitor (1-based). A value greater than 1 indicates the visitor paginated beyond the first results page. Used to analyze search depth and result page engagement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Pagination Tracking

attributes.name: search_engine_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the search engine or search algorithm configuration active at the time the query was processed. Supports A/B testing, algorithm rollout tracking, and search relevance regression analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Search Engine Configuration Management

attributes.name: top_result_sku
attributes.description: The SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) of the highest-ranked product returned in the search results for this query. Null when result_count is zero. Used to evaluate search ranking quality and relevance of the top-of-results position.
attributes.references: GS1 — SKU Identification Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) — Product Catalog

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this search query record was last modified in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer (e.g., enrichment, correction, or late-arriving attribution updates). Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance — Audit Trail Standards; ISO 27001 Information Security

products.name: product_review
products.description: Customer-submitted product review and rating record on a digital storefront, capturing the SKU reviewed, star rating (1-5), review title, review body text, reviewer display name, verified purchase flag, submission timestamp, moderation status (pending, approved, rejected, flagged), helpful votes count, and syndication source (native, Bazaarvoice, etc.). Supports social proof, product quality signals, and NPS-adjacent sentiment tracking.

attributes.name: product_review_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each customer-submitted product review record on the digital storefront. Primary key for the product_review data product.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Review Object PK

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Retailers often allow/require associates to review products (especially private label) for internal feedback or as verified expert reviews. Links review to associate for authentication and expert revi

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating order that included the reviewed SKU. Used to validate verified purchase status and support post-purchase review solicitation workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail SD Module — Sales Order; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Object

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authenticated customer who submitted the review. Null for anonymous or guest reviewers. Used for CRM linkage and CLTV analysis.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM — Customer Golden Record; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) being reviewed. Links the review to the product master for quality signal aggregation and assortment analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) — Item Master; GS1 Product Identification Standards

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital storefront or e-commerce site on which the review was submitted. Supports multi-banner and multi-locale storefront segmentation within Salesforce Commerce Cloud.

attributes.name: abuse_report_count
attributes.description: Number of times shoppers have reported this review as abusive, spam, or inappropriate. Triggers automatic escalation to moderation queue when threshold is exceeded. Supports community trust and safety operations.
attributes.references: FTC — Endorsement and Testimonial Guidelines 16 CFR Part 255; Salesforce Service Cloud — Case Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the product_review record was first ingested into the Silver Layer data lakehouse. Audit field for data lineage and pipeline monitoring. Distinct from submission_timestamp which reflects the business event time.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Security Management; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards

attributes.name: data_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer provided explicit consent for their review content and associated personal data to be processed, stored, and displayed in accordance with GDPR and CCPA requirements at the time of submission.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 — Lawfulness of Processing; GDPR Article 7 — Conditions for Consent; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: external_review_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier assigned by the originating review platform or syndication source (e.g., Bazaarvoice review ID, native platform UUID). Enables deduplication and traceability back to the source system.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Review Object; Bazaarvoice Syndication API

attributes.name: fit_feedback
attributes.description: Structured fit feedback provided by the reviewer for apparel and footwear SKUs. Values: 'runs_small', 'true_to_size', 'runs_large', 'not_applicable'. Aggregated to generate size recommendation signals on the PDP and to inform private label product development.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Structured Review Attributes; NRF — Apparel Sizing Standards

attributes.name: has_media
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the review includes at least one image or video attachment. Derived from media_attachment_count > 0 but stored explicitly for efficient filtering in storefront display queries and analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Review Media Attachments

attributes.name: helpful_vote_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of 'helpful' votes cast by other shoppers on this review. Used to rank and surface the most useful reviews on the product detail page (PDP) and to weight social proof signals.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Review Helpfulness Voting

attributes.name: incentive_type
attributes.description: Type of incentive provided to the reviewer when is_incentivized is true. Populated for FTC disclosure compliance and loyalty program attribution. 'none' when no incentive was provided.
attributes.references: FTC — Endorsement and Testimonial Guidelines 16 CFR Part 255; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Loyalty Integration

attributes.name: is_deleted
attributes.description: Soft-delete flag indicating whether the review has been logically removed from active display and analytics. Set to true when a review is withdrawn by the customer (GDPR/CCPA right to erasure request) or permanently removed by moderation. Preserves the record for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 — Right to Erasure; CCPA Section 1798.105; ISO 27001 — Data Retention

attributes.name: is_incentivized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer received an incentive (discount, loyalty points, free product) in exchange for submitting the review. Required for FTC endorsement disclosure compliance. Incentivized reviews must be disclosed on the storefront.
attributes.references: FTC — Endorsement and Testimonial Guidelines 16 CFR Part 255; NRF — Ethical Marketing Standards

attributes.name: is_verified_purchase
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer has a confirmed purchase of the reviewed SKU on record, as validated against the order management system. Verified reviews carry higher trust weight in social proof algorithms and FTC compliance for endorsements.
attributes.references: FTC — Endorsement and Testimonial Guidelines 16 CFR Part 255; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Verified Purchaser Flag

attributes.name: media_attachment_count
attributes.description: Number of media files (images or videos) attached to the review by the reviewer. Reviews with media attachments have higher engagement rates and conversion lift. Used to prioritize rich-media reviews for prominent display on the PDP.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Review Media Attachments

attributes.name: moderated_by
attributes.description: Username or system identifier of the moderator (human or automated system) who last updated the moderation status. Supports accountability and audit trail for content governance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Security Management; Salesforce Service Cloud — Assigned To

attributes.name: moderated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the review moderation decision was last applied. Used for SLA tracking of moderation turnaround and compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Review Moderation Audit; ISO 9001 — Quality Management

attributes.name: moderation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the content moderator explaining the moderation decision, particularly for flagged or rejected reviews. Supports audit trail and escalation workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce Service Cloud — Case Notes; ISO 27001 — Information Security Management

attributes.name: moderation_rejection_reason
attributes.description: Categorical reason code assigned when a review is rejected or flagged during content moderation. Supports compliance audit trails and moderator quality reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spam|profanity|off_topic|fake_review|safety_concern|competitor_mention|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FTC — Endorsement and Testimonial Guidelines 16 CFR Part 255; Salesforce Service Cloud — Case Reason Codes

attributes.name: moderation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the review in the content moderation pipeline. 'pending' = awaiting review; 'approved' = cleared for public display; 'rejected' = removed for policy violation; 'flagged' = escalated for manual review. Controls storefront visibility.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Review Moderation Workflow; FTC — Endorsement and Testimonial Guidelines 16 CFR Part 255; CPSC — Product Safety Communication Standards

attributes.name: product_size_purchased
attributes.description: Self-reported or order-derived size variant of the SKU purchased by the reviewer (e.g., 'M', '32x30', '500ml'). Enables size-specific review filtering on the PDP and informs fit/sizing feedback for assortment planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) — Item Variant Attributes; GS1 — Product Attribute Standards

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the review was approved and made publicly visible on the storefront. Distinct from submission_timestamp; the gap between the two measures moderation turnaround time and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Review Published Date; ISO 9001 — Quality Management

attributes.name: purchase_channel
attributes.description: The fulfillment channel through which the reviewer acquired the product. Values include: 'online' (standard e-commerce), 'bopis' (Buy Online Pick Up In Store), 'ropis' (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store), 'in_store', 'drop_ship', 'marketplace'. Enables channel-specific product quality analysis.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) — Channel Attribution; NRF — Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: review_body
attributes.description: Full free-text narrative of the customer review. Primary input for NLP-based sentiment analysis, topic modelling, and product quality signal extraction. May be subject to moderation before display.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Review Body Field; FTC — Endorsement and Testimonial Guidelines 16 CFR Part 255

attributes.name: review_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) of the review text, e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'es-MX'. Supports multi-locale storefront display, NLP model routing, and translation workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 — Language Codes; ISO 3166-1 — Country Codes; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Locale Configuration

attributes.name: review_title
attributes.description: Short headline or subject line of the review as entered by the customer. Used for display on the product detail page (PDP) and for text analytics and sentiment classification.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Review Title Field

attributes.name: reviewer_display_name
attributes.description: Pseudonymous or chosen display name shown publicly alongside the review on the storefront. May be a username alias rather than a legal name. Classified as confidential PII as it can be linked back to a customer identity.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Reviewer Nickname Field

attributes.name: reviewer_expertise_level
attributes.description: Categorical tier assigned to the reviewer based on their review history, helpfulness votes, and engagement on the platform. Used to weight review credibility in product quality scoring and to surface expert reviews prominently on the PDP.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Reviewer Reputation System; NRF — Customer Engagement Standards

attributes.name: reviewer_location_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code representing the self-reported or inferred country of the reviewer. Used for geo-segmented product quality analysis and regulatory compliance (GDPR for EU reviewers, CCPA for California residents).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 — Country Codes; GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: sentiment_label
attributes.description: Categorical sentiment classification derived from the sentiment_score: 'positive', 'neutral', or 'negative'. Provides a human-readable bucketing of the ML score for reporting dashboards and product quality KPI tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — AI-Powered Review Analytics; NRF — Customer Experience Analytics

attributes.name: sentiment_score
attributes.description: Machine-learning-derived sentiment polarity score for the review body text, ranging from -1.0000 (most negative) to 1.0000 (most positive). Computed by the NLP enrichment pipeline and stored as a Silver Layer attribute for downstream analytics and AI/ML model features.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — AI-Powered Review Analytics; NRF — Customer Experience Analytics

attributes.name: star_rating
attributes.description: Numeric star rating submitted by the reviewer on a 1-to-5 scale, where 1 is the lowest satisfaction and 5 is the highest. Core quantitative signal for product quality scoring, NPS-adjacent sentiment tracking, and GMROI analysis.
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) — Customer Experience Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Rating Field

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer submitted the review on the digital storefront. This is the principal business event timestamp representing when the review was created by the reviewer. Used for recency ranking and post-purchase review solicitation SLA measurement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Review Created Date; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: syndication_partner_review_reference
attributes.description: The unique review identifier assigned by the third-party syndication partner (e.g., Bazaarvoice, PowerReviews). Populated only when syndication_source is not 'native'. Enables reconciliation with partner platforms.

attributes.name: syndication_source
attributes.description: Identifies the platform or syndication network from which the review originated. 'native' = submitted directly on the retailer's own storefront; other values indicate third-party review syndication partners. Drives deduplication and source attribution logic.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Review Source Field; GS1 — Product Data Syndication Standards

attributes.name: unhelpful_vote_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of 'not helpful' votes cast by other shoppers on this review. Used alongside helpful_vote_count to compute net helpfulness score and filter low-quality reviews from prominent display.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Review Helpfulness Voting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the product_review record was last modified in the Silver Layer, including moderation status changes, vote count updates, or syndication enrichments. Supports incremental processing and change data capture.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Security Management; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards

products.name: ab_test
products.description: Master record for A/B and multivariate tests run on digital storefronts, including per-visitor variant assignments. Captures test name, hypothesis, test type (layout, pricing, copy, recommendation algorithm), start/end dates, status (draft, running, paused, concluded), target storefront, traffic split configuration, primary success metric (CR, AOV, CTR), and statistical significance threshold. Contains assignment-level detail: each visitor/session assignment to a variant (control/treatment), assignment timestamp, session reference, customer reference if authenticated, and whether the assigned session resulted in the target conversion event. Supports continuous digital experience optimization and per-variant statistical analysis.

attributes.name: ab_test_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each A/B or multivariate test record in the digital commerce platform. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: A/B tests targeting employee segments (e.g., employee portal features, internal ordering systems, training module variations) require associate linkage for segmentation, result analysis, and employee

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: A/B tests are often campaign-specific experiments (e.g., testing campaign landing page variants, promo messaging). Links test results to campaign performance, enabling test-driven campaign optimizatio

attributes.name: privacy_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_assessment. Business justification: A/B testing involving personal data requires DPIA under GDPR Article 35. Retail must assess privacy risks of experimental data processing, document consent mechanisms for test participation, and justi

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authenticated customer assigned to a variant. Nullable for anonymous/guest visitors. Enables cross-session attribution and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) impact analysis.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM — Customer Golden Record; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital storefront on which this test is executed. Links to the e-commerce storefront master record in Salesforce Commerce Cloud.

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: Reference to the web session during which the visitor was assigned to a test variant. Links to the ecommerce.web_session product for session-level context including device, referral, and UTM attribution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Session Tracking; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: assigned_variant
attributes.description: The specific variant (control or treatment) assigned to this visitor/session for the test. Core field for per-variant statistical analysis and CR/AOV/CTR lift calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: control|treatment_a|treatment_b|treatment_c|treatment_d — promote to reference product for tests with more than 4 variants]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Experiment Variant Assignment

attributes.name: assignment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the visitor/session was assigned to the variant. Used for time-series analysis of assignment distribution and novelty effect detection.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Experiment Assignment Log

attributes.name: conclusion_reason
attributes.description: Reason the test was concluded or stopped. Supports post-test governance review and audit trail for digital commerce optimization decisions.

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: The confidence level used for statistical inference, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9500 for 95%). Complements the significance threshold and is used in power analysis and sample size calculations.

attributes.name: conversion_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the conversion event occurred for this assignment record. Nullable if no conversion occurred. Used for time-to-convert analysis and attribution window validation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Experiment Conversion Log

attributes.name: conversion_value
attributes.description: Monetary value of the conversion event associated with this assignment (e.g., order total in local currency). Used for AOV (Average Order Value) and GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) lift analysis per variant. Nullable if no conversion occurred or metric is non-monetary.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Revenue Attribution; FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this test or assignment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Audit Logging; GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the conversion_value (e.g., 'USD', 'GBP', 'EUR'). Required for multi-currency storefront operations and international GMV reporting.

attributes.name: device_targeting
attributes.description: Device category restriction for visitor eligibility in this test. Enables device-specific experience optimization aligned with omnichannel digital commerce strategy.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Experiment Targeting Rules

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the test is scheduled to conclude or was actually concluded. Nullable for open-ended tests. Used for duration calculations and reporting windows.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone) when the test was deactivated or concluded. Nullable for tests still in progress. Used for exact duration and overlap analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Experiment Deactivation Log

attributes.name: geo_targeting_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code restricting test eligibility to visitors from a specific country (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR'). Nullable for globally-targeted tests. Supports regional pricing and localization experiments.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GS1 Global Location Standards

attributes.name: hypothesis
attributes.description: Formal statement of the expected outcome of the test (e.g., 'Changing the CTA button color to green will increase CR by 5% for mobile visitors'). Supports scientific rigor in digital experience optimization.

attributes.name: is_converted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assigned session/visitor completed the primary conversion event (True) as defined by the primary_metric for this test (e.g., placed an order, clicked a CTA). Core field for Conversion Rate (CR) calculation per variant.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Experiment Conversion Tracking; NRF Digital Commerce KPI Standards

attributes.name: is_multivariate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test is a multivariate test (True) testing multiple element combinations simultaneously, or a standard A/B test (False) with a single variable. Drives statistical analysis methodology selection.

attributes.name: is_personalized
attributes.description: Indicates whether variant assignment uses personalization logic (True) such as customer segment or behavioral targeting, versus purely random assignment (False). Relevant for GDPR Article 22 automated decision-making compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 22; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Einstein Personalization

attributes.name: minimum_detectable_effect
attributes.description: The smallest relative or absolute change in the primary metric that the test is designed to detect with the configured confidence level and sample size. Used in pre-test power analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 3534-1 Statistical Vocabulary; NRF Digital Commerce Best Practices

attributes.name: owner_team
attributes.description: Name of the business team or squad responsible for designing and monitoring this test (e.g., 'Digital Merchandising', 'UX Optimization', 'Pricing Strategy'). Supports governance and accountability for digital experience experiments.

attributes.name: page_type_target
attributes.description: The type of storefront page where the test variant is rendered. PDP = Product Detail Page, PLP = Product Listing Page. Drives test scope and analytics attribution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: homepage|pdp|plp|cart|checkout|search|category|account|confirmation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Page Type Classification

attributes.name: primary_metric
attributes.description: The principal Key Performance Indicator (KPI) used to determine the winning variant. Common values: CR (Conversion Rate), AOV (Average Order Value), CTR (Click-Through Rate), GMV (Gross Merchandise Value). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cr|aov|ctr|gmv|upt|add_to_cart_rate|bounce_rate|revenue_per_visitor — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sample_size_target
attributes.description: Pre-calculated minimum number of visitor assignments required per variant to achieve the configured statistical power. Derived from power analysis using significance_threshold, confidence_level, and minimum_detectable_effect. Used to determine when the test has sufficient data.
attributes.references: ISO 3534-1 Statistical Vocabulary; NRF Digital Commerce Best Practices

attributes.name: secondary_metric
attributes.description: Optional supporting KPI monitored alongside the primary metric to detect unintended side effects (e.g., monitoring AOV while optimizing for CR). Nullable.

attributes.name: significance_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum statistical significance level (p-value threshold) required to declare a winning variant, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 for 95% confidence). Governs when the test can be concluded.
attributes.references: ISO 3534-1 Statistical Vocabulary; NRF Digital Commerce Best Practices

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the test begins accepting visitor traffic and recording variant assignments. Used for scheduling and campaign alignment.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone) when the test was activated and began serving variant experiences to visitors. Distinct from start_date for intra-day precision in traffic analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Experiment Activation Log

attributes.name: target_audience_segment
attributes.description: Description or identifier of the visitor/customer segment eligible for this test (e.g., 'new_visitors', 'loyalty_members', 'mobile_us_only'). Supports personalization and segmented experimentation strategies.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Audience Segmentation; GDPR Article 22 (automated profiling)

attributes.name: test_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the test, used in downstream analytics pipelines, tagging systems, and Salesforce Commerce Cloud experiment references.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Experiment Key Convention

attributes.name: test_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the test scope, changes being tested, and business context. Provides additional detail beyond the hypothesis for stakeholder communication and post-test documentation.

attributes.name: test_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name identifying the test, used by merchandising and digital commerce teams for reporting and communication (e.g., 'Homepage Hero Banner Layout Q3 2024').

attributes.name: test_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the test. Controls whether variant assignment and data collection are active. Transitions: draft → running → paused/concluded/cancelled.

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: Category of the element being tested on the digital storefront. Drives analytics segmentation and test design governance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: layout|pricing|copy|recommendation|navigation|personalization|checkout_flow|imagery — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Experiment Type Classification

attributes.name: total_traffic_allocation_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total eligible storefront visitors included in the test (e.g., 80.00 means 80% of visitors are enrolled; the remaining 20% are excluded from all variants). Supports holdout group management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Experiment Traffic Allocation

attributes.name: traffic_split_config
attributes.description: JSON-serialized or delimited string describing the percentage of total eligible traffic allocated to each variant (e.g., 'control:50,treatment_a:50' or 'control:33,treatment_a:33,treatment_b:34'). Must sum to 100.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Experiment Traffic Allocation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this record was last modified. Tracks test configuration changes, status transitions, and winner declarations for audit and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Audit Logging; GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability

attributes.name: variant_count
attributes.description: Total number of variants in the test including the control group (e.g., 2 for a standard A/B test, 3+ for multivariate). Drives traffic split validation logic.

attributes.name: visitor_code
attributes.description: Pseudonymous cookie-based or device-based identifier for the visitor, used for anonymous visitor tracking and consistent variant assignment across sessions. Distinct from customer_id which requires authentication. Subject to GDPR/CCPA pseudonymization requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4(5) Pseudonymisation; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Visitor Tracking

attributes.name: winning_variant
attributes.description: Identifier of the variant declared as the winner upon test conclusion (e.g., 'treatment_a'). Nullable until the test is concluded and a winner is determined. Used for rollout decisions.

products.name: abandoned_cart_recovery
products.description: Operational record tracking abandoned cart recovery workflow executions, capturing the abandoned cart reference, recovery channel used (email, SMS, push notification, retargeting ad), recovery message sent timestamp, recovery message template, customer contact reference, recovery status (sent, opened, clicked, recovered, expired), recovered order reference if successful, recovered GMV amount, and recovery time-to-conversion. Supports abandoned cart recovery program management, channel effectiveness measurement, and recovery revenue attribution. Integrates with marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze) for trigger-based recovery campaigns.

attributes.name: abandoned_cart_recovery_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each abandoned cart recovery workflow execution record. Primary key for this entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Employee purchase cart abandonment recovery (e.g., reminders for uniform orders, required equipment purchases, benefits enrollment purchases) requires associate linkage for targeted recovery campaigns

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing automation campaign or journey that triggered this recovery workflow execution (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud Journey ID, Braze Canvas ID). Enables campaign-level aggregation of recovery performance metrics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Journey Builder; Braze Canvas Reference

attributes.name: cart_id
attributes.description: Reference to the abandoned shopping cart that triggered this recovery workflow. Links to the originating cart record in the e-commerce platform (Salesforce Commerce Cloud).

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.category. Business justification: Recovery campaigns targeted by merchandise category enable category-specific incentive strategies, merchandising optimization, and category-level conversion funnel analysis. Buyers use category-level

attributes.name: checkout_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.checkout. Business justification: Abandoned cart recovery workflows need to know WHERE in the checkout funnel the cart was abandoned (cart review, address entry, payment entry, etc.). The checkout entity tracks funnel progression with

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Recovery campaign costs (email, SMS, incentives) are charged to marketing cost centers for budget tracking, ROI analysis, and marketing spend variance reporting in retail finance systems.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order placed as a result of a successful cart recovery. Null when recovery status is not 'recovered'. Enables direct revenue attribution from recovery campaigns.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Object; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: message_template_id
