attributes.description: Identifier of the message template used for this recovery communication, as defined in the marketing automation platform (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze). Enables template-level performance analysis and A/B test tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Content Builder; Braze Template Reference

attributes.name: privacy_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_assessment. Business justification: Automated marketing based on cart abandonment requires privacy assessment. Retail must document legal basis for processing (legitimate interest vs consent), assess profiling risks, and demonstrate opt

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer whose cart was abandoned. Used for recovery channel targeting, personalization, and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) attribution. PARTY_REFERENCE category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM Customer Golden Record; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital storefront (e.g., web, mobile app, marketplace) where the cart was originally created. Supports channel-level recovery performance analysis.

attributes.name: abandoned_cart_gmv
attributes.description: The total Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) of the cart at the time of abandonment, representing the potential revenue at risk. Used to prioritize high-value cart recovery efforts and measure recovery rate against at-risk GMV.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Value; NRF GMV Definition

attributes.name: abandoned_cart_item_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct line items (SKUs) present in the cart at the time of abandonment. Used alongside abandoned_cart_gmv to segment recovery priority and personalize recovery message content.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Cart Object; NRF Basket Analysis Standards

attributes.name: contact_address
attributes.description: The actual contact address used to deliver the recovery message — email address for email channel, phone number for SMS channel, or device push token for push notification channel. Classified as restricted PII as it directly identifies the customer contact point. Aligns with GDPR and CCPA data minimization requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; PCI SSC Data Security Standards

attributes.name: conversion_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer placed the recovered order, marking a successful conversion. Null if recovery_status is not 'recovered'. Used to calculate time-to-conversion from cart abandonment and from message send.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Placement Event; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this recovery workflow execution record was first created in the data platform. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts in this record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). MONETARY_TRIPLET currency component.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: data_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer provided valid data processing consent for marketing communications at the time this recovery record was created. True = consent on record; False = no consent. Critical for GDPR Article 6 lawful basis and CCPA compliance audits.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 Lawful Basis; GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Device type used by the customer when they clicked the recovery link and returned to the storefront. Supports device-level Conversion Rate (CR) analysis and mobile-first optimization decisions.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Device Detection; NRF Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: incentive_type
attributes.description: Type of incentive offered in the recovery message to motivate cart completion. 'none' = no incentive; 'percentage_discount' = markdown percentage off; 'fixed_discount' = fixed currency reduction; 'free_shipping' = waived shipping fee; 'loyalty_points' = bonus loyalty program points; 'gift_with_purchase' = complimentary item. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|percentage_discount|fixed_discount|free_shipping|loyalty_points|gift_with_purchase — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Promotions Management Standards

attributes.name: incentive_value
attributes.description: Quantitative value of the incentive offered in the recovery message. For percentage_discount, this is the percentage (e.g., 10.00 = 10%). For fixed_discount, this is the currency amount. Null when incentive_type is 'none' or 'free_shipping'. Used to measure cost-of-recovery against recovered GMV.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: is_first_recovery_attempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents the first recovery message sent for the associated abandoned cart. True = first attempt; False = subsequent attempt in a multi-touch sequence. Supports first-touch vs. multi-touch attribution analysis.

attributes.name: is_incentive_redeemed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the promotional incentive included in the recovery message was actually redeemed by the customer in the recovered order. True = incentive applied to recovered order; False = incentive not used. Null when no incentive was offered or no recovery occurred.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) Redemption Tracking; NRF Promotions Standards

attributes.name: message_clicked_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer clicked the recovery call-to-action link within the recovery message. Null if no click occurred. Used to compute Click-Through Rate (CTR) and click-to-conversion lag.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Click Tracking; Braze Click Event

attributes.name: message_opened_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer opened or viewed the recovery message. Null if the message was not opened. Supports open-rate and engagement analysis by channel and template.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement Tracking; Braze Open Event

attributes.name: message_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the recovery message was dispatched to the customer via the selected recovery channel. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category for the primary real-world event.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Send Log; Braze Message Activity

attributes.name: opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer opted out of recovery communications via this channel at the time of message dispatch. True = customer had opted out (message should not have been sent — used for compliance audit); False = customer was opted in. Supports GDPR and CCPA consent compliance tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 Consent; CCPA Section 1798.120; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Promotional or discount code included in the recovery message as an incentive for the customer to complete the purchase (e.g., 'COMEBACK10' for 10% off). Null if no incentive was offered. Used to measure incentive-driven vs. organic recovery rates.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) Promotion Rules; NRF Promotions Standards

attributes.name: recovered_gmv
attributes.description: The Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) of the order placed as a result of a successful cart recovery. Null when recovery_status is not 'recovered'. Core revenue attribution metric for the abandoned cart recovery program. MONETARY_TRIPLET gross-base amount component.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; NRF GMV Definition

attributes.name: recovered_order_discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount or markdown amount applied to the recovered order, including any recovery-specific promotional incentive. Null when no recovery occurred. MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) Markdown Rules; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: recovered_order_net_amount
attributes.description: Net revenue amount of the recovered order after discounts and promotions, representing the actual revenue recognized. Null when no recovery occurred. MONETARY_TRIPLET net-total component.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: recovery_channel
attributes.description: The outreach channel used to deliver the cart recovery message to the customer. Drives channel effectiveness measurement and Click-Through Rate (CTR) and Conversion Rate (CR) analysis by channel.
attributes.references: NRF Omnichannel Standards; Salesforce Marketing Cloud Channel Definitions

attributes.name: recovery_expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time after which the recovery workflow for this cart is considered expired and no further recovery attempts will be made. Determined by campaign configuration (e.g., 72 hours after abandonment). Used to manage recovery window and transition status to 'expired'.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Journey Exit Criteria; Braze Canvas Expiry

attributes.name: recovery_sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this recovery message within a multi-touch recovery campaign sequence for the same abandoned cart (e.g., 1 = first reminder, 2 = second reminder with incentive, 3 = final expiry notice). Supports multi-touch attribution and sequence effectiveness analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Journey Builder Sequence; Braze Canvas Step

attributes.name: recovery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the abandoned cart recovery workflow execution. 'sent' = message dispatched; 'opened' = message opened by customer; 'clicked' = customer clicked recovery link; 'recovered' = order placed; 'expired' = recovery window elapsed without conversion. LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: NRF Digital Commerce Standards; Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement Tracking

attributes.name: recovery_workflow_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this recovery workflow execution, as generated by the marketing automation platform (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze). Used for cross-system traceability and campaign reporting. BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Journey Reference; Braze Campaign Reference

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The marketing automation platform that originated and executed this recovery workflow (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze). Used for system-of-record traceability and cross-platform reconciliation in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Informatica MDM Source System Registry

attributes.name: time_to_conversion_minutes
attributes.description: Number of minutes elapsed between the recovery message send timestamp and the customer's order placement (conversion). Null when recovery_status is not 'recovered'. Key metric for recovery time-to-conversion analysis and campaign optimization.
attributes.references: NRF Digital Commerce KPI Standards; Salesforce Marketing Cloud Conversion Attribution

attributes.name: trigger_delay_minutes
attributes.description: Number of minutes elapsed between cart abandonment and the dispatch of this recovery message. Configured per campaign sequence step. Used to optimize trigger timing for maximum Conversion Rate (CR).
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Journey Builder Wait Activity; Braze Delay Step

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this recovery workflow execution record was last modified, reflecting status transitions or enrichment updates. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.

attributes.name: utm_campaign
attributes.description: Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) campaign parameter appended to the recovery link URL, identifying the specific recovery campaign (e.g., 'abandoned_cart_q4_2024'). Enables campaign-level attribution in web analytics platforms.
attributes.references: Google Analytics UTM Parameter Standards; NRF Digital Commerce Attribution

attributes.name: utm_source
attributes.description: Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) source parameter appended to the recovery link URL, identifying the marketing platform that sent the recovery message (e.g., 'salesforce_mc', 'braze'). Used for digital attribution and cross-channel analytics.
attributes.references: Google Analytics UTM Parameter Standards; NRF Digital Commerce Attribution

products.name: marketplace_listing
products.description: Master record for Retail's product listings on third-party marketplaces (Amazon, eBay, Walmart Marketplace, Google Shopping), capturing the marketplace platform, marketplace-specific identifier (ASIN, eBay item ID, Walmart item ID), mapped internal SKU/UPC, listing title, listing status (active, suppressed, inactive, out-of-stock), buy-box ownership flag, marketplace price, marketplace fulfillment method (FBM, FBA, WFS), listing quality score, content compliance flags, and last sync timestamp. Supports marketplace channel management, competitive pricing intelligence, and GMV tracking across third-party channels.

attributes.name: marketplace_listing_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each marketplace listing record in the Retail data platform. Primary key for the marketplace_listing product. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM — Master Data Management golden record identifier

attributes.name: buyer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.buyer. Business justification: Marketplace assortment managed by buyers who are accountable for third-party platform performance, pricing competitiveness, and inventory allocation. Buyer-level marketplace reporting is essential for

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to merchandising.category. Business justification: Marketplace listings organized by retail category hierarchy for performance reporting, competitive analysis, and assortment planning. Category-level marketplace strategy (pricing, promotion, inventory

attributes.name: fulfillment_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_location. Business justification: Marketplace orders fulfilled from stores require tracking which store ships the item. Real business process: marketplace ship-from-store operations, store-level marketplace performance reporting, inve

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) that this marketplace listing represents. Links the marketplace listing to Retail's internal product master record managed in Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) and Informatica MDM.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); GS1 product identification standards

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Marketplace listings sync real-time inventory quantities from warehouse stock positions to prevent overselling across channels. Enables automated marketplace inventory updates and multi-channel ATP al

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: Marketplace drop-ship and third-party seller models require tracking which vendor fulfills each listing. Business processes: drop-ship order routing to correct vendor, vendor performance scorecarding

attributes.name: age_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product listing has an age restriction (e.g., alcohol, tobacco, adult content, rated video games). True = age-gated product; False = no age restriction. Drives marketplace compliance controls and checkout age verification flows.
attributes.references: FTC regulations on age-restricted products; FDA tobacco and alcohol labeling; CPSC age-graded toy safety standards

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The brand name associated with the marketplace listing. Used for brand registry enforcement, private label identification, and marketplace brand analytics. Sourced from Informatica MDM product golden record.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM product master; GS1 brand identification standards; Amazon Brand Registry

attributes.name: category_path
attributes.description: The full hierarchical category path assigned to this listing on the marketplace (e.g., 'Electronics > Computers > Laptops'). Used for category management, assortment breadth analysis, and marketplace taxonomy alignment. May differ from internal Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) category hierarchy.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) category hierarchy; GS1 product classification (GPC); NRF category management standards

attributes.name: competitor_price
attributes.description: The lowest competing seller price observed for this listing on the marketplace at the time of last sync. Used for competitive pricing intelligence, Hi-Lo (High-Low Pricing Strategy) analysis, and automated repricing decisions via Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM). Populated from marketplace API competitive pricing data.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) competitive pricing module; FTC pricing transparency regulations

attributes.name: content_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the listing content meets all applicable marketplace content policies and regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA labeling for food/grocery, CPSC safety warnings, FTC advertising standards). True = compliant; False = compliance issue detected requiring remediation.
attributes.references: FDA food labeling requirements (21 CFR Part 101); CPSC product safety labeling; FTC advertising standards; Amazon Seller Central content policy

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the marketplace locale where this listing is published (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN, DEU). Supports international marketplace operations, cross-border compliance, and regional GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes; GDPR cross-border data requirements; FTC international commerce standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this marketplace_listing record was first created in the Retail data platform (Silver Layer). Distinct from listed_timestamp which reflects the marketplace publication date. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer audit standards; ISO 8601 timestamp standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the marketplace_price (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD). Required for multi-currency marketplace operations and GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 currency codes; FASB ASC 606 revenue recognition

attributes.name: ean
attributes.description: The 13-digit European Article Number (EAN) / GTIN-13 for the listed product. Required for international marketplace listings (e.g., eBay international, Google Shopping). Sourced from Informatica MDM product golden record.
attributes.references: GS1 EAN-13 / GTIN-13 international barcode standard

attributes.name: fulfillment_method
attributes.description: The fulfillment method used for this marketplace listing. FBM = Fulfilled by Merchant (Retail ships directly); FBA = Fulfilled by Amazon (Amazon warehouses and ships); WFS = Walmart Fulfillment Services; SFS = Ship-from-Store; Dropship = vendor direct-to-customer; 3PL = Third-Party Logistics provider. Drives operational routing in Manhattan Associates WMS and Blue Yonder Demand Planning.
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central FBA/FBM definitions; Walmart Marketplace WFS program; NRF omnichannel fulfillment standards

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the listed product is classified as hazardous material, requiring special handling, packaging, or shipping restrictions on the marketplace. True = hazmat product; False = standard product. Impacts FBA/WFS eligibility and shipping method selection.
attributes.references: CPSC hazardous material product safety standards; DOT hazmat shipping regulations; Amazon FBA hazmat review process

attributes.name: image_count
attributes.description: The total number of product images published on this marketplace listing. Contributes to listing_quality_score; marketplaces typically reward listings with multiple high-quality images with improved search placement.
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central listing quality guidelines; Walmart Marketplace content score methodology

attributes.name: inventory_quantity
attributes.description: The current available inventory quantity published to the marketplace for this listing. Drives out-of-stock status and buy box eligibility. Synchronized from Manhattan Associates WMS or Blue Yonder Demand Planning replenishment signals.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS inventory management; Blue Yonder Demand Planning; NRF inventory management standards

attributes.name: is_buy_box_owner
attributes.description: Indicates whether Retail currently owns the buy box (featured offer) for this marketplace listing. True = Retail is the featured seller; False = a competing seller holds the buy box. Critical KPI for marketplace channel management and competitive pricing strategy. Sourced from marketplace API sync.
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central Buy Box eligibility criteria; Walmart Marketplace featured merchant program

attributes.name: is_private_label
attributes.description: Indicates whether this listing is for a private label (store brand) product owned by Retail. True = private label / own-brand product; False = national or third-party brand. Private label listings typically have exclusive buy box ownership and different margin profiles.
attributes.references: NRF private label product standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) brand classification

attributes.name: last_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent successful data synchronization between Retail's internal systems (Salesforce Commerce Cloud / Informatica MDM) and the marketplace platform API. Used to detect stale listings and trigger re-sync workflows. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud marketplace connector; Informatica MDM synchronization audit; ISO 8601 timestamp standard

attributes.name: listed_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this listing was first published or activated on the marketplace platform. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED equivalent for the MASTER_RESOURCE role. Used for listing age analysis and new product launch tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud listing management; ISO 8601 timestamp standard

attributes.name: listing_quality_score
attributes.description: Marketplace-assigned or internally calculated score (0–100) reflecting the completeness and quality of the listing content (title, images, bullet points, description, A+ content). Higher scores correlate with improved search ranking and conversion rate (CR). Sourced from marketplace API or internal PIM (Product Information Management) audit.
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central Listing Quality dashboard; Walmart Marketplace Content Score; NRF product content standards

attributes.name: listing_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the marketplace listing. LIFECYCLE_STATUS for the MASTER_RESOURCE role. 'active' = live and buyable; 'suppressed' = marketplace has hidden the listing due to content/compliance issues; 'inactive' = manually deactivated; 'out_of_stock' = no inventory available; 'pending_review' = awaiting marketplace approval; 'removed' = permanently delisted. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|suppressed|inactive|out_of_stock|pending_review|removed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central listing status definitions; Walmart Marketplace Seller Help; NRF omnichannel standards

attributes.name: listing_title
attributes.description: The product title as displayed on the marketplace listing page. This is the IDENTITY_LABEL for the MASTER_RESOURCE role. Optimized per marketplace SEO and content guidelines; may differ from the internal product name in the PIM (Product Information Management) system.
attributes.references: GS1 product content standards; Amazon Seller Central listing guidelines; Walmart Marketplace content policy

attributes.name: listing_url
attributes.description: The direct URL to the product listing page on the marketplace. Used for competitive monitoring, digital marketing attribution, and customer service reference. Sourced from marketplace API.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud digital commerce URL management; NRF e-commerce standards

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: The IETF BCP 47 locale code for the marketplace listing (e.g., en-US, en-GB, fr-FR, de-DE). Determines language, currency formatting, and regulatory content requirements for the listing. Supports localization compliance for international marketplace operations.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47 language tag standard; GDPR localization requirements; Amazon Seller Central marketplace locale definitions

attributes.name: main_image_url
attributes.description: URL of the primary product image displayed on the marketplace listing. Image quality and compliance with marketplace image standards directly impacts listing_quality_score and conversion rate (CR). Managed via PIM (Product Information Management) system.
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central image requirements; Walmart Marketplace image standards; GS1 product image guidelines

attributes.name: marketplace_item_code
attributes.description: The platform-native unique identifier assigned by the marketplace to this listing (e.g., Amazon ASIN, eBay Item ID, Walmart Item ID). Used for API synchronization, competitive pricing intelligence, and marketplace-specific operations. This is the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for the MASTER_RESOURCE role.
attributes.references: GS1 global product identification standards; Amazon Seller Central ASIN specification; Walmart Marketplace API

attributes.name: marketplace_platform
attributes.description: The third-party marketplace platform on which this listing is published (e.g., Amazon, eBay, Walmart Marketplace, Google Shopping). Drives channel-specific GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) reporting and marketplace channel management strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: amazon|ebay|walmart_marketplace|google_shopping|target_plus|other — promote to reference product if additional platforms are onboarded]
attributes.references: National Retail Federation (NRF) omnichannel commerce standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud channel taxonomy

attributes.name: marketplace_price
attributes.description: The current selling price of the product on the marketplace listing, expressed in the listing currency. MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE for the MASTER_RESOURCE role. Used for competitive pricing intelligence, AUR (Average Unit Retail) tracking, and GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) calculation. Managed via Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); FTC pricing transparency regulations; FASB ASC 606 revenue recognition

attributes.name: marketplace_rating
attributes.description: The average customer star rating for this listing on the marketplace (typically 1.0–5.0 scale). Influences buy box eligibility, search ranking, and conversion rate (CR). Sourced from marketplace API.
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central product rating; Walmart Marketplace seller performance metrics; NRF customer experience standards

attributes.name: marketplace_seller_code
attributes.description: Retail's seller account identifier on the marketplace platform (e.g., Amazon Merchant ID, Walmart Seller ID). Used to distinguish Retail's listings from third-party sellers on the same marketplace and to attribute GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) to the correct seller account.
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central merchant account; Walmart Marketplace seller account management

attributes.name: marketplace_storefront_name
attributes.description: The display name of Retail's storefront or seller profile on the marketplace (e.g., 'Retail Official Store' on Amazon). Used for brand consistency monitoring and customer-facing identity management across marketplace channels.
attributes.references: Amazon Brand Store guidelines; Walmart Marketplace storefront policy; NRF omnichannel brand standards

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: The manufacturer's suggested retail price (MSRP) or list price for the product. Used as the reference price for markdown calculations and marketplace price compliance. Sourced from Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); FTC pricing transparency and deceptive pricing regulations

attributes.name: prime_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this listing qualifies for marketplace premium fast-shipping programs (e.g., Amazon Prime, Walmart TwoDay). True = eligible for fast-shipping badge; False = standard shipping only. Directly impacts buy box eligibility and conversion rate (CR).
attributes.references: Amazon Prime eligibility requirements; Walmart TwoDay delivery program; NRF last-mile delivery standards

attributes.name: promotion_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this marketplace listing is eligible to participate in marketplace-native promotions (e.g., Amazon Lightning Deals, Walmart Rollback). True = eligible; False = ineligible due to price, category, or performance constraints. Supports Pricing and Promotions Management business process.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) promotion rules; Amazon Deals eligibility criteria; Walmart Marketplace promotional programs

attributes.name: reorder_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum inventory quantity level at which a replenishment order is triggered for this marketplace listing. Used in conjunction with Blue Yonder Demand Planning to prevent out-of-stock events and maintain listing availability.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning replenishment rules; Manhattan Associates WMS reorder point logic

attributes.name: review_count
attributes.description: The total number of customer reviews submitted for this listing on the marketplace. Used alongside marketplace_rating to assess listing credibility and conversion rate (CR) performance. Sourced from marketplace API.
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central review metrics; Walmart Marketplace seller performance dashboard; FTC guidelines on consumer reviews

attributes.name: sell_through_rate
attributes.description: The ratio of units sold to units available for this listing over a rolling period (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.75 = 75% sell-through rate). Used for inventory health monitoring, markdown decision support, and dead stock identification. Calculated from SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) POS/digital transaction data.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); NRF inventory management KPIs; Blue Yonder Demand Planning sell-through analytics

attributes.name: shipping_weight_kg
attributes.description: The shipping weight of the product in kilograms as declared on the marketplace listing. Used for marketplace fulfillment fee calculation (FBA, WFS), shipping cost estimation, and hazmat classification. Sourced from Informatica MDM product master.
attributes.references: GS1 product measurement standards; Amazon FBA weight-based fee schedule; Walmart WFS dimensional weight policy

attributes.name: suppression_reason
attributes.description: The reason code or description provided by the marketplace when a listing is suppressed or removed (e.g., 'missing_main_image', 'price_violation', 'restricted_product', 'safety_recall'). Populated only when listing_status = 'suppressed' or 'removed'. Used for remediation workflow management.
attributes.references: Amazon Seller Central suppression reason codes; Walmart Marketplace listing policy violations; CPSC product recall notifications

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: The 12-digit Universal Product Code (UPC) associated with this listing. Used by marketplaces for product catalog matching and compliance. Sourced from Informatica MDM product golden record.
attributes.references: GS1 US UPC-A barcode standard; CPSC product identification requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: storefront_fulfillment_network
products.description: This association product represents the fulfillment routing configuration between digital storefronts and distribution center facilities. It captures the operational rules that govern which DCs can fulfill orders from which storefronts, including priority rankings, service level agreements, cutoff times, and shipping cost tiers. Each record links one storefront to one DC with attributes that define the fulfillment relationship parameters and exist only in the context of this routing configuration.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, each digital storefront (main site, mobile app, marketplace presence) is configured to route orders to multiple distribution centers based on geography, inventory availability, and service level requirements. Simultaneously, each DC serves multiple storefronts across different channels and locales. The business actively manages this fulfillment network configuration, adjusting priority rankings, cutoff times, and capacity limits as operational conditions change.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the distribution center facility that can fulfill orders for this storefront

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the digital storefront that this fulfillment routing rule applies to

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fulfillment routing configuration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cutoff_time
attributes.description: The daily cutoff time (in HH:MM:SS format, in the DC's local time zone) by which orders must be received to qualify for the service level agreement. Orders received after this time are processed the next business day.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this fulfillment routing configuration was or will be deactivated and no longer eligible for order routing. NULL indicates the configuration is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this fulfillment routing configuration became or will become active and eligible for order routing decisions.

attributes.name: fulfillment_priority_rank
attributes.description: Integer ranking indicating the priority order in which this DC should be considered for fulfilling orders from this storefront (1 = highest priority). Lower numbers are attempted first in order routing logic.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment routing configuration is currently active and should be considered by order routing logic. Derived from effective date range but maintained for query performance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fulfillment routing configuration record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: max_daily_order_capacity
attributes.description: The maximum number of orders from this storefront that this DC can process per day under this routing configuration. Used for capacity-aware order routing to prevent DC overload.

attributes.name: service_level_agreement
attributes.description: The service level commitment for orders fulfilled from this DC to this storefront (e.g., STANDARD, EXPRESS, SAME_DAY, NEXT_DAY, TWO_DAY). Defines the delivery speed promise for this fulfillment path.

attributes.name: shipping_cost_tier
attributes.description: The cost tier classification for shipping from this DC to customers in this storefront's primary market (e.g., TIER_1 for lowest cost local fulfillment, TIER_5 for highest cost cross-country fulfillment). Used in fulfillment cost optimization.

products.name: storefront_assortment
products.description: This association product represents the localized assortment execution strategy between assortment_plan and storefront. It captures how a single merchandising assortment plan is adapted and deployed across different digital storefronts with locale-specific SKU selections, timing, and depth targets. Each record links one assortment_plan to one storefront with attributes that exist only in the context of this channel-specific execution.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, a single merchandising assortment plan (e.g., Spring Apparel 2024) is executed differently across multiple digital storefronts based on locale, market maturity, currency, and channel strategy. Conversely, a single storefront carries multiple assortment plans simultaneously across different categories, seasons, and departments. The business actively manages these storefront-specific assortment configurations as operational records with localized SKU selections, launch timing, budget allocations, and publication workflows.

attributes.name: storefront_assortment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this storefront-specific assortment execution record. Primary key.

attributes.name: assortment_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the source assortment plan being executed on this storefront

attributes.name: published_by_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user (merchandiser or e-commerce manager) who published this assortment configuration to the storefront.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the digital storefront where this assortment plan is deployed

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this assortment plan expires on this specific storefront. May differ from the plan's global effective_end_date due to locale-specific seasonality, clearance timing, or market-specific product lifecycle.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this assortment plan becomes active on this specific storefront. May differ from the plan's global effective_start_date due to locale-specific launch timing, market readiness, or phased rollout strategy.

attributes.name: localized_assortment_strategy
attributes.description: Detailed description of how the assortment plan is adapted for this storefront's market, including SKU selection rationale, depth/breadth adjustments, locale-specific product preferences, competitive positioning, and any regulatory or cultural considerations.

attributes.name: localized_otb_budget_amount
attributes.description: Open-to-Buy budget allocated specifically for this storefront's execution of the assortment plan. Represents the portion of the plan's total OTB budget allocated to this channel.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the deployment priority of this storefront for this assortment plan. Used for phased rollout strategies where high-priority markets launch first.

attributes.name: publication_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this storefront assortment configuration: draft (under development), pending_review (awaiting approval), approved (ready for publication), published (live on storefront), suspended (temporarily inactive), archived (historical record).

attributes.name: published_date
attributes.description: Date when this assortment configuration was published and made live on the storefront. Used for tracking deployment history and performance analysis.

attributes.name: sku_count_target
attributes.description: Target number of SKUs to be carried on this specific storefront for this assortment plan. May be a subset of the plan's global planned_sku_count due to locale preferences, regulatory restrictions, warehouse availability, or market size.

products.name: storefront_responsibility
products.description: This association product represents the buying responsibility assignment between a merchandise buyer and a digital storefront. It captures the multi-channel accountability structure where buyers manage assortments, budgets, and performance targets across different storefronts (main site, mobile app, marketplace, international sites). Each record links one buyer to one storefront with channel-specific scope, budget allocation, and performance targets that exist only in the context of this buyer-storefront assignment.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, merchandise buyers commonly manage assortments across multiple digital storefronts (main e-commerce site, mobile app, marketplace presences, international sites), and each storefront typically has multiple buyers responsible for different categories or departments. A buyer managing apparel may have different category scopes, budget allocations, and performance targets for the US site versus the UK site versus the Amazon marketplace presence. This is an operational accountability structure that the business actively manages.

attributes.name: storefront_responsibility_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each buyer-storefront responsibility assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: buyer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the merchandise buyer responsible for this storefront assignment

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the digital storefront for which buying responsibility is assigned

attributes.name: approval_authority_override
attributes.description: Optional override of the buyers standard buying_authority_limit specifically for this storefront. Null if the buyers default authority applies. Used when certain channels require different approval thresholds due to risk profile or business model differences.

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this buyer was assigned buying responsibility for this storefront. Used to track assignment history and tenure per channel.

attributes.name: budget_allocation
attributes.description: The portion of the buyers total OTB budget allocated specifically to this storefront for the current fiscal period. Enables tracking of multi-channel budget distribution and storefront-specific spending authority.

attributes.name: category_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of category codes for which this buyer has purchasing and assortment responsibility specifically for this storefront. May differ from the buyers overall assigned_category_codes if storefront-specific scope is narrower or different.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this buyers responsibility for this storefront ended or is scheduled to end. Null for active assignments.

attributes.name: performance_target
attributes.description: JSON or structured text capturing storefront-specific performance targets for this buyer assignment, which may include GMROI, sell-through rate, inventory turn, and other KPIs that differ by channel due to different customer demographics, fulfillment models, or competitive dynamics.

attributes.name: primary_responsibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront is the buyers primary channel responsibility. Used when a buyer manages multiple storefronts but one is their main focus or accountability center.

attributes.name: responsibility_scope
attributes.description: Classification of the scope of buying responsibility for this buyer-storefront combination. Indicates whether the buyer manages the full assortment, a subset of categories/departments, or specific product types (private label, seasonal) for this storefront.

attributes.name: storefront_responsibility_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this buyer-storefront responsibility assignment. ACTIVE indicates the buyer is currently responsible; INACTIVE indicates the assignment has ended; SUSPENDED indicates temporary removal of responsibility; PENDING indicates future-dated assignment.

products.name: catalog_node_inventory
products.description: This association product represents the inventory position of a digital catalog SKU at a specific fulfillment node. It captures the omnichannel inventory management relationship between what is published online and where it can be physically fulfilled. Each record links one digital catalog item to one fulfillment node with node-specific inventory levels, reorder thresholds, lead times, and channel-specific availability flags (BOPIS, ship-from-store) that exist only in the context of this catalog-node pairing.. Existence Justification: In omnichannel retail operations, a single digital catalog SKU is stocked and fulfilled from multiple fulfillment nodes (stores, DCs, MFCs), and each node stocks thousands of catalog SKUs. The business actively manages per-node inventory positions, reorder thresholds, and channel-specific availability flags (BOPIS, SFS) for each catalog-node pairing. This is operational inventory management, not an analytical correlation.

attributes.name: catalog_node_inventory_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Catalog Node Inventory - Catalog Node Inventory Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the catalog_node_inventory association

attributes.name: digital_catalog_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Catalog Node Inventory - Digital Catalog Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the digital catalog SKU record representing the online product listing

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Catalog Node Inventory - Fulfillment Node Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the fulfillment node where this catalog item may be stocked or fulfilled from

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this catalog-node inventory relationship was first established in the system, typically when a SKU is first allocated to a node.

attributes.name: inventory_quantity
attributes.description: Current on-hand inventory quantity of this catalog SKU available at this specific fulfillment node. Used for ATP (available-to-promise) calculations in order routing and online availability display.

attributes.name: is_available_for_bopis
attributes.description: Indicates whether this catalog SKU is currently available for Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) fulfillment at this specific node. Node-specific because not all nodes support BOPIS and availability depends on local inventory and operational capacity.

attributes.name: is_available_for_ship_from_store
attributes.description: Indicates whether this catalog SKU is currently available for Ship-From-Store (SFS) fulfillment at this specific node. Node-specific because SFS capability depends on node type, pack station availability, and carrier assignments at the node level.

attributes.name: is_bopis_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is eligible for the Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) fulfillment option on this storefront. Supports omnichannel fulfillment routing and online-to-offline attribution analytics. [Moved from digital_catalog: BOPIS eligibility is not a global catalog attribute but varies by fulfillment node. A SKU may be BOPIS-eligible at nodes with BOPIS capability and sufficient inventory, but not at nodes lacking BOPIS infrastructure or stock. This belongs in the catalog-node association as is_available_for_bopis.]
attributes.references: NRF — Omnichannel Fulfillment Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: is_ship_from_store_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU can be fulfilled via the Ship-from-Store (SFS) model, where a physical retail store acts as the fulfillment center for online orders. Supports distributed fulfillment network optimization. [Moved from digital_catalog: Ship-from-store eligibility is not a global catalog attribute but varies by fulfillment node capabilities. A SKU may be SFS-eligible at stores with pack stations and carrier contracts, but not at dark stores or MFCs with different fulfillment models. This belongs in the catalog-node association as is_available_for_ship_from_store.]
attributes.references: NRF — Omnichannel Fulfillment Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: last_inventory_update_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent inventory quantity update for this catalog-node pairing. Used to monitor inventory data freshness and trigger reconciliation processes.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required to replenish inventory of this catalog SKU at this specific node from its upstream supply source. Varies by node due to geographic distance and transportation mode.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Inventory level threshold at which a replenishment order should be triggered for this catalog SKU at this node. Node-specific because different nodes have different demand patterns and replenishment lead times.

products.name: message_template
products.description: Master reference table for message_template. Referenced by message_template_id.

attributes.name: message_template_id
attributes.description: Primary key for message_template

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created this message template.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_associate_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Modified By User Associate Id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this message template.

attributes.name: a_b_test_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this template is part of an A/B testing experiment for message optimization.

attributes.name: a_b_test_variant
attributes.description: Identifies which variant this template represents in an A/B test experiment.

attributes.name: average_click_through_rate_percent
attributes.description: Historical average click-through rate percentage for messages sent using this template. Key performance indicator for engagement.

attributes.name: average_conversion_rate_percent
attributes.description: Historical average conversion rate percentage for messages sent using this template. Measures effectiveness in driving desired actions.

attributes.name: average_open_rate_percent
attributes.description: Historical average open rate percentage for messages sent using this template. Used for template performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: body_content
attributes.description: Main message body content with support for HTML markup for email templates or plain text for SMS. Contains merge field placeholders for personalization.

attributes.name: call_to_action_text
attributes.description: Primary call-to-action button or link text encouraging recipient engagement.

attributes.name: call_to_action_url
attributes.description: Target URL for the primary call-to-action link. May include UTM parameters for campaign tracking.

attributes.name: character_count
attributes.description: Total character count of the message body content. Critical for SMS templates with character limits.

attributes.name: compliance_reviewed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the template content has been reviewed and approved for regulatory compliance including CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and TCPA requirements.

attributes.name: compliance_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date when the template was last reviewed for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this message template record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: design_template_code
attributes.description: Reference to the visual design template or layout framework used for rendering this message.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this template is no longer available for use. Null indicates no expiration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this template becomes available for use in campaigns and automated messaging workflows.

attributes.name: estimated_send_time_seconds
attributes.description: Average estimated time in seconds required to process and send a message using this template.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code with optional ISO 3166-1 country code indicating the language and locale of the template content.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this message template record was last updated.

attributes.name: last_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when a message was last sent using this template.

attributes.name: merge_fields
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of merge field placeholders available in this template for dynamic content insertion (e.g., customer_name, order_number, product_name).

attributes.name: message_category
attributes.description: Business category classification of the message template indicating its purpose and use case in the customer journey.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Internal notes and comments about the template for team collaboration and documentation purposes.

attributes.name: personalization_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the template includes dynamic personalization merge fields for customer-specific content.

attributes.name: preheader_text
attributes.description: Preview text displayed in email clients before the message is opened. Used to increase open rates.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Delivery priority level for message queue processing and send order optimization.

attributes.name: reply_to_email
attributes.description: Email address where recipient replies will be directed.

attributes.name: sender_email
attributes.description: Email address used as the from address for email templates.

attributes.name: sender_name
attributes.description: Display name shown as the sender of the message to recipients.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the message template indicating its availability for use in campaigns and automated messaging.

attributes.name: subject_line
attributes.description: Subject line text for email templates or title text for push notifications. May contain merge field placeholders.

attributes.name: template_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the message template used for external reference and integration purposes.

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the message template for identification and selection purposes.

attributes.name: template_type
attributes.description: Classification of the message template by delivery channel type.

attributes.name: total_sends_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of messages sent using this template since activation.

attributes.name: unsubscribe_link_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this template type requires an unsubscribe link per regulatory requirements for promotional messages.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the template for change tracking and rollback capability.

attributes.name: parent_message_template_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on message_template (parent_message_template_id)

domains.name: fulfillment
domains.description: Manages order picking, packing, ship-from-store, BOPIS/ROPIS processing, dark store fulfillment, last-mile delivery execution, carrier selection, route optimization, and fulfillment KPI tracking. Owns the operational execution layer between order capture and customer delivery, including transportation planning and last-mile logistics.

products.name: fulfillment_order
products.description: Core operational record representing a fulfillment work order created from a customer order. Tracks the end-to-end execution of picking, packing, and shipping activities for a single order or order subset. Captures fulfillment method (ship-from-store, dark store, DC, BOPIS, ROPIS, drop-ship), assigned fulfillment node, SLA commitment, promised delivery date, current fulfillment status, and carrier assignment. This is the primary entity in the fulfillment domain and the operational counterpart to the order domain's order record.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fulfillment order. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the third-party logistics provider or carrier assigned to deliver this fulfillment order.

attributes.name: carrier_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.carrier_service. Business justification: fulfillment_order has carrier_id FK and denormalized carrier_service_level column, but no FK to carrier_service. Business reality: a fulfillment order is assigned a specific carrier service for shipme

attributes.name: compliance_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Fulfillment orders for regulated products (food, pharma, hazmat) must comply with specific programs (HACCP, FDA, DOT). Enables compliance tracking per order and supports audit trails for regulatory in

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Fulfillment operations incur labor, packaging, and shipping costs that must be allocated to cost centers for operational expense tracking, budget variance analysis, and P&L reporting by fulfillment ch

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the inventory node (store, dark store, distribution center, or warehouse) assigned to fulfill this order.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or store employee assigned to pick items for this fulfillment order. Used for productivity tracking.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_packer_employee_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who packed this fulfillment order. Used for quality control and productivity analysis.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating customer order that spawned this fulfillment work order. Links back to the order domain.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store location when fulfillment method is ship-from-store, BOPIS, or ROPIS.

attributes.name: outbound_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.outbound_order. Business justification: Store replenishment orders fulfilled from DC create both outbound_order (DC perspective) and fulfillment_order (execution). Links DC dispatch to fulfillment execution for ship-to-store scenarios, enab

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Fulfillment orders execute in specific price zones for zone-based pricing, shipping cost allocation, and regional pricing compliance. Retail operations track which price zone applies to each fulfillme

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who placed the originating order. Required for customer communication and service.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Orders generate revenue attributed to specific profit centers (store, online channel, region) for segment reporting, profitability analysis, and management reporting required for retail financial stat

attributes.name: shipping_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer address where this fulfillment order will be delivered. Not applicable for BOPIS/ROPIS orders.

attributes.name: sku_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.sku_price. Business justification: Fulfillment orders require actual selling price for shipment value declaration, insurance coverage calculation, customs documentation, and financial reconciliation. Links fulfillment execution to the

attributes.name: actual_fulfillment_hours
attributes.description: The actual elapsed time in hours from fulfillment order creation to completion. Used for performance measurement against SLA.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this fulfillment order was cancelled, if applicable. Used for root cause analysis.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fulfillment order reached final completion state (delivered or picked up by customer).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this fulfillment order.

attributes.name: fulfillment_assigned_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fulfillment order was assigned to a specific fulfillment node and became actionable.

attributes.name: fulfillment_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment order record was created in the system. Marks the start of fulfillment processing.

attributes.name: fulfillment_method

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_number

attributes.name: fulfillment_status

attributes.name: gift_message
attributes.description: Customer-provided gift message to be included with the shipment, if this is a gift order.

attributes.name: is_gift
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment order is a gift, requiring special packaging and excluding pricing information from packing slip.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this fulfillment order record. Used for change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the customer placed the originating order. Used for SLA calculation and aging analysis.

attributes.name: package_count
attributes.description: Number of physical packages or parcels created for this fulfillment order. Orders may be split across multiple packages.

attributes.name: packing_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fulfillment order was packed and ready for shipment or pickup.

attributes.name: packing_slip_url
attributes.description: URL to the packing slip document that accompanies the shipment, listing order contents.

attributes.name: picking_completed_timestamp

attributes.name: picking_started_timestamp

attributes.name: pickup_location_code
attributes.description: Designated area or counter code within the store where BOPIS/ROPIS orders are staged for customer pickup.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Processing priority assigned to this fulfillment order based on customer tier, service level, or business rules.

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date communicated to the customer as the expected delivery or pickup availability date. Used for SLA tracking.

attributes.name: shipped_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fulfillment order was handed off to the carrier for delivery.

attributes.name: shipping_cost_amount
attributes.description: Actual cost incurred for carrier services to ship this fulfillment order. Used for profitability analysis and cost allocation.

attributes.name: shipping_label_url
attributes.description: URL to the generated shipping label document for this fulfillment order, used by warehouse staff for package labeling.

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours from order creation to promised delivery, representing the committed service level for this fulfillment method.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Additional instructions for fulfillment staff regarding fragile items, gift wrapping, temperature control, or other special requirements.

attributes.name: total_item_quantity
attributes.description: Total number of individual units across all line items in this fulfillment order. Used for capacity planning and picker productivity.

attributes.name: total_line_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct SKU line items in this fulfillment order. Impacts picking complexity and time.

attributes.name: total_volume_cubic_meters
attributes.description: Total volumetric size of the fulfillment order in cubic meters, used for transportation planning and dimensional weight pricing.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of the fulfillment order in kilograms, used for carrier selection, shipping cost calculation, and capacity planning.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: The carrier-provided tracking identifier used by customers and operations to monitor shipment progress.

products.name: fulfillment_line
products.description: Line-level detail of a fulfillment order, representing each SKU/UPC being fulfilled. Captures quantity requested, quantity picked, quantity packed, quantity shipped, unit of measure, pick location, substitution flag, and line-level fulfillment status. Enables granular tracking of partial fulfillments, substitutions, and out-of-stock exceptions at the item level.

attributes.name: fulfillment_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fulfillment line item. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific fulfillment location (DC number, store number, vendor ID, etc.). Links to the physical location that executed fulfillment.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fulfillment order header. Links this line to the overall fulfillment order.

attributes.name: haccp_control_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.haccp_control_point. Business justification: Perishable/food SKUs must reference HACCP critical control points for temperature monitoring, lot traceability, and recall management. Required for FDA compliance and food safety audits in grocery ful

attributes.name: handling_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the shipping carton or container into which this line was packed. Links line items to physical shipment packages.

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original sales order line that this fulfillment line is satisfying. Links fulfillment execution back to customer order.

attributes.name: outbound_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.outbound_order_line. Business justification: Line-level linkage for DC-to-store replenishment. Each fulfillment_line executing store replenishment corresponds to outbound_order_line in DC system. Critical for SKU-level reconciliation and invento

attributes.name: primary_fulfillment_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse associate who picked this line. Used for productivity tracking and quality accountability.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Fulfillment lines must reference the product SKU being fulfilled. The product_name column becomes redundant as it can be joined from product.sku. This links fulfillment execution to the product catalo

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor_item. Business justification: Fulfillment costing and allocation decisions require vendor item master data for cost, pack configuration, and vendor-specific attributes. Real-world WMS systems query vendor_item during order fulfill

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fulfillment line record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Code identifying any exception or issue encountered during fulfillment of this line (stockout, damage, mispick, etc.). Null if no exception occurred.

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the fulfillment exception or issue. Provides context for exception resolution and process improvement.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the picked inventory. Critical for perishable goods, food safety, and FEFO (First Expired First Out) fulfillment strategies.

attributes.name: extended_cost
attributes.description: Total cost for this line (unit cost × quantity shipped). Represents total COGS for the fulfilled quantity.

attributes.name: fulfillment_source_type
attributes.description: Type of fulfillment location from which this line was fulfilled (distribution center, store, dark store, vendor direct, third-party logistics). Enables omnichannel fulfillment analysis.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number for the product. International standard product identifier used across supply chain and fulfillment systems.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the fulfillment order. Used for ordering and referencing specific line items.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment status of this line item. Tracks progression through the fulfillment workflow from allocation to shipment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|allocated|picked|packed|shipped|cancelled|exception — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot or batch number of the picked inventory. Critical for traceability, recalls, and expiry management.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fulfillment line record was last updated. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: original_sku
attributes.description: The originally ordered SKU if this line is a substitution. Null if no substitution occurred. Enables tracking of substitution patterns and customer acceptance.

attributes.name: pack_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this line was packed into a shipping container. Used for throughput analysis and bottleneck identification.

attributes.name: pick_location
attributes.description: The warehouse location (aisle, bin, shelf) from which this item was picked. Used for inventory tracking and pick path optimization.

attributes.name: pick_timestamp

products.name: delivery_stop

products.name: carrier
products.description: Master record for carrier and 3PL partners used for outbound shipment execution, encompassing carrier identity, service catalog, and contracted rate cards. Captures carrier name, carrier code, carrier type (parcel, LTL, FTL, last-mile, same-day), SCAC code, EDI/API integration capabilities. Service catalog includes service levels (ground, 2-day, overnight, same-day, BOPIS-ready), transit days by zone, cutoff times, max weight/dimensions, surcharge types, tracking capability, signature required flag, and geographic restrictions. Rate card includes base rates by zone/weight/service, dimensional weight factor, fuel surcharges, residential delivery surcharges, extended area surcharges, negotiated discount percentages, rate effective and expiry dates, and weight breaks. Serves as the single source of truth for all carrier master data, service definitions, and freight cost references within the fulfillment domain. Used in carrier selection logic during fulfillment order routing and freight cost estimation.

products.name: carrier_facility_contract
products.description: This association product represents the contractual service agreement between a carrier and a distribution center facility. It captures facility-specific carrier terms including negotiated rates, service level commitments, pickup schedules, and dock door assignments. Each record links one carrier to one DC facility with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific carrier-facility relationship, enabling multi-carrier operations at each DC and multi-facility service coverage by each carrier.. Existence Justification: In retail distribution operations, carriers provide service to multiple DC facilities across the network, and each DC facility contracts with multiple carriers to ensure service redundancy, cost optimization, and capacity flexibility. attributes.name: profit_center_id

attributes.name: return_policy_id

attributes.references: Internal Financial Controls and Audit Standard

products.name: vendor_credit
products.description: Financial credit memo record issued by a supplier/vendor in response to an approved RTV request. Captures the vendor reference, RTV request reference, credit memo number issued by the vendor, credit amount, credit date, credit type (full credit, partial credit, replacement goods), credit status (pending, received, applied, disputed), and the accounts payable document reference for credit application. Enables vendor credit reconciliation and chargeback management.

attributes.name: vendor_credit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor credit memo record. Primary key for the vendor credit entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Vendor credit processing and dispute resolution costs allocated to procurement or supply chain cost centers. Required for operational expense tracking, budget management, and supplier relationship cos

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vendor Credit Gl Account Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Vendor credits post to AP GL accounts for RTV (Return to Vendor) transactions. Critical for month-end close, AP reconciliation, and three-way match validation. Replaces denormalized gl_account_code wi

attributes.name: primary_vendor_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the buyer or procurement employee responsible for managing this vendor credit and RTV process. Identifies the business owner of the credit transaction.

attributes.name: quaternary_vendor_last_modified_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: User ID of the system user who last modified this vendor credit record. Provides audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: rtv_request_id
attributes.description: Reference to the RTV request that triggered this vendor credit. Links the credit memo to the original return authorization.

attributes.name: tertiary_vendor_created_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: User ID of the system user who created this vendor credit record. Provides audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor who issued this credit memo. Identifies the party providing the credit.

attributes.name: ap_document_number
attributes.description: Reference to the accounts payable document or transaction where this vendor credit was applied. Links the credit to the financial system posting.

attributes.name: chargeback_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to any vendor compliance chargeback that this credit is offsetting or related to. Links credits to vendor penalty reversals.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor credit record was first created in the system. Represents the initial capture of the credit memo information.

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the credit issued by the vendor. Represents the amount to be credited to the retailer's accounts payable or applied against future purchases.

attributes.name: credit_applied_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credit was applied to the retailer's accounts payable ledger or offset against vendor invoices.

attributes.name: credit_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor issued the credit memo. This is the official credit issuance date from the vendor's perspective.

attributes.name: credit_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date by which the vendor credit must be utilized or applied. After this date, the credit may no longer be valid per vendor terms.

attributes.name: credit_memo_number
attributes.description: The unique credit memo number issued by the vendor. This is the vendor's external reference for the credit document.

attributes.name: credit_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which the retailer received notification or documentation of the vendor credit. May differ from the credit issuance date.

attributes.name: credit_status
attributes.description: Current status of the vendor credit in the credit lifecycle. Tracks whether the credit has been received from the vendor, applied to accounts payable, or is under dispute.

attributes.name: credit_type
attributes.description: The type of credit being issued by the vendor. Indicates whether the vendor is providing full monetary credit, partial credit, replacement goods in lieu of credit, or other credit arrangements.

attributes.name: credit_variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between expected credit amount and actual credit amount. Positive variance indicates the retailer received more credit than expected; negative indicates less.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the credit amount. Identifies the currency in which the vendor credit is denominated.

attributes.name: dispute_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for dispute if the credit status is disputed. Captures why the retailer is contesting the vendor's credit amount or terms.

attributes.name: dispute_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed text description of the dispute reason. Provides additional context for credit disputes requiring vendor negotiation or resolution.

attributes.name: expected_credit_amount
attributes.description: The credit amount that the retailer expected to receive based on the RTV request and vendor agreement. Used for variance analysis when actual credit differs from expected.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor credit record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to credit status, amounts, or other attributes.

attributes.name: notes
