attributes.description: Date of the most recent periodic depreciation calculation run for this asset. Updated monthly during financial close.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer or original equipment manufacturer (OEM) of the asset.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer model or part number identifying the specific asset configuration or variant.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fixed asset record was last updated. Audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying value of the asset calculated as acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the asset's value on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number under which the asset was procured. Provides audit trail to procurement transaction.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was retired from service or disposed. Marks the end of the depreciation lifecycle.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life. Subtracted from acquisition cost to determine depreciable base.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number or unique equipment identifier for trackable assets such as POS terminals, vehicles, and warehouse equipment.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the asset in years as determined by asset class and accounting policy. Used to calculate annual depreciation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the manufacturer or vendor warranty coverage expires. Used for maintenance planning and risk assessment.

products.name: lease_contract
products.description: Retail lease contract master record with full payment lifecycle for store locations, DC facilities, and equipment leases under FASB ASC 842. Captures lessor, lease term, classification (operating vs. finance), ROU asset value, lease liability, incremental borrowing rate, payment schedule with individual payment records (payment date, amount, principal/interest split, variable lease payments), ROU amortization, lease liability reduction, renewal options, and GL posting references. Supports monthly lease accounting close, ASC 842 balance sheet recognition, payment tracking, and disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: lease_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the lease contract record. Primary key for the lease_contract data product in the finance domain Silver layer.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Lease contracts have gl_cost_center (STRING) but no FK to cost_center master. This FK enables cost allocation for lease expenses (ASC 842 compliance).

attributes.name: environmental_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.environmental_event. Business justification: Retail store leases involve environmental compliance (refrigerant leaks, hazmat storage, waste disposal). Environmental events at leased locations are tracked against leases for landlord notification,

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store or facility location covered by this lease. Links to the store master record for operational reporting, comp sales (SSS) analysis, and P&L attribution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA RE-FX; NRF Store Operations

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Retail store leases require regulatory filings (occupancy permits, zoning compliance, environmental disclosures). Lease administration tracks associated filings for renewal compliance verification and

attributes.name: rou_asset_gl_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rou Asset Gl Account Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Lease contracts have gl_account_rou_asset (STRING) but no FK to gl_account master. This FK links to the GL account for right-of-use asset under ASC 842. This is the FIRST of two FKs from lease_contrac

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lessor's master supplier/vendor record in the MDM system (Informatica MDM). Enables linkage to supplier payment terms, banking details, and vendor compliance records.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM; SAP S/4HANA Vendor Master

attributes.name: base_rent_monthly
attributes.description: Fixed monthly base rent payment amount as stipulated in the lease contract, excluding variable lease components (e.g., percentage rent, CAM charges). Used as the primary input for lease payment schedule generation and ASC 842 liability measurement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-10-15-28; NRF Retail Lease Standards

attributes.name: commencement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lease term begins and the lessee obtains the right to use the underlying asset. This is the measurement date for initial ROU asset and lease liability recognition under ASC 842.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the lease contract, used in correspondence with lessors, auditors, and legal teams. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI/CO lease contract object (RE-FX module).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lease contract record was first created in the system (SAP S/4HANA RE-FX or finance data product). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and financial close process tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this lease contract (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency lease portfolios for international retail operations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Contractual end date of the non-cancellable lease term. Used to calculate remaining lease term, schedule final payments, and trigger renewal option evaluation workflows.

attributes.name: gl_account_lease_liability
attributes.description: SAP GL account number for the lease liability recognized on the balance sheet at lease commencement under ASC 842. Tracks the present value of future lease payments for balance sheet disclosure.

attributes.name: implicit_rate
attributes.description: The rate of interest implicit in the lease as defined by the lessor, used as the discount rate when readily determinable. Takes precedence over the incremental borrowing rate (IBR) for lease liability measurement under ASC 842. Expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: incremental_borrowing_rate
attributes.description: The interest rate the lessee would have to pay to borrow funds on a collateralized basis over a similar term and in a similar economic environment, used to discount future lease payments to present value when the implicit rate is not readily determinable. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.045000 = 4.5%). Required for ASC 842 lease liability measurement.

attributes.name: initial_direct_cost
attributes.description: Incremental costs incurred by the lessee directly attributable to negotiating and arranging the lease (e.g., legal fees, broker commissions). Added to the initial ROU asset value at commencement under ASC 842.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent lease payment was made to the lessor. Used for payment reconciliation, delinquency monitoring, and lease liability roll-forward calculations during monthly close.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO AP

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the lease contract record, including remeasurements, modifications, and status changes. Supports incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver layer and audit compliance.

attributes.name: lease_incentive_amount
attributes.description: Total lease incentives received from the lessor (e.g., tenant improvement allowances, rent-free periods, moving allowances). Reduces the initial ROU asset value at commencement under ASC 842 and is amortized over the lease term.

attributes.name: lease_liability_balance
attributes.description: Current outstanding lease liability balance as of the last accounting close, reflecting initial recognition less principal payments made to date. Split into current and non-current portions for balance sheet classification per ASC 842.

attributes.name: lease_liability_initial
attributes.description: Present value of future lease payments discounted at the applicable rate (implicit rate or IBR) at lease commencement date. Represents the initial lease liability recognized on the balance sheet under ASC 842.

attributes.name: lease_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the lease contract. Drives accounting treatment, payment processing, and disclosure eligibility. 'Modified' indicates a lease modification event requiring remeasurement under ASC 842.

attributes.name: lease_term_months
attributes.description: Total non-cancellable lease term expressed in months, including any renewal periods that are reasonably certain to be exercised. Used for amortization schedule generation and ASC 842 disclosure of weighted-average remaining lease term.

attributes.name: lease_type
attributes.description: ASC 842 classification of the lease as either an operating lease (expense recognized straight-line on P&L) or a finance lease (ROU asset amortized separately from interest expense). Drives balance sheet recognition and disclosure treatment.

attributes.name: leased_asset_category
attributes.description: Category of the underlying leased asset. Retail-specific categories include store locations (hypermarkets, department stores, discount outlets), distribution centers (DC), dark stores, micro-fulfillment centers (MFC), equipment, and vehicles. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: store_location|distribution_center|office|equipment|vehicle|dark_store|micro_fulfillment_center — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; NRF Retail Property Standards

attributes.name: lessor_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the lessor (landlord or equipment owner) as stated in the lease agreement. Used for counterparty identification in AP processing, EDI transactions, and disclosure reporting.

attributes.name: low_value_asset_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease qualifies for the low-value asset practical expedient (typically assets with an underlying value below $5,000 when new). When True, lease payments are recognized as expense on a straight-line basis without balance sheet recognition.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25-2; IFRS 16 (reference for international operations)

attributes.name: modification_date
attributes.description: Date on which a lease modification event occurred (e.g., extension of lease term, addition of leased space, change in rent). Triggers remeasurement of the ROU asset and lease liability at the modification date under ASC 842.

attributes.name: modification_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the nature of the most recent lease modification event. Determines whether the modification is accounted for as a separate new lease or a remeasurement of the existing lease under ASC 842.

attributes.name: next_payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next scheduled lease payment is due to the lessor. Used for AP cash management, payment run scheduling, and short-term lease liability classification on the balance sheet.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which lease payments are due under the contract terms. Drives payment schedule generation, cash flow forecasting, and AP payment run scheduling in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: purchase_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contract includes an option for the lessee to purchase the underlying asset. A purchase option that is reasonably certain to be exercised is a criterion for finance lease classification under ASC 842.

attributes.name: renewal_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contract contains one or more renewal options. When True, renewal_option_term_months and renewal_reasonably_certain_flag must be evaluated for inclusion in the lease term under ASC 842.

attributes.name: renewal_option_term_months
attributes.description: Duration in months of the renewal option period(s) available under the lease contract. Included in the lease term measurement when the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise the option.

attributes.name: renewal_reasonably_certain_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lessee has determined it is reasonably certain to exercise the renewal option, requiring inclusion of the renewal period in the lease term and remeasurement of ROU asset and lease liability under ASC 842.

attributes.name: rou_asset_carrying_value
attributes.description: Current net book value of the ROU asset after accumulated amortization (finance lease) or straight-line adjustments (operating lease) as of the last accounting close date. Used for balance sheet presentation and ASC 842 disclosure.

attributes.name: rou_asset_initial_value
attributes.description: Initial carrying amount of the Right-of-Use (ROU) asset recognized at lease commencement, equal to the initial lease liability plus any lease payments made at or before commencement, less any lease incentives received, plus initial direct costs. Expressed in functional currency (USD).

attributes.name: short_term_lease_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease qualifies for the short-term lease practical expedient under ASC 842 (lease term of 12 months or less at commencement). When True, the lessee is not required to recognize an ROU asset or lease liability on the balance sheet.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the lease was terminated early (if applicable). Triggers derecognition of the ROU asset and lease liability and recognition of any gain or loss on termination under ASC 842.

attributes.name: termination_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contract contains an early termination option. When True, the termination option must be assessed for reasonable certainty of exercise, which may shorten the lease term used in ASC 842 measurement.

attributes.name: variable_lease_payment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contract includes variable lease payments (e.g., percentage rent based on store sales, CPI-indexed escalations, or CAM charges). Variable payments not dependent on an index or rate are excluded from lease liability measurement but disclosed separately under ASC 842.

attributes.name: variable_payment_basis
attributes.description: Describes the basis on which variable lease payments are calculated. 'sales_percentage' is common in retail (percentage rent tied to store revenue). 'cpi_index' indicates CPI-linked escalation. 'cam_charges' covers common area maintenance. Drives variable payment disclosure under ASC 842.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-10-15-35; NRF Retail Lease Standards

attributes.name: weighted_avg_remaining_term
attributes.description: Weighted average remaining lease term in years as of the reporting date, calculated across the lease portfolio. Required ASC 842 disclosure for both operating and finance leases in the financial statement footnotes.

products.name: intercompany_transaction
products.description: Intercompany financial transaction record capturing cross-entity postings between retail subsidiaries, international entities, and corporate holding companies in SAP S/4HANA FI. Includes sending/receiving company codes, transaction type (management fee, shared service allocation, inventory transfer, loan, dividend), amount, document and local currency, FX conversion rate, netting status, elimination flag, and reconciliation status. Supports legal entity consolidation, intercompany elimination entries, transfer pricing documentation, and multi-currency settlement.
products.reference: SAP FI Intercompany Posting (BKPF with IC indicator)

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the intercompany transaction record. Primary key for cross-entity financial postings between retail subsidiaries, international entities, and corporate holding companies.

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: Intercompany transactions are posted to fiscal periods. The table has fiscal_year (INT) and fiscal_period (INT) but no FK to financial_period master. This FK enables period-level reconciliation and cl

attributes.name: netting_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the netting run in which this intercompany transaction was included for multilateral settlement optimization.

attributes.name: sending_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Intercompany transactions have gl_account_sending (STRING) but no FK to gl_account master. This is the FIRST of two FKs from intercompany_transaction to gl_account, so the FK column name has a disting

attributes.name: sending_profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Intercompany transactions have sending_profit_center (STRING) but no FK to profit_center master. This is the FIRST of two FKs from intercompany_transaction to profit_center, so the FK column name has

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this intercompany transaction record was first created in SAP S/4HANA FI. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: document_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the intercompany transaction was originally denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on the source document or invoice that originated this intercompany transaction. May differ from posting date for timing differences.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP FI document number for this intercompany transaction. Used for audit trail and reconciliation across legal entities.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the intercompany transaction amount is due for settlement between the sending and receiving entities.

attributes.name: elimination_document_number
attributes.description: Reference to the consolidation elimination journal entry document that offsets this intercompany transaction in group reporting.

attributes.name: elimination_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) marking whether this intercompany transaction requires elimination entries during consolidation to remove intra-group transactions from consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate used to convert the document currency to local currencies. Critical for multi-currency intercompany settlement and consolidation.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the exchange rate used (spot rate, monthly average, budget rate, or fixed rate) for currency conversion.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year to which this intercompany transaction is assigned.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this intercompany transaction is assigned for financial reporting and consolidation purposes.

attributes.name: gl_account_receiving
attributes.description: General ledger account number in the receiving company code chart of accounts where the intercompany transaction is posted.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: local_currency_amount_receiving
attributes.description: Transaction amount converted to the local currency of the receiving company code for statutory reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount_sending
attributes.description: Transaction amount converted to the local currency of the sending company code for statutory reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: local_currency_receiving
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the receiving company code's local currency for statutory books.

attributes.name: local_currency_sending
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the sending company code's local currency for statutory books.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this intercompany transaction record was last modified. Tracks changes for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: netting_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intercompany transaction has been included in a multilateral netting process to reduce settlement volumes and FX exposure.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: SAP payment terms code defining the due date calculation and settlement terms for this intercompany transaction (e.g., NET30, NET60).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date when the intercompany transaction was posted to the general ledger. Used for period assignment and financial reporting.

attributes.name: receiving_company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code of the legal entity receiving the intercompany transaction (creditor side in most cases).

attributes.name: receiving_profit_center
attributes.description: Profit center within the receiving company code that is charged or credited for this intercompany transaction. Used for internal P&L reporting.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date when the intercompany transaction was successfully reconciled and confirmed by both sending and receiving entities.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the intercompany reconciliation process indicating whether sending and receiving entries match and have been confirmed by both entities.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference to the originating business document (purchase order, invoice, contract) that triggered this intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: sending_company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code of the legal entity originating the intercompany transaction (debtor side in most cases).

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the intercompany transaction was settled through cash transfer, netting, or other settlement mechanism.

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: The mechanism used to settle the intercompany transaction (cash transfer, multilateral netting, bilateral offset, or in-kind settlement).

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the intercompany transaction in the document currency. Represents the gross amount before any adjustments.

attributes.name: transaction_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional business context and details about the nature and purpose of this intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the intercompany transaction in the financial close and consolidation workflow.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the intercompany transaction indicating the nature of the cross-entity posting (management fee, shared service allocation, inventory transfer, loan, dividend, royalty).

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_documentation_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the supporting transfer pricing documentation, study, or agreement that justifies the pricing of this intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_method
attributes.description: The OECD-compliant transfer pricing methodology applied to determine the arm's length price for this intercompany transaction for tax compliance.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date for cash flow and treasury purposes, particularly relevant for intercompany loans and settlements.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary difference identified during intercompany reconciliation between sending and receiving entity records. Zero indicates perfect match.

products.name: tax_posting
products.description: Tax transaction record capturing sales tax, VAT, use tax, and excise duty postings on retail transactions in SAP S/4HANA FI-TX. Includes tax code, tax jurisdiction (state/county/city/country), taxable base amount, tax amount, tax rate, tax type (input/output), tax determination date, reporting period, nexus indicator, exempt flag, and source document reference. Supports multi-jurisdiction sales tax compliance, Streamlined Sales Tax (SST) reporting, tax return preparation, tax audit defense, and regulatory reporting to federal, state, and local tax authorities.

attributes.name: tax_posting_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tax posting transaction record in SAP S/4HANA FI-TX.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Posting Object

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Tax postings have cost_center (STRING) but no FK to cost_center master. This FK enables cost allocation for tax expenses.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.dc_facility. Business justification: Sales and use tax postings by facility location for nexus determination, tax jurisdiction assignment, and compliance reporting. Required for multi-state retail tax compliance and audit defense.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Tax postings have gl_account_number (STRING) but no FK to gl_account master. This FK enables account validation for tax postings.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the retail store location where the taxable transaction occurred (for POS sales tax postings).

attributes.name: original_posting_tax_posting_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original tax posting ID that this record reverses (populated only when reversal_flag is true).

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the customer for output tax postings on sales transactions.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Tax postings have profit_center (STRING) but no FK to profit_center master. This FK enables P&L allocation for tax expenses.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the supplier/vendor for input tax postings on purchase transactions.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Cross-reference to supporting documentation for tax audit defense (original invoice, receipt, exemption certificate, tax calculation log).

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: The business area code for cross-company-code financial reporting and segment analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Area Configuration

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code representing the legal entity responsible for this tax posting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tax posting record was first created in the SAP S/4HANA FI-TX system.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known accounting document number from which this tax posting originated (invoice, receipt, credit memo).

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of source accounting document that generated this tax posting.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate used to convert transaction currency to local currency for GL posting.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the company's local reporting currency for financial consolidation.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tax posting record was last modified (for correction postings or adjustments).

attributes.name: nexus_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the retailer has established tax nexus (physical or economic presence) in this jurisdiction, triggering tax collection obligation.
attributes.references: US Supreme Court South Dakota v. Wayfair (2018)

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date when the tax transaction was posted to the general ledger in SAP S/4HANA FI.

attributes.name: reporting_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (YYYY-MM format) to which this tax posting is assigned for tax return preparation and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this posting is a reversal of a previously posted tax transaction (for corrections or cancellations).

attributes.name: reverse_charge_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a reverse charge VAT transaction where the customer is responsible for self-assessing and remitting VAT.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount posted to the tax GL account, in transaction currency.

attributes.name: tax_amount_local_currency
attributes.description: The tax amount converted to local reporting currency for financial statement consolidation.

attributes.name: tax_authority_name
attributes.description: The name of the government tax authority to which this tax will be remitted (e.g., California Department of Tax and Fee Administration, IRS).
attributes.references: State and Local Tax Authority Registry

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The SAP tax code that defines the tax type, rate, and GL account assignment for this posting.

attributes.name: tax_determination_date
attributes.description: The business event date used to determine applicable tax rates and jurisdiction (typically transaction date or delivery date).

attributes.name: tax_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is input tax (paid to suppliers) or output tax (collected from customers).

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction qualified for tax exemption (e.g., resale certificate, government entity, non-profit exemption).

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate_number
attributes.description: The exemption certificate number provided by the customer to support tax-exempt status (resale certificate, government ID, non-profit certificate).
attributes.references: Streamlined Sales Tax (SST) Exemption Certificate Standards

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_city
attributes.description: City or municipality name for city-level sales tax jurisdictions (applicable in US multi-jurisdiction tax scenarios).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Composite jurisdiction code uniquely identifying the complete tax authority (country-state-county-city combination).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the tax jurisdiction where the tax obligation arises.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_county
attributes.description: County or district name for county-level sales tax jurisdictions (applicable in US multi-jurisdiction tax scenarios).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code within the country for state-level sales tax (US) or provincial tax (Canada).

attributes.name: tax_point_date
attributes.description: The date when the tax liability arises for VAT purposes (typically invoice date or goods delivery date per VAT regulations).

attributes.name: tax_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The effective tax rate percentage applied to the taxable base (e.g., 8.25000 for 8.25% sales tax).
attributes.references: State and Local Tax Authority Rate Tables

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: The retailer's tax registration number with the jurisdiction's tax authority (sales tax permit number, VAT registration number, GST number).

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: The category of tax being posted (sales tax, VAT, use tax, excise duty, withholding tax, customs duty).

attributes.name: taxable_base_amount
attributes.description: The gross transaction amount subject to tax before tax calculation, in transaction currency.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the tax transaction was recorded.

products.name: bank_account
products.description: Corporate bank account master record for retail entity bank accounts used for AP disbursements, AR collections, payroll funding, and treasury operations in SAP S/4HANA FI-TR. Captures bank name, account number, routing/SWIFT/IBAN, account type (operating, payroll, concentration, lockbox), currency, bank key, daily balance positions, authorized signatories, account status, and GL reconciliation account. Supports cash position reporting, daily bank statement processing, payment method determination, and bank reconciliation workflows.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the corporate bank account record. Primary key for the bank account entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR Bank Account Master

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Bank accounts have gl_account_code (STRING) representing the GL account for bank reconciliation, but no FK to gl_account master. This FK links the bank account to its corresponding GL account in the c

attributes.name: account_closed_date
attributes.description: The date when the bank account was permanently closed, if applicable. Null for active accounts.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The legal name or business description of the bank account as registered with the financial institution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR Bank Account Master

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The financial institution account number used for AP disbursements, AR collections, payroll funding, and treasury operations. Confidential financial identifier.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR Bank Account Master

attributes.name: account_opened_date
attributes.description: The date when the bank account was originally opened with the financial institution.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the bank account indicating whether it is available for transactions, temporarily suspended, permanently closed, or awaiting activation.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The functional classification of the bank account indicating its primary business purpose: operating (general business transactions), payroll (employee compensation), concentration (cash pooling), lockbox (AR collections), disbursement (AP payments), or collection (customer payments).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR Account Type Classification

attributes.name: ach_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this bank account is enabled for ACH electronic funds transfer processing for domestic US transactions.

attributes.name: authorized_signatories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of employee names or identifiers authorized to approve transactions and sign on behalf of the company for this bank account.

attributes.name: available_balance
attributes.description: The available balance for withdrawal or payment processing, accounting for pending transactions, holds, and minimum balance requirements.

attributes.name: bank_key
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the bank in the SAP system, used for payment processing and bank statement reconciliation.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: The name of the financial institution where the account is held.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR Bank Account Master

attributes.name: branch_address
attributes.description: The physical street address of the bank branch where the account is held, used for correspondence and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: branch_city
attributes.description: The city where the bank branch is located.

attributes.name: branch_country_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166 country code representing the country where the bank branch is located.

attributes.name: branch_name
attributes.description: The name of the specific bank branch where the account is domiciled.

attributes.name: branch_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code of the bank branch location.

attributes.name: branch_state

attributes.name: scenario_id
attributes.description: Primary key for scenario

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this scenario was formally approved. Critical for establishing the official baseline for financial planning and reporting.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the scenario in the financial governance workflow. Pending indicates awaiting review; Approved indicates formally accepted; Rejected indicates not accepted; Under Review indicates in approval process.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or committee who approved this scenario. Used for audit trail and governance compliance.

attributes.name: assumptions_summary
attributes.description: Summary of key financial and business assumptions underlying this scenario (e.g., revenue growth rates, cost inflation, market conditions, strategic initiatives). Critical for scenario interpretation and sensitivity analysis.

attributes.name: baseline_scenario_id
attributes.description: Reference to the baseline scenario used for variance analysis and comparison. Typically points to the approved budget or prior year actual scenario.

attributes.name: business_unit_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of business units, divisions, or legal entities included in this scenario. Defines the organizational scope of the scenario for segmented reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: consolidation_method
attributes.description: Method used for consolidating financial data in this scenario. Full for 100% consolidation of subsidiaries; Proportional for consolidation based on ownership percentage; Equity for equity method accounting; None for standalone entity reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this scenario record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the reporting currency for this scenario (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). All financial amounts in this scenario are expressed in this currency.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary system or process that generated or maintains this scenario (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Hyperion Planning, Excel-based planning model). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the scenario, including its purpose, assumptions, key drivers, and intended use cases. Provides business context for financial analysts and planners.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date through which this scenario remains effective. Nullable for scenarios with indefinite validity (e.g., rolling forecasts).

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this scenario becomes effective and can be used for financial planning, reporting, and analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period within the year to which this scenario applies. Format: Q1-Q4 for quarters, M01-M12 for months, H1-H2 for half-years, FY for full year.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this scenario applies (e.g., 2024). Used for period-based financial planning and reporting alignment.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Description of geographic regions or countries included in this scenario (e.g., North America, EMEA, Global). Defines the geographic coverage for regional financial planning and reporting.

attributes.name: is_consolidated
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this scenario represents consolidated financial data across multiple entities or business units. True for enterprise-wide consolidated scenarios; False for standalone entity scenarios.

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the default scenario for reporting and analysis. True if this scenario should be used as the primary reference; False otherwise. Only one scenario per fiscal period should be marked as default.

attributes.name: is_public
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this scenario is used for external public reporting and disclosure. True for scenarios used in SEC filings, earnings releases, and investor communications; False for internal management scenarios.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the user who last modified this scenario record. Used for audit trail and accountability in financial data governance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this scenario record was last updated. Critical for change tracking and ensuring users are working with the most current scenario version.

attributes.name: lock_date
attributes.description: Date on which this scenario was locked to prevent further modifications. Ensures data integrity for finalized scenarios used in reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or documentation related to this scenario. Used for capturing ad-hoc information, special instructions, or context that does not fit in structured fields.

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or team responsible for maintaining and updating this scenario. Typically a financial planning analyst, FP&A manager, or controller.

attributes.name: parent_scenario_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent scenario from which this scenario was derived or versioned. Nullable for original scenarios. Enables hierarchical scenario relationships and version lineage tracking.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_months
attributes.description: Number of months into the future that this scenario covers. Used for forecasting and planning scenarios to define the projection period (e.g., 12 for annual budget, 36 for strategic plan).

attributes.name: scenario_category
attributes.description: Business category of the scenario indicating its primary use case. Operational for day-to-day financial management; Strategic for long-term planning; Regulatory for compliance reporting; Management for internal decision-making; Consolidated for enterprise-wide aggregation.

attributes.name: scenario_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the scenario for external reference and reporting (e.g., ACTUAL, BUDGET_2024, FORECAST_Q1).

attributes.name: scenario_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the financial scenario (e.g., Actual Results, Annual Budget 2024, Rolling Forecast Q1 2024).

attributes.name: scenario_type
attributes.description: Classification of the scenario indicating its purpose in financial planning and analysis. Actual represents realized results; Budget represents approved annual plan; Forecast represents updated projections; Plan represents strategic multi-year plan; Projection represents long-term estimates; Baseline represents reference point for variance analysis.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the scenario. Draft indicates scenario is being prepared; Active indicates scenario is in use for reporting and analysis; Locked indicates scenario is finalized and no further changes allowed; Archived indicates scenario is retained for historical reference; Superseded indicates scenario has been replaced by a newer version; Cancelled indicates scenario was abandoned.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number for scenarios that undergo revisions. Enables tracking of scenario evolution and comparison across versions (e.g., Budget v1, Budget v2).
