attributes.name: is_public_company
attributes.description: Indicates whether the legal entity is a publicly traded company with securities listed on a stock exchange.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this legal entity record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The official registered legal name of the entity as it appears on incorporation documents and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: lei_code
attributes.description: The 20-character alphanumeric Legal Entity Identifier code used for financial transaction reporting and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of ownership interest held by the parent entity, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 100.00 for wholly-owned, 51.00 for majority-owned).

attributes.name: parent_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent legal entity if this entity is a subsidiary or branch within a corporate hierarchy.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: The email address of the primary contact person or registered agent.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the primary contact person or registered agent for the legal entity.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: The phone number of the primary contact person or registered agent.

attributes.name: registered_address_line_1
attributes.description: The first line of the official registered address of the legal entity as filed with regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: registered_address_line_2
attributes.description: The second line of the official registered address (suite, floor, building name, etc.).

attributes.name: registered_city
attributes.description: The city of the official registered address.

attributes.name: registered_country_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO country code of the official registered address.

attributes.name: registered_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code of the official registered address.

attributes.name: registered_state_province
attributes.description: The state or province of the official registered address.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: The unique registration or incorporation number assigned by the government or regulatory authority.

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: The currency used for consolidated financial reporting and regulatory filings, using ISO 4217 three-letter code.

attributes.name: stock_exchange_code
attributes.description: The code or symbol of the stock exchange where the entity's securities are listed (e.g., NYSE, NASDAQ, LSE).

attributes.name: stock_ticker_symbol
attributes.description: The ticker symbol used to identify the entity's publicly traded securities on the stock exchange.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: The tax identification number assigned by the tax authority for tax reporting and compliance purposes (e.g., EIN in the US).

attributes.name: ultimate_parent_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the top-level parent legal entity in the corporate ownership hierarchy.

products.name: chart_of_accounts
products.description: Master reference table for chart_of_accounts. Referenced by chart_of_accounts_id.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Primary key for chart_of_accounts

attributes.name: account_category
attributes.description: The sub-classification within the account type, providing additional granularity for financial statement presentation and analysis (e.g., current vs. non-current assets, operating vs. non-operating revenue).

attributes.name: account_level
attributes.description: The level in the account hierarchy (e.g., 1 for top-level summary accounts, 2 for sub-accounts, 3 for detail accounts), supporting multi-level financial reporting.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The human-readable name of the account (e.g., Cash and Cash Equivalents, Accounts Receivable, Cost of Goods Sold).

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The unique account number used to identify this account in the general ledger. This is the externally-known business identifier used in financial transactions and reporting.

attributes.name: account_subcategory
attributes.description: Further detailed classification within the account category for more granular reporting and analysis (e.g., Trade Receivables, Inventory - Raw Materials, Salaries and Wages).

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The fundamental accounting classification of the account based on the accounting equation (Assets = Liabilities + Equity) and income statement categories.

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: The business unit or division code associated with this account for organizational reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: consolidation_account
attributes.description: The account number in the consolidated chart of accounts that this account maps to for group-level financial reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The default cost center code associated with this account for management accounting and cost allocation purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this chart of accounts record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for accounts that are denominated in a specific currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null for multi-currency accounts.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the account purpose, usage guidelines, and what types of transactions should be posted to this account.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this account is no longer active for new transactions. Null for accounts with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this account becomes active and available for use in financial transactions.

attributes.name: external_reporting_code
attributes.description: The code or line item reference used for external regulatory reporting (e.g., SEC filing line items, tax authority reporting codes).

attributes.name: financial_statement
attributes.description: The primary financial statement where this account is reported (Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow Statement, or Statement of Changes in Equity).

attributes.name: is_control_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a control account (summary account) that is reconciled to subsidiary ledgers (e.g., Accounts Receivable control account reconciled to customer sub-ledger).

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is used for intercompany transactions that require elimination during consolidation.

attributes.name: is_posting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct transaction posting is allowed to this account. Summary/control accounts typically do not allow direct posting.

attributes.name: is_reconciliation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account requires periodic reconciliation (e.g., bank accounts, intercompany accounts, suspense accounts).

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this chart of accounts record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this chart of accounts record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: normal_balance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account normally carries a debit or credit balance based on accounting principles (assets and expenses are debit; liabilities, equity, and revenue are credit).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the use and management of this account.

attributes.name: parent_account_number
attributes.description: The account number of the parent account in a hierarchical chart of accounts structure, enabling roll-up reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The default profit center code associated with this account for profitability analysis and segment reporting.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the account indicating whether it is available for posting transactions.

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: The tax category or tax line item classification for this account, used for tax reporting and compliance (e.g., taxable income, deductible expense, non-deductible expense).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this chart of accounts record.

attributes.name: parent_chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on chart_of_accounts (parent_chart_of_accounts_id)

domains.name: workforce
domains.description: Manages retail workforce including store associates, distribution center staff, and corporate employees. Owns employee master records, scheduling, time and attendance, payroll, benefits, talent acquisition, performance management, training programs, labor cost allocation, OSHA compliance records, and headcount planning. Integrates with Workday HCM for unified human capital management across all retail locations.

products.name: associate
products.description: Master record for all retail workforce members including store associates, DC staff, and corporate employees. Sourced from Workday HCM as the golden record. Captures employee ID, legal name, preferred name, employment type (full-time, part-time, seasonal, temporary), job classification, FLSA status (exempt/non-exempt), hire date, termination date, rehire eligibility, work authorization status (I-9 verification date, document type, expiration date), primary work location (store, DC, corporate), cost center, pay grade, pay type (hourly/salaried), standard hours per week, manager employee ID, HR business partner, union membership flag, union local code, collective bargaining agreement identifier, badge number, Workday worker ID, and multi-location assignment history including temporary transfers, cross-training assignments, and seasonal redeployments between stores and DCs.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the retail workforce member. Primary key for the associate entity.

attributes.name: collective_bargaining_agreement_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the collective bargaining agreement governing the associate's terms and conditions of employment. Null for non-union associates. Used for contract compliance and labor cost modeling.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center where the associate is primarily assigned. Null for store and corporate associates. Used for DC labor reporting and capacity planning.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store where the associate is primarily assigned. Null for DC and corporate associates. Used for store-level labor reporting and scheduling.

attributes.name: manager_associate_id
attributes.description: Associate ID of the direct manager or supervisor. Used for organizational hierarchy reporting, approval workflows, and performance management.

attributes.name: badge_number
attributes.description: Physical badge or access card number used for facility access, time clock punches, and POS system login.
attributes.references: Internal Security and Access Control Policy

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial accounting code for labor cost allocation. Maps to the organizational unit (store, DC, department) responsible for the associate's compensation expenses.
attributes.references: Internal Chart of Accounts, FASB ASC 720

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this associate record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Corporate email address assigned to the associate for business communications, system access, and internal collaboration.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the person to contact in case of workplace emergency or injury. Required for OSHA compliance and duty of care.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the emergency contact person. Required for OSHA compliance and duty of care.

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the associate's employment. Active indicates currently working, leave-of-absence for approved absences (medical, parental, personal), suspended for disciplinary actions, terminated for ended employment.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of employment relationship defining work schedule expectations, benefits eligibility, and labor cost allocation. Full-time typically 35+ hours/week, part-time under 35 hours/week, seasonal for peak periods (holidays, back-to-school), temporary for fixed-duration assignments.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), Internal HR Policy

attributes.name: flsa_status
attributes.description: Classification determining overtime eligibility under FLSA. Exempt employees are salaried and not eligible for overtime; non-exempt employees are eligible for overtime pay at 1.5x regular rate for hours over 40/week.

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: Date the associate was originally hired by the organization. Used for seniority calculations, benefits vesting, anniversary recognition, and tenure reporting.

attributes.name: hr_business_partner_name
attributes.description: Name of the HR business partner assigned to support this associate. Used for HR case routing, employee relations, and policy guidance.

attributes.name: i9_document_type
attributes.description: Type of documentation provided for I-9 verification. Examples: US Passport (List A), Driver's License + Social Security Card (List B+C), Permanent Resident Card (List A).
attributes.references: Immigration Reform and Control Act (IRCA) 8 USC 1324a, Form I-9

attributes.name: i9_verification_date
attributes.description: Date the employer completed Section 2 of Form I-9 verifying the associate's identity and employment authorization. Required within 3 business days of hire date.
attributes.references: Immigration Reform and Control Act (IRCA) 8 USC 1324a, Form I-9

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the job classification for compensation, workforce planning, and labor reporting. Maps to pay grade and FLSA status.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title reflecting the associate's role and responsibilities. Examples: Sales Associate, Department Manager, Distribution Center Picker, Merchandising Coordinator, Store Manager.

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal performance review or appraisal. Used for performance management cycle tracking and development planning.

attributes.name: last_training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date the associate most recently completed a required training program. Used for compliance tracking (safety, harassment prevention, food safety) and skills development monitoring.

attributes.name: legal_first_name
attributes.description: Legal first name as recorded on government-issued identification and payroll records. Used for tax reporting, benefits administration, and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: legal_last_name
attributes.description: Legal last name (surname) as recorded on government-issued identification and payroll records. Used for tax reporting, benefits administration, and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: legal_middle_name
attributes.description: Legal middle name or initial as recorded on government-issued identification. Optional field used for formal documentation.

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Compensation band or level within the organization's pay structure. Determines salary range or hourly rate range for the position.

attributes.name: pay_type
attributes.description: Compensation structure indicating whether the associate is paid based on hours worked (hourly) or a fixed annual salary (salaried).

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary work phone number for the associate. May be a direct line, extension, or mobile number depending on role and location.

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: Name the associate prefers to be called in day-to-day work interactions. Used for name badges, internal communications, and scheduling displays.

attributes.name: primary_work_location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the associate's primary work location. Used for labor cost allocation, workforce planning, and facility capacity management.

attributes.name: rehire_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the associate is eligible for rehire based on their employment history and termination circumstances. True indicates eligible, False indicates not eligible.

attributes.name: standard_hours_per_week
attributes.description: Expected number of hours the associate is scheduled to work per week under normal conditions. Used for labor planning, benefits eligibility determination, and FTE calculations.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date the associate's employment ended. Null for active employees. Used for turnover analysis, final payroll processing, and benefits termination.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Classification of the reason for employment termination. Used for turnover analysis, unemployment claims, and rehire eligibility determination.

attributes.name: union_local_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the local union chapter to which the associate belongs. Null for non-union associates. Used for dues deduction, grievance processing, and contract administration.

attributes.name: union_membership_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the associate is a member of a labor union. True indicates union member, False indicates non-union. Used for collective bargaining compliance and labor relations reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this associate record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit trails.

attributes.name: work_authorization_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of work authorization documentation for non-citizens. Null for citizens and permanent residents. Used to trigger reverification requirements.
attributes.references: Immigration Reform and Control Act (IRCA) 8 USC 1324a, Form I-9

attributes.name: work_authorization_status
attributes.description: Legal authorization status for employment in the jurisdiction. Used for I-9 compliance verification and work eligibility tracking.
attributes.references: Immigration Reform and Control Act (IRCA) 8 USC 1324a, Form I-9

attributes.name: workday_worker_code
attributes.description: External unique identifier from Workday HCM system. Golden record reference for workforce data integration.

products.name: job_profile
products.description: Reference catalog of all job profiles and roles defined across the retail organization. Captures job code, job title, job family, job level, FLSA classification, minimum and maximum pay range, standard hours, required certifications, physical requirements, department, division, and whether the role is store-facing, DC-facing, or corporate. Sourced from Workday HCM job catalog. Used for headcount planning, compensation benchmarking, and talent acquisition.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the job profile. Primary key for the job profile reference catalog. Sourced from Workday HCM job catalog.

attributes.name: semantic_layer_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.semantic_layer_entity. Business justification: Job profiles are dimensional entities in workforce analytics semantic models. BI tools expose job_profile as a certified dimension for slicing labor metrics by role, level, and job family in retail wo

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this job profile record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the pay range (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN). Used for multi-currency compensation management in global retail operations.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Primary department or functional area where this job profile is typically assigned (e.g., Store Operations, Distribution Center, Merchandising, Finance, Human Resources).

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: Higher-level organizational division or business unit where this job profile resides (e.g., Retail Operations, Corporate, Supply Chain, E-Commerce).

attributes.name: eeoc_job_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) Job Category
attributes.description: Standard EEOC job category classification for this profile (e.g., Executive/Senior Level Officials and Managers, Professionals, Sales Workers, Service Workers). Used for EEO-1 reporting and compliance.
attributes.references: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) EEO-1 Report

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this job profile was retired or became inactive. Null for currently active profiles. Used for historical tracking and organizational change management.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this job profile became active and available for use in the organization. Used for historical tracking and organizational change management.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Standard employment classification indicating whether the role is full-time, part-time, seasonal, temporary, or contractor. Used for benefits eligibility and workforce planning.

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: Classification under the Fair Labor Standards Act indicating whether the role is exempt or non-exempt from overtime pay requirements. Critical for payroll and labor cost compliance.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) - U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: is_bonus_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this role is eligible for performance-based bonuses or incentive compensation. Used for total compensation planning and performance management.

attributes.name: is_commission_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this role is eligible for sales commission or variable compensation based on sales performance. Used for sales compensation planning.

attributes.name: is_corporate
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this role is a corporate or headquarters position. Used for organizational structure reporting and overhead cost allocation.

attributes.name: is_customer_facing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this role involves direct interaction with customers (e.g., sales associates, customer service representatives). Used for customer experience planning and training programs.

attributes.name: is_dc_facing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this role is primarily assigned to distribution center or warehouse locations. Used for supply chain workforce planning.

attributes.name: is_leadership_role
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this job profile is a leadership or management position with direct reports. Used for leadership development programs and organizational structure analysis.

attributes.name: is_overtime_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this role is eligible for overtime pay. Typically aligns with FLSA non-exempt classification. Used for payroll and labor cost forecasting.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) - U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: is_store_facing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this role is primarily assigned to retail store locations. Used for store headcount planning and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: is_union_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this job profile is eligible for union membership or collective bargaining representation. Used for labor relations and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the job profile for system identification and reporting. Used in payroll, headcount planning, and compensation benchmarking.

attributes.name: job_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the job profile including responsibilities, duties, and expectations. Used for job postings, performance management, and organizational documentation.

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: Broad occupational grouping that categorizes similar roles together (e.g., Retail Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Technology, Merchandising). Used for career pathing and talent development.

attributes.name: job_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level or grade of the job within the organization (e.g., Entry Level, Mid-Level, Senior, Manager, Director, Executive). Used for compensation planning and organizational structure.

attributes.name: job_profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the job profile. Active profiles are available for hiring and assignment; inactive profiles are no longer used but retained for historical reporting.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title as displayed on employee records, offer letters, and organizational charts. Human-readable name for the job profile.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this job profile record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date when this job profile was last reviewed for accuracy and relevance by Human Resources. Used for job profile maintenance and compliance audits.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Indicates the primary work location type for this job profile. Used for workforce planning, real estate allocation, and operational reporting.

attributes.name: maximum_pay_range
attributes.description: Maximum annual or hourly compensation for this job profile. Used for compensation benchmarking, offer generation, and pay equity analysis.

attributes.name: minimum_pay_range
attributes.description: Minimum annual or hourly compensation for this job profile. Used for compensation benchmarking, offer generation, and pay equity analysis.

attributes.name: minimum_years_experience
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant work experience required for this job profile. Used for talent acquisition and career progression planning.

attributes.name: onet_code
attributes.description: Standard occupational classification code from the O*NET database maintained by the U.S. Department of Labor. Used for labor market analysis, compensation benchmarking, and skills mapping.
attributes.references: O*NET - Occupational Information Network (U.S. Department of Labor)

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: Indicates whether compensation for this role is calculated on an hourly, salary, or commission basis. Used for payroll processing and labor cost modeling.

attributes.name: physical_requirements
attributes.description: Description of physical demands and requirements for this job profile (e.g., ability to lift 50 lbs, prolonged standing, repetitive motion). Used for OSHA compliance, ADA accommodations, and safety planning.
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) - U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: required_certifications
attributes.description: List of professional certifications, licenses, or credentials required for this job profile (e.g., forklift operator license, pharmacy technician license, food safety certification). Used for talent acquisition and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: required_education_level
attributes.description: Minimum education level required for this job profile. Used for talent acquisition screening and workforce development planning.

attributes.name: span_of_control_max
attributes.description: Maximum number of direct reports typically managed by this role. Used for organizational design and management capacity planning. Null for individual contributor roles.

attributes.name: span_of_control_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of direct reports typically managed by this role. Used for organizational design and management capacity planning. Null for individual contributor roles.

attributes.name: standard_hours_per_week
attributes.description: Expected number of hours per week for this job profile. Used for scheduling, labor cost allocation, and full-time equivalency (FTE) calculations.

attributes.name: succession_planning_tier
attributes.description: Classification indicating the importance of this role for succession planning and talent pipeline development. Critical roles require active succession plans and talent bench strength.

attributes.name: travel_requirement_percentage
attributes.description: Expected percentage of time this role requires business travel. Used for expense planning and candidate expectations management.

products.name: shift_schedule
products.description: Planned work schedules for store associates and DC staff generated through Workday HCM workforce scheduling. Captures schedule week start date, store or DC location, department, shift type (opening, mid, closing, overnight), scheduled start time, scheduled end time, scheduled hours, break duration, assigned associate, scheduling status (draft, published, confirmed), schedule source (auto-generated, manager-assigned), and employee availability/preference indicators. Also encompasses shift swap requests, coverage requests, and open shift postings including swap request status, requesting associate, covering associate, and manager approval. Supports labor cost planning, SLA compliance for store coverage, and associate schedule flexibility.

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the shift schedule record. Primary key for the shift schedule entity.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: The user ID or system account that last modified the shift schedule record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: coverage_request_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the coverage request if this schedule was created to fill an open shift posted by a manager or another associate. Null if the shift was not a coverage assignment.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.dc_facility. Business justification: DC associates require shift scheduling at their assigned distribution center. Workforce planning, labor cost allocation, and operational scheduling depend on facility-specific shift management. Essent

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the department or functional area within the location where the associate is scheduled to work (e.g., grocery, apparel, checkout, receiving).

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.job_profile. Business justification: Shifts are scheduled for specific job roles. Workforce scheduling systems need to ensure shifts are staffed with appropriate job classifications (cannot schedule a cashier shift with a stocker). The s

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store, distribution center, or corporate office where the shift is scheduled. Links to the location master.

attributes.name: primary_shift_associate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the associate or employee assigned to this shift. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: break_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of unpaid breaks in minutes scheduled during the shift. Required for compliance with state labor laws regarding meal and rest breaks.
attributes.references: OSHA Break Requirements and State Labor Laws

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The reason why the shift schedule was cancelled. Low traffic indicates reduced customer demand, weather indicates store closure or reduced operations, employee absence indicates the associate called out, operational change indicates business need adjustment, employee request indicates the associate requested cancellation, and other captures miscellaneous reasons.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the shift schedule was cancelled. Used to track last-minute cancellations and compliance with predictive scheduling laws that require reporting pay for cancelled shifts.

attributes.name: confirmed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the associate acknowledged or confirmed receipt of the shift schedule in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the shift schedule record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: employee_availability_match
attributes.description: Indicates how well the scheduled shift aligns with the associates stated availability preferences in Workday HCM. Full match means the shift is within preferred hours, partial match means some overlap, no match means the shift conflicts with availability, and not specified means no preference was recorded.

attributes.name: estimated_labor_cost
attributes.description: The estimated total labor cost for this shift in USD, including base pay, overtime premium, holiday premium, and benefits allocation. Used for labor budget planning and variance analysis.

attributes.name: is_holiday_shift
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shift falls on a company-recognized holiday, which may qualify for premium pay or special scheduling rules.
attributes.references: Internal Holiday Calendar and Labor Agreements

attributes.name: is_overtime_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift qualifies for overtime pay based on the associates weekly hours and FLSA classification. True if the shift pushes the associate over 40 hours per week or is explicitly designated as overtime.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Overtime Rules

attributes.name: labor_cost_allocation_code
attributes.description: The cost center or general ledger account code to which the labor cost for this shift should be allocated. Used for financial planning and P&L reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Cost Center Master

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the shift schedule record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: paid_break_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of paid rest breaks in minutes scheduled during the shift. Separate from unpaid meal breaks.
attributes.references: OSHA Break Requirements and State Labor Laws

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the shift schedule was published and made visible to the associate. Used to track compliance with advance notice requirements under predictive scheduling laws.

attributes.name: schedule_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions related to the shift schedule. May include information about special tasks, training requirements, or operational considerations.

attributes.name: schedule_source
attributes.description: Indicates how the shift schedule was created. Auto-generated schedules are created by Workday HCM scheduling algorithms, manager-assigned schedules are manually created by supervisors, employee-requested schedules honor associate preferences, shift-swap schedules result from approved swaps, and coverage-request schedules fill open shifts.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the shift schedule. Draft schedules are being prepared, published schedules are visible to associates, confirmed schedules are acknowledged by the associate, cancelled schedules are voided, and completed schedules have been worked.

attributes.name: schedule_week_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the scheduling week for which this shift is planned. Typically Monday in a Monday-Sunday scheduling cycle.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: The planned end date and time for the shift, including time zone information.

attributes.name: scheduled_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the associate is scheduled to work during this shift, excluding breaks. Used for labor cost planning and compliance with labor laws.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Hours Tracking

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The planned start date and time for the shift, including time zone information.

attributes.name: shift_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the shift is scheduled to occur.

attributes.name: shift_priority
attributes.description: Business priority level of the shift. Critical shifts are essential for operations (e.g., opening manager, security), high priority shifts support peak traffic, normal shifts are standard coverage, and low priority shifts are optional or training.

attributes.name: shift_swap_request_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the shift swap request if this schedule resulted from an approved swap between two associates. Null if the shift was not swapped.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift based on time of day and operational role. attributes.name: approval_status

attributes.name: approval_timestamp

attributes.name: clock_in_timestamp

attributes.name: clock_out_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the employee clocked out to end their work shift. Nullable for in-progress shifts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: double_time_hours

attributes.name: exception_flag

attributes.name: exception_notes

attributes.name: exception_type

attributes.name: geolocation_latitude

attributes.name: geolocation_longitude

attributes.name: is_holiday_work

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: meal_break_minutes

attributes.name: paid_break_minutes

attributes.name: pay_rate

attributes.name: payroll_batch_code

attributes.name: payroll_processed_flag

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked at regular pay rate (typically up to 40 hours per week for non-exempt employees). Used for payroll processing.

attributes.name: shift_differential_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry qualifies for shift differential pay (e.g., night shift, weekend shift premium). Used for payroll calculation.

attributes.name: shift_differential_rate
attributes.description: Additional pay rate (as a percentage or dollar amount) applied for shift differential. Used in payroll calculation.

attributes.name: shift_differential_type
attributes.description: Type of shift differential applicable to this time entry. Determines the premium pay rate to be applied.

attributes.name: time_clock_device_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the physical time clock or terminal where the employee clocked in/out. Used for audit trail and device management.

attributes.name: time_entry_source
attributes.description: The system or method used to capture this time entry. Indicates data quality and audit trail for time tracking.

attributes.name: time_entry_type

attributes.name: payroll_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payroll record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: gl_account_id

attributes.name: primary_payroll_associate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee receiving this payroll payment. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Store-level P&L reporting requires payroll costs allocated to profit centers (store/channel). Essential for retail store profitability analysis, district manager reporting, and segment performance eva

attributes.name: approved_timestamp

attributes.name: bank_account_last_four_digits
attributes.description: Last four digits of the employee's bank account number for direct deposit verification. Masked for security and PCI compliance.

attributes.name: bonus_pay_amount
attributes.description: Discretionary or performance-based bonus compensation included in this pay period. Includes incentive bonuses, retention bonuses, and other one-time payments.

attributes.name: commission_pay_amount

attributes.name: cost_center_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payroll record was first created in the system. Initial record creation audit timestamp.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this payroll record. Typically USD for US retail operations.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Organizational department code for the employee during this pay period. Used for workforce analytics and labor distribution.

attributes.name: federal_tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Federal income tax withheld from gross pay based on employee W-4 elections and IRS withholding tables.

attributes.name: fica_medicare_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Medicare tax withheld under Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA). Employee portion of Medicare hospital insurance tax.

attributes.name: fica_social_security_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Social Security tax withheld under Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA). Employee portion of OASDI tax.

attributes.name: garnishment_amount

attributes.name: gross_pay_amount

attributes.name: health_insurance_deduction_amount

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: local_tax_withheld_amount

attributes.name: location_code

attributes.name: net_pay_amount

attributes.name: other_benefits_deduction_amount

attributes.name: overtime_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of overtime hours worked during the pay period. Hours exceeding standard work week threshold requiring premium pay.

attributes.name: overtime_pay_amount
attributes.description: Gross compensation for overtime hours worked, typically calculated at time-and-a-half or double-time premium rates.

attributes.name: pay_date
attributes.description: The date on which payment is issued or deposited to the employee. The actual disbursement date for compensation.

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency with which the employee is paid. Defines the payroll cycle cadence for this employee.

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the pay period covered by this payroll record. Defines the end of the work period for which compensation is calculated.

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the pay period covered by this payroll record. Defines the beginning of the work period for which compensation is calculated.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which net pay is disbursed to the employee. Indicates the payment instrument used for compensation delivery.

attributes.name: payroll_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the payroll record in the payroll workflow lifecycle. Tracks progression from calculation through final payment.

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payroll record was calculated and processed by the payroll system. Represents the payroll run execution time.

attributes.name: regular_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of regular hours worked during the pay period, excluding overtime. Standard work hours at base pay rate.

attributes.name: regular_pay_amount
attributes.description: Gross compensation for regular hours worked at the employee's base pay rate. Does not include overtime, bonuses, or other supplemental pay.

attributes.name: retirement_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Employee contribution to retirement savings plan such as 401(k) or 403(b). Pre-tax deferral reducing taxable income.

attributes.name: shift_differential_pay_amount
attributes.description: Additional compensation paid for working non-standard shifts such as evening, night, or weekend shifts. Premium pay for less desirable work hours.

attributes.name: state_tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: State income tax withheld from gross pay based on state withholding requirements and employee elections.

attributes.name: total_deductions_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all deductions from gross pay including taxes, benefits, garnishments, and other withholdings.

attributes.name: year_to_date_federal_tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative federal income tax withheld from the beginning of the calendar year through this pay period. Used for W-2 Box 2 reporting.

attributes.name: year_to_date_gross_pay_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative gross pay for the employee from the beginning of the calendar year through this pay period. Used for tax reporting and W-2 preparation.

products.name: leave_request
products.description: Employee leave and absence management records processed through Workday HCM Absence Management. Captures leave type (FMLA, PTO, sick, bereavement, jury duty, military, personal), requested start date, requested end date, approved start date, approved end date, total days requested, total days approved, leave reason, FMLA eligibility flag, intermittent leave flag, approval status, approving manager, HR review status, return-to-work date, and any leave balance impact. Supports FMLA compliance and labor cost forecasting.

attributes.name: leave_request_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the leave request record. Primary key for the leave request entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the cost center to which the employee's labor costs are allocated. Used for financial reporting, labor cost forecasting, and budget variance analysis during leave periods.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.dc_facility. Business justification: DC associates request leave tied to their facility for workforce planning and coverage management. Supervisors need facility-level leave visibility to ensure adequate staffing for warehouse operations

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee's department at the time of leave request. Used for labor cost allocation, departmental absence reporting, and workforce analytics.

attributes.name: primary_leave_associate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee submitting the leave request. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.shift_schedule. Business justification: Leave requests impact scheduled shifts and require coverage planning. When an associate requests leave, workforce scheduling systems need to identify which specific shifts are affected to trigger cove

attributes.name: tertiary_leave_hr_reviewer_associate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the HR representative who reviewed the leave request. Links to the employee master record. Used for compliance audit trail and case management.

attributes.name: work_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee's primary work location (store, distribution center, or corporate office) at the time of leave request. Used for workforce planning, coverage scheduling, and regional compliance reporting.

attributes.name: actual_return_date
attributes.description: The actual date the employee returned to work, as recorded in time and attendance systems. May differ from scheduled return to work date if leave was extended or employee returned early. Used for compliance tracking and leave reconciliation.

attributes.name: approval_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes entered by the approving manager or HR during the approval process. May include reasons for denial, conditions of approval, or special instructions.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the leave request was approved or denied by the manager or HR. Used for SLA tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the leave request in the workflow. Pending indicates awaiting manager or HR review, Approved indicates authorization granted, Denied indicates rejection, Cancelled indicates revoked after approval, Withdrawn indicates employee retracted the request.

attributes.name: approved_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of absence as approved by the manager or HR. May differ from requested end date if the request was modified during approval process. May be null for open-ended or intermittent leave.

attributes.name: approved_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of absence as approved by the manager or HR. May differ from requested start date if the request was modified during approval process.

attributes.name: fmla_designation_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Designation Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave has been officially designated as FMLA-qualifying by HR. Not Applicable for non-FMLA leave types, Pending for under review, Designated for confirmed FMLA protection, Not Designated for ineligible requests.

attributes.name: fmla_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for FMLA protection for this leave request. True if the employee meets FMLA eligibility criteria (12 months tenure, 1250 hours worked, employer size). Used for compliance reporting and employee rights protection.

attributes.name: hr_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the HR review was completed. Used for compliance tracking and SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: hr_review_notes
attributes.description: Confidential notes entered by HR during the review process. May include compliance assessments, accommodation considerations, or legal consultation notes. Restricted access for HR personnel only.

attributes.name: hr_review_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether HR review is required and the current state of that review. Not Required for standard leave, Pending for awaiting HR input, Reviewed for completed HR assessment, Escalated for complex cases requiring senior HR intervention.

attributes.name: intermittent_leave_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is an intermittent leave request (sporadic absences rather than continuous block). True for intermittent FMLA, chronic condition management, or flexible leave arrangements. Affects scheduling and leave balance tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the leave request record was last updated. Captures any changes to dates, status, or other attributes. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: leave_balance_after
attributes.description: Employee's projected leave balance (in hours or days) after this leave request is approved and processed. Calculated as balance before minus approved hours/days. Used for employee self-service visibility and planning.

attributes.name: leave_balance_before
attributes.description: Employee's available leave balance (in hours or days) before this leave request is processed. Used for validation that sufficient balance exists and for audit trail of balance changes.

attributes.name: leave_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation or justification for the leave request provided by the employee. May contain sensitive personal or medical information. Used for HR review and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: leave_request_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the leave request, typically generated by Workday HCM Absence Management module. Used for tracking and reference in HR communications.

attributes.name: leave_subtype
attributes.description: Detailed classification within the leave type. For example, FMLA may have subtypes like Birth/Adoption, Serious Health Condition, Military Caregiver. Provides granular categorization for compliance and reporting.

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: Category of leave being requested. PTO (Paid Time Off) for vacation, Sick for illness, FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) for qualifying medical/family reasons, Bereavement for family death, Jury Duty for court service, Military for service obligations, Personal for other approved absences. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PTO|Sick|FMLA|Bereavement|Jury Duty|Military|Personal — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: medical_certification_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which medical certification must be submitted to HR. Typically 15 calendar days from leave request submission per FMLA regulations. Used for compliance tracking and employee notification.

attributes.name: medical_certification_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether required medical certification has been received and validated by HR. True when documentation is on file and approved. Used for compliance audit trail and approval workflow gating.

attributes.name: medical_certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether medical certification documentation is required for this leave request. True for FMLA, medical leave, or extended sick leave requiring physician documentation. Used for compliance enforcement and case management.

attributes.name: paid_leave_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave is paid (using accrued PTO balance or paid leave benefits) or unpaid. True for paid leave, False for unpaid leave. Affects payroll processing and leave balance deductions.
attributes.references: Company Leave Policy; Workday HCM Payroll

attributes.name: reduced_schedule_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave involves a reduced work schedule (working fewer hours per day or days per week) rather than full absence. True for part-time return-to-work arrangements or phased leave. Used for scheduling and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: request_submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the leave request was originally submitted by the employee through Workday HCM self-service. Used for SLA tracking, audit trail, and advance notice compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Absence Management; FMLA 29 CFR 825.302

attributes.name: requested_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of absence requested by the employee. Represents the end of the leave period as initially submitted. May be null for open-ended or intermittent leave.

attributes.name: requested_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of absence requested by the employee. Represents the beginning of the leave period as initially submitted.

attributes.name: return_to_work_date
attributes.description: The date the employee is scheduled to return to work following the leave. May be the day after approved end date or a later date for extended leave. Used for workforce planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the system of record from which this leave request data originated. Typically Workday HCM Absence Management. Used for data lineage tracking and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this leave request in the source system (Workday HCM). Used for data reconciliation, audit trail, and bidirectional integration with operational systems.

attributes.name: total_days_approved
attributes.description: Total number of calendar or business days approved by the manager or HR for this leave. May differ from total days requested if the request was partially approved or modified. May include partial days for intermittent leave.

attributes.name: total_days_requested
attributes.description: Total number of calendar or business days requested by the employee for this leave. Calculated based on requested start and end dates, accounting for work schedule and holidays. May include partial days for intermittent leave.

attributes.name: total_hours_approved
attributes.description: Total number of work hours approved for this leave. Used for leave balance deduction and payroll processing. May differ from total hours requested if the request was modified during approval.

attributes.name: total_hours_requested
attributes.description: Total number of work hours requested for this leave. Used for precise leave balance calculations and labor cost forecasting. Particularly important for part-time employees and intermittent leave.

attributes.name: aca_1095c_offer_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Form 1095-C Offer of Coverage Code
attributes.description: The IRS code indicating the type of health coverage offered to the employee for ACA reporting. Examples: 1A (qualifying offer), 1B (employee only), 1C (employee and dependents), 1E (no offer). Required for annual 1095-C filing.

attributes.name: aca_1095c_safe_harbor_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Form 1095-C Safe Harbor Code
attributes.description: The IRS code indicating the safe harbor method used to determine ACA affordability. Examples: 2A (W-2 wages), 2B (rate of pay), 2C (federal poverty line). Used to avoid employer shared responsibility penalties.

attributes.name: aca_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for ACA-compliant health coverage based on full-time equivalent (FTE) hours worked during the measurement period. True if employee averaged 30+ hours per week. Used for 1095-C reporting.

attributes.name: aca_measurement_period_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Measurement Period End Date
attributes.description: The end date of the measurement period used to determine ACA eligibility. Follows the start date by 12 months for standard measurement periods.

attributes.name: aca_measurement_period_start
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Measurement Period Start Date
attributes.description: The start date of the measurement period used to determine ACA eligibility. Typically a 12-month lookback period (e.g., October 1 to September 30) used to calculate average hours worked.

attributes.name: aca_stability_period_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Stability Period End Date
attributes.description: The end date of the stability period during which the employee's ACA eligibility determination remains in effect. Typically December 31 of the plan year.

attributes.name: aca_stability_period_start
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Stability Period Start Date
attributes.description: The start date of the stability period during which the employee's ACA eligibility determination remains in effect. Typically follows the measurement period and aligns with the plan year (e.g., January 1).

attributes.name: annual_election_amount
attributes.description: For benefits with annual election limits (FSA, HSA, 401k), this is the total amount the employee elected to contribute for the plan year. Subject to IRS annual limits. Nullable for benefits without annual elections.

attributes.name: beneficiary_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the primary beneficiary designated for life insurance or retirement benefits. Nullable for benefits without beneficiary designations (e.g., health insurance). Contains personally identifiable information.

attributes.name: beneficiary_relationship

attributes.name: benefit_type

attributes.name: carrier_policy_number
attributes.description: The policy or group number assigned by the insurance carrier or benefit provider. Used for claims processing and coordination of benefits. Nullable for self-insured plans or benefits without external carriers.

attributes.name: cobra_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for COBRA continuation coverage upon termination of employment or loss of coverage. True if the employee was enrolled in a group health plan and experienced a qualifying event.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: The level of coverage elected by the employee. Determines premium rates and dependent coverage. Not applicable for non-health benefits like 401k or FSA.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The per-pay-period amount deducted from the employee's paycheck for this benefit. For percentage-based contributions (e.g., 401k), this is the dollar amount per pay period, not the percentage. Currency is USD unless otherwise specified in organizational standards.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which employee contributions are deducted from payroll. Aligns with the organization's payroll schedule. Per pay period is the most common for retail associates with varying schedules.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The per-pay-period amount contributed by the employer toward this benefit. For 401k, this may include employer match. For health insurance, this is the employer subsidy. Currency is USD unless otherwise specified.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_frequency

attributes.name: veteran_status

Provides full compensation history audit trail.

attributes.description: Unique identifier of the job profile (role definition) that the employee holds after this compensation change. Links to the job profile master for job title, FLSA classification, and standard pay ranges.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the work location (store, distribution center, or corporate office) where the employee is assigned at the time of the compensation change.

attributes.description: Unique identifier of the annual merit review cycle during which this compensation change was processed. Null for off-cycle changes such as promotions or market adjustments.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the department in which the employee works at the time of the compensation change. Used for organizational reporting and headcount planning.

attributes.name: performance_review_id

The compensation_change table has performance_rating and merit_cycle_id attributes; linking to performance_review creates an audit trail from p

attributes.name: primary_compensation_associate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee receiving the compensation change. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: quaternary_compensation_modified_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: The system user ID or service account that last modified this compensation change record. Used for audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: tertiary_compensation_hr_approver_associate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the HR business partner or compensation analyst who reviewed and approved this compensation change.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the compensation change received final HR approval and was committed for payroll processing. Null if still pending or rejected.

attributes.name: budget_impact_amount
attributes.description: The annualized financial impact of this compensation change on the department or cost center budget. Calculated based on the pay rate change and the employee's standard hours per year.

attributes.name: change_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compensation change becomes effective and is reflected in payroll processing. This is the business event date for the compensation adjustment.

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Detailed business justification for the compensation change. Provides context beyond the change type, such as specific performance achievements, market benchmarking results, or organizational restructuring rationale.

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: The category of compensation change event. Merit: annual performance-based increase. Promotion: increase due to role advancement. Equity: adjustment to address internal pay equity. Market Adjustment: correction based on external market data. COLA: Cost of Living Adjustment. Demotion: decrease due to role change.

attributes.name: compa_ratio_after
attributes.description: The employee's compensation ratio (actual pay divided by pay grade midpoint) after this change takes effect. Used to ensure the new pay rate is within acceptable range for the grade.

attributes.name: compa_ratio_before
attributes.description: The employee's compensation ratio (actual pay divided by pay grade midpoint) before this change. A compa-ratio of 1.00 means the employee is paid at the midpoint of their grade. Used to assess pay equity and positioning within grade.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this compensation change record was first created in the data lakehouse. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the pay rates and budget impact are denominated. Supports multi-currency compensation for international retail operations.

attributes.name: hr_approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the compensation change in the HR workflow. Pending: awaiting HR review. Approved: HR has approved and change will be processed. Rejected: HR denied the change. Cancelled: change request was withdrawn.

attributes.name: is_lump_sum
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compensation change includes a one-time lump sum payment in addition to or instead of a base pay rate increase. True if lump sum is included, False if only base pay rate change.

attributes.name: is_retroactive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compensation change includes retroactive pay for a period prior to the change effective date. True if retroactive pay is owed, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this compensation change record was most recently updated in the data lakehouse. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: lump_sum_amount
attributes.description: The one-time lump sum payment amount awarded as part of this compensation change. Null if no lump sum is included. Used for merit bonuses or retention payments that do not increase base pay.

attributes.name: new_pay_grade
attributes.description: The employee's pay grade or salary band after this compensation change takes effect. Used to track career progression and ensure pay equity within grade ranges.

attributes.name: new_pay_rate
attributes.description: The employee's base pay rate after this compensation change event takes effect. Expressed in the currency and frequency defined in the employee's job profile.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional context, special circumstances, or instructions related to this compensation change. Used for audit trail and future reference.

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the employee is paid, defining the time unit for the pay rate. Hourly: rate per hour. Weekly: rate per week. Biweekly: rate per two weeks. Semimonthly: rate per half month. Monthly: rate per month. Annual: rate per year.

attributes.name: pay_rate_change_amount
attributes.description: The absolute monetary difference between the new pay rate and the previous pay rate. Calculated as new_pay_rate minus previous_pay_rate. May be negative for demotions.

attributes.name: pay_rate_change_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage change in pay rate, calculated as (pay_rate_change_amount / previous_pay_rate) * 100. Used for merit budget tracking and compensation analysis.

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: The employee's performance rating from the most recent performance review that influenced this compensation change. Used to correlate merit increases with performance outcomes.

attributes.name: previous_pay_grade
attributes.description: The employee's pay grade or salary band immediately prior to this compensation change. Pay grades define the compensation range for a given job level.

attributes.name: previous_pay_rate
attributes.description: The employee's base pay rate immediately prior to this compensation change event. Expressed in the currency and frequency defined in the employee's job profile.

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the compensation change was successfully processed into the payroll system and reflected in the employee's pay record.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation provided by HR or approving manager if the compensation change request was rejected. Null if the change was approved or is still pending.

attributes.name: retroactive_amount
attributes.description: The total retroactive pay amount owed to the employee for the period between the retroactive start date and the change effective date. Null if the change is not retroactive.

attributes.name: retroactive_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the period for which retroactive pay is calculated. Null if the change is not retroactive. Used to calculate back pay owed to the employee.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the compensation change request was initially submitted into the Workday HCM system for approval workflow.

products.name: staffing_plan
products.description: This association product represents the workforce allocation plan between organizational units and job profiles. It captures the planned and actual headcount allocation of standardized job roles to specific organizational units (stores, departments, distribution centers, corporate divisions). Each record links one org unit to one job profile with budgeted FTE counts, actual headcount, effective dates, and approval status. This is a core workforce planning entity managed jointly by HR and Finance through formal planning cycles and budget approval workflows.. Existence Justification: This is a genuine operational M:N relationship representing workforce staffing plans in retail. One organizational unit (store, department, DC) requires multiple job profiles to operate (cashiers, managers, stockers, etc.), and one job profile is allocated across multiple organizational units (e.g., Store Manager role exists in hundreds of stores). The business actively manages these allocations through formal workforce planning cycles with approval workflows, budget constraints, and variance tracking.

attributes.name: staffing_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this staffing plan allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approved_by_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee (typically HR Director or Finance Manager) who approved this staffing allocation.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to job_profile. Identifies which job role is being allocated to the org unit.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to org_unit. Identifies which organizational unit this staffing allocation applies to.

attributes.name: actual_headcount
attributes.description: Current actual FTE headcount for this job profile within this organizational unit. Updated as employees are hired, transferred, or terminated.

attributes.name: annual_labor_budget
attributes.description: Annual labor cost budget allocated to this organizational unit in local currency. Used for variance analysis and cost control. [Moved from org_unit: Labor budget is allocated by job profile within each org unit, not as a single lump sum. The total labor budget for an org unit is the SUM of staffing_plan.annual_labor_cost_budget across all job profile allocations. This should be removed from org_unit and calculated from the association.]

attributes.name: annual_labor_cost_budget
attributes.description: Total annual labor cost budget for this job profile allocation within this org unit. Calculated from FTE count and pay range.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when this staffing allocation was formally approved through the workforce planning approval workflow.

attributes.name: budgeted_fte_count
attributes.description: Budgeted full-time equivalent count for this job profile in this org unit. Used for labor budget planning and variance analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this staffing plan record was created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this staffing allocation ceases or ceased to be effective. Null for current active allocations.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this staffing allocation becomes or became effective. Supports historical tracking of staffing plan changes across planning cycles.

attributes.name: headcount_actual
attributes.description: Current actual full-time equivalent (FTE) headcount assigned to this organizational unit. Updated from active employee assignments. [Moved from org_unit: Similar to headcount_planned, actual headcount is tracked at the org_unit × job_profile level in workforce planning systems. The actual headcount for an org unit is the SUM of staffing_plan.actual_headcount across all job profiles. This should be a derived metric, not stored on org_unit.]

attributes.name: headcount_allocated
attributes.description: Planned or budgeted FTE headcount for this job profile within this organizational unit. This is the approved staffing level from the workforce planning cycle.

attributes.name: headcount_planned
attributes.description: Planned full-time equivalent (FTE) headcount for this organizational unit. Used for workforce planning and budget allocation. [Moved from org_unit: This attribute represents planned headcount at the org unit level, but in reality, headcount planning is done at the org_unit × job_profile granularity. The planned headcount for a store or department is the SUM of staffing_plan.headcount_allocated across all job profiles for that org unit. This attribute should be removed from org_unit and calculated from the association.]

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes explaining the rationale for this staffing allocation, special circumstances, or planning assumptions.

attributes.name: planning_cycle
attributes.description: Identifier for the workforce planning cycle this allocation belongs to (e.g., FY2024-Q1, Annual-2024). Links staffing decisions to budget cycles.

attributes.name: staffing_plan_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this staffing allocation. Tracks workflow state from draft through approval to active deployment. Values: draft, pending_approval, approved, active, historical, cancelled.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this staffing plan record was last modified.

attributes.name: variance_fte
attributes.description: Variance between budgeted and actual FTE count (actual minus budgeted). Used for workforce planning variance reporting.

products.name: dashboard_access
products.description: This association product represents the access relationship between retail associates and business intelligence dashboards. It captures user-level access provisioning, personalization settings, and usage analytics for each associate-dashboard combination. Each record links one associate to one dashboard with access metadata, usage tracking, and personalization preferences that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In retail BI operations, associates access multiple dashboards based on their role and responsibilities (store managers access store operations dashboards, buyers access merchandising dashboards, DC supervisors access logistics dashboards), and each dashboard is accessed by multiple associates across the organization. The business actively manages dashboard access provisioning, tracks usage analytics per associate-dashboard pair, and maintains personalization settings (favorites, custom filters) that belong to the relationship, not to either the associate or the dashboard alone.

attributes.name: access_status

attributes.name: last_accessed_timestamp

products.name: workforce_kpi_target
products.description: This association product represents the performance target assignment between organizational units and KPI definitions. It captures the specific target values, measurement frequencies, and accountability levels that exist only in the context of a specific org unit being measured against a specific KPI. Each record links one org unit to one KPI definition with the target parameters and effective dates for that accountability relationship.. Existence Justification: In retail performance management, organizational units (stores, regions, departments, DCs) are measured against multiple KPIs simultaneously (sales per labor hour, shrink rate, safety incidents, turnover rate, customer satisfaction), and each KPI is measured across multiple organizational units at different levels of the hierarchy. The business actively manages KPI target assignments as a distinct operational process, setting specific target values, accountability levels, and measurement frequencies for each org-unit-KPI combination during annual planning and quarterly reviews.
