attributes.description: The date when this KPI target expires or is replaced for this org unit. Null indicates the target is currently active. Supports historical tracking of target changes over time.

attributes.name: target_set_date

attributes.name: target_value

attributes.name: threshold_green

products.name: org_unit_compliance_scope
products.description: This association product represents the Scope Assignment between org_unit and compliance_program. It captures which compliance programs apply to which organizational units and tracks the program-specific implementation details at the org unit level. Each record links one org_unit to one compliance_program with attributes that exist only in the context of this scoping relationship, including responsible parties, audit schedules, and effective dates for that specific org unit-program combination.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, organizational units (stores, departments, distribution centers) are subject to multiple compliance programs simultaneously (FDA food safety, OSHA workplace safety, PCI payment security, environmental regulations), and each compliance program applies to multiple organizational units across the enterprise. The business actively manages these scope assignments, tracking which programs apply to which org units with program-specific implementation details including responsible parties, audit schedules, risk assessments, and compliance status at the org unit-program level.

attributes.name: last_audit_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the most recent compliance audit for this program at this org unit. Passed: full compliance. Passed_with_observations: compliant but with minor findings. Failed: non-compliance identified. Not_audited: no audit conducted yet. In_progress: audit underway.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance audit for this program at this specific org unit. Used for audit planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context about this org unit-program scope assignment, including special conditions, implementation challenges, or historical context.

attributes.name: responsible_party

attributes.description: Percentage of required employees at this org unit who have completed mandatory training for this compliance program. Calculated as (completed_employees / required_employees) * 100.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scope record was last modified. Tracks changes to scope status, responsible parties, or audit schedules.

domains.name: marketing
domains.description: Manages marketing campaigns, audience targeting, media spend, attribution analytics, email/SMS marketing automation, social media engagement, and brand management across all retail channels. Distinct from promotion (which owns deal mechanics and redemption) — marketing owns the upstream campaign strategy, channel execution, and ROI measurement.

Distinct from promotion.campaign which owns deal mechanics and redemption — this entity owns upstream campaign strategy and channel execution.

products.name: audience_segment
products.description: Marketing-owned audience segment definitions used for campaign targeting, media buying, and personalization. Captures segment name, segment type (behavioral, demographic, psychographic, RFM-based, lookalike, suppression), definition logic (SQL predicate or rule set), estimated reach, data sources used (CRM, loyalty, web analytics), refresh frequency, activation status, and owning marketing team. Distinct from customer.segment which is the customer-domain SSOT for customer classification — this entity represents marketing-specific targeting constructs built on top of customer segments for campaign activation.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the marketing audience segment. Primary key.

attributes.name: average_purchase_frequency

attributes.name: business_objective

attributes.name: model_version

attributes.name: next_refresh_timestamp

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: refresh_frequency

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code or abbreviation for the segment, used in campaign tagging and reporting systems.

attributes.name: segment_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the segment purpose, target audience characteristics, and intended use cases for marketing activation.

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the audience segment used for campaign targeting and identification by marketing teams.

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the audience segment indicating whether it is available for campaign activation.

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the segment methodology: behavioral (purchase patterns, browsing), demographic (age, income, location), psychographic (lifestyle, values), RFM-based (Recency Frequency Monetary analysis), lookalike (modeled similarity to high-value customers), or suppression (exclusion list).

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of user-defined tags or labels for segment categorization, search, and filtering (e.g., seasonal, promotional, loyalty, acquisition).

attributes.name: target_persona
attributes.description: Marketing persona or customer archetype this segment represents (e.g., high-value shoppers, bargain hunters, omnichannel enthusiasts, lapsed customers).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the marketing analyst or system that created this segment definition.

attributes.name: parent_audience_segment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on audience_segment (parent_audience_segment_id)

products.name: campaign_audience
products.description: Association record linking a marketing campaign to one or more audience segments, defining the targeting configuration for each campaign execution. Captures campaign reference, audience segment reference, targeting role (include, exclude/suppress, lookalike seed), estimated reach at time of activation, actual reached count post-execution, channel applicability, and activation timestamp. Enables multi-segment targeting strategies and suppression list management per campaign.

attributes.name: campaign_audience_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the campaign audience association record.

attributes.name: audience_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the audience segment being targeted by this campaign.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign that is targeting this audience segment.

attributes.name: activation_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this audience segment targeting ends or expires within the campaign. Used for time-bound targeting windows or campaign flight schedules.

attributes.name: activation_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this audience segment targeting becomes active within the campaign. Used for scheduled or phased campaign rollouts.

attributes.name: activation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this audience segment was activated for the campaign and messages were sent or ads were served.

attributes.name: actual_reached_count
attributes.description: The actual number of customers or contacts successfully reached after campaign execution. Populated post-execution for performance measurement.

attributes.name: budget_allocation_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the campaign budget allocated specifically to this audience segment for media spend, creative production, or channel costs.

attributes.name: budget_allocation_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the budget allocation amount.

attributes.name: campaign_audience_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this campaign-audience association. Tracks whether the targeting configuration is in planning, execution, or post-campaign state.

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: The marketing channel(s) for which this audience segment is applicable within the campaign. Determines where this segment will be activated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: email|sms|push|display|social|search|direct_mail|in_store|all_channels — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: consent_verification_date
attributes.description: The date when opt-in consent was last verified for this audience segment. Used for regulatory compliance and audit trails.

attributes.name: conversion_count
attributes.description: The number of customers in this audience segment who completed the campaign conversion goal (purchase, sign-up, store visit, etc.). Populated post-execution for ROI measurement.

attributes.name: conversion_rate_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of reached customers who converted (conversion_count / actual_reached_count * 100). Primary metric for campaign return on investment.

attributes.name: cost_per_acquisition
attributes.description: The average cost to acquire one conversion from this audience segment (budget_allocation_amount / conversion_count). Key efficiency metric for campaign optimization.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the marketing user who created this campaign-audience association.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this campaign-audience association record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delivery_rate_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of the estimated reach that was successfully delivered (actual_reached_count / estimated_reach * 100). Calculated post-execution to measure targeting accuracy and deliverability.

attributes.name: estimated_reach
attributes.description: The estimated number of customers or contacts in this audience segment at the time of campaign planning and activation setup.

attributes.name: frequency_cap
attributes.description: The maximum number of times a customer in this audience segment should be contacted or exposed to campaign messages within the campaign period. Used to prevent over-messaging.

attributes.name: frequency_cap_period_days
attributes.description: The time period in days over which the frequency cap is enforced. For example, a frequency cap of 3 over 7 days means no more than 3 messages in any 7-day window.

attributes.name: lookalike_model_code
attributes.description: Reference to the lookalike modeling algorithm or configuration used when this audience segment serves as a seed for lookalike expansion. Only populated when targeting_role is lookalike_seed.

attributes.name: lookalike_similarity_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum similarity score (0.0000 to 1.0000) required for a customer to be included in the lookalike expansion audience. Higher thresholds produce smaller, more similar audiences.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this campaign-audience association, including targeting rationale, special instructions, or post-campaign observations.

attributes.name: opt_in_consent_verified
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether opt-in consent has been verified for all customers in this audience segment for the specified channel. Required for GDPR, CCPA, and CAN-SPAM compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7, CCPA Section 1798.120, CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: personalization_strategy
attributes.description: The personalization or dynamic content strategy applied to this audience segment within the campaign (e.g., product recommendations, location-based offers, behavioral triggers, demographic customization).

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: The priority ranking of this audience segment within the campaign when multiple segments are targeted. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for message delivery or budget allocation.

attributes.name: response_count
attributes.description: The number of customers in this audience segment who responded to the campaign (clicked, opened, converted, or took the desired action). Populated post-execution for performance measurement.

attributes.name: response_rate_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of reached customers who responded to the campaign (response_count / actual_reached_count * 100). Key performance indicator for campaign effectiveness.

attributes.name: return_on_ad_spend
attributes.description: The ratio of attributed revenue to budget allocation for this audience segment (revenue_attributed_amount / budget_allocation_amount). Measures campaign profitability per segment.

attributes.name: revenue_attributed_amount
attributes.description: The total revenue attributed to this audience segment from the campaign based on the attribution model. Used for ROI calculation and segment performance comparison.

attributes.name: revenue_attributed_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the attributed revenue amount.

attributes.name: segment_refresh_date
attributes.description: The date when the audience segment membership was last refreshed or recalculated prior to campaign activation. Important for understanding data recency.

attributes.name: suppression_reason
attributes.description: The business reason why this audience segment is being excluded or suppressed from the campaign (e.g., recent purchasers, unsubscribed, high-value customers to protect, regulatory exclusion). Only populated when targeting_role is exclude or suppress.

attributes.name: targeting_role
attributes.description: The role this audience segment plays in the campaign targeting strategy (include for primary targeting, exclude/suppress for opt-outs or suppression lists, lookalike_seed for expansion modeling, control_group for A/B testing, holdout for measurement).

attributes.name: test_group_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this audience segment is part of an A/B test or experimental group within the campaign. True if this is a test variant, false if control or standard execution.

attributes.name: test_variant_name
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the test variant applied to this audience segment (e.g., Variant A, Creative B, Offer 20% Off). Only populated when test_group_indicator is true.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the marketing user who last modified this campaign-audience association.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this campaign-audience association record was last modified.

attributes.name: split_from_campaign_audience_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on campaign_audience (split_from_campaign_audience_id)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this SMS send record was first created in the marketing automation system. Represents the initial setup or draft creation event.

attributes.name: delivered_count
attributes.description: The number of SMS messages successfully delivered to recipient mobile devices as confirmed by carrier delivery receipts. Key metric for send effectiveness and billing reconciliation.

attributes.name: failed_count
attributes.description: The number of SMS messages that failed to deliver due to invalid numbers, carrier blocks, network errors, or recipient device issues. Used for list hygiene and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic targeting scope for this SMS send, such as national, regional, or specific metro areas. Used for localized campaigns and compliance with regional SMS regulations.

attributes.name: is_mms
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this send included multimedia content (images, video, audio) making it an MMS rather than plain text SMS. MMS has different pricing and delivery characteristics.

attributes.name: media_url
attributes.description: The URL of the multimedia asset (image, video, audio file) included in an MMS message. Null for standard SMS. Used for content tracking and compliance archiving.

attributes.name: message_content
attributes.description: The actual text content of the SMS/MMS message sent to recipients. May include personalization tokens that were dynamically replaced per recipient. For MMS, this is the text portion; media URLs are tracked separately.

attributes.name: message_length
attributes.description: The character count of the SMS message content. Standard SMS is 160 characters; longer messages are segmented. Used for billing and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: message_segment_count
attributes.description: The number of SMS segments required to transmit the message. Messages over 160 characters are split into multiple segments, each billed separately. Critical for cost calculation.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this SMS send record was last modified or updated. Tracks changes to send configuration, status updates, or metric refreshes.

attributes.name: opt_out_count
attributes.description: The number of recipients who replied with STOP or unsubscribe keywords in response to this SMS send, triggering automatic removal from future sends. Critical for TCPA compliance and list management.

attributes.name: platform_job_code
attributes.description: The unique job or batch identifier assigned by the SMS marketing automation platform (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Iterable) for this send execution. Used for platform-specific troubleshooting and reconciliation.

attributes.name: scheduled_send_timestamp
attributes.description: The planned date and time when the SMS send job was scheduled to execute. For immediate sends, this matches actual_send_timestamp. For scheduled sends, this represents the intended send time.

attributes.name: send_cost_amount
attributes.description: The total cost incurred for this SMS send, calculated based on message segment count, recipient count, and carrier pricing. Used for campaign ROI analysis and budget tracking.

attributes.name: send_cost_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the send cost amount. Typically USD for US operations, but may vary for international sends.

attributes.name: send_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label assigned to this SMS send event for identification and reporting purposes within the marketing automation platform.

attributes.name: send_priority
attributes.description: The priority level assigned to this SMS send for queue processing. High priority sends are processed first, used for time-sensitive alerts or transactional messages. Normal and low priority for bulk promotional sends.

attributes.name: send_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SMS send job. Draft indicates preparation; scheduled indicates queued for future send; sending indicates in-progress; completed indicates all messages processed; failed indicates system error; cancelled indicates user-aborted.

attributes.name: send_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SMS send purpose. Promotional sends are marketing offers; transactional sends are order/account updates; alerts are time-sensitive notifications; reminders are appointment/event notifications; service messages are operational communications.

attributes.name: sender_code
attributes.description: The alphanumeric sender ID or long code phone number displayed to recipients as the message sender. Alternative to short codes, used for lower-volume or international sends.

attributes.name: short_code
attributes.description: The 5-6 digit short code number used as the sender ID for this SMS send. Short codes are leased from carriers and used for high-volume marketing sends. Provides brand recognition and opt-out handling.

attributes.name: target_country_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes representing the countries targeted by this SMS send. Used for international campaign tracking and carrier routing.

attributes.name: total_recipients
attributes.description: The total number of unique mobile phone numbers targeted by this SMS send. Represents the audience size before any delivery filtering or failures.

attributes.name: tracked_url
attributes.description: The shortened, trackable URL included in the SMS message that redirects to the campaign landing page. Enables click tracking and attribution. Typically uses bit.ly or custom domain shortener.

attributes.name: utm_campaign
attributes.description: The UTM campaign parameter embedded in tracked URLs to identify the specific campaign or promotion. Enables granular campaign performance tracking in web analytics.

attributes.name: utm_medium
attributes.description: The UTM medium parameter embedded in tracked URLs to classify the marketing medium. Typically 'text-message' or 'sms' for SMS sends.

attributes.name: utm_source
attributes.description: The UTM source parameter embedded in tracked URLs to identify the traffic source as SMS in web analytics. Standard value is 'sms' for SMS channel attribution.

attributes.name: resend_of_sms_send_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on sms_send (resend_of_sms_send_id)

products.name: push_notification_send
products.description: Transactional record of a mobile push notification send event executed through the marketing automation platform for the retailer's mobile app. Captures send name, campaign reference, audience segment, notification title and body, deep link URL, send timestamp, total recipients, delivered count, open count, dismissed count, send type (promotional, behavioral trigger, cart abandonment, price drop alert), platform (iOS, Android), and push platform job ID.

attributes.name: push_notification_send_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the push notification send event. Primary key for this transactional record.

attributes.name: audience_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer segment that was targeted for this push notification send. Defines the recipient population based on behavioral, demographic, or transactional criteria.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent marketing campaign that this push notification send is part of. Links this send event to the broader campaign strategy and budget.

attributes.name: primary_push_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or system account that created this push notification send record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.profile. Business justification: Push notifications target individual customer profiles for device-specific delivery, engagement tracking, and app-based customer journey orchestration. New FK required. Essential for mobile app market

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.storefront. Business justification: Push notifications target specific mobile apps/storefronts. Required for app-specific push performance measurement, ensures notifications route to correct app instance, and enables storefront-level mo

attributes.name: ab_test_variant
attributes.description: The variant identifier if this push notification send is part of an A/B test or multivariate experiment. Used to compare performance across different message versions.

attributes.name: action_button_1_label
attributes.description: The text label for the first action button displayed in the push notification. Enables direct customer actions such as Shop Now or View Details.

attributes.name: action_button_1_url
attributes.description: The deep link URL associated with the first action button. Directs the customer to a specific app screen when the button is tapped.

attributes.name: action_button_2_label
attributes.description: The text label for the second action button displayed in the push notification. Provides an alternative customer action option.

attributes.name: action_button_2_url
attributes.description: The deep link URL associated with the second action button. Directs the customer to an alternative app screen when the button is tapped.

attributes.name: actual_send_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the push notification send was executed by the marketing automation platform. Primary business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: badge_count
attributes.description: The number displayed on the app icon badge after this notification is delivered. Used to indicate unread notifications or pending actions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this push notification send record was first created in the marketing automation system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: deep_link_url
attributes.description: The URL that directs the customer to a specific screen or content within the retailers mobile app when the notification is tapped. Enables direct navigation to relevant product, category, or promotional content.

attributes.name: delivered_count
attributes.description: The number of push notifications that were successfully delivered to customer devices. Indicates successful transmission to the mobile operating system.

attributes.name: dismissed_count
attributes.description: The number of customers who dismissed or swiped away the push notification without opening it. Indicates lack of engagement or relevance.

attributes.name: failed_count
attributes.description: The number of push notifications that failed to deliver due to technical errors, invalid device tokens, or platform issues.

attributes.name: image_url
attributes.description: The URL of the image asset displayed within the push notification. Rich media notifications can include product images, promotional banners, or brand visuals.

attributes.name: is_silent_notification
attributes.description: Indicates whether this push notification was sent as a silent background notification without alerting the user. Used for data synchronization or app state updates.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this push notification send record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update to the record.

attributes.name: notification_body
attributes.description: The main message content or body text of the push notification. Provides detailed information or call-to-action to the customer.

attributes.name: notification_title
attributes.description: The headline or title text displayed in the push notification on the customers mobile device. Primary attention-grabbing message component.

attributes.name: opened_count
attributes.description: The number of customers who tapped or opened the push notification. Key engagement metric for measuring notification effectiveness.

attributes.name: personalization_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether dynamic personalization was applied to the notification content based on customer data. Personalized notifications may include customer name, product recommendations, or behavioral triggers.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: The mobile operating system platform targeted by this push notification send. Determines the push notification service used (APNS for iOS, FCM for Android).

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: The delivery priority level assigned to this push notification send. High priority notifications are delivered immediately, while lower priority may be batched or delayed.

attributes.name: push_platform_job_code
attributes.description: The unique job or batch identifier assigned by the push notification platform (e.g., Firebase Cloud Messaging, Apple Push Notification Service) for this send execution. Used for technical troubleshooting and reconciliation.

attributes.name: scheduled_send_timestamp
attributes.description: The planned date and time when the push notification send was scheduled to execute. Used for campaign planning and timing optimization.

attributes.name: send_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or code for this push notification send, used for external reference and cross-system tracking.

attributes.name: send_cost_amount
attributes.description: The total cost incurred for executing this push notification send, typically charged by the push notification platform provider on a per-message or per-recipient basis.

attributes.name: send_cost_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the send cost amount. Enables multi-currency cost tracking for global marketing operations.

attributes.name: send_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title assigned to this specific push notification send for internal tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: send_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the push notification send event. Tracks the execution state from planning through completion.

attributes.name: send_type
attributes.description: Classification of the push notification send based on its business purpose and trigger mechanism. Determines the messaging strategy and expected customer response. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promotional|behavioral_trigger|cart_abandonment|price_drop_alert|order_update|loyalty_reward|back_in_stock — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sound_file_name
attributes.description: The name of the audio file played when the push notification is received. Enables custom notification sounds for different message types.

attributes.name: target_recipient_count
attributes.description: The total number of customers or mobile devices that were targeted to receive this push notification send. Represents the intended audience size.

attributes.name: time_to_live_seconds
attributes.description: The duration in seconds that the push notification platform will attempt to deliver the notification if the device is offline. After this period, the notification expires.

attributes.name: utm_campaign
attributes.description: The UTM campaign parameter embedded in the deep link URL for campaign attribution tracking. Identifies the specific campaign or promotion.

attributes.name: utm_medium
attributes.description: The UTM medium parameter embedded in the deep link URL for campaign attribution tracking. Typically set to push or mobile_push.

attributes.name: utm_source
attributes.description: The UTM source parameter embedded in the deep link URL for campaign attribution tracking. Identifies the traffic source as push notification.

attributes.name: resend_of_push_notification_send_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Resend Of Push Notification Send Id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on push_notification_send (resend_of_push_notification_send_id)

products.name: social_post
products.description: Master record for organic and paid social media posts published across all social platforms (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, X/Twitter, YouTube, LinkedIn) on behalf of the retailer's brands and banners. Captures post content, platform, account/page, post type (image, video, carousel, story, reel, live), campaign association, scheduled and published timestamps, boosted/paid flag, targeting parameters if boosted, reach, impressions, engagements (likes, comments, shares, saves), link clicks, and post status.

attributes.name: social_post_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the social media post record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: The platform-specific unique identifier for the social media account (e.g., Facebook Page ID, Instagram Business Account ID). Used for API integration and cross-platform tracking.

attributes.name: advertising_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Boosted social posts must comply with FTC disclosure policies and platform advertising policies. Real business need: approval workflow before paid promotion, regulatory compliance verification. Retail

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign this post is associated with, if applicable. Links post to upstream campaign strategy and budget allocation.

attributes.name: creative_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.creative_asset. Business justification: Social posts often use creative assets from the marketing asset library (images, videos, graphics). The social_post table has media_asset_url (STRING) which stores a URL, but if the asset is managed i

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail brand or banner this post represents (e.g., main retail brand, private label brand, regional banner). Used for multi-brand portfolio management and brand performance analysis.

attributes.name: primary_social_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal user or marketing team member who created the post record. Used for content authorship tracking and workflow accountability.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.storefront. Business justification: Social posts promote specific storefronts/brands. Multi-brand retailers need storefront-level social performance tracking, brand-appropriate content governance, and channel-specific engagement metrics

attributes.name: tertiary_social_modified_by_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal user who last modified the post record. Used for audit trail and accountability tracking.

attributes.name: account_handle
attributes.description: The username or handle of the brand or banner account that published the post (e.g., @RetailBrandUSA). Identifies which corporate social account owns the post.

attributes.name: actual_publish_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the post went live on the platform. May differ from scheduled time due to manual overrides, platform delays, or approval workflows.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the post was approved for publication. Null if no approval workflow is required or if post is still in draft. Used for compliance and governance tracking.

attributes.name: boost_budget_amount
attributes.description: The total budget allocated for boosting or promoting this post, in the currency specified by boost_budget_currency_code. Null for organic posts.

attributes.name: boost_budget_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the boost budget (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null for organic posts.

attributes.name: call_to_action
attributes.description: The primary call-to-action button or directive included in the post, particularly for boosted or paid posts. None indicates no explicit CTA. Used for conversion optimization and campaign effectiveness analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shop_now|learn_more|sign_up|download|book_now|contact_us|apply_now|watch_more|none — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: The total number of comments the post received. Platform-reported metric; updated periodically via API sync.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this social post record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: engagement_rate
attributes.description: The calculated engagement rate for the post, typically (likes + comments + shares) / reach. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0523 for 5.23%). May be calculated internally or sourced from platform analytics.

attributes.name: hashtags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of hashtags included in the post (e.g., #RetailDeals, #SummerSale, #BOPIS). Used for content categorization and trend analysis.

attributes.name: impressions
attributes.description: The total number of times the post was displayed, including multiple views by the same user. Platform-reported metric; updated periodically via API sync.

attributes.name: is_boosted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the post has paid media spend behind it (boosted or promoted). True means paid amplification is active; false means organic reach only.

attributes.name: likes
attributes.description: The total number of likes or reactions the post received. Platform-reported metric; updated periodically via API sync.

attributes.name: link_clicks
attributes.description: The total number of clicks on any links embedded in the post (e.g., product links, landing page URLs). Platform-reported metric; updated periodically via API sync.

attributes.name: mentions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of user handles or brand accounts mentioned in the post (e.g., @InfluencerName, @PartnerBrand). Used for influencer tracking and partnership attribution.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this social post record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: The social media platform where the post was published. X refers to the platform formerly known as Twitter. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Facebook|Instagram|TikTok|Pinterest|X|YouTube|LinkedIn — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: platform_post_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned by the social media platform to this post (e.g., Facebook Post ID, Instagram Media ID). Used for API integration and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: post_content
attributes.description: The full text content of the social media post, including captions, hashtags, and copy. May be null for image-only or video-only posts without text.

attributes.name: post_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the post. Draft indicates content is being prepared; scheduled indicates approved and queued; published indicates live; failed indicates publication error; deleted indicates removed by user; archived indicates past content retained for compliance.

attributes.name: post_type
attributes.description: The format or media type of the social post. Carousel refers to multi-image swipeable posts; story refers to ephemeral 24-hour content; reel refers to short-form vertical video. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: image|video|carousel|story|reel|live|link|text — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: post_url
attributes.description: The direct URL link to the published post on the social media platform. Used for auditing, reporting, and customer service reference.

attributes.name: reach
attributes.description: The total number of unique users who saw the post at least once. Platform-reported metric; updated periodically via API sync.

attributes.name: saves
attributes.description: The total number of times users saved or bookmarked the post for later viewing. Applicable to platforms like Instagram and Pinterest. Platform-reported metric; updated periodically via API sync.

attributes.name: scheduled_publish_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the post was scheduled to be published. Used for content calendar planning and automated publishing workflows.

attributes.name: sentiment_score
attributes.description: Calculated sentiment score for the post based on comment analysis and engagement patterns, ranging from -1.00 (very negative) to +1.00 (very positive). May be derived from AI/ML sentiment analysis tools or third-party social listening platforms.

attributes.name: shares
attributes.description: The total number of times the post was shared or reposted by users. Platform-reported metric; updated periodically via API sync.

attributes.name: target_age_range
attributes.description: The age range targeted for boosted posts (e.g., 18-24, 25-34, 35-44). Null for organic posts or when age targeting is not applied.

attributes.name: target_audience_definition
attributes.description: Textual description or JSON representation of the audience targeting parameters applied to boosted posts (e.g., age range, gender, interests, geographic regions). Null for organic posts.

attributes.name: target_country_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes representing the geographic targeting for boosted posts (e.g., USA,CAN,MEX). Null for organic posts or global targeting.

attributes.name: target_gender
attributes.description: The gender demographic targeted for boosted posts. All indicates no gender filtering. Null for organic posts.

attributes.name: video_views
attributes.description: The total number of video views for video or reel posts. Definition of a view varies by platform (e.g., 3 seconds on Facebook, 1 second on TikTok). Null for non-video posts. Platform-reported metric; updated periodically via API sync.

attributes.name: reply_to_social_post_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on social_post (reply_to_social_post_id)

attributes.name: contract_status

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: channel_weighting_rules

attributes.name: conversion_event_types

attributes.name: data_source_systems

attributes.name: included_channels
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of marketing channels included in this attribution model (e.g., 'paid_search, organic_search, email, social_media, display, affiliate, direct'). Channels not listed are excluded from attribution credit.
attributes.references: Marketing Channel Taxonomy, GS1 Digital Link Standards

attributes.name: is_default_model
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the default attribution model used for standard campaign ROI reporting when no specific model is requested. Only one model should be marked as default at any given time.

attributes.name: lookback_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to conversion during which touchpoints are considered for attribution credit. Common values are 7, 14, 30, 60, or 90 days. Defines the temporal scope of the customer journey included in attribution analysis.
attributes.references: Marketing Attribution Standards, Google Ads Conversion Window

attributes.name: max_touchpoints_considered
attributes.description: Maximum number of touchpoints in a customer journey that will be included in attribution analysis. Touchpoints beyond this limit are truncated. Used to manage computational complexity and focus on most relevant interactions.

attributes.name: min_touchpoints_required
attributes.description: Minimum number of marketing touchpoints required in a customer journey for attribution credit to be assigned. Journeys with fewer touchpoints may be excluded or handled differently. Common values are 1 (all journeys) or 2 (multi-touch only).

attributes.name: model_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the model for system integration and reporting (e.g., 'LC_2024Q4', 'MTL_STD').

attributes.name: model_description

attributes.name: model_name

attributes.name: model_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attribution model. Active models are in production use; inactive models are paused; draft models are under development; archived models are retained for historical reference; deprecated models are superseded by newer versions.

attributes.name: model_type
attributes.description: The methodology used to assign conversion credit across touchpoints. Last-click assigns 100% credit to the final touchpoint; first-click to the initial touchpoint; linear distributes credit equally; time-decay gives more weight to recent interactions; position-based (U-shaped) emphasizes first and last; algorithmic/data-driven uses machine learning to determine credit distribution. products.name: marketing_brand

attributes.name: associate_id

attributes.name: parent_brand_marketing_brand_id

attributes.name: primary_marketing_associate_id

attributes.name: accent_color_hex

attributes.name: annual_marketing_budget_amount

attributes.name: approval_status

attributes.name: approved_timestamp

attributes.name: brand_category

attributes.name: brand_code

attributes.name: brand_status

attributes.name: brand_tier

attributes.name: budget_currency_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: discontinuation_date

attributes.name: equity_score

attributes.name: geographic_scope

attributes.name: is_omnichannel

attributes.name: is_sustainable_brand

attributes.name: launch_date

attributes.name: logo_asset_reference
attributes.description: Digital asset management system reference or URI pointing to the primary brand logo file in approved formats.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: net_promoter_score

attributes.name: owning_marketing_team

attributes.name: positioning_statement

attributes.name: social_media_handles
attributes.description: JSON or comma-separated list of official social media account handles for this brand across platforms (e.g., @brandname on Twitter, Facebook, Instagram).

attributes.name: tagline
attributes.description: Official tagline or slogan associated with the brand used in advertising and marketing communications.

attributes.name: target_country_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where this brand is marketed and sold.

attributes.name: target_demographic
attributes.description: Primary demographic profile of the intended consumer audience for this brand, including age range, income level, lifestyle attributes, and psychographic characteristics.

attributes.name: tone_of_voice
attributes.description: Descriptive characterization of the brand's communication style and personality used in messaging, content, and customer interactions (e.g., friendly and approachable, professional and authoritative, playful and energetic).

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Primary website URL or landing page dedicated to this brand for consumer engagement and information.

attributes.name: parent_marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on marketing_brand (parent_marketing_brand_id)

products.name: channel
products.description: Reference master defining all marketing channels used for campaign execution and media planning. Captures channel name, channel category (owned, earned, paid), channel type (email, SMS, push, paid search, paid social, display, video, OOH, print, radio, TV, in-store, affiliate), platform or vendor name, integration status with marketing automation platform, cost model (CPM, CPC, CPA, flat), and active status. Provides standardized channel taxonomy for consistent reporting and budget allocation across all campaigns.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the marketing channel. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created this channel record, for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this channel record, for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: api_authentication_method
attributes.description: Authentication method required for API integration: OAuth, API key, basic authentication, SAML (Security Assertion Markup Language), or none.

attributes.name: api_endpoint_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: API (Application Programming Interface) Endpoint URL (Uniform Resource Locator)
attributes.description: API endpoint URL for programmatic integration with the channel platform, used by marketing automation systems.

attributes.name: attribution_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days after interaction during which conversions are attributed to this channel for attribution analytics.

attributes.name: average_cpa_amount
attributes.description: Average cost per acquisition or conversion for this channel, key metric for ROI (Return on Investment) measurement.

attributes.name: average_cpc_amount
attributes.description: Average cost per click for this channel, used for performance benchmarking and budget allocation.

attributes.name: average_cpm_amount
attributes.description: Average cost per thousand impressions for this channel, used for budget planning and ROI (Return on Investment) analysis.

attributes.name: channel_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the channel: owned (company-controlled properties), earned (organic reach), or paid (purchased media).

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the channel for reporting and integration purposes.

attributes.name: channel_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the channel, including its purpose, audience reach, and typical use cases within the marketing strategy.

attributes.name: channel_name

attributes.name: channel_type

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: email|sms|push|paid_search|paid_social|display|video|ooh|print|radio|tv|in_store|affiliate — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: compliance_notes

attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Standards, GDPR, CCPA

attributes.name: contract_end_date

attributes.name: cost_model
attributes.description: Pricing model for the channel: CPM (Cost Per Mille/Thousand Impressions), CPC (Cost Per Click), CPA (Cost Per Acquisition), flat (fixed fee), hybrid (combination), performance (outcome-based).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this channel record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all cost metrics associated with this channel (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: data_refresh_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which performance data from this channel is refreshed in the marketing analytics platform: real-time, hourly, daily, weekly, or manual.

attributes.name: geographic_coverage
attributes.description: Geographic regions or markets where this channel is available and effective (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR, global).

attributes.name: integration_status
attributes.description: Current integration status with the marketing automation platform: integrated (fully connected), pending (in progress), not_integrated (manual or offline), deprecated (legacy, no longer used).

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel is currently active and available for campaign execution. True if active, False if inactive or retired.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this channel record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: owner_email
attributes.description: Email address of the channel owner for operational communication and escalation.

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or team responsible for managing and optimizing this channel.

attributes.name: platform_vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the platform or vendor providing the channel service (e.g., Google, Meta, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Mailchimp, Adobe Campaign).

attributes.name: primary_kpi
attributes.description: The primary key performance indicator used to measure success for this channel (e.g., CTR (Click-Through Rate), conversion rate, ROAS (Return on Ad Spend), engagement rate).

attributes.name: supports_ab_testing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports A/B testing or multivariate testing for campaign optimization. True if supported, False otherwise.

attributes.name: supports_automation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports marketing automation workflows (e.g., triggered campaigns, drip sequences). True if supported, False otherwise.

attributes.name: supports_personalization
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel supports personalized content delivery based on customer data and segmentation. True if supported, False otherwise.

attributes.name: target_audience_profile
attributes.description: Description of the typical audience demographics and psychographics that this channel reaches most effectively.

attributes.name: vendor_contract_number

attributes.name: parent_channel_id

products.name: utm_parameter
products.description: Master record for standardized UTM parameter configurations used to tag marketing URLs for campaign tracking across digital channels. Captures UTM source, UTM medium, UTM campaign, UTM content, UTM term, full tagged URL, campaign reference, channel reference, creative asset reference, creation date, created by, and active status. Ensures consistent UTM taxonomy governance to prevent fragmented or inconsistent tagging that would corrupt attribution and web analytics data.

attributes.name: utm_parameter_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the UTM parameter configuration record.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent marketing campaign that this UTM parameter configuration supports.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.marketing_channel. Business justification: UTM parameters are used to tag URLs for channel tracking and should reference the authoritative marketing_channel master. Currently, utm_parameter has a denormalized channel_type STRING attribute. Add

attributes.name: primary_utm_associate_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created this UTM parameter configuration record.

attributes.name: tertiary_utm_approved_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who approved this UTM parameter configuration for campaign use.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this UTM parameter configuration was approved for use in marketing campaigns.

attributes.name: base_url
attributes.description: The destination URL before UTM parameters are appended (e.g., https://www.retailer.com/products/shoes). Used as the foundation for tagged URL construction.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this UTM parameter configuration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: creative_asset_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the creative asset (banner, video, email template) associated with this UTM configuration. Links to Digital Asset Management (DAM) system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this UTM parameter configuration is no longer valid for use. Null indicates no expiration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this UTM parameter configuration is valid and approved for use in marketing campaigns.

attributes.name: full_tagged_url
attributes.description: Complete URL with all UTM parameters appended as query string. This is the final URL used in marketing materials and campaigns.

attributes.name: geographic_target
attributes.description: Geographic scope for this UTM configuration (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR, global). Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or 'global' for worldwide campaigns.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this UTM parameter configuration is currently active and approved for use in marketing campaigns.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: Date when this UTM parameter configuration was most recently used in a campaign or marketing material.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this UTM parameter configuration record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, usage instructions, or special considerations for this UTM parameter configuration.

attributes.name: owning_team
attributes.description: Name of the marketing team or business unit responsible for managing and maintaining this UTM parameter configuration.

attributes.name: parameter_code
attributes.description: Unique business code for this UTM parameter configuration, used for system integration and lookup.

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for this UTM parameter configuration, used for internal reference and governance.

attributes.name: parameter_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this UTM parameter configuration. Active configurations are approved for use in campaigns.

attributes.name: platform_integration
attributes.description: Name of the marketing platform or tool where this UTM configuration is deployed (e.g., Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Mailchimp).

attributes.name: short_url
attributes.description: Shortened version of the full tagged URL, used in space-constrained marketing materials such as SMS, social media posts, or print ads.

attributes.name: target_audience_segment
attributes.description: Description of the audience segment this UTM configuration is intended to reach (e.g., high_value_customers, new_prospects, cart_abandoners).

attributes.name: taxonomy_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the UTM taxonomy standard applied to this configuration. Ensures consistency across campaigns and prevents taxonomy drift.

attributes.name: tracking_domain
attributes.description: Domain used for URL shortening or click tracking (e.g., bit.ly, custom branded domain). Used when the full tagged URL is shortened for display purposes.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Number of times this UTM parameter configuration has been deployed in marketing campaigns or materials. Used for governance and reuse tracking.

attributes.name: utm_campaign
attributes.description: Identifies the specific campaign name (e.g., spring_sale_2024, black_friday, back_to_school). Used to group related marketing efforts.

attributes.name: utm_content
attributes.description: Identifies the specific content or creative variant within a campaign (e.g., banner_ad_1, text_link, hero_image). Used for A/B testing and creative performance analysis.

attributes.name: utm_medium
attributes.description: Identifies the marketing medium (e.g., cpc, email, social, display, affiliate). Represents the channel type.

attributes.name: utm_source
attributes.description: Identifies the source of traffic (e.g., google, facebook, newsletter, affiliate_partner). Represents the referrer or origin platform.

attributes.name: utm_term
attributes.description: Identifies the paid search keyword or term that triggered the ad (e.g., running_shoes, discount_electronics). Primarily used for paid search campaigns.

attributes.name: validation_errors
attributes.description: Description of any validation errors or warnings identified during automated quality checks. Used for governance and correction workflows.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Status of automated validation checks for this UTM parameter configuration. Ensures compliance with naming conventions and taxonomy rules.

attributes.name: derived_from_utm_parameter_id

products.name: ab_test_campaign
products.description: Master record for A/B and multivariate tests conducted within marketing campaigns to optimize creative, messaging, audience targeting, and channel strategy. Captures test name, campaign reference, test type (subject line, creative variant, send time, audience split, channel mix), hypothesis, control and variant definitions, audience split percentages, test start/end dates, primary success metric, statistical significance threshold, winning variant, and test status. Distinct from ecommerce.ab_test which governs on-site UX experiments — this entity governs marketing message and channel experiments.

attributes.name: ab_test_campaign_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the A/B test campaign record. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or user who created this A/B test campaign record.

attributes.name: audience_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the audience segment used for this A/B test, defining the target population.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent marketing campaign under which this A/B test is conducted.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.marketing_channel. Business justification: A/B test campaigns are conducted within specific marketing channels and should reference the authoritative marketing_channel master. Currently, ab_test_campaign has a denormalized channel_tested STRIN

attributes.name: creative_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.creative_asset. Business justification: A/B tests often test different creative variants. The ab_test_campaign should link to the creative_asset being tested. The control_variant_definition and test_variant_definition are STRING description

attributes.name: modified_by_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or user who last modified this A/B test campaign record.

attributes.name: primary_ab_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or user responsible for designing, executing, and analyzing this A/B test.

attributes.name: test_sku_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.sku_price. Business justification: A/B tests in retail frequently test different price points or promotional depths. Test variant definitions require linking to the specific prices being tested. Real business process: promotional optim

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the A/B test campaign execution ended.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the A/B test campaign execution began.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the A/B test design and execution plan has been approved by the appropriate stakeholders.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the A/B test campaign was approved for execution.

attributes.name: confidence_level_pct
attributes.description: The actual confidence level achieved in the test results, indicating the statistical reliability of the outcome.

attributes.name: control_audience_size
attributes.description: Number of individuals or contacts assigned to the control variant.

attributes.name: control_audience_split_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the total audience allocated to the control variant (e.g., 50.00 for a 50/50 split).

attributes.name: control_metric_value
attributes.description: The measured value of the primary success metric for the control variant (e.g., 25.50 for 25.5% open rate).

attributes.name: control_variant_definition
attributes.description: Detailed description of the control (baseline) variant used in the test, including creative elements, messaging, and configuration.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this A/B test campaign record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: hypothesis
attributes.description: The hypothesis statement describing the expected outcome or behavior change being tested (e.g., 'Changing subject line to include urgency will increase open rate by 10%').

attributes.name: lift_pct
attributes.description: The percentage improvement (or decline) of the test variant over the control variant for the primary success metric.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this A/B test campaign record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: primary_success_metric
attributes.description: The key performance indicator (KPI) used to determine the winning variant (e.g., open rate, click-through rate, conversion rate, revenue, engagement rate).

attributes.name: statistical_significance_threshold_pct
attributes.description: The confidence level threshold (e.g., 95.00) required to declare a variant as statistically significant winner.

attributes.name: test_audience_size
attributes.description: Number of individuals or contacts assigned to the test variant(s).

attributes.name: test_audience_split_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the total audience allocated to the test variant(s) (e.g., 50.00 for a 50/50 split).

attributes.name: test_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or code assigned to the test for tracking and reference across systems.

attributes.name: test_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the A/B test objectives, methodology, and expected business impact.

attributes.name: test_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the A/B test campaign concluded or is scheduled to conclude.

attributes.name: test_metric_value
attributes.description: The measured value of the primary success metric for the test variant (e.g., 28.75 for 28.75% open rate).

attributes.name: test_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the A/B or multivariate test for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: test_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or learnings captured during or after the test execution.

attributes.name: test_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the A/B test campaign was launched and began collecting data.

attributes.name: test_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the A/B test campaign (draft, scheduled, running, completed, cancelled, paused).

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: Category of the test indicating what element is being tested (e.g., subject line, creative variant, send time, audience split, channel mix, landing page).

attributes.name: test_variant_definition
attributes.description: Detailed description of the test (challenger) variant(s) used in the experiment, including creative elements, messaging, and configuration.

attributes.name: total_audience_size
attributes.description: Total number of individuals or contacts included in the A/B test across all variants.

attributes.name: winning_variant
attributes.description: Indicates which variant won the test based on the primary success metric (control, test, or inconclusive if no clear winner).

attributes.name: baseline_ab_test_campaign_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on ab_test_campaign (baseline_ab_test_campaign_id)
