attributes.description: Current number of customers actively progressing through the flow (not yet completed or exited). Indicates in-flight journey volume.

attributes.name: branching_logic_description
attributes.description: Description of conditional branching and decision points within the flow (e.g., 'If email opened, send offer; if not opened after 24h, send reminder'). Captures personalization and dynamic path logic.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The business unit, brand, or division that owns this automation flow (e.g., 'Grocery', 'Apparel', 'Electronics'). Used for organizational segmentation and reporting.

attributes.name: channel_sequence
attributes.description: Ordered list of marketing channels used in this flow (e.g., 'email → SMS → push notification', 'email → email → SMS'). Describes the multi-touch communication strategy.

attributes.name: completed_count
attributes.description: Total number of customers who have completed all steps in the automation flow. Measures journey completion rate.

attributes.name: consent_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit customer consent is required before enrollment in this flow. Critical for General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this automation flow record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and governance.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when the automation flow was deactivated or paused, stopping new customer enrollments. Null if the flow is still active.

attributes.name: entry_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed business rules and conditions that a customer must meet to enter this automation flow. May include segment membership, purchase history, engagement thresholds, or attribute filters.

attributes.name: exit_criteria
attributes.description: Conditions under which a customer is removed from the automation flow before completion (e.g., purchase made, unsubscribed, goal achieved, maximum time elapsed).

attributes.name: flow_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or code for the automation flow, used for external reference and integration with marketing automation platforms.

attributes.name: flow_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the automation flows purpose, strategy, and expected customer experience. Provides context for stakeholders and future reference.

attributes.name: flow_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the marketing automation flow or journey (e.g., 'Cart Abandonment Recovery', 'Loyalty Welcome Series', 'Post-Purchase Thank You').

attributes.name: flow_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the automation flow: draft (being configured), active (running and enrolling customers), paused (temporarily stopped), completed (finished execution), or archived (historical record).

attributes.name: flow_type
attributes.description: Classification of the automation flow based on execution pattern: triggered by customer action, scheduled at specific times, recurring on a cadence, one-time campaign, event-based, or behavioral targeting.

attributes.name: goal_achieved_count
attributes.description: Number of customers who achieved the defined goal while enrolled in this flow. Primary success metric for conversion attribution.

attributes.name: goal_definition
attributes.description: The primary business objective or conversion goal for this automation flow (e.g., 'Complete purchase', 'Activate loyalty account', 'Re-engage dormant customer', 'Increase Average Order Value (AOV)').

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this automation flow record was last modified. Tracks configuration changes and updates over time.

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the automation flow to conclude or be archived. Used for time-bound campaigns or seasonal flows.

attributes.name: platform_flow_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this flow in the source marketing automation platform. Used for integration and reconciliation with platform reporting.

attributes.name: platform_name
attributes.description: Name of the marketing automation platform where this flow is configured (e.g., 'Salesforce Marketing Cloud', 'Braze', 'Klaviyo', 'Adobe Campaign', 'HubSpot').

attributes.name: primary_channel
attributes.description: The main marketing channel used for this automation flow. Determines platform integration and message delivery infrastructure.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this automation flow, indicating its strategic importance and resource allocation precedence.

attributes.name: step_count
attributes.description: Total number of steps or touchpoints configured in this automation flow. Indicates complexity and length of the customer journey.

attributes.name: suppression_list_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether suppression lists (unsubscribed, opted-out, or blocked customers) are enforced for this flow to ensure compliance with communication preferences.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of tags or labels applied to this flow for categorization, search, and reporting (e.g., 'retention', 'seasonal', 'high-value', 'mobile-first').

attributes.name: test_mode_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this flow is running in test or preview mode (not sending to real customers). Used during configuration and quality assurance.

attributes.name: total_enrolled_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of customers who have entered this automation flow since activation. Key metric for reach and scale assessment.

attributes.name: trigger_event
attributes.description: The specific customer behavior or system event that initiates entry into this automation flow (e.g., 'cart_abandonment', 'loyalty_enrollment', 'birthday', 'win_back', 'post_purchase', 'browse_abandonment', 'product_back_in_stock').

attributes.name: wait_period_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of wait times and delays between steps in the flow (e.g., 'Wait 2 hours, then wait 1 day, then wait 3 days'). Defines the timing cadence of the journey.

attributes.name: cloned_from_automation_flow_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on automation_flow (cloned_from_automation_flow_id)

products.name: automation_enrollment
products.description: Transactional record capturing each customer's entry into and progression through a marketing automation flow. Captures customer identifier, automation flow reference, enrollment trigger event, enrollment timestamp, current step in the flow, step history, exit reason (completed, unsubscribed, suppressed, manually removed), exit timestamp, and conversion flag. Enables operational monitoring of automation flow health and customer journey progression.

attributes.name: automation_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the automation enrollment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: audience_segment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the audience segment that the customer belonged to at the time of enrollment. Used for targeting analysis and segment performance measurement.

attributes.name: automation_flow_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing automation flow that the customer was enrolled into. References the specific automation campaign or journey definition.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent marketing campaign that this automation enrollment is associated with. Links the automation flow to broader campaign strategy and budget.

attributes.name: current_step_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the current step or stage in the automation flow where the customer is positioned. Null if the customer has exited the flow.

attributes.name: primary_automation_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that created this enrollment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer enrolled in the automation flow. Links to the customer who entered the marketing automation journey.

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: The current consent status of the customer for receiving marketing communications in this automation flow. Ensures compliance with data privacy regulations.

attributes.name: conversion_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the conversion value amount.

attributes.name: conversion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer achieved the target conversion goal of the automation flow. True if the customer completed the desired action (purchase, sign-up, engagement), false otherwise.

attributes.name: conversion_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer achieved the conversion goal. Null if no conversion occurred.

attributes.name: conversion_value_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value attributed to the conversion event. Represents revenue, order value, or estimated customer lifetime value (CLTV) impact from the automation-driven conversion.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this enrollment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: current_step_entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer entered the current step of the automation flow. Used to calculate time-in-step and identify stalled journeys.

attributes.name: current_step_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the current step in the automation flow. Provides business context for operational monitoring and reporting.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: The primary marketing channel through which the automation flow communicates with the customer. Indicates the delivery mechanism for automation messages.

attributes.name: enrollment_code
attributes.description: Business-readable unique code for this enrollment instance. Used for operational tracking and customer service reference.

attributes.name: enrollment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this enrollment. Used for operational context, troubleshooting, or manual intervention documentation.

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: The system or method that initiated the enrollment. Indicates whether the enrollment was triggered automatically by an event, manually by a user, or via batch processing.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the customer within the automation flow. Indicates whether the customer is actively progressing, has completed, or has exited the flow.

attributes.name: enrollment_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer was enrolled into the automation flow. Represents the start of the customers journey through the automation.

attributes.name: enrollment_trigger_event
attributes.description: The business event or action that triggered the customers enrollment into the automation flow. Examples include cart abandonment, product purchase, account creation, loyalty tier change, or manual enrollment.

attributes.name: exit_reason
attributes.description: The reason the customer exited the automation flow. Examples include completed (finished all steps), unsubscribed (opted out), suppressed (consent withdrawn), manually_removed (admin action), goal_achieved (converted), or error (technical failure). Null if still active.

attributes.name: exit_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer exited the automation flow. Null if the customer is still actively enrolled.

attributes.name: last_interaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time of the customers most recent interaction with any message in this automation flow. Includes opens, clicks, or other engagement actions.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this enrollment record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_action_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the next automation action (message send, step transition, or evaluation) is scheduled for this enrollment. Used for operational monitoring and queue management.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: The business priority assigned to this enrollment. High-priority enrollments may receive expedited processing or preferential treatment in message queues.

attributes.name: step_sequence_number
attributes.description: The ordinal position of the current step within the automation flow. Indicates progression depth through the journey.

attributes.name: suppression_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is currently suppressed from receiving further messages in this automation flow due to consent withdrawal, unsubscribe, or compliance requirements.

attributes.name: suppression_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer was suppressed from the automation flow. Null if not suppressed.

attributes.name: total_messages_clicked
attributes.description: Count of marketing messages where the customer clicked a link or call-to-action during this automation enrollment. Indicates deeper engagement and intent.

attributes.name: total_messages_opened
attributes.description: Count of marketing messages that the customer opened during this automation enrollment. Used to measure engagement and message effectiveness.

attributes.name: total_messages_sent
attributes.description: Count of marketing messages (emails, SMS, push notifications) sent to the customer as part of this automation enrollment. Used to measure communication volume and frequency.

attributes.name: total_steps_completed
attributes.description: Count of automation flow steps that the customer has successfully completed since enrollment. Used to measure journey progression and engagement.

attributes.name: re_enrolled_from_automation_enrollment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Re Enrolled From Automation Enrollment Id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on automation_enrollment (re_enrolled_from_automation_enrollment_id)

products.name: opt_in_record
products.description: Authoritative record of customer marketing communication opt-in and opt-out preferences by channel, distinct from customer.consent which covers broader GDPR/CCPA privacy consent. Captures customer identifier, channel type (email, SMS, push, direct mail, phone), opt-in status, opt-in source (checkout, loyalty enrollment, website preference center, in-store), opt-in timestamp, opt-out timestamp, opt-out reason, suppression list membership, and CAN-SPAM/TCPA compliance flags. Governs which customers can be contacted via each marketing channel.

attributes.name: opt_in_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the marketing communication opt-in record. Primary key for the opt-in record entity.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that created this opt-in record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.marketing_channel. Business justification: Opt-in records are channel-specific (email opt-in, SMS opt-in, push opt-in) and should reference the authoritative marketing_channel master. Currently, opt_in_record has a denormalized channel_type ST

attributes.name: modified_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that last modified this opt-in record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who owns this opt-in preference. Links to the customer master record.

attributes.name: can_spam_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this opt-in record meets CAN-SPAM Act requirements for email marketing. True if compliant, false otherwise.

attributes.name: ccpa_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this opt-in record meets CCPA requirements for California residents. True if compliant, false otherwise.

attributes.name: consent_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date when this opt-in consent expires and must be re-confirmed. Null if consent does not expire. Required in some jurisdictions (e.g., GDPR recommends periodic re-consent).

attributes.name: consent_text_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent language presented to the customer at the time of opt-in. Required for GDPR compliance to prove informed consent.

attributes.name: contact_count
attributes.description: The total number of marketing communications sent to this customer via this channel since opt-in. Used for frequency capping and customer experience management.

attributes.name: contact_value
attributes.description: The actual contact point value for this channel (email address for email channel, phone number for SMS/phone channels, device token for push, mailing address for direct mail). Stored for audit and verification purposes.

attributes.name: contact_verification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the contact value was last verified. Null if never verified.

attributes.name: contact_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact value has been verified as valid and deliverable. True if verified, false otherwise.

attributes.name: content_preference
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the types of content the customer wants to receive (e.g., promotions, new arrivals, loyalty rewards). Used for personalized targeting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this opt-in record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: double_opt_in_confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer confirmed their opt-in via double opt-in process. Null if double opt-in was not used or not yet confirmed.

attributes.name: double_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer confirmed their opt-in via a double opt-in process (e.g., email confirmation link). True if double opt-in confirmed, false if single opt-in.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Email Marketing Best Practices

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this opt-in record ceases to be effective. Null if currently effective. Set when customer opts out or consent expires.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this opt-in record becomes effective and the customer can be contacted. May differ from opt_in_timestamp if there is a processing delay.

attributes.name: frequency_preference
attributes.description: The customers preferred frequency for receiving marketing communications on this channel. Used to honor customer preferences and reduce unsubscribes.

attributes.name: gdpr_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this opt-in record meets GDPR consent requirements for customers in EU jurisdictions. True if compliant, false otherwise.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the geographic jurisdiction under which this opt-in was collected. Used for compliance with jurisdiction-specific regulations.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address from which the opt-in or opt-out action was performed. Stored for fraud detection and consent audit trail.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code indicating the customers preferred language for marketing communications on this channel.

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: The date when the customer was last contacted via this channel. Used to enforce frequency preferences and avoid over-communication.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this opt-in record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this opt-in record. Used for documenting special circumstances, customer service interactions, or compliance exceptions.

attributes.name: opt_in_source
attributes.description: The touchpoint or system where the customer provided their opt-in consent. Critical for audit trail and consent provenance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: checkout|loyalty_enrollment|website_preference_center|in_store|mobile_app|customer_service|third_party — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: opt_in_status
attributes.description: Current opt-in status for this customer and channel combination. Governs whether the customer can be contacted via this channel.

attributes.name: opt_in_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer opted in to receive marketing communications for this channel. Required for CAN-SPAM and GDPR consent audit trails.

attributes.name: opt_out_method
attributes.description: The mechanism or channel through which the customer opted out. Required for compliance reporting and process improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: unsubscribe_link|preference_center|customer_service|email_reply|sms_stop|in_store|automated — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: opt_out_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the customer for opting out. Used for customer experience analysis and retention strategies.

attributes.name: opt_out_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer opted out of receiving marketing communications for this channel. Null if customer has not opted out.

attributes.name: suppression_list_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this customer-channel combination is on a suppression list and must not be contacted. True if suppressed, false otherwise.

attributes.name: suppression_reason
attributes.description: The reason why this customer-channel combination is suppressed from marketing communications. Null if not suppressed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hard_bounce|spam_complaint|legal_request|fraud|deceased|duplicate|invalid_contact — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tcpa_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this opt-in record meets TCPA requirements for SMS and phone marketing. True if compliant, false otherwise. Applies to SMS and phone channels only.

attributes.name: third_party_consent_date
attributes.description: The date when consent was originally obtained by the third-party source. Null if not applicable. Required for GDPR Article 14 transparency.

attributes.name: third_party_source_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party vendor or partner who provided this opt-in record, if applicable. Null if opt-in was collected directly. Required for compliance and data lineage.

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: The browser or application user agent string captured at the time of opt-in or opt-out. Used for audit trail and fraud detection.

attributes.name: superseded_opt_in_record_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on opt_in_record (superseded_opt_in_record_id)

products.name: campaign_performance
products.description: Operational performance snapshot record capturing measured results for a campaign at a given reporting period and channel level. Captures campaign reference, channel reference, reporting period (day, week, month), impressions delivered, reach, clicks, CTR, conversions, conversion rate, attributed revenue, ROAS (Return on Ad Spend), CPM, CPC, CPA, email open rate, unsubscribe rate, and spend to date. This is an operational Silver Layer record aggregated at the campaign-channel-period grain for campaign management — NOT a Gold Layer analytics product.

attributes.name: campaign_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the campaign performance record. Primary key for this operational performance snapshot.

attributes.name: attribution_model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.attribution_model. Business justification: Campaign performance metrics are calculated using attribution models. The campaign_performance table has attribution_model (STRING) which stores the model name/code, but this should be normalized to a

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign being measured. Links this performance record to the parent campaign entity.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.marketing_channel. Business justification: Campaign performance is measured by marketing channel and should reference the authoritative marketing_channel master. Currently, campaign_performance has a denormalized channel_type STRING attribute.

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: Campaign performance metrics must align with financial reporting periods for ROI analysis, budget variance reporting, and board-level marketing effectiveness reviews. CFO and CMO jointly review market

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_hierarchy. Business justification: Campaign performance reporting in retail aggregates by product category/hierarchy for category managers and merchandising teams. Essential for measuring campaign effectiveness by department/class/subc

attributes.name: kpi_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.kpi_definition. Business justification: Performance records measure specific KPIs defined in analytics (impressions, conversions, ROAS). Each performance row tracks one or more standardized metrics; this link enables consistent metric defin

attributes.name: price_strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_strategy. Business justification: Campaign performance reporting segments results by pricing strategy (promotional vs everyday pricing campaigns). Real business process: marketing mix modeling compares ROAS across different price stra

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.storefront. Business justification: Campaign performance is measured per storefront in multi-channel retail. Enables storefront-level campaign ROI reporting, supports budget allocation decisions by channel, and tracks brand-specific cam

attributes.name: attributed_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Total revenue attributed to this campaign and channel during the reporting period, based on the attribution model in use.

attributes.name: click_count
attributes.description: Total number of clicks recorded during the reporting period for this campaign and channel.

attributes.name: conversion_count
attributes.description: Total number of conversions (completed desired actions such as purchases, sign-ups, downloads) attributed to this campaign and channel during the reporting period.

attributes.name: conversion_rate_percent
attributes.description: Conversion rate expressed as a percentage, calculated as (conversions / clicks) * 100 for the reporting period.

attributes.name: cpa_amount
attributes.description: Cost per acquisition or conversion (CPA) for this campaign and channel during the reporting period, in the spend currency.

attributes.name: cpc_amount
attributes.description: Cost per click (CPC) for this campaign and channel during the reporting period, in the spend currency.

attributes.name: cpm_amount
attributes.description: Cost per thousand impressions (CPM) for this campaign and channel during the reporting period, in the spend currency.

attributes.name: ctr_percent
attributes.description: Click-through rate expressed as a percentage, calculated as (clicks / impressions) * 100 for the reporting period.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system or platform from which this performance data was extracted (e.g., Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Analytics).

attributes.name: email_delivered_count
attributes.description: Total number of emails successfully delivered (not bounced) for this campaign during the reporting period. Applicable only when channel_type is email.

attributes.name: email_open_count
attributes.description: Total number of email opens recorded for this campaign during the reporting period. Applicable only when channel_type is email.

attributes.name: email_open_rate_percent
attributes.description: Email open rate expressed as a percentage, calculated as (opens / delivered) * 100 for the reporting period. Applicable only when channel_type is email.

attributes.name: email_send_count
attributes.description: Total number of emails sent for this campaign during the reporting period. Applicable only when channel_type is email.

attributes.name: email_unsubscribe_count
attributes.description: Total number of unsubscribes triggered by this campaign during the reporting period. Applicable only when channel_type is email.

attributes.name: email_unsubscribe_rate_percent
attributes.description: Email unsubscribe rate expressed as a percentage, calculated as (unsubscribes / delivered) * 100 for the reporting period. Applicable only when channel_type is email.

attributes.name: engagement_count
attributes.description: Total number of engagements (likes, shares, comments, reactions) recorded for this campaign and channel during the reporting period. Primarily applicable to social media channels.

attributes.name: engagement_rate_percent
attributes.description: Engagement rate expressed as a percentage, calculated as (engagements / impressions) * 100 for the reporting period. Primarily applicable to social media channels.

attributes.name: impressions_delivered
attributes.description: Total number of impressions delivered during the reporting period for this campaign and channel combination.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this performance data was measured and recorded. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this performance record, including anomalies, data quality issues, or contextual information.

attributes.name: performance_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the campaign performance tracking for this channel and period (active, paused, completed, cancelled).

attributes.name: reach_count
attributes.description: Total unique individuals or accounts reached during the reporting period for this campaign and channel.

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the reporting period for which this performance data was captured. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the reporting period for which this performance data was captured. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: reporting_period_type
attributes.description: The granularity of the reporting period for this performance snapshot (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly).

attributes.name: revenue_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the attributed revenue amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: roas_ratio
attributes.description: Return on Ad Spend ratio, calculated as attributed revenue divided by spend for this campaign and channel during the reporting period. A value of 3.50 means $3.50 revenue per $1.00 spent.

attributes.name: spend_amount
attributes.description: Total media spend or campaign cost for this campaign and channel during the reporting period.

attributes.name: spend_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the spend amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: video_completion_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of video views that were completed (watched to the end) during the reporting period. Applicable only when channel_type is video.

attributes.name: video_view_count
attributes.description: Total number of video views recorded for this campaign during the reporting period. Applicable only when channel_type is video.

attributes.name: prior_period_campaign_performance_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on campaign_performance (prior_period_campaign_performance_id)

products.name: campaign_deployment
products.description: This association product represents the deployment of a marketing campaign to a specific digital storefront. It captures the operational execution of campaign strategy at the storefront level, including budget allocation, activation timing, and performance metrics specific to each campaign-storefront combination. Each record links one campaign to one storefront with attributes that exist only in the context of this deployment relationship.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, marketing campaigns are routinely deployed across multiple digital storefronts simultaneously (e.g., a national holiday campaign runs on the main e-commerce site, mobile app, and marketplace storefronts), and each storefront hosts multiple campaigns concurrently (seasonal promotions, category-specific campaigns, brand campaigns). Marketing teams actively manage these deployments as distinct operational entities, allocating budgets, setting activation windows, and tracking performance metrics at the campaign-storefront level.

products.name: campaign_fulfillment
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment between marketing campaigns and distribution center facilities that fulfill campaign-driven demand. It captures the multi-facility fulfillment strategy for national and regional campaigns, where each DC is allocated specific inventory quantities, assigned priority rankings, and bound by campaign-specific SLAs. Each record links one campaign to one DC facility with attributes that exist only in the context of this fulfillment relationship.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, national and regional marketing campaigns are routinely fulfilled from multiple distribution centers based on geographic coverage, inventory positioning, and capacity. Each campaign-to-DC assignment is an operational decision with specific allocated inventory quantities, priority rankings for order routing, and campaign-specific fulfillment SLAs. Conversely, each DC simultaneously supports multiple active campaigns with different inventory allocations and priorities. This is an actively managed operational relationship, not a derived analytical correlation.

products.name: campaign_policy_compliance
products.description: This association product represents the compliance verification relationship between marketing campaigns and internal compliance policies. It captures the acknowledgment, verification, and exception management for each campaign-policy pairing. Each record links one campaign to one policy with attributes that track when compliance was verified, by whom, and whether any exceptions were granted.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, marketing campaigns must comply with multiple internal policies (data privacy, advertising standards, promotional terms, sweepstakes regulations, PCI security for payment promotions). The compliance team actively manages campaign-policy compliance records as operational entities, tracking acknowledgment dates, verification status, reviewer assignments, and exception approvals for audit and regulatory reporting purposes.

attributes.description: The number of data points or transactions used to calculate this KPI value. Relevant for statistically-derived metrics to assess reliability.

attributes.name: trend_direction

attributes.description: The unit in which the KPI value is expressed (e.g., USD, units, percentage, days, ratio). Critical for proper interpretation and display of the metric.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The absolute difference between the actual value and the target value (actual_value - target_value). Positive values indicate performance above target.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage difference between actual and target values, calculated as ((actual_value - target_value) / target_value) * 100. Enables normalized performance comparison.

products.name: kpi_dimensionality
products.description: This association product represents the configuration relationship between KPI definitions and the metric dimensions by which they can be sliced and analyzed. It captures the explicit business rules governing which dimensions are available for each KPI, how they aggregate, and their display behavior in BI tools. Each record links one KPI definition to one metric dimension with configuration attributes that exist only in the context of this specific KPI-dimension pairing.. Existence Justification: In retail analytics operations, BI teams actively configure which dimensions are available for each KPI, how they aggregate, their display order, and drill-down behavior. This is not a derived analytical correlation but an explicit configuration that semantic layer architects manage as part of OLAP cube design and BI tool setup. The business recognizes this as 'KPI dimensionality configuration' - a managed artifact that determines how business users can slice and filter metrics.

This should be replaced by the explicit M:N relationship captured in kpi_dimensionality, where each valid dimension is a separate record with its own configuration.]

attributes.name: drill_enabled

products.name: report_composition
products.description: This association product represents the configuration relationship between KPI definitions and report definitions in the retail analytics catalog. It captures how KPIs are composed into reports with report-specific presentation rules, display ordering, visualization preferences, and threshold overrides. Each record links one KPI definition to one report definition with attributes that control how that specific KPI appears and behaves within that specific report context.. Existence Justification: In retail analytics operations, BI teams actively manage the composition of reports by selecting which KPIs to include, configuring how each KPI is visualized, setting display order, and defining report-specific presentation rules. A single KPI (e.g., Comparable Store Sales) appears in multiple reports (Executive Dashboard, Store Operations Report, Regional Performance Report) with different visualizations, thresholds, and filters. Conversely, each report contains multiple KPIs arranged in a specific sequence with report-specific configuration. This is an operational configuration activity managed through BI catalog tools, not an analytical correlation.

products.name: metric_entity_dependency
products.description: This association product represents the metadata lineage relationship between semantic metrics and the semantic layer entities they depend on for calculation. It captures the technical join configuration, filter logic, and aggregation behavior required to compute each metric from its constituent entities. Each record links one semantic metric to one semantic layer entity with attributes that define how the entity participates in the metric calculation within the BI semantic layer platform.. Existence Justification: In retail semantic layer platforms (Looker, dbt Semantic Layer, Databricks Unity Catalog), metrics explicitly depend on multiple entities for calculation (e.g., a Gross Margin % metric requires sales_fact, product_dim, and cost_dim entities), and entities are reused across many metrics. The business actively manages these dependencies as metadata configurations that drive BI query generation, defining join paths, filter logic, and aggregation roles for each metric-entity pair.

products.name: sla_kpi_measurement
products.description: This association product represents the measurement contract between supply chain SLA definitions and enterprise KPI definitions. It captures the specific measurement parameters, thresholds, and penalty structures that apply when a particular KPI is used to evaluate a particular SLA. Each record links one SLA definition to one KPI definition with measurement-specific attributes that exist only in the context of this monitoring relationship.. Existence Justification: In retail supply chain operations, a single SLA (e.g., Supplier Fill Rate SLA) is measured by multiple KPIs (fill rate percentage, order completeness count, line item accuracy), and each enterprise KPI (e.g., On-Time Delivery %) is used to measure multiple SLAs across different suppliers, product categories, and distribution centers. The business actively manages SLA performance scorecards where each KPI-SLA pairing has its own measurement frequency, threshold, penalty rate, and effective dates.

attributes.name: breach_penalty_rate

domains.name: compliance
domains.description: Manages regulatory compliance tracking, food safety (FDA/FSMA) audit schedules, OSHA workplace safety compliance, PCI-DSS payment security, GDPR/CCPA privacy compliance programs, environmental regulations, and certification lifecycle management across all retail operations.

products.name: compliance_program
products.description: Master record for each formal compliance program operated by Retail, such as the FDA/FSMA Food Safety Program, OSHA Safety Program, PCI-DSS Payment Security Program, GDPR Privacy Program, CCPA Privacy Program, and Environmental Compliance Program. Captures program name, owning business unit, program sponsor, regulatory framework(s) covered, program status (active, suspended, under review), effective date, renewal date, and program scope (enterprise-wide, banner-specific, channel-specific). Acts as the top-level organizing entity for all compliance activities.

attributes.name: compliance_program_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the compliance program. Primary key. Inferred role: MASTER_AGREEMENT (long-running compliance framework container).

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: Required or planned frequency of compliance audits for this program. Continuous: real-time monitoring. Ad_hoc: event-driven or unscheduled audits.

attributes.name: certification_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current certification or accreditation expires and must be renewed. Null if not applicable or perpetual.

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Official certification or accreditation number issued by the governing body or third-party auditor (e.g., ISO 27001 certificate number, PCI-DSS Attestation of Compliance number). Null if program does not issue certifications.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; ISO 27001; PCI SSC; Internal Compliance Framework

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current status of external certification or accreditation for this program. Not_applicable: program does not require external certification.

attributes.name: compliance_program_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the compliance program purpose, objectives, key requirements, and business rationale.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance program record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance program became or will become binding and enforceable within the organization.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance program ends or requires renewal. Null for perpetual programs without fixed term.

attributes.name: governing_body
attributes.description: Name of the external regulatory authority, standards organization, or certification body that oversees this compliance program (e.g., Federal Trade Commission, Consumer Product Safety Commission, PCI Security Standards Council).
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC); Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC); Food and Drug Administration (FDA); Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA); Payment Card Industry Security Standards Council (PCI SSC); General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR); California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)

attributes.name: incident_count_ytd
attributes.description: Number of compliance incidents, violations, or breaches recorded for this program in the current calendar year.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance audit or assessment conducted for this program.

attributes.name: last_audit_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the most recent compliance audit. Passed: full compliance. Passed_with_findings: compliant but with minor issues noted. Failed: non-compliant. Not_applicable: audit not yet conducted or program not subject to audit.

attributes.name: manager
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the individual responsible for day-to-day program management and coordination. Business-confidential organizational information.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this compliance program record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance program record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance audit or assessment for this program.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, historical notes, or program-specific considerations not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: owning_business_unit
attributes.description: Name of the business unit, division, or department responsible for managing and executing this compliance program (e.g., Legal & Compliance, Food Safety, Information Security, Store Operations).

attributes.name: penalty_amount_max
attributes.description: Maximum potential financial penalty or fine (in USD) for non-compliance with this program, based on regulatory framework or historical precedent. Business-confidential risk assessment data.
attributes.references: Federal Trade Commission (FTC); Food and Drug Administration (FDA); GDPR; CCPA; Internal Risk Framework

attributes.name: policy_document_url
attributes.description: URL or document management system reference to the official compliance program policy document, standard operating procedures, or program charter.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the compliance program (e.g., FDA-FSMA-2024, PCI-DSS-V4, GDPR-EU). Used in regulatory filings and audit documentation.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the compliance program (e.g., Food and Drug Administration Food Safety Modernization Act Program, Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard Program).

attributes.name: program_scope

Channel_specific: applies to e-commerce, stores, or distribution only. Region_specific: applies to specific geographic regions. Store_specific: applies to individual stores. DC_specific: applies to distribution centers.

Retired: no longer applicable. Pending_activation: approved but not yet effective. Non_compliant: program exists but organization is currently out of compliance.

attributes.name: program_type

products.name: obligation
products.description: Operational record linking a specific regulatory requirement to a compliance program, defining the specific control obligation the retailer must fulfill. Captures obligation title, obligation type (policy, procedure, training, audit, certification, reporting), due date cadence (annual, quarterly, monthly, event-driven), responsible owner role, applicable location scope, and current fulfillment status. Bridges the regulatory requirement catalog to actionable compliance tasks and audit schedules.
