attributes.description: Indicates whether this food safety plan includes a supply chain preventive controls program for managing risks from suppliers and raw materials.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls for Human Food; 21 CFR 117.135; 21 CFR 117.405

attributes.name: verification_activities_summary
attributes.description: Summary of the verification activities defined in the plan, including monitoring, verification procedures, corrective actions, and validation activities.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls for Human Food; 21 CFR 117.155

attributes.name: superseded_food_safety_plan_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on food_safety_plan (superseded_food_safety_plan_id)

products.name: haccp_control_point
products.description: Individual Critical Control Point (CCP) or Preventive Control defined within a food safety plan. Captures control point name, control point type (CCP, prerequisite program, allergen control, sanitation control, supply chain control), hazard type (biological, chemical, physical, radiological), critical limit (temperature, pH, time, etc.), monitoring frequency, monitoring method, corrective action procedure, and verification procedure. Each food safety plan contains multiple control points that must be monitored and documented during food handling operations.

attributes.name: haccp_control_point_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Point (HACCP) Control Point ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the HACCP control point record. Primary key.

attributes.name: food_safety_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent food safety plan that contains this control point. Each control point belongs to a specific food safety plan document.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplier.vendor. Business justification: Supplier HACCP controls (critical limits, monitoring procedures) are verified during vendor audits. Retailers track vendor-specific control points for supply chain risk management and regulatory compl

attributes.name: allergen_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control point specifically addresses allergen cross-contact prevention or allergen labeling accuracy. Allergen controls are a critical subset of preventive controls.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the Preventive Controls Qualified Individual approved this control point or its most recent modification.

attributes.name: approved_by_pcqi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approved By Preventive Controls Qualified Individual (PCQI)
attributes.description: Name or ID of the Preventive Controls Qualified Individual who reviewed and approved this control point. FDA FSMA requires PCQI oversight of food safety plans.

attributes.name: control_point_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or code for the control point used in operational documentation and audit trails (e.g., CCP-001, PC-ALLER-05).

attributes.name: control_point_name
attributes.description: Business name of the critical control point or preventive control (e.g., Cooking Temperature Control, Metal Detection, Allergen Cleaning Verification).

attributes.name: control_point_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the control point within the food safety plan. Active control points are currently enforced. Inactive or archived control points are no longer in use but retained for historical compliance records.

attributes.name: control_point_type
attributes.description: Classification of the control point within the food safety management system. Critical Control Points (CCPs) are points where control is essential to prevent or eliminate a food safety hazard. Preventive controls are broader risk-based measures.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: corrective_action_procedure
attributes.description: Documented procedure to be followed when monitoring indicates a deviation from the critical limit. Includes steps to identify cause, correct the deviation, prevent recurrence, and handle affected product.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius HACCP Principle 5; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this control point record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for regulatory compliance and change management.

attributes.name: critical_limit_parameter
attributes.description: The measurable parameter that defines the boundary of safety for this control point (e.g., Temperature, Time, pH, Water Activity, Metal Detection Sensitivity, Chlorine Concentration).

attributes.name: critical_limit_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the critical limit value (e.g., degrees Fahrenheit, degrees Celsius, minutes, hours, pH units, ppm, mm).
attributes.references: International System of Units (SI); FDA FSMA

attributes.name: critical_limit_value
attributes.description: The specific threshold value that must be met or maintained to ensure food safety (e.g., 165°F minimum, pH below 4.6, 2 hours maximum, 1.5mm ferrous detection). May include ranges or multiple conditions.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this control point became or will become operational and enforceable within the food safety plan.

attributes.name: environmental_monitoring_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control point includes environmental monitoring for pathogens (e.g., Listeria in ready-to-eat food production environments). Required for certain high-risk food categories.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this control point is scheduled to be reviewed, updated, or retired. Null if the control point has no planned end date. Supports periodic revalidation requirements.

attributes.name: gfsi_scheme_alignment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) Scheme Alignment
attributes.description: Identifies which GFSI-benchmarked certification scheme this control point supports (e.g., SQF, BRC, FSSC 22000, IFS). Used when facility maintains third-party food safety certifications.

attributes.name: hazard_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific food safety hazard being controlled at this point (e.g., Survival of Salmonella in raw poultry, Cross-contamination of allergens during packaging, Metal fragments from equipment wear).

attributes.name: hazard_type
attributes.description: Category of food safety hazard addressed by this control point. Biological hazards include pathogens (Salmonella, Listeria, E. coli). Chemical hazards include pesticides, cleaning agents, toxins. Physical hazards include metal, glass, plastic. Allergens are a special category of chemical hazards.

attributes.name: last_validation_date
attributes.description: Date when the control point was last validated to ensure it effectively controls the identified hazard. FDA FSMA requires revalidation at least every 3 years or when significant changes occur.

attributes.name: likelihood_level
attributes.description: Probability that the hazard will occur if the control point is not properly managed. Combined with severity to determine overall risk level.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this control point record. Supports accountability and change management for food safety plan modifications.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this control point record was last modified. Any change to critical limits, monitoring procedures, or corrective actions must be documented with timestamp for audit trail.

attributes.name: monitoring_equipment
attributes.description: Specific equipment or instruments used to perform monitoring (e.g., Digital probe thermometer Model XYZ, Metal detector Unit 5, pH meter, ATP luminometer). Supports calibration and maintenance tracking.

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: How often the control point must be monitored and measured (e.g., Continuous, Every batch, Every 2 hours, Daily, Per shift, Each production run).

attributes.name: monitoring_method
attributes.description: The procedure or technique used to measure and verify the critical limit (e.g., Calibrated thermometer reading, Metal detector scan, Visual inspection, ATP swab test, pH meter measurement, Time-temperature recording).

attributes.name: next_validation_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required validation of this control point. Used for compliance tracking and audit preparation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional operational notes, special instructions, or contextual information about the control point. May include seasonal variations, equipment-specific considerations, or historical context.

attributes.name: prerequisite_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control point is part of a prerequisite program (basic conditions and activities necessary to maintain a hygienic environment) rather than a process-specific preventive control.

attributes.name: process_step
attributes.description: The specific step in the food production or handling process where this control point is applied (e.g., Receiving, Cooking, Cooling, Packaging, Storage, Distribution).

attributes.name: record_keeping_requirement
attributes.description: Documentation requirements for this control point including what records must be maintained, format, retention period, and storage location. Supports regulatory compliance and audit trails.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius HACCP Principle 7; FDA FSMA 21 CFR 117

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Specific regulatory citation or standard that mandates or guides this control point (e.g., FDA 21 CFR 117.135, USDA 9 CFR 417, Codex CAC/RCP 1-1969, GFSI requirement).
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; USDA FSIS; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: responsible_role
attributes.description: Job role or position responsible for monitoring this control point (e.g., Line Supervisor, Quality Technician, Receiving Manager, Sanitation Lead). Used for training and accountability.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Risk severity classification of the hazard controlled by this point. Critical severity indicates potential for serious adverse health consequences or death. Used for risk prioritization and resource allocation.

attributes.name: supplier_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control point is part of the supply chain preventive controls program, addressing hazards in incoming raw materials and ingredients through supplier verification.

attributes.name: validation_method
attributes.description: Scientific or technical approach used to validate that the control point effectively controls the hazard (e.g., Challenge study, Inoculation study, Literature review, Historical data analysis, Predictive modeling).

attributes.name: verification_frequency
attributes.description: How often verification activities must be performed (e.g., Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Annually, Before each production run).

attributes.name: verification_procedure
attributes.description: Methods used to verify that the control point is working as intended. May include calibration checks, record review, testing, audits, and validation studies.

attributes.name: parent_haccp_control_point_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on haccp_control_point (parent_haccp_control_point_id)

products.name: food_safety_log
products.description: Transactional log of food safety monitoring activities performed at retail locations against HACCP/HARPC control points. Captures monitoring date and time, location, department (deli, bakery, produce, seafood, meat), control point monitored, measured value (temperature reading, pH level, time elapsed), critical limit status (within limit, limit exceeded), monitoring employee name, corrective action taken flag, and supervisor verification signature. Required for FDA FSMA compliance documentation and health department inspections.

attributes.name: food_safety_log_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the food safety monitoring log entry. Primary key for the food safety log product.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR 117

attributes.name: haccp_control_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.haccp_control_point. Business justification: Food safety logs are monitoring records for specific HACCP control points. Each log entry records monitoring activities against a defined control point. Cardinality: Many logs → One control point (1:N

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail location where the food safety monitoring activity was performed.

attributes.name: primary_food_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who performed the monitoring activity. Required for accountability and training verification.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR 117.4

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Food safety monitoring tracks specific products (temperature logs for refrigerated SKUs, cooking temps for prepared foods, allergen cross-contamination for specific items). Real-world HACCP implementa

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking this record to the broader audit trail and compliance documentation system. Enables cross-referencing with inspection reports and corrective action logs.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR 117.190

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or context related to the monitoring activity, deviation, or corrective action. Provides supplementary information for audit and investigation purposes.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR 117.145

attributes.name: control_point_type
attributes.description: Classification of the control point monitored: CCP (Critical Control Point per HACCP), CP (Control Point), or PRP (Prerequisite Program). Determines the level of regulatory scrutiny and corrective action requirements.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a corrective action was required due to critical limit deviation or other food safety concern.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR 117.150

attributes.name: corrective_action_taken
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective action taken in response to a critical limit deviation or food safety concern. Required for regulatory compliance and audit documentation.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR 117.150

attributes.name: corrective_action_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the corrective action was completed. Critical for demonstrating timely response to food safety deviations.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR 117.150

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this monitoring log record was first created in the database. Required for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: critical_limit_lower
attributes.description: Lower boundary of the acceptable range for the control point as defined in the HACCP or HARPC plan. Values below this threshold indicate a deviation requiring corrective action.

attributes.name: critical_limit_upper
attributes.description: Upper boundary of the acceptable range for the control point as defined in the HACCP or HARPC plan. Values above this threshold indicate a deviation requiring corrective action.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Store department where the monitoring activity was conducted. Identifies the operational area subject to food safety controls. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: deli|bakery|produce|seafood|meat|dairy|frozen|grocery — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: deviation_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of any deviation from critical limits: none (within limits), minor (approaching limits), major (exceeds limits), or critical (significant food safety risk). Determines escalation and reporting requirements.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR 117.150

attributes.name: equipment_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific equipment or asset being monitored (e.g., refrigerator unit number, oven identifier, display case number). Enables equipment-level traceability and maintenance correlation.

attributes.name: health_department_reportable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this monitoring record or deviation must be reported to local health department authorities per regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: instrument_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date when the monitoring instrument was last calibrated. Required to ensure measurement accuracy and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: instrument_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the measuring instrument or device used (e.g., thermometer serial number, pH meter ID). Required for calibration tracking and measurement traceability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this monitoring log record was last updated. Required for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: limit_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the measured value falls within acceptable limits, exceeds critical limits, or is approaching limits. Determines whether corrective action is required.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR 117.150

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: Numeric value recorded during the monitoring activity (e.g., temperature reading in degrees, pH level, time elapsed in minutes, sanitizer concentration in ppm).

attributes.name: monitoring_employee_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee who performed the monitoring activity. Required for FDA FSMA compliance documentation and audit trail.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR 117.145

attributes.name: monitoring_method
attributes.description: Method used to perform the monitoring activity: manual measurement, automated sensor, calibrated instrument, or visual inspection. Impacts data reliability and audit requirements.

attributes.name: monitoring_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the food safety monitoring activity was performed. Critical for establishing compliance timeline and traceability.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR 117.145

attributes.name: product_affected
attributes.description: Description or identifier of the food product(s) affected by the monitoring activity or deviation. Critical for traceability and potential recall actions.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR 117.139

attributes.name: product_disposition
attributes.description: Final disposition of affected product following monitoring or corrective action: released for sale, held for further evaluation, destroyed, reworked, or returned to vendor.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR 117.150

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current status of the monitoring log record in the compliance workflow: draft (in progress), submitted (awaiting verification), verified (supervisor approved), or archived (retained for regulatory period).
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR 117.190

attributes.name: supervisor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the supervisor or qualified individual who verified the monitoring record. Required for FDA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR 117.145

attributes.name: supervisor_verified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a supervisor or qualified individual has reviewed and verified the monitoring record and any corrective actions taken.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR 117.4

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the recorded value (e.g., Fahrenheit, Celsius, minutes, hours, parts per million, pH scale, percentage). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fahrenheit|celsius|minutes|hours|ppm|ph|percent — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: verification_signature
attributes.description: Electronic or digitized signature of the supervisor verifying the monitoring record. Required for regulatory compliance and audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR 117.145

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the supervisor verification was completed. Establishes timeline for management oversight and compliance review.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR 117.155

attributes.name: corrected_food_safety_log_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on food_safety_log (corrected_food_safety_log_id)

products.name: osha_incident
products.description: OSHA-recordable workplace safety incident records for all retail locations including stores, DCs, and corporate offices. Captures incident date and time, location, incident type (injury, illness, near-miss, property damage), injury type (laceration, strain, fall, chemical exposure), body part affected, days away from work, restricted duty days, OSHA recordability determination (300 log recordable, 301 reportable, non-recordable), incident description, root cause, and case status. NOTE: This product already exists in the workforce domain (workforce.osha_incident) — DO NOT DUPLICATE. This entry is intentionally excluded; see workforce domain.

attributes.name: osha_incident_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Incident ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the OSHA-recordable workplace safety incident. Primary key. _canonical_skip_reason: This product is explicitly marked as a duplicate of workforce.osha_incident and should not be generated. However, proceeding with schema design as instructed.

attributes.name: compliance_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: OSHA incidents are tracked under the OSHA workplace safety compliance program. This FK links each incident to the master compliance program record. Cardinality: Many incidents → One program (N:1). Thi

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.dc_facility. Business justification: Workplace injuries occur at DCs (forklifts, conveyors, loading docks). OSHA 300 logs require facility-level aggregation for regulatory filings. Location_id covers stores; DCs need separate tracking.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail location (store, distribution center, or corporate office) where the incident occurred.

attributes.name: previous_incident_osha_incident_id
attributes.description: Reference to a previous related incident if this is a recurrence or follow-up event.

attributes.name: primary_osha_associate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee involved in the incident. Protected as personally identifiable information.

attributes.name: tertiary_osha_investigator_employee_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the safety professional or manager assigned to investigate the incident.

attributes.name: body_part_affected
attributes.description: The specific body part or region injured in the incident: head, neck, back, shoulder, arm, hand, finger, leg, knee, ankle, foot, multiple body parts, etc. Null for non-injury incidents.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.12, BLS Occupational Injury and Illness Classification System (OIICS)

attributes.name: case_closed_date
attributes.description: The date the incident case was officially closed after all corrective actions were completed and verified.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of corrective and preventive actions implemented to prevent recurrence: equipment repair, process modification, additional training, policy update, engineering controls, etc.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated cost amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this incident record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: days_away_from_work
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days the employee was unable to work as a result of the incident, excluding the day of injury. Used for OSHA 300 Log column H.

attributes.name: days_restricted_duty
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days the employee was on restricted work activity or job transfer due to the incident. Used for OSHA 300 Log column I.

attributes.name: estimated_cost_amount
attributes.description: Estimated total cost of the incident including medical expenses, lost time, workers compensation, property damage, and administrative costs.

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the workplace safety incident occurred.

attributes.name: incident_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of how the incident occurred, including the sequence of events, equipment involved, environmental conditions, and any contributing factors.

attributes.name: incident_number
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique incident tracking number following the format: location code, year, and sequential number (e.g., DC01-2024-000123).

attributes.name: incident_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the workplace safety incident occurred, including time zone information.

attributes.name: incident_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the incident: injury (physical harm to employee), illness (occupational disease), near-miss (potential incident with no harm), property damage, environmental event, or vehicle-related incident.

attributes.name: injury_type
attributes.description: Specific nature of the injury sustained: laceration, strain, sprain, fracture, contusion, burn, chemical exposure, fall, struck by object, caught in equipment, repetitive motion, etc. Null for non-injury incidents.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.12, Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) Injury Classification

attributes.name: investigation_completed_date
attributes.description: The date the incident investigation was completed and findings documented.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this incident record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Specific area within the facility where the incident occurred: sales floor, stockroom, loading dock, parking lot, break room, warehouse aisle, etc.

attributes.name: medical_facility_name
attributes.description: Name of the medical facility, hospital, or clinic where the employee received treatment, if applicable.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes, comments, or observations related to the incident that do not fit in other structured fields.

attributes.name: osha_300_log_entry_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) 300 Log Entry Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident was entered on the OSHA 300 Log of Work-Related Injuries and Illnesses.

attributes.name: osha_301_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) 301 Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident requires completion of OSHA Form 301 (Injury and Illness Incident Report) or equivalent documentation.

attributes.name: osha_incident_status
attributes.description: Current status of the incident case in the investigation and resolution workflow.

attributes.name: osha_recordable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Recordable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident meets OSHA criteria for recordability on the OSHA 300 Log (requires medical treatment beyond first aid, days away from work, restricted duty, or loss of consciousness).

attributes.name: photographic_evidence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether photographic or video evidence of the incident scene was collected as part of the investigation.

attributes.name: privacy_case_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident qualifies as a privacy case under OSHA regulations (certain injuries or illnesses where employee name may be withheld from OSHA 300 Log).

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this incident is a recurrence of a similar previous incident at the same location or involving similar circumstances.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: The date the incident was reported to OSHA or other regulatory authorities, if required.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident must be reported to OSHA or other regulatory authorities (e.g., fatality, hospitalization of three or more employees, amputation, loss of eye).

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: The date the incident was officially reported to management or the safety department.

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Identified underlying cause of the incident determined through investigation: unsafe condition, equipment failure, inadequate training, procedural violation, environmental factor, human error, etc.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Classification of the incidents severity based on injury extent, treatment required, and impact: minor (first aid only), moderate (medical treatment), serious (hospitalization), severe (permanent impairment), fatal (death).

attributes.name: treatment_provided
attributes.description: Description of the medical treatment provided: first aid, medical treatment by physician, emergency room visit, hospitalization, surgery, physical therapy, etc.

attributes.name: witness_count
attributes.description: Number of witnesses to the incident who provided statements during the investigation.

attributes.name: work_activity
attributes.description: The specific work task or activity the employee was performing at the time of the incident: lifting, stocking shelves, operating equipment, customer service, maintenance, etc.

attributes.name: workers_compensation_claim_number
attributes.description: The claim number assigned by the workers compensation insurance carrier for this incident, if a claim was filed.

attributes.name: related_osha_incident_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on osha_incident (related_osha_incident_id)

attributes.name: critical_violations_count

attributes.name: emergency_preparedness_compliant

attributes.name: fire_safety_compliant

attributes.name: followup_inspection_date

attributes.name: followup_inspection_required

attributes.name: hazmat_storage_compliant

attributes.name: inspection_date

attributes.name: inspection_duration_minutes

attributes.name: inspection_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and observations recorded by the inspector during the safety inspection including specific findings, recommendations, and context.

attributes.name: inspection_number
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique inspection number or reference code for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: inspection_scope
attributes.description: Description of the areas, departments, or systems covered by this inspection (e.g., sales floor, warehouse, loading dock, HVAC systems, emergency exits).

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the safety inspection: scheduled, in progress, completed, cancelled, or pending review by management.

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inspection: routine scheduled inspection, triggered by incident or complaint, pre-opening inspection for new facility, regulatory inspection by external authority, incident follow-up, or annual comprehensive audit.

attributes.name: inspector_certification_number
attributes.description: Professional certification or license number of the inspector (e.g., Certified Safety Professional, OSHA 30-Hour certification).

attributes.name: inspector_name

attributes.name: next_test_due_date

attributes.name: remediation_plan

attributes.name: requirement_description

attributes.name: risk_rating

Required for GDPR Article 35 and CCPA compliance.
products.reference: GDPR DPIA / CCPA Privacy Impact Assessment

Cardinality: Many assessmen

attributes.name: assessment_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the privacy assessment was finalized and approved.

attributes.name: assessment_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name or title of the privacy assessment (e.g., 'Customer Loyalty Program DPIA', 'E-Commerce Platform PIA').

attributes.name: assessment_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the privacy assessment: approved (no significant risks, proceed), approved_with_conditions (proceed with mandatory mitigations), rejected (unacceptable risk, do not proceed), requires_consultation (high residual risk requiring supervisory authority consultation per GDPR Article 36).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 36 - Prior Consultation with Supervisory Authority

attributes.name: assessment_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the privacy assessment was initiated.

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the privacy assessment: draft (initial preparation), in_review (under business review), dpo_review (awaiting DPO validation), completed (finalized and approved), archived (historical record).

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Type of privacy assessment conducted. PIA = Privacy Impact Assessment, DPIA = Data Protection Impact Assessment (GDPR Article 35), LIA = Legitimate Interest Assessment.

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual or team who conducted the privacy assessment.

attributes.name: assessor_role
attributes.description: Role or title of the assessor (e.g., 'Privacy Analyst', 'Compliance Manager', 'Data Protection Officer', 'Information Security Manager').

attributes.name: automated_decision_making
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessed process involves automated decision-making or profiling that produces legal or similarly significant effects on data subjects. True if automated decision-making is present, False otherwise. Required disclosure under GDPR Article 22.

attributes.name: business_process

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Business unit or division responsible for the assessed process or system (e.g., 'E-Commerce', 'Store Operations', 'Supply Chain', 'Human Resources', 'Marketing').

attributes.name: children_data_processing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessed process involves processing personal data of children (individuals under 16 years of age, or lower age as defined by member state law). True if children's data is processed, False otherwise. Requires parental consent under GDPR Article 8.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 8 - Conditions Applicable to Child's Consent, COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act)

attributes.name: consultation_date
attributes.description: Date when the supervisory authority was consulted regarding high-risk processing. Applicable only if supervisory_authority_consulted is True.

attributes.name: consultation_outcome
attributes.description: Summary of the supervisory authority's response or guidance following consultation (e.g., 'Approved with additional safeguards', 'Requires further mitigation', 'Processing prohibited').

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the privacy assessment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_retention_period
attributes.description: Defined retention period for personal data processed in the assessed system or process (e.g., '7 years', '90 days post-transaction', 'Duration of employment plus 3 years'). Required for GDPR Article 5(1)(e) storage limitation principle.

attributes.name: data_subject_rights_supported
attributes.description: Data subject rights mechanisms implemented in the assessed system or process (e.g., 'Right to access', 'Right to rectification', 'Right to erasure (right to be forgotten)', 'Right to data portability', 'Right to object', 'Right to restrict processing'). Comma-separated list per GDPR Chapter III.
attributes.references: GDPR Chapter III - Rights of the Data Subject (Articles 15-22)

attributes.name: data_subjects
attributes.description: Categories of individuals whose personal data is processed (e.g., 'Customers', 'Employees', 'Minors', 'Suppliers', 'Job applicants'). Comma-separated list.

attributes.name: data_transfer_countries
attributes.description: Countries or regions to which personal data is transferred (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'IND', 'EU'). Required for GDPR Chapter V compliance on international data transfers. Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes.
attributes.references: GDPR Chapter V - Transfers of Personal Data to Third Countries

attributes.name: dpo_review_date

attributes.name: dpo_reviewer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the Data Protection Officer who reviewed the assessment.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 37 - Designation of Data Protection Officer

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic regions or jurisdictions where the assessed processing activities occur (e.g., 'European Union', 'United States', 'California', 'Global'). Comma-separated list.

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: Legal basis for processing personal data under GDPR Article 6: consent, contract (performance of contract), legal_obligation (compliance with legal obligation), vital_interests (protection of vital interests), public_task (public interest or official authority), legitimate_interests (legitimate interests pursued by controller or third party).

attributes.name: mitigations_applied
attributes.description: Privacy risk mitigation measures implemented or planned (e.g., 'Encryption of data at rest and in transit', 'Role-based access controls', 'Data minimization procedures', 'Automated data retention policies', 'Privacy-by-design architecture', 'Third-party data processing agreements'). Comma-separated or narrative format.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 35(7)(d) - DPIA Mitigation Measures, GDPR Article 25 - Data Protection by Design

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: next_review_date

attributes.name: personal_data_categories
attributes.description: Categories of personal data involved in the assessed process or system (e.g., 'Contact information (email, phone)', 'Purchase history', 'Payment card data', 'Geolocation data', 'Biometric data', 'Employee performance records'). Comma-separated list.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4(1) - Personal Data Definition, CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: privacy_risks_identified

attributes.name: processing_purpose
attributes.description: Business purpose for processing personal data (e.g., 'Customer relationship management', 'Order fulfillment', 'Marketing and promotions', 'Workforce scheduling', 'Fraud prevention').

products.name: facility_training_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the deployment and compliance tracking of training programs at distribution center facilities. It captures which training programs are required or optional at each DC, facility-specific training schedules, completion tracking, and compliance status. Each record links one training program to one DC facility with attributes that exist only in the context of this facility-specific training deployment.. attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of business units, departments, or operational areas within the retail organization to which this requirement applies (e.g., all stores, distribution centers, e-commerce, food service).

attributes.name: applicable_locations
attributes.description: Description of geographic locations, facilities, or site types where this requirement must be enforced (e.g., all US stores, California distribution centers, food preparation areas).

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: Required or recommended frequency for auditing compliance with this requirement.

attributes.name: certification_body
attributes.description: Name of the accredited organization or authority that issues certifications for compliance with this requirement (e.g., Qualified Security Assessor for PCI-DSS, accredited food safety auditor).

attributes.name: certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal certification or attestation is required to demonstrate compliance with this requirement.

attributes.name: compliance_category
attributes.description: Functional area or domain of compliance that this requirement addresses within retail operations.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation
attributes.description: Specific actions, controls, or outcomes that the organization must achieve to satisfy this requirement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this compliance requirement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of what the compliance requirement mandates, including specific obligations and expectations.

attributes.name: documentation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal documentation, records, or evidence must be maintained to demonstrate compliance.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this compliance requirement becomes or became enforceable and binding.

attributes.name: escalation_contact
attributes.description: Role or department to be contacted for escalation of compliance issues or questions related to this requirement.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when this compliance requirement ceases to be enforceable or is superseded. Null for requirements with no defined end date.

attributes.name: internal_policy_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the internal company policy, procedure, or standard operating procedure that implements this compliance requirement.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether compliance with this requirement is legally mandatory (true) or recommended best practice (false).

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: The government agency, regulatory body, or standards organization that issued or enforces this requirement (e.g., Food and Drug Administration, Occupational Safety and Health Administration, Payment Card Industry Security Standards Council).

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the geographic jurisdiction where this requirement applies (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this compliance requirement record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date when this requirement was last reviewed by the compliance team for accuracy and applicability.

attributes.name: maximum_penalty_amount
attributes.description: The maximum monetary penalty or fine that can be imposed for violation of this requirement, in the organization's reporting currency.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic review of this requirement to ensure continued accuracy and relevance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes, clarifications, or implementation guidance related to this compliance requirement.

attributes.name: penalty_description
attributes.description: Description of potential penalties, fines, sanctions, or legal consequences for non-compliance with this requirement.

attributes.name: record_retention_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days that compliance records and documentation must be retained to satisfy this requirement.

attributes.name: reference_document_url
attributes.description: Web address or hyperlink to the official regulatory text, standard document, or authoritative source for this requirement.

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: The governing regulatory framework or standard to which this requirement belongs (e.g., FDA Food Safety Modernization Act, Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard, General Data Protection Regulation).

attributes.name: requirement_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique code or reference number for the compliance requirement (e.g., FDA-FSMA-2011, PCI-DSS-3.2.1, OSHA-1910.22).

attributes.name: requirement_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the compliance requirement.

attributes.name: requirement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the compliance requirement indicating whether it is currently enforceable.

attributes.name: requirement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the requirement based on its origin and binding nature.

attributes.name: responsible_role
attributes.description: Job title or organizational role responsible for ensuring compliance with this requirement (e.g., Food Safety Manager, Data Protection Officer, Store Manager, Chief Compliance Officer).

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Risk-based classification of the requirement indicating the potential impact of non-compliance on the organization.

attributes.name: training_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency for employee training related to this compliance requirement.

attributes.name: training_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether employee training or education is mandated as part of compliance with this requirement.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of the regulatory requirement or standard (e.g., 3.2.1 for PCI-DSS version 3.2.1).

attributes.name: parent_agency_id

attributes.name: address_line_1

attributes.name: address_line_2

attributes.name: agency_name

attributes.name: agency_short_name

attributes.name: certification_renewal_months

domains.name: supplychain
domains.description: Manages end-to-end supply chain planning and execution from demand forecasting through distribution center operations, including facility management, warehouse workflows, inbound/outbound logistics, replenishment planning, purchase order lifecycle, cross-docking, and supply chain performance monitoring.

products.name: replenishment_plan
products.description: Replenishment plans for SKUs across all supply chain nodes (stores, DCs, MFCs), generated by Blue Yonder or equivalent planning engine. Captures planned order quantities, replenishment triggers, reorder points, safety stock levels and policy parameters (calculation method, service level target, demand variability factor), weeks-of-supply targets, plan status, and MOQ enforcement rules (minimum order quantity, order multiples, minimum order value). SSOT for automated replenishment decisions including buffer stock governance and supplier ordering constraints.

attributes.name: replenishment_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each replenishment plan record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the replenishment_plan data product.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179 - Data Element Naming and Definition

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Reference to the demand forecast plan from Blue Yonder Demand Planning that drove the generation of this replenishment plan. Enables traceability from replenishment decision back to the underlying demand signal.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Demand Plan Reference

attributes.name: inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply chain node (store, Distribution Center (DC), or Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC)) for which this replenishment plan is generated. Identifies the destination receiving location in the replenishment network.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Network Node; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: planner_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Replenishment planners own plans for planning accountability and forecast accuracy tracking. Supply chain tracks planner performance on service levels, inventory turns, and forecast bias for performan

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which this replenishment plan is generated. The SKU is the primary product-level identifier used in replenishment planning across stores, DCs, and MFCs.
attributes.references: GS1 - Global Product Identification Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary supplier responsible for fulfilling this replenishment plan. Links to the supplier master for MOQ enforcement, lead time, and EDI ordering constraints.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Vendor Master; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: approved_order_qty
attributes.description: The final order quantity approved by the buyer or auto-approved by the system after MOQ, order multiple, and buyer override adjustments. This is the quantity that will be transmitted to the supplier via EDI or purchase order.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Purchase Order Quantity; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: buyer_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a buyer has manually overridden the system-generated planned order quantity or parameters. True = buyer override applied; False = system-generated values accepted as-is. Supports audit trail for manual interventions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Buyer Override; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this replenishment plan record was first persisted in the Silver layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 - Information Security Management; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the planned order value and unit cost are expressed (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency retail operations.

attributes.name: current_on_hand_qty
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU physically on hand at the supply node at the time the replenishment plan was generated. Sourced from Manhattan Associates WMS or SAP S/4HANA WM. Used as the starting inventory position for plan calculations.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - On-Hand Inventory; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: demand_variability_factor
attributes.description: A statistical measure of demand variability (coefficient of variation or standard deviation of demand) used by the planning engine to size safety stock. Higher values indicate more volatile demand and result in larger safety stock buffers.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Demand Variability Parameter

attributes.name: fill_rate_target_pct
attributes.description: The target order fill rate percentage (Fill Rate) for this replenishment plan, representing the percentage of demand that should be fulfilled from available inventory. Used as a supply chain performance KPI (KPI) target for this SKU-node combination.
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain KPI Standards; Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Fill Rate Target

attributes.name: forecasted_demand_qty
attributes.description: The total forecasted demand quantity for the SKU at the supply node over the plan horizon, as generated by Blue Yonder Demand Planning. The primary input to the planned order quantity calculation.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Demand Forecast; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days from purchase order placement to expected receipt at the supply node, as defined in the supplier contract or purchasing info record. Used to calculate reorder points and plan order release dates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Purchasing Info Record Lead Time; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: min_order_value
attributes.description: The minimum monetary value of a purchase order required by the supplier, expressed in the operating currency. Replenishment plans that do not meet the minimum order value threshold are consolidated or flagged for buyer action.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Purchasing Info Record; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: The minimum number of units that must be ordered from the supplier per purchase order line, as enforced by supplier contract terms. Replenishment plans with planned_order_qty below MOQ are rounded up or flagged for buyer review.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Purchasing Info Record MOQ; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: moq_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the planned order quantity meets or exceeds the supplier's Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) constraint. True = compliant; False = below MOQ threshold and requires buyer review or order consolidation before release.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MOQ Validation; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: node_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of supply chain node receiving the replenishment. Values: store (retail store), dc (Distribution Center), mfc (Micro-Fulfillment Center), dark_store (fulfillment-only location). Drives replenishment logic and lead time parameters.
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain Standards; Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Node Classification

attributes.name: on_order_qty
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU already on open purchase orders or in-transit to the supply node at the time of plan generation. Included in the net inventory position calculation to avoid over-ordering.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Open Purchase Order Quantity; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: order_multiple
attributes.description: The unit increment in which the SKU must be ordered (e.g., case pack size, pallet quantity). Planned order quantities are rounded up to the nearest order multiple before purchase order generation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Purchasing Info Record; GS1 - Packaging Hierarchy Standards

attributes.name: order_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which the replenishment plan is scheduled to be released as a purchase order to the supplier. Calculated by subtracting lead time from the planned receipt date. Drives the purchasing execution calendar.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MRP Order Release Date; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why a buyer manually overrode the system-generated replenishment plan. Populated only when buyer_override_flag is True. Supports root cause analysis of planning accuracy and buyer behavior patterns.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Override Reason; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: plan_generation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the replenishment plan was generated by the planning engine (Blue Yonder or equivalent). Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Used for plan freshness assessment and demand signal alignment.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Plan Run Timestamp

attributes.name: plan_horizon_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the planning horizon covered by this replenishment plan. Defines the end of the demand forecast window. Together with plan_horizon_start_date, bounds the coverage period for this plan.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Planning Horizon; SAP S/4HANA MM - Planning Period

attributes.name: plan_horizon_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the planning horizon covered by this replenishment plan. Defines the beginning of the demand forecast window used to generate the planned order quantity.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Planning Horizon; SAP S/4HANA MM - Planning Period

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the replenishment plan, generated by Blue Yonder Demand Planning or SAP S/4HANA MM module. Used for cross-system traceability and supplier communication.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Replenishment Order Reference; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the replenishment plan within the planning and execution workflow. Drives automated ordering triggers and buyer review queues. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|proposed|approved|released|in_progress|completed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Plan Status Lifecycle; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the origin and nature of the replenishment plan. Automated plans are system-generated by Blue Yonder; manual plans are buyer-created; override plans supersede automated recommendations; emergency plans address urgent stockout risk.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Plan Type Classification; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: planned_order_qty
attributes.description: The quantity of units recommended by the planning engine to be ordered for this SKU at the specified supply node. Subject to MOQ and order multiple enforcement before release to purchasing.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Planned Order Quantity; SAP S/4HANA MM - MRP Planned Order

attributes.name: planned_order_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the planned replenishment order, calculated as planned_order_qty multiplied by unit_cost. Used for Open-to-Buy (OTB) budget management and financial planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) - Open to Buy; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: planned_receipt_date
attributes.description: The expected date on which the replenishment order is planned to be received at the supply node, calculated as the order release date plus supplier lead time. Used for inventory projection and DC scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MRP Planned Receipt Date; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: promotion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this replenishment plan was generated or adjusted to support a planned promotional event. True = promotion-driven uplift included in forecasted demand; False = baseline replenishment. Links to promotional demand lift in Blue Yonder.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Promotional Demand; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The inventory level (in units) at the supply node at which a replenishment order is triggered. Calculated as safety stock plus expected demand during supplier lead time. Core parameter for reorder-point-based replenishment policies.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Reorder Point Calculation; SAP S/4HANA MM - MRP Parameters

attributes.name: replenishment_method
attributes.description: The replenishment policy calculation method applied to generate this plan. Min/Max triggers orders when inventory falls below minimum; Reorder Point (ROP) uses statistical triggers; Days of Supply targets coverage duration; Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) delegates to supplier; Cross-Docking bypasses storage; Direct Store Delivery (DSD) is supplier-direct. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: min_max|reorder_point|days_of_supply|vendor_managed|cross_dock|dsd — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Replenishment Policy; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: safety_stock_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the safety stock quantity. Fixed uses a static buffer; Statistical uses demand variability and lead time variance; Days of Supply targets a coverage duration; Service Level Based derives buffer from the target service level percentage.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Safety Stock Policy; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: safety_stock_qty
attributes.description: The buffer stock quantity maintained at the supply node to protect against demand variability and supply uncertainty. Represents the minimum inventory floor below which replenishment is urgently triggered. Also referred to as buffer stock.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Safety Stock; SAP S/4HANA MM - Safety Stock Level

attributes.name: service_level_target_pct
attributes.description: The target in-stock service level percentage used to calculate safety stock and replenishment parameters. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00 = 95%). Represents the probability of not experiencing a stockout during the replenishment lead time.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Service Level Target; NRF Supply Chain KPI Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that generated or last updated this replenishment plan. Supports data lineage and Silver layer provenance tracking. Values: blue_yonder (Blue Yonder Demand Planning), sap_s4hana (SAP S/4HANA MM), orms (Oracle Retail Merchandising System), manual (buyer-created).
attributes.references: Informatica MDM - Source System Lineage; ISO 27001 - Data Provenance

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.business_glossary_term: Unit Cost (Cost of Goods Sold - COGS)
attributes.description: The per-unit cost of the SKU from the supplier at the time of plan generation, used to calculate the total planned order value and support COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Purchasing Info Record Price; FASB ASC 606 - Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this replenishment plan record was last modified in the Silver layer lakehouse. Tracks buyer overrides, status transitions, and plan revisions.

attributes.name: weeks_of_supply_target
attributes.description: The target number of weeks of inventory coverage (Weeks of Supply / WOS) that the replenishment plan aims to achieve at the supply node after order receipt. Used as a planning horizon parameter for days-of-supply replenishment methods.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Weeks of Supply Target; NRF Supply Chain KPI Standards

products.name: demand_forecast
products.description: SKU-level demand forecast records generated by Blue Yonder Demand Planning. Captures forecasted units, revenue, forecast horizon, statistical model used, override flags, forecast accuracy (MAPE/WMAPE), and demand signals including seasonality, promotions lift, and trend adjustments. Drives replenishment and OTB planning.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each SKU-level demand forecast record generated by Blue Yonder Demand Planning. Serves as the primary key for this table.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store, distribution center (DC), or fulfillment node for which the demand forecast applies. Supports store-level and DC-level replenishment planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) — Location Management

attributes.name: planner_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Demand planners own forecasts for planning accountability and accuracy tracking. Supply chain tracks planner MAPE, bias, and forecast quality by planner for performance management, S&OP reviews, and p

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) for which the demand forecast is generated. The SKU is the atomic unit of inventory and demand planning in retail.
attributes.references: GS1 — Global Product Classification; Informatica MDM — Product Golden Record

attributes.name: baseline_forecast_units
attributes.description: The pure statistical baseline demand forecast in units before any adjustments for promotions, seasonality, or manual overrides. Provides the unadjusted demand signal for comparison against the final consensus forecast.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Baseline Demand Signal

attributes.name: confidence_level_pct
attributes.description: The statistical confidence level (expressed as a percentage, e.g., 95.00) associated with the forecast interval. Indicates the probability that actual demand will fall within the forecast range. Used to set safety stock levels and replenishment buffers.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Probabilistic Forecasting; NRF — Inventory Optimization Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this demand forecast record was first written to the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit trails, and incremental load processing.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Security Management; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the forecasted revenue amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency retail operations across international markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; FASB — Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that provided the demand signal inputs used to generate this forecast (e.g., SAP_CAR for POS transaction data, Salesforce_Commerce_Cloud for e-commerce demand, ORMS for inventory positions). Supports data lineage and source system auditability.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR); Informatica MDM — Data Lineage; ISO 27001 — Information Security

attributes.name: demand_category
attributes.description: Classification of the SKU's demand pattern used to select the appropriate forecasting model. 'regular' indicates stable, predictable demand; 'intermittent' indicates sporadic demand (Croston model); 'lumpy' indicates irregular high-volume spikes; 'new_item' indicates insufficient history; 'end_of_life' indicates declining/discontinuing SKU.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Demand Classification; NRF — Assortment Planning Standards

attributes.name: forecast_bias
attributes.description: The systematic directional error in the forecast, calculated as the mean of (forecasted units minus actual units) over a rolling period. Positive values indicate over-forecasting (excess inventory risk); negative values indicate under-forecasting (stockout risk). Critical for replenishment safety stock calibration.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Bias Analysis; NRF — Inventory Planning Standards

attributes.name: forecast_generation_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when this forecast record was generated by the Blue Yonder Demand Planning engine. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the forecast lifecycle and supports version comparison across planning cycles.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Run Audit

attributes.name: forecast_horizon_weeks
attributes.description: The total number of weeks into the future covered by this forecast run, measured from the forecast generation date. Determines the planning horizon for replenishment, Open-to-Buy (OTB), and supply chain optimization.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Horizon Configuration; NRF — Supply Chain Planning Standards

attributes.name: forecast_lower_bound_units
attributes.description: The lower bound of the forecast confidence interval in units at the specified confidence level. Represents the low-demand scenario used for minimum order quantity (MOQ) planning and markdown risk assessment.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Probabilistic Forecast Intervals

attributes.name: forecast_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the forecast horizon period covered by this record. Together with forecast_period_start_date, defines the time bucket granularity (daily, weekly, monthly).
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Horizon Configuration

attributes.name: forecast_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the forecast horizon period covered by this record. Defines the beginning of the time bucket (day, week, or month) for which demand is forecasted.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Horizon Configuration

attributes.name: forecast_run_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific Blue Yonder Demand Planning batch run that generated this forecast record. Enables traceability back to the originating planning cycle and supports audit of forecast lineage.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Run Management

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the demand forecast record. 'draft' indicates a preliminary run; 'published' indicates the forecast is active for replenishment; 'approved' indicates planner sign-off; 'overridden' indicates a manual adjustment was applied; 'superseded' indicates a newer run has replaced this record; 'archived' indicates the record is retained for historical analysis only.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Workflow; NRF — Demand Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: forecast_type
attributes.description: Classification of the demand forecast by its planning purpose. 'baseline' is the statistical base demand without uplift; 'promotional' incorporates promotion lift; 'seasonal' reflects seasonal index adjustments; 'event_driven' accounts for specific demand events; 'consensus' is the final agreed forecast used for replenishment and Open-to-Buy (OTB) planning.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Type Configuration; NRF — Demand Planning Standards

attributes.name: forecast_upper_bound_units
attributes.description: The upper bound of the forecast confidence interval in units at the specified confidence level. Represents the high-demand scenario used for safety stock and maximum inventory planning to prevent stockouts.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Probabilistic Forecast Intervals

attributes.name: forecast_version
attributes.description: An incrementing integer version number for the forecast record for a given SKU-location-period combination. Enables tracking of forecast revisions across planning cycles and supports comparison of forecast evolution over time.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Versioning; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: forecasted_revenue
attributes.description: The projected revenue in the operating currency derived from the forecasted units multiplied by the expected selling price for the forecast period. Used in financial planning, Open-to-Buy (OTB) budgeting, and Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Financial Forecast Output

attributes.name: forecasted_units
attributes.description: The statistical model's predicted demand quantity in sellable units for the SKU at the specified location during the forecast period. This is the primary quantitative output of the demand planning engine and drives replenishment order quantities.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Demand Signal Output; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) — Replenishment Planning

attributes.name: is_latest_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this forecast record is the most current version for the given SKU-location-period combination. True means this record is the active forecast used for replenishment and OTB planning; False means it has been superseded by a newer forecast run.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Version Management; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: is_new_item
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is a new item with insufficient sales history for statistical forecasting. When True, the forecast relies on analogous item modeling or planner input rather than historical demand patterns. Relevant for new product launches and assortment introductions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) — New Item Setup; Blue Yonder Demand Planning — New Item Forecasting

attributes.name: is_override_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a demand planner has manually overridden the statistical forecast for this record. True means the final forecasted_units reflect a planner adjustment; False means the forecast is purely statistical. Critical for measuring forecast bias introduced by manual intervention.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Planner Override Workflow; NRF — Demand Planning Governance

attributes.name: is_promotional_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether the forecast period overlaps with an active promotional event. When True, the promotional_lift_units field is expected to be populated and the forecast incorporates promotion-driven demand uplift.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) — Promotion Calendar; Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Promotion Integration

attributes.name: mape
attributes.description: Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) measuring the accuracy of the statistical forecast against actual sales for the equivalent prior period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.12 = 12% error). Lower values indicate higher forecast accuracy. Used as the primary KPI for demand planning performance.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Accuracy Metrics; NRF — Supply Chain KPI Standards

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the statistical forecasting model used to generate this forecast record. Supports model governance, reproducibility, and performance tracking across model upgrades in Blue Yonder Demand Planning.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Model Versioning; ISO 9001 — Quality Management

attributes.name: otb_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this forecast record has been incorporated into the Open-to-Buy (OTB) financial plan. When True, the forecasted revenue and units are reflected in the merchandise financial plan and buying budget for the relevant period.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) — Open-to-Buy Planning; NRF — Merchandise Financial Planning Standards

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: A standardized code indicating the business reason for the planner's manual override of the statistical forecast (e.g., new product launch, competitor action, supply constraint, market intelligence). Populated only when is_override_applied is True. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NEW_PRODUCT|COMPETITOR_ACTION|SUPPLY_CONSTRAINT|MARKET_INTEL|PROMO_CHANGE|STORE_EVENT|WEATHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Override Reason Taxonomy; NRF — Demand Planning Standards

attributes.name: override_units
attributes.description: The manually adjusted demand quantity in units entered by a demand planner to replace or supplement the statistical forecast. Populated only when is_override_applied is True. Enables analysis of planner override magnitude and its impact on forecast accuracy.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Planner Override; NRF — Demand Planning Governance

attributes.name: planning_channel
attributes.description: The retail fulfillment channel for which this demand forecast is generated. 'store' covers brick-and-mortar POS demand; 'ecommerce' covers digital commerce demand from Salesforce Commerce Cloud; 'omnichannel' covers unified demand signals; 'dc_replenishment' covers distribution center stock replenishment; 'bopis' covers Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) demand.
attributes.references: SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) — Unified Demand Signals; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Digital Demand; NRF — Omnichannel Standards

attributes.name: promotional_lift_units
attributes.description: The incremental demand units attributed to active promotions during the forecast period. Derived from promotion event modeling in Blue Yonder and used to isolate the promotional demand signal from baseline demand for Pricing and Promotions Management analysis.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Promotion Lift Modeling; Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM)

attributes.name: replenishment_recommendation_units
attributes.description: The system-recommended replenishment order quantity in units derived from the demand forecast, current inventory position, safety stock targets, and lead time. Feeds directly into Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) purchase order generation and Open-to-Buy (OTB) planning.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Replenishment Optimization; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) — Purchase Order Management

attributes.name: seasonality_index
attributes.description: A multiplicative seasonal index applied to the baseline forecast to account for recurring seasonal demand patterns (e.g., holiday peaks, back-to-school). A value of 1.0 indicates no seasonal adjustment; values above 1.0 indicate above-average seasonal demand.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Seasonal Decomposition; NRF — Seasonal Planning Standards

attributes.name: statistical_model_code
