attributes.description: The identifier or code of the statistical forecasting algorithm used by Blue Yonder Demand Planning to generate this forecast (e.g., ARIMA, Holt-Winters exponential smoothing, Croston for intermittent demand, machine learning ensemble). Enables model performance benchmarking and algorithm governance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ARIMA|HOLT_WINTERS|CROSTON|ETS|MOVING_AVG|ML_ENSEMBLE|CAUSAL — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Model Library; NRF — Demand Forecasting Best Practices

attributes.name: time_bucket_granularity
attributes.description: The temporal granularity of the forecast period covered by this record. 'daily' is used for short-horizon replenishment; 'weekly' is the standard planning cadence; 'monthly' is used for financial and Open-to-Buy (OTB) planning.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Planning Calendar Configuration

attributes.name: trend_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: A multiplicative factor representing the long-term demand trend applied to the forecast. Values above 1.0 indicate upward trend; values below 1.0 indicate declining demand trend. Used to capture secular demand shifts beyond seasonal patterns.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Trend Component; NRF — Demand Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this demand forecast record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse, including override applications, accuracy recalculations, or status changes.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Security Management; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: weeks_of_supply
attributes.description: Weeks of Supply (WOS) — the projected number of weeks the current on-hand inventory will cover demand based on the forecasted units. A key inventory health metric used in replenishment planning to identify stockout risk and excess inventory positions.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Replenishment Planning; NRF — Inventory Management KPIs

attributes.name: wmape
attributes.description: Weighted Mean Absolute Percentage Error (WMAPE) measuring forecast accuracy weighted by sales volume, reducing the distortion caused by low-volume SKUs. Expressed as a decimal. Preferred accuracy metric for high-volume retail assortments where MAPE can be misleading.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning — Forecast Accuracy Metrics; NRF — Supply Chain KPI Standards

products.name: purchase_order
products.description: Purchase order header records representing procurement commitments to suppliers, managed in SAP MM or Oracle RMS. Captures PO number, supplier reference, buyer, order and expected delivery dates, total value, currency, payment terms, incoterms, PO type (standard, blanket, DSD), approval status, and EDI transmission status. SSOT for the PO lifecycle from creation through closure.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Primary key for purchase_order

attributes.name: blanket_po_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent blanket or framework purchase order from which this release or call-off order was created. Null for standalone standard POs. Enables tracking of spend against blanket agreement limits.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (Outline Agreement); Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: buyer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal buyer or purchasing agent responsible for creating and managing this purchase order. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.EKGRP (purchasing group) owner.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.EKGRP); Workday HCM

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution center or store location designated as the delivery destination for this purchase order. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.WERKS (plant/site).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.WERKS); Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: receiving_coordinator_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: DC receiving coordinators manage PO receipts for operational ownership and accountability. Operations tracks receipt accuracy, cycle time, and discrepancy resolution by coordinator for performance man

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier (vendor) fulfilling this purchase order. Links to the supplier master data product managed in Informatica MDM. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.LIFNR (vendor account number).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.LIFNR); Informatica MDM

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which goods were physically received at the destination facility. Populated upon goods receipt posting in SAP (MIGO transaction). Used to calculate supplier on-time delivery performance and lead time actuals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (MKPF.BUDAT); Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Supplier Compliance Standards

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Authorization workflow status indicating whether the purchase order has been approved by the required approvers per the company's procurement authorization matrix. Distinct from po_status as it tracks the internal approval gate specifically.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (Release Strategy); FASB ASC 606; Internal Procurement Policy

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the purchase order received final authorization approval. Captures the precise moment the procurement commitment became binding. Used for approval cycle time analytics and compliance auditing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (Release Strategy); FASB ASC 606; Internal Procurement Policy

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date by which the purchase order must be cancelled if goods have not shipped. Also known as the cancel date or cancel-by date in retail procurement. Null if the PO has not been cancelled or does not have a cancellation deadline.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Retail Procurement Standards

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity or business unit issuing the purchase order. Used for financial reporting, P&L allocation, and intercompany reconciliation. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.BUKRS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module (EKKO.BUKRS); FASB ASC 606; EBITDA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by the supplier after PO acknowledgment. May differ from expected_delivery_date if the supplier cannot meet the original requested date. Used to update replenishment plans and manage weeks of supply (WOS).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; GS1 EDI 855 PO Acknowledgment Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the purchase order record was first created in the source system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.AEDAT (creation date) combined with time.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this purchase order (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD). Corresponds to SAP EKKO.WAERS (currency key).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.WAERS); GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount or allowance amount applied to the purchase order by the supplier, including volume discounts, promotional allowances, and trade deals. Reduces the net payable amount. Expressed in the currency specified by currency_code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: edi_transmission_status
attributes.description: Status of the EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) transmission of this purchase order to the supplier. Not Sent = EDI not applicable or not yet initiated; Pending = queued for transmission; Transmitted = EDI 850 PO sent to supplier; Acknowledged = supplier returned EDI 855 acknowledgment; Failed = transmission error; Rejected = supplier rejected the PO via EDI.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 850/855 Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM EDI Module; NRF EDI Standards

attributes.name: edi_transmitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the purchase order was transmitted to the supplier via EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) as an EDI 850 transaction set. Null if EDI transmission has not occurred. Used for supplier communication SLA tracking.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 850 Standard; SAP S/4HANA MM EDI Module; NRF EDI Standards

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the purchase order amounts from the supplier's transaction currency to the company's functional currency at the time of PO creation. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.WKURS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module (EKKO.WKURS); FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: expected_delivery_date
attributes.description: The agreed-upon date by which the supplier is expected to deliver the ordered goods to the designated distribution center or store. Used for supply chain planning, replenishment scheduling, and SLA monitoring. Corresponds to SAP EKET.EINDT (scheduled delivery date).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKET.EINDT); Blue Yonder Demand Planning; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: fill_rate_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of ordered units that have been received and fulfilled by the supplier, calculated as (total_received_units / total_ordered_units) * 100. Fill Rate is a key supplier performance KPI measuring order completion. Stored as a pre-computed operational field updated upon each goods receipt.
attributes.references: NRF Supplier Performance Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the responsibilities of buyer and seller for delivery, risk transfer, and cost allocation (e.g., FOB = Free On Board, DDP = Delivered Duty Paid, CIF = Cost Insurance Freight). Corresponds to SAP EKKO.INCO1. Critical for import/export compliance and logistics cost allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.INCO1); GS1 EDI Standards; FTC Import Regulations

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: The named place or port associated with the Incoterms code, specifying the exact location where risk and cost transfer between buyer and seller (e.g., 'Port of Los Angeles' for FOB). Corresponds to SAP EKKO.INCO2.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.INCO2); GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: is_cross_dock
attributes.description: Indicates whether this purchase order is designated for cross-docking at the distribution center, meaning goods will be transferred directly from inbound to outbound without putaway storage. Cross-docking reduces DC handling costs and accelerates store replenishment.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Distribution Center Standards; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: is_drop_ship
attributes.description: Indicates whether this purchase order is a drop ship arrangement where the supplier ships goods directly to the end customer, bypassing the retailer's distribution center. Drop ship POs are common in e-commerce and extended aisle assortments.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF E-Commerce Standards

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the purchase order record was most recently modified in the source system. Used for incremental data loading, change data capture, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The agreed or expected number of days from purchase order placement to goods receipt at the destination facility. Used in replenishment planning, weeks of supply (WOS) calculations, and Blue Yonder demand planning models. Corresponds to supplier lead time in the procurement master data.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: merchandise_category_code
attributes.description: The merchandise category or department code associated with the primary goods on this purchase order, aligned with the retailer's category management hierarchy. Used for spend analytics by category, OTB (Open to Buy) tracking, and GMROI reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Category Management Standards; GS1 Product Classification

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity the supplier requires for this purchase order, as defined in the supplier agreement or item master. MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) constraints drive order sizing decisions in replenishment planning and OTB management.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA MM Module; NRF Procurement Standards

attributes.name: net_payable_amount
attributes.description: The net amount payable to the supplier after applying all discounts, allowances, and adjustments to the gross total order amount. This is the financial commitment recorded in accounts payable. Expressed in the currency specified by currency_code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; FASB ASC 606; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for buyer notes, special instructions, or remarks associated with the purchase order. May include delivery instructions, quality requirements, or supplier-specific handling notes. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.IHREZ (your reference) or header text.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the purchase order was officially created and issued. This is the principal real-world event date for the procurement commitment. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.BEDAT (document date).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.BEDAT); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the agreed payment terms between the retailer and supplier (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30 for 2% discount if paid within 10 days). Corresponds to SAP EKKO.ZTERM (terms of payment key). Drives accounts payable scheduling and early payment discount capture.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module (EKKO.ZTERM); Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable purchase order number assigned by the procurement system (SAP MM or Oracle RMS). Used in EDI transmissions, supplier communications, and receiving workflows. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.EBELN field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.EBELN); GS1 EDI Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: po_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the purchase order from creation through closure. Draft = created but not submitted; Pending Approval = awaiting authorization; Approved = authorized for transmission; Sent = transmitted to supplier via EDI or portal; Partially Received = some goods received; Received = all goods received; Closed = fully processed and closed; Cancelled = voided. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|sent|partially_received|received|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: po_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase order by procurement method. Standard = regular replenishment PO; Blanket = open-quantity framework agreement; DSD (Direct Store Delivery) = supplier delivers directly to store; Drop Ship = vendor ships direct to customer; Consignment = inventory owned by supplier until sold; RTV (Return to Vendor) = merchandise returned to supplier. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|blanket|direct_store_delivery|drop_ship|consignment|return_to_vendor — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.BSART); Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Industry Standards

attributes.name: purchasing_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the buyer group or commodity team responsible for this purchase order within the purchasing organization. Used for spend analytics by category and buyer performance reporting. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.EKGRP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.EKGRP); Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: purchasing_org_code
attributes.description: SAP purchasing organization code representing the organizational unit responsible for procuring goods and services. Defines the legal entity and negotiation authority for the purchase order. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.EKORG.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (EKKO.EKORG); Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this purchase order record originated. SAP_MM = SAP S/4HANA Materials Management; ORMS = Oracle Retail Merchandising System; MANUAL = manually entered; EDI = created via EDI inbound processing. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM; ISO 27001 Data Lineage; NRF Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: supplier_po_reference
attributes.description: The supplier's own reference number or acknowledgment number for this purchase order, returned via EDI 855 or supplier portal. Used for cross-referencing in supplier invoices, ASNs (Advance Ship Notices), and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 855 PO Acknowledgment Standard; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: total_order_amount
attributes.description: The gross total monetary value of the purchase order before any adjustments, representing the sum of all line item values. Expressed in the currency specified by currency_code. Used for open-to-buy (OTB) tracking, financial commitments, and accounts payable accruals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; FASB ASC 606; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: total_ordered_units
attributes.description: The total quantity of units ordered across all line items on this purchase order. Used for fill rate calculation, receiving reconciliation, and inventory planning. Expressed in the base unit of measure.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: total_received_units
attributes.description: The total quantity of units physically received and goods-receipted against this purchase order to date. Used to calculate fill rate (order completion percentage) and identify short shipments or over-deliveries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (MIGO); Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Supply Chain Standards

products.name: po_line
products.description: Line-item detail for each purchase order. Captures SKU/GTIN, ordered quantity, unit of measure, unit cost, extended cost, confirmed quantity, shipped quantity, received quantity, line status, MOQ compliance flag, and lead-time commitment. Enables granular PO tracking at the SKU level.

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each purchase order line item in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the po_line data product.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: buyer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise buyer or procurement officer responsible for this PO line. Supports buyer performance reporting, OTB management, and approval workflow tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Workday HCM

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific destination location (DC, store, or fulfillment center) where this PO line is to be delivered. Supports multi-destination PO management and DC-to-store allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/WM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise department or category to which this PO line's SKU belongs. Supports departmental OTB tracking, assortment planning, and financial reporting by merchandise hierarchy.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master product record for the item being ordered on this PO line. Links to the product master for full item attributes. [RESOURCE_REFERENCE — TRANSACTION_LINE canonical category]
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; Informatica MDM; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: supply_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent purchase order header to which this line item belongs. Establishes the header-to-line relationship for PO lifecycle tracking. [HEADER_REFERENCE — TRANSACTION_LINE canonical category]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier (vendor) fulfilling this PO line. Enables supplier performance analysis at the line level, including fill rate and lead time compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which goods for this PO line were physically received at the destination. Used to calculate on-time delivery performance and actual lead time versus committed lead time.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/WM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: allowance_amount
attributes.description: Supplier-granted trade allowance or promotional funding amount applied to this PO line (e.g., off-invoice allowance, scan allowance). Reduces net cost and impacts COGS and GMROI calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; FASB ASC 606; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Supplier-provided Advance Shipment Notice (ASN) number associated with the shipment of this PO line. Enables pre-receipt processing at the DC and cross-referencing with EDI 856 transactions.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards (EDI 856); SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: cancel_date
attributes.description: The latest date by which this PO line must be received; if not received by this date, the line is automatically cancelled. Critical for seasonal and fashion merchandise to prevent late deliveries.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA MM Module; NRF Retail Standards

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by the supplier for this PO line. May differ from the requested delivery date; variance drives lead time compliance KPIs and supplier scorecards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: confirmed_qty
attributes.description: Quantity confirmed by the supplier as available and committed for shipment on this PO line. May differ from ordered quantity due to supplier capacity constraints or MOQ adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the product on this PO line was manufactured or produced. Required for customs declarations, import compliance, and consumer labeling regulations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; U.S. Customs and Border Protection; FTC Made in USA Standards; CPSC Product Safety

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PO line record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for PO creation and supports data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ISO 27001 Information Security

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the unit cost and extended cost on this PO line (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency supplier contracts and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: destination_type
attributes.description: Type of destination for this PO line shipment. Indicates whether goods are routed to a Distribution Center (DC), direct to store (DSD), cross-docking facility, drop ship to customer, or Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/WM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: extended_cost
attributes.description: Total cost for this PO line calculated as ordered_qty multiplied by unit_cost. Represents the gross financial commitment for this line item before any allowances or discounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; FASB ASC 606; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1-standard Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) for the product on this PO line. Supports EDI transactions, supplier collaboration, and cross-retailer product identification. May be a GTIN-8, GTIN-12 (UPC), GTIN-13 (EAN), or GTIN-14.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; FTC Pricing Transparency Standards

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: ICC Incoterms code defining the delivery terms and transfer of risk/cost responsibility between buyer and supplier for this PO line (e.g., FOB, DDP, CIF). Critical for landed cost calculation and logistics planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA MM Module; U.S. Customs and Border Protection

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Supplier invoice number associated with this PO line for three-way match processing (PO, receipt, invoice). Links to accounts payable for payment processing and FASB ASC 606 revenue recognition compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; FASB ASC 606; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this PO line record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change data capture, audit compliance, and Silver Layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ISO 27001 Information Security

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Committed supplier lead time in calendar days from PO placement to expected delivery for this line item. Used for replenishment planning, OTB management, and supplier SLA compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Blue Yonder Demand Planning; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the parent purchase order, used to uniquely identify and order line items within a PO. Corresponds to SAP MM item number (EBELP). [LINE_SEQUENCE — TRANSACTION_LINE canonical category]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of this PO line item, tracking progression from open through fulfillment or cancellation. Drives replenishment alerts and supplier follow-up actions. [LIFECYCLE_STATUS — TRANSACTION_LINE canonical category]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: The supplier's contractual Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) for this SKU on this PO line. Used to validate ordered_qty compliance and negotiate order consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: moq_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ordered quantity on this PO line meets or exceeds the supplier's Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) requirement. Non-compliant lines may incur supplier penalties or require buyer approval.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Supplier Standards

attributes.name: net_cost
attributes.description: Net cost per unit after applying all supplier allowances, discounts, and deductions to the unit cost. Represents the true landed cost basis for COGS and margin calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; FASB ASC 606; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: order_uom_qty
attributes.description: Number of base selling units (eaches) contained within one purchase unit of measure. Enables conversion between purchase UOM and retail selling UOM for inventory and sales reporting (e.g., 12 eaches per case).
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: ordered_qty
attributes.description: Total quantity of the SKU ordered on this PO line, expressed in the purchase unit of measure. Represents the buyer's original demand signal to the supplier. [LINE_QUANTITY — TRANSACTION_LINE canonical category]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: otb_consumed
attributes.description: Dollar value of Open to Buy (OTB) budget consumed by this PO line at the time of order placement. Used for merchandise financial planning and budget compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; NRF Merchandise Planning Standards

attributes.name: received_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU physically received and confirmed at the distribution center or store against this PO line. Drives inventory on-hand updates and three-way match for invoice processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/WM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for any quantity rejected or returned to vendor (RTV) during receiving for this PO line (e.g., damaged goods, wrong item, quality failure). Supports chargeback processing and supplier compliance management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the retailer requests delivery of this PO line at the destination (DC or store). Used for lead time compliance monitoring and replenishment planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: retail_price
attributes.description: Planned retail selling price (AUR - Average Unit Retail) for this SKU at the time of PO creation. Used for initial margin calculation and GMROI planning at the line level.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Pricing Standards

attributes.name: ship_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supplier shipped goods for this PO line, as reported via ASN or EDI 856. Used to calculate in-transit duration and validate supplier shipping compliance.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: shipped_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU that the supplier has physically shipped against this PO line, as reported via ASN (Advance Shipment Notice) or EDI 856. Used to calculate in-transit inventory.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; GS1 EDI Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Internal retailer-assigned Stock Keeping Unit code identifying the specific product variant (size, color, style) ordered on this line. Used for inventory management and POS reconciliation.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; NRF Industry Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Agreed purchase cost per unit of the SKU on this PO line, in the transaction currency. Represents the negotiated supplier price and is the basis for COGS calculation and GMROI analysis. [LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT — TRANSACTION_LINE canonical category]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; FASB ASC 606; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which the ordered, confirmed, shipped, and received quantities are expressed (e.g., EA=Each, CS=Case, PK=Pack, LB=Pound). Aligns with GS1 and SAP MM unit of measure codes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PK|LB|KG|OZ|L|M|FT|DZ — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: vendor_item_number
attributes.description: Supplier's own item number or part number for the product on this PO line. Used in EDI transactions and supplier communications to cross-reference retailer SKU with supplier catalog number.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

products.name: plan
products.description: Aggregated supply plan at the SKU-DC-week level, reconciling demand forecasts with available supply, open POs, in-transit inventory, and supplier capacity constraints. Captures planned receipt quantities, projected on-hand, weeks-of-supply, stockout risk score, excess inventory flags, allocation priorities for constrained supply, and plan version/approval status. Master supply-demand balancing record used by planners in weekly S&OP reviews to identify coverage gaps, trigger replenishment actions, and prioritize allocation across stores and DCs.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Primary key for plan

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Distribution Center (DC) for which this supply plan is generated. Identifies the fulfillment node responsible for receiving, storing, and distributing the planned SKU.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to an active promotion associated with this SKU-DC-week supply plan. Promotional events drive demand uplift adjustments to the consensus demand quantity and may require incremental supply planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); NRF Promotions Management Best Practices

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the open Purchase Order (PO) associated with this supply plan record. Links the plan to the procurement execution layer for tracking open PO quantities and expected receipt dates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) being planned. The SKU is the lowest-level product identifier used for inventory tracking and replenishment planning.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Product Classification; NRF MDM Standards

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary supplier responsible for fulfilling the planned receipt quantities for this SKU-DC combination. Used to evaluate supplier capacity constraints during supply-demand balancing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; EDI Standards

attributes.name: allocation_priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank (1 = highest priority) assigned to this DC for allocation of constrained supply for the SKU. Used by planners to prioritize distribution of limited inventory across DCs and stores during supply-constrained periods.
attributes.references: NRF Allocation and Replenishment Best Practices; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status of the supply plan record within the S&OP governance process. Pending plans await planner or manager sign-off; approved plans are authorized for execution; rejected plans require revision; escalated plans require senior leadership review.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the supply plan record was approved in the S&OP workflow. Provides a precise audit trail for plan authorization and supports compliance with internal governance controls.
attributes.references: NRF S&OP Governance Best Practices; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the supply chain planner or manager who approved this supply plan record in the S&OP workflow. Provides audit trail for plan authorization decisions.
attributes.references: NRF S&OP Governance Best Practices; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: beginning_on_hand_qty
attributes.description: Projected on-hand inventory quantity for the SKU at the DC at the start of the planning week, before any receipts or demand consumption. Used as the opening inventory position for supply-demand balancing calculations.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: consensus_demand_qty
attributes.description: Agreed demand quantity after S&OP consensus adjustments, incorporating planner overrides, promotional uplifts, and commercial inputs. This is the demand signal used for supply-demand balancing in the approved plan.
attributes.references: NRF S&OP Best Practices; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this supply plan record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for the plan lifecycle and supports data lineage tracking in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8000 Data Quality Standards; ISO 27001 Information Security

attributes.name: crossdock_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU planned for cross-docking at the DC, bypassing put-away storage and flowing directly from inbound receipt to outbound shipment. Supports DC throughput optimization and reduces handling costs for high-velocity items.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Distribution Center Operations Best Practices

attributes.name: demand_forecast_qty
attributes.description: Statistical demand forecast quantity for the SKU at the DC for the planning week, expressed in the SKU's unit of measure. Sourced from Blue Yonder Demand Planning and represents the baseline demand signal before supply constraints are applied.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: excess_inventory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the projected on-hand quantity exceeds the maximum inventory target for the SKU-DC combination in the planning week. When True, signals a potential dead stock or overstock situation requiring markdown or redistribution action.
attributes.references: NRF Inventory Management Best Practices; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: in_transit_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU currently in transit from supplier or another DC, expected to arrive at the destination DC within the planning week. Represents confirmed supply pipeline inventory not yet received.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: max_inventory_qty
attributes.description: Maximum allowable on-hand inventory quantity for the SKU at the DC, representing the upper bound of the inventory target range. Projected on-hand quantities exceeding this threshold trigger the excess inventory flag.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: min_order_qty
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) required by the supplier for this SKU, representing the smallest quantity that can be ordered in a single purchase order. Constrains replenishment order quantities in the supply plan.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: open_po_qty
attributes.description: Quantity on open, unfulfilled Purchase Orders (POs) for this SKU-DC combination expected to be received within the planning week. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM and ORMS to represent committed supply.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Business-facing externally-known identifier for the supply plan record, used in S&OP communications, planner workflows, and cross-system references. Typically formatted as a combination of DC code, SKU, and planning week.
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain Planning Best Practices; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supply plan record within the S&OP approval workflow. Draft plans are under construction; submitted plans await approval; approved plans are baselined for execution; locked plans are frozen for the current cycle.
attributes.references: NRF S&OP Best Practices; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supply plan by planning methodology. Consensus plans reflect agreed S&OP output; unconstrained plans reflect pure demand signal; constrained plans incorporate supplier and DC capacity limits; allocation plans reflect prioritized distribution of limited supply.
attributes.references: NRF S&OP Best Practices; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: planned_receipt_qty
attributes.description: Total quantity of the SKU planned to be received at the DC during the planning week from all supply sources (open POs, in-transit, cross-dock). Core output of the supply planning process used to assess coverage against demand.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: planner_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the supply chain planner to document assumptions, exceptions, override rationale, or action items associated with this supply plan record. Supports S&OP review discussions and audit trail.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_weeks
attributes.description: Number of weeks forward from the plan week start date that this supply plan covers. Defines the rolling planning window used for demand-supply balancing and replenishment trigger decisions.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; NRF Supply Chain Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: projected_on_hand_qty
attributes.description: Projected ending on-hand inventory quantity for the SKU at the DC at the end of the planning week, calculated as beginning on-hand plus planned receipts minus consensus demand. Key metric for identifying coverage gaps and excess inventory.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: promotional_uplift_qty
attributes.description: Incremental demand quantity attributed to a promotional event for this SKU-DC-week, added on top of the baseline statistical forecast to derive the consensus demand quantity. Sourced from the promotions planning system.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM); Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: replenishment_order_qty
attributes.description: Recommended replenishment order quantity for the SKU-DC combination for the planning week, calculated by the planning system to bring projected on-hand to the target inventory level. Serves as the basis for generating new purchase orders.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: safety_stock_qty
attributes.description: Minimum buffer inventory quantity required for the SKU at the DC to protect against demand variability and supply uncertainty. Serves as the replenishment trigger threshold in the supply plan.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; NRF Inventory Management Best Practices

attributes.name: sell_through_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of available inventory for this SKU that has been sold within the planning period, calculated as units sold divided by beginning inventory plus receipts. Used to assess demand velocity and identify slow-moving or dead stock.
attributes.references: NRF Inventory Performance KPIs; SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this supply plan record originated. Enables data lineage tracking and reconciliation between planning systems. Values include BLUE_YONDER (Blue Yonder Demand Planning), SAP_S4 (SAP S/4HANA), ORMS (Oracle Retail Merchandising System), or MANUAL (planner-entered).

attributes.name: stockout_risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk score (0-100) indicating the probability of a stockout event for the SKU at the DC within the planning horizon. Derived from demand variability, supply reliability, and projected on-hand versus safety stock. Used to prioritize replenishment actions.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; NRF Supply Chain Risk Management

attributes.name: supplier_fill_rate_pct
attributes.description: Historical fill rate percentage for this supplier-SKU combination, representing the percentage of ordered quantity actually delivered on time. Used as a supply reliability input to safety stock and risk score calculations.
attributes.references: NRF Supplier Performance Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: supplier_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days from purchase order placement to expected receipt at the DC for this SKU-supplier combination. Used in replenishment planning to determine order timing and assess supply pipeline coverage.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: supply_constrained_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supply plan for this SKU-DC-week is constrained by supplier capacity, lead time, or minimum order quantity (MOQ) limitations. When True, planned receipt quantity is below unconstrained demand, triggering allocation prioritization.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which all quantity fields (demand, receipt, on-hand) are expressed for this SKU in the supply plan. Common values include EA (each), CS (case), PK (pack). Ensures consistent quantity interpretation across planning systems. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PK|LB|KG|OZ|L|M — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this supply plan record was last modified, including planner overrides, system recalculations, or status changes. Supports change tracking and version management in the S&OP process.
attributes.references: ISO 8000 Data Quality Standards; ISO 27001 Information Security

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the supply plan, incremented each time the plan is revised within the same planning cycle. Enables planners to track plan evolution and compare versions during S&OP reviews.
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: week_end_date
attributes.description: The last day (Sunday) of the planning week for which this supply plan record applies. Used in conjunction with plan_week_start_date to define the weekly planning horizon bucket.
attributes.references: NRF Retail Calendar Standards; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: week_start_date
attributes.description: The first day (Monday) of the planning week for which this supply plan record applies. Defines the weekly time bucket used in S&OP reviews and demand-supply balancing at the SKU-DC-week granularity.
attributes.references: NRF Retail Calendar Standards; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: weeks_of_supply
attributes.description: Weeks of Supply (WOS) metric representing the number of weeks the projected on-hand inventory can cover at the current consensus demand rate. A key S&OP KPI used to identify stockout risk and excess inventory positions.
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain KPI Standards; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

products.name: sla_definition
products.description: Defines supply chain SLA commitments between the retailer and suppliers or 3PL partners. Captures SLA type (fill rate, lead time, on-time delivery, EDI compliance), target threshold, measurement frequency, penalty structure, effective date, and owning business unit. Provides the contractual baseline for supply chain performance monitoring.

attributes.name: sla_definition_id
attributes.description: Primary key for sla_definition

attributes.name: superseded_by_sla_sla_definition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply_chain_sla_id of the newer SLA definition that replaces this record when terms are renegotiated. Null if this is the current active version. Enables SLA version chain navigation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control; NRF Supplier Management Standards

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier referencing the supplier, 3PL partner, or logistics carrier that is the counterparty to this SLA. Links to the supplier or partner master record in Informatica MDM.
attributes.references: Informatica MDM Master Data Management; GS1 GLN Standards

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this SLA definition received formal business approval. Distinct from effective_start_date as approval may precede activation. Required for governance and audit trail.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the business authority who formally approved this SLA definition. Typically a Supply Chain Director or VP of Procurement. Required for audit trail and governance compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: auto_penalty_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether penalty assessment is automatically triggered upon SLA breach detection (True) or requires manual approval before issuance (False). Drives automated chargeback processing in SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; NRF Vendor Compliance Standards

attributes.name: channel_scope
attributes.description: The fulfillment channel(s) to which this SLA applies. All covers omnichannel; Store covers brick-and-mortar replenishment; E-Commerce covers digital order fulfillment; BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) and Ship-from-Store (SFS) cover hybrid fulfillment models.
attributes.references: NRF Omnichannel Standards; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: consecutive_breach_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of consecutive measurement periods in which SLA performance may fall below the minimum threshold before triggering contract review or termination proceedings. Used in Blue Yonder performance monitoring workflows.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: The legal contract or purchase agreement number from which this SLA is derived. Links to the master vendor agreement in SAP S/4HANA MM contract management. Confidential as it references binding legal agreements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management; FASB ASC 606; FTC Contract Standards

attributes.name: counterparty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the external party bound by this SLA. Supplier applies to vendor fill rate and lead time SLAs; 3PL Partner applies to third-party logistics SLAs; DC Operator applies to distribution center SLAs; Carrier applies to last-mile delivery SLAs.
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain Standards; GS1 Partner Classification

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SLA definition record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Populated by the ingestion pipeline from SAP S/4HANA or Informatica MDM source system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: dc_scope
attributes.description: Identifies the specific Distribution Center (DC) or network of DCs to which this SLA applies. Null indicates the SLA applies to all DCs. Used in Manhattan Associates WMS for DC-level performance tracking.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; NRF Distribution Standards

attributes.name: edi_transaction_set
attributes.description: For EDI compliance SLAs, specifies the EDI transaction set(s) covered (e.g., '850 Purchase Order', '856 Advance Ship Notice', '810 Invoice'). Null for non-EDI SLA types. Aligns with GS1 EDI standards.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; NRF EDI Compliance Framework

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this SLA definition ceases to be binding. Nullable for open-ended agreements. When populated, triggers SLA expiry workflow in Blue Yonder Demand Planning and SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this SLA definition becomes contractually binding and enforceable between the retailer and the supplier or 3PL partner. Aligns with purchase order or logistics contract activation.

attributes.name: escalation_threshold_value
attributes.description: Performance level at which an SLA breach triggers formal escalation to senior management or executive review, beyond standard penalty processing. Typically set below minimum_threshold_value for critical SLAs.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Corrective Action; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days after an SLA breach is detected before penalty assessment is initiated. Allows counterparty time to remediate without immediate financial consequence. Zero indicates no grace period.
attributes.references: NRF Vendor Compliance Standards; ISO 9001 Corrective Action

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this SLA definition record in the lakehouse silver layer. Updated on any field change including status transitions, threshold amendments, or penalty structure updates. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: lead_time_end_event
attributes.description: For Lead Time SLAs, defines the business event that stops the lead time clock. DC Receipt is standard for supplier SLAs; Store Receipt applies to DSD (Direct Store Delivery); Customer Delivery applies to last-mile SLAs.
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: lead_time_start_event
attributes.description: For Lead Time SLAs, defines the business event that starts the lead time clock. Purchase Order Issued is the standard start; Order Confirmed starts from supplier acknowledgement; Pick Released starts from warehouse pick; Ship Confirmed starts from carrier pickup.
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM; GS1 EDI 856

attributes.name: measurement_frequency
attributes.description: How often SLA performance is measured and evaluated against the target threshold. Per-shipment applies to individual delivery SLAs; Weekly/Monthly apply to aggregate fill rate and EDI compliance SLAs.
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain KPI Framework; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: measurement_window_days
attributes.description: Rolling number of calendar days over which SLA performance is aggregated for evaluation. For example, a 30-day rolling window for monthly fill rate measurement. Works in conjunction with measurement_frequency.
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain KPI Framework; ISO 9001

attributes.name: minimum_threshold_value
attributes.description: The floor performance level below which penalty clauses are automatically triggered. Distinct from target_threshold_value which is the aspirational goal. For example, target fill rate may be 98% while minimum acceptable is 95%.
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain Standards; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the next formal SLA review meeting with the counterparty. Populated based on review_cycle and last review completion. Used to trigger review preparation workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Management Review; NRF Supplier Management Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, exceptions, or negotiation history relevant to this SLA definition. Not used for structured data. Supports procurement team documentation needs.

attributes.name: owning_business_unit
attributes.description: The internal business unit or department responsible for managing and enforcing this SLA, e.g., 'Supply Chain Operations', 'Procurement', 'DC Management', 'E-Commerce Fulfillment'. Used for accountability and escalation routing.
attributes.references: NRF Organizational Standards; SAP S/4HANA Organizational Management

attributes.name: owning_cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO cost center code for the business unit responsible for this SLA. Used for financial allocation of penalty charges and SLA management costs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; FASB Cost Accounting Standards

attributes.name: penalty_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum financial penalty that can be assessed in a single measurement period, regardless of the degree of SLA breach. Expressed in the contract currency. Protects counterparty from unlimited liability. Confidential contract term.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; NRF Vendor Compliance Standards; FTC Consumer Protection

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for penalty amounts defined in this SLA (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures correct financial processing in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO for multi-currency supplier contracts.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: penalty_rate
attributes.description: The rate applied to calculate the financial penalty when SLA performance falls below the minimum threshold. Expressed as a percentage of invoice value for chargeback SLAs or as a fixed rate per unit for volume-based penalties. Confidential contract term.
attributes.references: NRF Vendor Compliance Standards; FASB ASC 606; FTC Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: penalty_structure_type
attributes.description: The mechanism by which penalties are applied when SLA thresholds are breached. Chargeback deducts from supplier invoice; Credit Memo issues a financial credit; Service Credit applies to 3PL contract credits; None indicates no financial penalty.
attributes.references: NRF Vendor Compliance Standards; FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: product_category_scope
attributes.description: The merchandise category or department to which this SLA applies, e.g., 'Grocery', 'Apparel', 'Electronics', 'Household Goods'. Null indicates the SLA applies across all categories for the counterparty. Aligns with Oracle Retail Merchandising System category hierarchy.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS); NRF Merchandise Standards

attributes.name: review_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency at which this SLA definition is formally reviewed and potentially renegotiated with the counterparty. Drives calendar scheduling for supplier business reviews and contract renewal workflows.
attributes.references: NRF Supplier Management Standards; ISO 9001 Management Review

attributes.name: sla_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this SLA definition, used in EDI communications, vendor contracts, and SAP S/4HANA MM module contract references.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management

attributes.name: sla_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the SLA commitment, e.g., 'Supplier Fill Rate SLA Q1 2025' or 'DC On-Time Delivery SLA'. Used in reporting dashboards and contract documentation.

attributes.name: sla_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the SLA definition. Draft indicates under review; Active indicates currently enforced; Suspended indicates temporarily paused; Expired indicates past effective period; Terminated indicates cancelled before expiry.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; FASB ASC 606 Contract Lifecycle

attributes.name: sla_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the SLA commitment. Fill Rate measures order completion percentage; Lead Time measures supplier delivery duration; On-Time Delivery measures punctuality; EDI Compliance measures electronic data interchange adherence; Order Accuracy measures shipment correctness; Return Processing measures RMA turnaround. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fill_rate|lead_time|on_time_delivery|edi_compliance|order_accuracy|return_processing — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; NRF Supply Chain KPI Framework; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: target_threshold_value
attributes.description: The principal quantitative performance target that must be met to satisfy this SLA. For Fill Rate SLAs this is a percentage (e.g., 98.5); for Lead Time SLAs this is a number of days; for EDI Compliance this is a percentage. Interpreted in conjunction with threshold_unit.
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain KPI Framework; ISO 9001

attributes.name: threshold_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the target_threshold_value. Percent applies to fill rate and compliance SLAs; Days or Hours apply to lead time and on-time delivery SLAs; Units or Cases apply to volume-based SLAs.
attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Standards; NRF Supply Chain KPI Framework

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this SLA definition, incremented each time the SLA terms are renegotiated or amended. Version 1 is the original agreement. Enables historical comparison of SLA terms over time.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control; NRF Supplier Management Standards

products.name: sla_performance
products.description: Operational records tracking actual vs. target SLA performance for each supply chain SLA commitment. Captures measurement period, actual and target metric values, variance, breach flag and severity, corrective action status, and resolution tracking. For fill rate SLAs: ordered/shipped/received quantities, fill rate percentage, short-ship reason codes, and chargeback eligibility. SSOT for SLA breach alerting, supplier fill rate compliance monitoring, scorecarding, and chargeback processing.

attributes.name: sla_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each SLA performance measurement record. Primary key for the sla_performance data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: compliance_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Vendor SLA compliance (on-time delivery, fill rate, quality) is tracked under compliance programs. SLA breaches trigger corrective actions, chargebacks, and vendor scorecard impacts requiring complian

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution center or fulfillment facility where this SLA performance is being measured. Supports DC-level SLA reporting.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order associated with this SLA performance record. Applicable for fill rate and on-time delivery SLA measurements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: sla_definition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SLA definition record that specifies the contractual commitment being measured. Links to the master SLA catalog.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier party against whom this SLA performance is being tracked. Supports supplier fill rate compliance monitoring and scorecarding.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: actual_value
attributes.description: The measured actual metric value achieved during the measurement period. For fill rate SLAs this is the actual fill rate percentage achieved. Compared against target_value to determine breach status.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the actual performance value failed to meet the contractual SLA target for this measurement period. True = SLA breach occurred; False = SLA target met or exceeded. Primary trigger for breach alerting workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: breach_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the SLA breach based on the magnitude of variance from target. Critical indicates severe underperformance requiring immediate escalation; none indicates no breach. Used to prioritize corrective action and chargeback processing.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: chargeback_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the vendor compliance chargeback assessed against the supplier for this SLA breach, expressed in the operating currency. Calculated per the contractual chargeback schedule. Applicable only when chargeback_eligible_flag is True.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; NRF Vendor Compliance Standards; FTC Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: chargeback_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLA breach qualifies for a vendor compliance chargeback (Chargeback) under the supplier agreement terms. True = chargeback may be issued; False = breach is not chargeback-eligible (e.g., force majeure, waived). SSOT for chargeback processing workflows.
attributes.references: NRF Vendor Compliance Standards; FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: chargeback_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the vendor compliance chargeback associated with this SLA breach. Pending = not yet issued; issued = chargeback sent to supplier; disputed = supplier has contested; resolved = settled; waived = chargeback forgiven.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; NRF Vendor Compliance Standards

attributes.name: consecutive_breach_count
attributes.description: The number of consecutive measurement periods in which this SLA has been breached by the same supplier, as of this record. Used to identify chronic underperformers and trigger escalation or contract review.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; NRF Vendor Compliance Standards

attributes.name: corrective_action_completed_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the supplier's corrective action plan was confirmed as completed and accepted. Null if corrective action is still in progress or not required.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: The contractually or operationally agreed deadline by which the supplier must submit or complete the corrective action plan for the SLA breach. Used for escalation tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: corrective_action_status
attributes.description: Status of the corrective action plan (CAP) initiated in response to an SLA breach. Not_required = no breach or waived; pending = CAP requested but not started; in_progress = CAP underway; completed = CAP closed; overdue = CAP past due date.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this SLA performance record was first created in the system. Audit trail field supporting data lineage and compliance requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which the SLA performance data was sourced. Supports data lineage, audit, and reconciliation. SAP_S4HANA = SAP S/4HANA Retail; ORMS = Oracle Retail Merchandising System; MANHATTAN_WMS = Manhattan Associates WMS; BLUE_YONDER = Blue Yonder Demand Planning; EDI = Electronic Data Interchange feed.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLA breach has been escalated to senior management or a formal supplier review process due to severity, recurrence, or overdue corrective action. True = escalated; False = not escalated.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: fill_rate_pct
attributes.description: The supplier fill rate expressed as a decimal percentage, calculated as shipped_quantity divided by ordered_quantity. Represents the Order Completion Percentage (Fill Rate) for this measurement period. Applicable only for fill_rate SLA type.
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain Standards; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: measurement_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which this SLA is measured and reported. Determines the granularity of the measurement_period_start_date and measurement_period_end_date window.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; NRF Industry Standards

attributes.name: measurement_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the measurement window for which this SLA performance record is calculated. Together with measurement_period_start_date defines the SLA evaluation window.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; NRF Industry Standards

attributes.name: measurement_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the measurement window for which this SLA performance record is calculated. Used to define the reporting period for scorecarding and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; NRF Industry Standards

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this SLA performance measurement was captured or calculated. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for this record.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; SAP S/4HANA Retail

attributes.name: metric_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the SLA metric values (target_value, actual_value, variance_value). Percentage applies to fill rate and accuracy SLAs; days/hours apply to lead time and on-time delivery SLAs; units/cases apply to quantity-based SLAs.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, dispute details, exception justifications, or operational commentary related to this SLA performance record. Used by supply chain analysts and vendor managers.

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of units or cases ordered on the associated purchase order(s) within the measurement period. Used as the denominator in fill rate percentage calculation for fill rate SLA types.
attributes.references: GS1 Supply Chain Standards; Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)

attributes.name: performance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this SLA performance record. Compliant = target met; breached = target missed; at_risk = approaching threshold; under_review = disputed or under investigation; waived = breach formally excused by agreement.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; SAP S/4HANA Retail

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of units or cases physically received and confirmed at the distribution center within the measurement period. May differ from shipped_quantity due to transit damage or discrepancies.
attributes.references: GS1 Supply Chain Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the SLA breach was formally resolved, including completion of corrective actions and/or chargeback settlement. Null for open or compliant records. Used for resolution cycle time reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: scorecard_period
attributes.description: The standardized scorecard period label for this SLA measurement, used in supplier performance scorecarding and reporting. Format: YYYY-Qn for quarterly, YYYY-Wnn for weekly, or YYYY-MM for monthly periods.
attributes.references: NRF Vendor Compliance Standards; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of units or cases shipped by the supplier against the ordered quantity within the measurement period. Used in fill rate calculation and short-ship analysis.
attributes.references: GS1 Supply Chain Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: short_ship_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity shortfall between ordered_quantity and shipped_quantity. Represents units not fulfilled by the supplier. Used for chargeback calculation and supplier compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain Standards; SAP S/4HANA Retail MM Module

attributes.name: short_ship_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the supplier shipped less than the ordered quantity. Used for root cause analysis, chargeback eligibility determination, and supplier performance improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: out_of_stock|allocation_shortage|production_delay|transportation_delay|order_error|weather_event|force_majeure — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: sla_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this SLA performance record, used in supplier communications, chargeback documentation, and audit trails. Format: SLA-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; SAP S/4HANA Retail

attributes.name: sla_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SLA commitment being measured. Fill rate tracks order completion percentage; on_time_delivery tracks delivery punctuality; lead_time tracks supplier delivery duration; order_accuracy tracks shipment correctness; invoice_accuracy tracks billing correctness; chargeback_compliance tracks vendor compliance penalty adherence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fill_rate|on_time_delivery|lead_time|order_accuracy|invoice_accuracy|chargeback_compliance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NRF Supply Chain Standards; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The originating transaction identifier from the source system of record (e.g., SAP delivery document number, EDI 856 ASN number, WMS receipt number) that this SLA performance record is derived from. Supports audit trail and reconciliation.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; SAP S/4HANA Retail; ISO 27001

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The contractually agreed target metric value for this SLA commitment. For fill rate SLAs this is the target fill rate percentage (e.g., 0.9500 = 95%). For lead time SLAs this is the target number of days. Unit of measure is defined by sla_type.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; NRF Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this SLA performance record was last modified. Audit trail field used to track corrections, status changes, and chargeback updates.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: variance_value
attributes.description: The arithmetic difference between actual_value and target_value (actual minus target). Negative values indicate underperformance against the SLA commitment. Used for trend analysis and breach severity assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; NRF Supply Chain Standards

products.name: inbound_appointment
products.description: Dock appointment scheduling records for inbound shipments at DCs and stores. Captures appointment date/time, dock door assignment, carrier, expected shipment, appointment status (scheduled, confirmed, arrived, completed, no-show), appointment type (live unload, drop trailer), and scheduling source (carrier portal, EDI, manual). Coordinates inbound logistics flow.

attributes.name: inbound_appointment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each dock appointment scheduling record for inbound shipments at distribution centers and stores.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Appointment Scheduling Module

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier responsible for delivering the inbound shipment to the facility.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Carrier Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center (DC) or store location where the inbound appointment is scheduled. Links to the facility master.
