attributes.description: Indicates whether the cross-docked goods are part of a promotional campaign or seasonal event.

attributes.name: is_temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cross-docked goods require temperature-controlled handling (e.g., refrigerated or frozen products).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments related to the cross-dock transaction for operational reference.

attributes.name: outbound_staging_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the goods were staged at the destination dock door for outbound shipment.

attributes.name: pallet_count
attributes.description: Number of pallets included in this cross-dock transaction.

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number linked to the inbound shipment being cross-docked.

attributes.name: priority_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cross-dock transaction was flagged as high-priority for expedited processing.

attributes.name: quantity_cross_docked
attributes.description: Total quantity of units successfully transferred from inbound to outbound without entering reserve storage.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit identifier for the product being cross-docked.

attributes.name: source_dock_door
attributes.description: Dock door number or identifier where the inbound shipment was received.

attributes.name: sscc
attributes.description: Serial Shipping Container Code for the logistics unit being cross-docked, providing unique identification for tracking.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Specific temperature range or condition required for the cross-docked goods (e.g., 2-8°C, frozen, ambient).

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: Trailer or vehicle number assigned to the outbound shipment carrying the cross-docked goods.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique transaction number for the cross-dock event, used for operational tracking and reference.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current status of the cross-dock transaction in its lifecycle: planned, in-progress, completed, cancelled, or exception.

attributes.name: transfer_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the goods were physically transferred from the inbound dock to the outbound staging area.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the cross-docked quantity: EA (each), CS (case), PL (pallet), LB (pound), KG (kilogram).

products.name: inventory_transfer
products.description: Records inter-facility inventory transfer orders and movements between DCs, MFCs, stores, and 3PL nodes. Captures transfer order number, origin facility, destination facility, SKU, transfer quantity, unit of measure, lot/batch, transfer reason (rebalancing, store replenishment, returns consolidation), requested ship date, actual ship date, receipt confirmation date, and transfer status. Distinct from inbound supplier shipments — this entity owns internal stock movement.

attributes.name: inventory_transfer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory transfer transaction. Primary key for the inventory transfer entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the carrier or logistics provider handling the transfer shipment. Links to the carrier master record for transportation tracking.

attributes.name: cross_dock_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this transfer to a cross-dock plan if applicable. References the cross-dock planning record for coordinated inbound-to-outbound movements.

attributes.name: destination_facility_dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the facility to which inventory is being transferred. Target location for the stock movement.

attributes.name: origin_inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.inventory_node. Business justification: Store-to-store and DC-to-store transfers require origin_inventory_node_id to track stock movement from specific nodes. Existing origin_facility_id targets dc_facility only; retail needs inventory_node

attributes.name: primary_inventory_dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the facility from which inventory is being transferred. Source location for the stock movement.

attributes.name: replenishment_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this transfer to a replenishment plan if the transfer is driven by automated replenishment logic. References the supply planning record that triggered the transfer.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this transfer to the physical shipment record. Connects the transfer order to the logistics execution layer.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product being transferred. Links to the master product record for the Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) being moved.

attributes.name: actual_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date when the inventory was actually received and confirmed at the destination facility. Marks completion of the transfer transaction.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Date when the inventory was actually shipped from the origin facility. Used for performance tracking and transit time calculation.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transfer order was approved. Marks the authorization point in the transfer lifecycle for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved the transfer order. Used for audit trail and accountability in inventory movement authorization.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Advanced Ship Notice number sent to the destination facility. EDI 856 transaction identifier providing advance notification of incoming inventory.

attributes.name: carrier_scac_code
attributes.description: Standard Carrier Alpha Code identifying the transportation carrier. Four-letter code assigned by the National Motor Freight Traffic Association (NMFTA) for carrier identification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transfer order record was first created in the system. Audit field tracking the initial creation of the transfer transaction.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transfer value. Indicates the currency in which inventory costs are denominated.

attributes.name: destination_facility_type
attributes.description: Type classification of the destination facility. Indicates whether the target is a Distribution Center (DC), Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC), store, Third-Party Logistics (3PL) provider, or vendor location.

attributes.name: expected_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date when the inventory is expected to arrive at the destination facility. Used for receiving planning and inventory availability forecasting.

attributes.name: freight_cost
attributes.description: Transportation cost incurred for moving the inventory between facilities. Used for total cost of ownership analysis and logistics expense tracking.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number for the product being transferred. International standard product identifier that may be UPC (Universal Product Code), EAN (European Article Number), or other GTIN format.

attributes.name: is_cross_dock
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this transfer is part of a cross-docking operation where inventory moves directly from inbound to outbound without storage. True if cross-dock, false otherwise.

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the transferred inventory contains hazardous materials requiring special handling and compliance. True if hazmat, false otherwise.
attributes.references: OSHA Hazard Communication Standard, DOT Hazmat Regulations

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transfer order record was last modified. Audit field tracking the most recent change to any attribute of the transfer transaction.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Lot or batch number for the inventory being transferred. Used for traceability, quality control, and recall management, particularly for perishable or regulated goods.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GS1 Traceability Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the transfer. Captures special instructions, handling requirements, or contextual information for the transfer transaction.

attributes.name: origin_facility_type
attributes.description: Type classification of the origin facility. Indicates whether the source is a Distribution Center (DC), Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC), store, Third-Party Logistics (3PL) provider, or vendor location.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for the transfer order. Determines handling urgency and shipping method selection for time-sensitive inventory movements.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity received and confirmed at the destination facility. May differ from shipped quantity due to damage, loss, or discrepancies during transit.

attributes.name: requested_ship_date
attributes.description: Date when the inventory is requested to be shipped from the origin facility. Represents the planned or desired shipment date for supply chain planning.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number for serialized inventory items being transferred. Provides unit-level traceability for high-value or regulated products.

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity shipped from the origin facility. May differ from transfer quantity due to stock availability or last-minute adjustments.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit code identifying the specific product variant being transferred. Unique item identifier used for inventory tracking and management.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the inventory requires temperature-controlled transportation and storage. True if temperature-sensitive, false otherwise.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Specific temperature control requirement for the transferred inventory. Defines the storage and transit temperature range needed to maintain product quality and safety.

attributes.name: total_transfer_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the inventory transfer calculated as unit cost multiplied by transfer quantity. Used for financial reporting and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-provided tracking number for the transfer shipment. Used for real-time shipment visibility and proof of delivery.

attributes.name: transfer_order_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transfer order number used for tracking and reference across systems and facilities. Externally visible identifier for the transfer transaction.

attributes.name: transfer_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of units being transferred from origin to destination facility. Represents the planned or actual number of items moved in the transfer transaction.

attributes.name: transfer_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for the inventory transfer. Provides standardized classification of why the stock movement is occurring for analytics and operational planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rebalancing|replenishment|returns|excess_stock|damaged_goods|recall|seasonal_shift — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inventory transfer order. Tracks progression from draft through approval, shipment, and receipt confirmation.

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transfer purpose. Indicates the business reason driving the inventory movement between facilities.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit of the inventory being transferred. Used for inventory valuation and financial accounting of inter-facility stock movements.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the transfer quantity. Defines how the transferred inventory is counted and tracked (individual units, cases, pallets, etc.).

products.name: dock_appointment
products.description: Manages scheduled dock door appointments and yard trailer tracking for inbound and outbound operations at DC facilities. Appointment attributes include scheduled date/time, dock door assignment, appointment type (inbound, outbound, cross-dock), carrier, trailer number, supplier/PO reference, appointment status (scheduled, checked-in, at-door, loading/unloading, completed, no-show), actual arrival time, and dock dwell time. Yard management attributes include trailer yard location (door, spot, staging lane), check-in/check-out timestamps, seal number, load status (empty, loaded, partial), temperature readings for reefer trailers, trailer type (dry van, reefer, flatbed), and associated inbound/outbound shipment references. SSOT for dock scheduling efficiency, yard visibility, and trailer dwell time monitoring at DC facilities.

attributes.name: dock_appointment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dock appointment record. Primary key for the dock appointment entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier responsible for the shipment associated with this dock appointment.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center or warehouse facility where the dock appointment is scheduled.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the inbound or outbound shipment record associated with this dock appointment. Links appointment to shipment transaction.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier or vendor associated with inbound shipments for this dock appointment. Applicable primarily for inbound and cross-dock appointments.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the carrier or trailer arrived at the facility gate or yard. Used to measure on-time performance and calculate dwell time.

attributes.name: actual_carton_count
attributes.description: Actual number of cartons or cases handled during the dock appointment operation. Used to measure variance against expected quantities.

attributes.name: actual_pallet_count
attributes.description: Actual number of pallets loaded or unloaded during the dock appointment operation. Used to measure variance against expected quantities.

attributes.name: actual_weight_kg
attributes.description: Actual total weight in kilograms of the shipment handled during the dock appointment operation. Used to measure variance and validate freight charges.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 Quantities and Units - Space and Time

attributes.name: appointment_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Planned duration in minutes allocated for the dock appointment from scheduled start to scheduled end. Used for dock capacity planning and scheduling optimization.

attributes.name: appointment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique appointment reference number used for scheduling and tracking dock appointments across systems and communications with carriers and suppliers.

attributes.name: appointment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dock appointment tracking progression from scheduling through completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|confirmed|checked_in|at_door|in_progress|completed|cancelled|no_show — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: appointment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the dock appointment indicating the nature of the operation: inbound receiving, outbound shipping, cross-dock transfer, live unload, or drop trailer.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the Advanced Ship Notice document sent by the supplier or carrier to notify the facility of the incoming shipment details prior to arrival.

attributes.name: at_door_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the trailer was positioned at the assigned dock door and ready for loading or unloading operations to begin.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Legal document number issued by the carrier acknowledging receipt of cargo for shipment. Serves as a contract of carriage and receipt.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason code for why the dock appointment was cancelled. Used for operational analysis and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: carrier_scac_code
attributes.description: Four-letter unique identifier assigned by the National Motor Freight Traffic Association (NMFTA) to identify transportation carriers in North America.

attributes.name: check_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the carrier checked in at the facility and was assigned to the yard or dock door queue.

attributes.name: check_out_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the carrier checked out of the facility and departed the yard.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the dock appointment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dock_door_number
attributes.description: Physical dock door identifier assigned to this appointment for loading or unloading operations. Represents the specific bay or door location at the facility.

attributes.name: dock_door_zone
attributes.description: Logical zone or area grouping for the dock door (e.g., inbound zone, outbound zone, cross-dock zone, refrigerated zone) used for operational planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: driver_license_number
attributes.description: Commercial driver license number of the driver. Captured for security verification and compliance with transportation regulations.
attributes.references: Department of Transportation (DOT) Commercial Driver License Standards

attributes.name: driver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the driver delivering or picking up the trailer for this dock appointment. Used for security and access control purposes.
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Standards

attributes.name: dwell_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes that the trailer spent at the facility from arrival to departure. Key performance indicator for dock efficiency and yard management.

attributes.name: expected_carton_count
attributes.description: Anticipated number of cartons or cases to be handled during this dock appointment based on advance shipping notice or order information.

attributes.name: expected_pallet_count
attributes.description: Anticipated number of pallets to be loaded or unloaded during this dock appointment based on advance shipping notice or order information.

attributes.name: expected_weight_kg
attributes.description: Anticipated total weight in kilograms of the shipment to be handled during this dock appointment. Used for capacity planning and equipment allocation.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 Quantities and Units - Space and Time

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the shipment contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, documentation, and safety protocols.
attributes.references: Department of Transportation (DOT) Hazardous Materials Regulations (HMR)

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the dock appointment record was most recently modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: late_arrival_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation or reason code for why the carrier arrived late outside the scheduled appointment window. Used for root cause analysis and carrier performance management.

attributes.name: load_status
attributes.description: Current loading state of the trailer indicating whether it is empty, fully loaded, or partially loaded.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional instructions, special handling requirements, or operational notes related to the dock appointment.

attributes.name: on_time_arrival_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the carrier arrived within the scheduled appointment window. Used for carrier performance measurement and Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking.

attributes.name: operation_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the loading or unloading operation was completed and the trailer was ready for departure or yard staging.

attributes.name: operation_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the actual loading or unloading operation commenced at the dock door.

attributes.name: original_scheduled_timestamp
attributes.description: The initial scheduled start timestamp before any rescheduling occurred. Preserved for audit trail and performance analysis.

attributes.name: pro_number
attributes.description: Unique shipment tracking number assigned by the carrier for less-than-truckload (LTL) shipments. Used for freight tracking and proof of delivery.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the purchase order associated with the inbound shipment for this dock appointment. Links appointment to procurement transaction.

attributes.name: reschedule_count
attributes.description: Number of times this dock appointment has been rescheduled. Used to track scheduling volatility and carrier reliability.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the dock appointment is scheduled to occur.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the dock appointment window ends. Defines the expected completion time for the loading or unloading operation.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the dock appointment window begins. Used for dock scheduling optimization and carrier arrival planning.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the security seal applied to the trailer door to ensure cargo integrity and prevent tampering during transit.

attributes.name: temperature_reading_celsius
attributes.description: Actual temperature reading in Celsius recorded for refrigerated or frozen trailers at check-in or during operations to ensure cold chain compliance.
attributes.references: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA)

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Temperature control classification required for the shipment indicating ambient, refrigerated, or frozen storage and handling conditions.
attributes.references: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA)

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier or license plate number of the trailer or container involved in the dock appointment. Used for yard management and tracking.
attributes.references: Department of Transportation (DOT) Vehicle Identification Standards

attributes.name: trailer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the trailer equipment type indicating the physical configuration and capabilities (dry van, refrigerated, flatbed, tanker, intermodal container).

attributes.name: yard_location
attributes.description: Physical location identifier within the facility yard where the trailer is staged when not at a dock door (e.g., spot number, staging lane, holding area).

products.name: handling_unit
products.description: Represents a physical handling unit (pallet, carton, tote, roll cage, each) tracked through the DC as a discrete unit load via License Plate Number (LPN). Captures handling unit type, LPN barcode, SSCC-18 identifier, parent/child hierarchy (pallet→carton→each), current storage location, contents manifest (SKU, quantity, lot, expiry), weight, dimensions, creation timestamp, last movement timestamp, and disposition status (active, in-transit, shipped, consumed, damaged, on-hold). LPN-level tracking is the foundational Manhattan WMS concept enabling unit-level traceability, inventory accuracy, lot recall capability, and quality hold enforcement. SSOT for physical unit identity within the distribution domain.
products.reference: LPN / SSCC / Handling Unit / License Plate

attributes.name: handling_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the handling unit. Primary key for the handling unit entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier assigned to move this handling unit, linking to the carrier master.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center facility where the handling unit is currently located or was created.

attributes.name: destination_dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the destination entity (store, DC, customer, or vendor) where the handling unit is being shipped, interpreted based on destination_type.

attributes.name: parent_handling_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent handling unit in the containment hierarchy, enabling pallet-to-carton-to-each nested tracking.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the outbound shipment to which this handling unit has been allocated or loaded, linking to the shipment master.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier or vendor who provided the merchandise in this handling unit, linking to the supplier master.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Advanced Ship Notice identifier from the supplier EDI 856 transaction, linking the handling unit to the inbound shipment notification.

attributes.name: consumed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the handling unit was fully consumed or broken down, marking the end of its lifecycle as a discrete tracking unit.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the handling unit record was first created in the warehouse management system, marking the beginning of its lifecycle.

attributes.name: cube_m3
attributes.description: Total volumetric cube of the handling unit in cubic meters, calculated from dimensions and used for warehouse capacity and freight optimization.

attributes.name: destination_type
attributes.description: Classification of the destination entity type for outbound handling units, determining routing and fulfillment logic.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration or best-before date for perishable or date-sensitive SKUs, used for FEFO inventory rotation and quality control.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1 global product identifier (UPC, EAN, or GTIN-14) for the SKU contained in the handling unit, enabling cross-enterprise product identification.

attributes.name: handling_unit_status
attributes.description: Current disposition status of the handling unit within the distribution center lifecycle, controlling operational workflows and quality holds.

attributes.name: handling_unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical handling unit form factor used for warehouse operations and material handling.

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: Height dimension of the handling unit in centimeters, used for space planning and carrier cube calculations.

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the handling unit contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, storage, and transportation compliance.

attributes.name: is_temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the handling unit requires temperature-controlled storage and transportation to maintain product integrity.

attributes.name: last_movement_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent physical movement or location change of the handling unit within the distribution center.

attributes.name: length_cm
attributes.description: Length dimension of the handling unit in centimeters, used for space planning and carrier cube calculations.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer or supplier lot or batch identifier for the SKU, enabling lot-level traceability and recall capability.

attributes.name: lpn
attributes.description: Unique barcode identifier assigned to the handling unit for tracking through the distribution center. The LPN is the foundational Manhattan WMS tracking identifier enabling unit-level traceability.

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date the SKU was manufactured or produced, supporting shelf-life calculations and quality traceability.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special handling instructions, or exception documentation related to the handling unit.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number associated with the inbound receipt that created this handling unit, enabling PO-to-inventory traceability.

attributes.name: quality_hold_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the handling unit is under quality hold, preventing allocation or shipment until quality inspection is completed.

attributes.name: quality_hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the reason for quality hold, such as damage inspection, recall investigation, or expiry verification.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of the SKU contained within the handling unit, measured in the unit of measure specified.

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Warehouse receipt transaction identifier generated when the handling unit was received and put away into inventory.

attributes.name: shipped_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the handling unit was loaded onto a carrier and departed the distribution center for outbound delivery.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Primary product identifier for the merchandise contained in the handling unit, linking to the product master.

attributes.name: sscc
attributes.description: 18-digit GS1 standard identifier for the logistics unit, enabling global supply chain traceability and EDI integration.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Current warehouse location identifier where the handling unit is stored, such as aisle-bay-level or zone-bin coordinates.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Required temperature zone classification for storage and transportation of the handling unit contents.

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: Trailer or container identifier where the handling unit is loaded for outbound shipment or was received from inbound delivery.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity field, defining how the SKU quantity is counted or weighed.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the handling unit including contents and packaging, measured in kilograms, used for freight calculation and capacity planning.

attributes.name: width_cm
attributes.description: Width dimension of the handling unit in centimeters, used for space planning and carrier cube calculations.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Logical warehouse zone classification for the current storage location, used for pick path optimization and inventory segmentation.

products.name: quality_hold
products.description: Records quality hold and quarantine events applied to handling units, storage locations, or inbound shipments within a DC or MFC. Captures hold type (damage, contamination, temperature excursion, recall, regulatory, expiry), affected entity reference (handling unit ID, location, shipment), hold reason, hold date, release date, disposition decision (return to vendor, destroy, rework, release), approver, and regulatory reference. Supports food safety compliance (FSMA), cold chain temperature excursion tracking, and hazmat quarantine requirements. Essential for retail grocery and perishable goods operations.

attributes.name: quality_hold_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the quality hold event. Primary key.

attributes.name: approver_employee_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the supervisor or quality manager who approved the disposition decision for the quality hold.

attributes.name: audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit_finding. Business justification: Quality holds are triggered by audit findings (temperature deviations, contamination, labeling violations). Hold disposition requires audit finding reference for regulatory traceability and corrective

attributes.name: corrective_action_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.corrective_action. Business justification: Quality holds are released after corrective action completion and verification. Hold disposition decisions (release, destroy, return to vendor) require corrective action reference for audit trail and

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the distribution center or micro-fulfillment center where the quality hold event occurred.

attributes.name: handling_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the handling unit (LPN/SSCC) under quality hold, if applicable.

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the inbound shipment under quality hold, if applicable.

attributes.name: primary_quality_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee who initiated the quality hold and performed the initial inspection.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the product master record for the item under quality hold.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the supplier or vendor who provided the inventory under quality hold. Used for supplier performance tracking and chargeback processing.

attributes.name: affected_entity_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific entity under hold (e.g., LPN number, SSCC, location code, ASN number, lot number). The interpretation depends on affected_entity_type.

attributes.name: affected_entity_type
attributes.description: Type of entity subject to the quality hold: handling_unit (specific LPN or SSCC), storage_location (entire warehouse location or zone), inbound_shipment (entire ASN or shipment), pallet (pallet-level hold), carton (carton-level hold), lot (lot or batch number hold).

attributes.name: affected_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of inventory units placed under quality hold. Measured in the unit of measure specified.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the disposition decision was approved by authorized personnel. Required for audit trail and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Advanced Ship Notice number for the inbound shipment containing the inventory under quality hold. Used for traceability and supplier accountability.

attributes.name: chargeback_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount charged back to the supplier for the quality hold event, including product cost, handling fees, and disposal costs.

attributes.name: chargeback_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the chargeback amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: chargeback_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this quality hold event is eligible for supplier chargeback or cost recovery based on supplier accountability and contract terms.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this quality hold record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: Date when the disposition decision was executed and inventory was released, returned, destroyed, or otherwise processed.

attributes.name: disposition_decision
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the held inventory: release (approved for use), return_to_vendor (RTV for credit or replacement), destroy (dispose per hazmat or food safety protocols), rework (repackage or relabel), donate (to food bank or charity), transfer (move to alternate facility).
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; CPSC Recall Guidelines; Internal Quality Standards

attributes.name: disposition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the disposition process, including actions taken, approvals obtained, and any deviations from standard procedures.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Product expiration or best-by date. Relevant for perishable goods and pharmaceutical items. Quality holds may be triggered when inventory approaches expiry.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number (UPC, EAN, or GTIN-14) for the product under quality hold. Used for supplier communication and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: hold_date
attributes.description: Date when the quality hold was initiated and inventory was quarantined.

attributes.name: hold_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the quality hold event, used for tracking and reference in communications with suppliers and regulatory bodies.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the specific reason for the quality hold (e.g., TEMP_EXCURSION, DAMAGED_PACKAGING, CONTAMINATION_SUSPECTED, RECALL_CLASS_I). Aligns with internal quality management system codes.

attributes.name: hold_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed free-text description of the reason for the quality hold, including observations, inspector notes, and contextual information.

attributes.name: hold_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the quality hold: active (hold in effect, inventory quarantined), released (hold lifted, inventory available), pending_disposition (awaiting decision on disposition), escalated (requires senior management or regulatory review), closed (disposition completed and documented).

attributes.name: hold_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the quality hold was initiated, including time zone information. Used for SLA tracking and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: hold_type
attributes.description: Classification of the quality hold event indicating the nature of the issue: damage (physical damage to product or packaging), contamination (biological or chemical contamination), temperature excursion (cold chain breach), recall (supplier or regulatory recall), regulatory (compliance hold pending inspection), expiry (approaching or past expiration date), quality_defect (does not meet quality specifications). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: damage|contamination|temperature_excursion|recall|regulatory|expiry|quality_defect — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); CPSC Product Safety Standards

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inventory under quality hold is classified as hazardous material requiring special handling and disposal procedures.
attributes.references: OSHA Hazard Communication Standards; DOT Hazmat Regulations

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this quality hold record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer lot or batch number for the inventory under quality hold. Critical for traceability in food safety and recall scenarios.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Traceability Rule; GS1 Lot/Batch Standards

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number associated with the inventory under quality hold. Used for supplier communication and cost recovery.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number for regulatory agency communication, recall notice, or compliance inspection related to this quality hold (e.g., FDA recall number, CPSC case number).
attributes.references: FDA Recall Guidelines; CPSC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date when the quality hold was released and inventory was made available for use, if applicable. Null if hold is still active or resulted in disposition other than release.

attributes.name: release_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the quality hold was released, if applicable. Used for hold duration calculation and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized items under quality hold (e.g., electronics, high-value goods).

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit identifier for the product under quality hold. Denormalized for operational convenience.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Warehouse storage location code (aisle-rack-shelf) where the held inventory resides, if applicable.

attributes.name: temperature_reading_celsius
attributes.description: Actual temperature reading in Celsius at the time of quality hold initiation, if applicable. Critical for cold chain temperature excursion events.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Standards; Cold Chain Management Best Practices

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Required temperature zone for the product under quality hold: ambient (room temperature), chilled (refrigerated 0-5°C), frozen (below 0°C).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the affected quantity: EA (each), CS (case), PL (pallet), LB (pound), KG (kilogram), GAL (gallon), LTR (liter). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|LB|KG|GAL|LTR — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: escalated_from_quality_hold_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on quality_hold (escalated_from_quality_hold_id)

products.name: po_shipment_receipt
products.description: This association product represents the Receipt Event between inbound_shipment and purchase_order. It captures the operational mapping between ASNs (Advance Ship Notices) and purchase orders during receiving operations at distribution centers. Each record links one inbound shipment to one purchase order with receipt-specific attributes including received quantities, timestamps, variances, and quality holds. This is the SSOT for PO-level receipt tracking, supplier performance measurement, and three-way match reconciliation (PO-Receipt-Invoice).. Existence Justification: In retail distribution operations, a single inbound shipment (ASN) routinely contains goods for multiple purchase orders consolidated by the supplier or carrier for efficiency. Conversely, a single purchase order is frequently split across multiple shipments due to partial fulfillments, supplier capacity constraints, or phased delivery schedules. The receipt mapping between ASNs and POs is actively managed during receiving operations with specific data tracked per PO-shipment combination including received quantities, timestamps, variances, and quality holds.

attributes.name: po_shipment_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this purchase order shipment receipt record. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse associate who performed receiving operations for this PO within this shipment. Used for accountability and productivity tracking.

attributes.name: distribution_inbound_shipment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Po Shipment Receipt - Distribution Inbound Shipment Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the inbound shipment (ASN) being received at the distribution center

attributes.name: supply_purchase_order_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Po Shipment Receipt - Supply Purchase Order Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the purchase order being fulfilled by this shipment

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PO-shipment receipt record was first created in the WMS during receiving operations.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this receipt record was most recently modified, capturing updates to status, quantities, or quality holds.

attributes.name: quality_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether goods received against this PO in this shipment are placed on quality hold pending inspection. Prevents putaway and inventory availability until released.

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this specific PO was receipted within the shipment. May differ from overall shipment receiving timestamps when a shipment contains multiple POs processed at different times.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity received against this specific purchase order within this shipment. Used for three-way match and supplier performance tracking.

attributes.name: receiving_status
attributes.description: Current status of receiving operations for this specific PO within the shipment. Tracks progression from pending through completion or exception states.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: Difference between expected quantity (from PO) and actual received quantity for this PO-shipment combination. Positive indicates overage, negative indicates shortage. Used for supplier scorecarding.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `retail_ecm`.`_metrics`.`analytics_alert`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Alert management and response metrics tracking alert volume, severity distribution, resolution performance, and escalation patterns. Critical for operational monitoring and incident response effectiveness."
  source: "`retail_ecm`.`analytics`.`alert`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "alert_type"
      expr: alert_type
      comment: "Classification of alert (threshold breach, anomaly, data quality, compliance, operational)"
    - name: "alert_status"
      expr: alert_status
      comment: "Current status of alert (new, acknowledged, in-progress, resolved, closed, false-positive)"
    - name: "severity_level"
      expr: severity_level
      comment: "Severity classification (critical, high, medium, low)"
    - name: "escalation_level"
      expr: escalation_level
      comment: "Current escalation tier (L1, L2, L3, executive)"
    - name: "false_positive_flag"
      expr: false_positive_flag
      comment: "Whether alert was determined to be a false positive"
    - name: "notification_sent_flag"
      expr: notification_sent_flag
      comment: "Whether notification was successfully sent"
    - name: "notification_channel"
      expr: notification_channel
      comment: "Channel used for alert notification (email, SMS, Slack, PagerDuty)"
    - name: "business_entity_type"
      expr: business_entity_type
      comment: "Type of business entity that triggered the alert"
    - name: "data_source"
      expr: data_source
      comment: "Source system or process that generated the alert"
    - name: "triggered_date"
      expr: DATE(triggered_timestamp)
      comment: "Date the alert was triggered for time-series analysis"
  measures:
    - name: "total_alerts"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of alerts generated"
    - name: "total_resolved_alerts"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN alert_status IN ('resolved', 'closed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of alerts that have been resolved or closed"
    - name: "total_false_positives"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN false_positive_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of alerts identified as false positives"
    - name: "alert_resolution_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN alert_status IN ('resolved', 'closed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of alerts that have been resolved"
    - name: "false_positive_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN false_positive_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of alerts that were false positives - key quality metric"
    - name: "notification_success_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN notification_sent_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of alerts where notification was successfully sent"
    - name: "avg_actual_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(actual_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average actual value that triggered alerts"
    - name: "avg_threshold_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(threshold_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average threshold value for alert triggers"
    - name: "avg_variance_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(variance_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average variance between actual and threshold values"
    - name: "distinct_kpi_definitions"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT kpi_definition_id)
      comment: "Number of unique KPI definitions that generated alerts"
    - name: "distinct_business_entities"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT business_entity_id)
      comment: "Number of unique business entities that triggered alerts"
$$
metric_views.description: Alert management and response metrics tracking alert volume, severity distribution, resolution performance, and escalation patterns. Critical for operational monitoring and incident response effectiveness.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `retail_ecm`.`_metrics`.`analytics_dq_issue`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

    - name: "severity"
      expr: severity
      comment: "Severity level of the DQ issue (critical, high, medium, low)"

      comment: "Priority for resolution (P0, P1, P2, P3)"
    - name: "root_cause_category"
      expr: root_cause_category
      comment: "Category of root cause (source system, transformation logic, data entry, integration)"
    - name: "domain"
      expr: domain
      comment: "Data domain where issue occurred"
    - name: "data_product"
      expr: data_product
      comment: "Specific data product affected by the issue"
    - name: "compliance_impact_flag"
      expr: compliance_impact_flag
      comment: "Whether issue has compliance or regulatory impact"
    - name: "recurrence_flag"
      expr: recurrence_flag
      comment: "Whether this is a recurring issue"
    - name: "business_impact"
      expr: business_impact
      comment: "Description of business impact level"
    - name: "detected_date"
      expr: DATE(detected_timestamp)
      comment: "Date issue was detected for time-series analysis"
  measures:
    - name: "total_dq_issues"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of data quality issues logged"
    - name: "total_resolved_issues"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN dq_issue_status IN ('resolved', 'closed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of DQ issues that have been resolved"
    - name: "total_open_issues"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN dq_issue_status NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of DQ issues still open"
    - name: "total_affected_records"
      expr: SUM(CAST(affected_record_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of records affected by DQ issues"
    - name: "avg_affected_records"
      expr: AVG(CAST(affected_record_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of records affected per DQ issue"
    - name: "total_remediation_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(remediation_cost_estimate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated cost to remediate all DQ issues"
    - name: "avg_remediation_cost"
      expr: AVG(CAST(remediation_cost_estimate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average estimated remediation cost per DQ issue"
    - name: "issue_resolution_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN dq_issue_status IN ('resolved', 'closed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of DQ issues that have been resolved"
    - name: "compliance_impact_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN compliance_impact_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of DQ issues with compliance impact"
    - name: "recurrence_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN recurrence_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of DQ issues that are recurring - indicates systemic problems"
    - name: "distinct_dq_rules"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT dq_rule_id)
      comment: "Number of unique DQ rules that generated issues"
    - name: "distinct_data_products"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT data_product)
      comment: "Number of unique data products with DQ issues"
$$
metric_views.description: Data quality issue tracking and resolution metrics measuring issue volume, resolution time, root cause patterns, and business impact. Critical for data quality improvement programs and compliance.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `retail_ecm`.`_metrics`.`analytics_dq_result`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Data quality execution results tracking rule pass/fail rates, failure trends, and data trust scores. Essential for data governance, compliance reporting, and data reliability monitoring."
  source: "`retail_ecm`.`analytics`.`dq_result`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "dq_rule_id"
      expr: dq_rule_id
      comment: "Foreign key to data quality rule definition"
    - name: "execution_status"
      expr: execution_status
      comment: "Status of DQ rule execution (success, failure, error, timeout)"
    - name: "pass_fail_status"
      expr: pass_fail_status
      comment: "Overall pass/fail result of the data quality check"
    - name: "severity_level"
      expr: severity_level
      comment: "Severity of DQ failures (critical, high, medium, low)"
    - name: "rule_type"
      expr: rule_type
      comment: "Type of data quality rule (completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, validity)"
    - name: "target_domain"
      expr: target_domain
      comment: "Domain of the data product being validated"
    - name: "target_product"
      expr: target_product
      comment: "Specific data product being validated"
    - name: "sla_compliance_flag"
      expr: sla_compliance_flag

    - name: "trend_direction"
      expr: trend_direction
      comment: "Trend of data quality over time (improving, declining, stable)"
    - name: "execution_date"
      expr: DATE(execution_timestamp)
      comment: "Date of DQ rule execution for time-series analysis"
  measures:
    - name: "total_dq_executions"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of data quality rule executions"
    - name: "total_records_evaluated"
      expr: SUM(CAST(records_evaluated_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of records evaluated across all DQ checks"
    - name: "total_records_passed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(records_passed_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of records that passed DQ checks"
    - name: "total_records_failed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(records_failed_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of records that failed DQ checks"
    - name: "dq_pass_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(records_passed_count AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(records_evaluated_count AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Overall data quality pass rate - key data trust metric"
    - name: "dq_failure_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(records_failed_count AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(records_evaluated_count AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Overall data quality failure rate"
    - name: "avg_data_trust_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(data_trust_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average data trust score across all DQ executions"
    - name: "avg_execution_duration_seconds"
      expr: AVG(CAST(execution_duration_seconds AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average execution time for DQ checks - performance metric"
    - name: "sla_compliance_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sla_compliance_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of DQ checks that met SLA requirements"
    - name: "execution_success_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN execution_status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of DQ rule executions that completed successfully"
    - name: "distinct_dq_rules"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT dq_rule_id)
      comment: "Number of unique DQ rules executed"
    - name: "distinct_target_products"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT target_product)
      comment: "Number of unique data products validated"
$$
metric_views.description: Data quality execution results tracking rule pass/fail rates, failure trends, and data trust scores. Essential for data governance, compliance reporting, and data reliability monitoring.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `retail_ecm`.`_metrics`.`analytics_kpi_value`

      expr: period_type

    - name: "total_kpi_measurements"

      comment: "Sum of actual KPI values across all measurements"

      comment: "Sum of target KPI values across all measurements"

    - name: "avg_actual_value"

    - name: "avg_target_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(target_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average target KPI value per measurement"

    - name: "distinct_kpi_definitions"

      comment: "Number of unique KPI definitions measured"
    - name: "distinct_business_entities"

    - name: "distinct_report_definitions"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `retail_ecm`.`_metrics`.`analytics_self_service_query`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

    - name: "cache_hit_rate"

      comment: "Average query execution time in seconds - user experience metric"
    - name: "total_compute_cost_usd"

    - name: "avg_compute_cost_usd"

      comment: "Average compute cost per query"
    - name: "total_data_scanned_bytes"

    - name: "avg_data_scanned_bytes"
      expr: AVG(CAST(data_scanned_bytes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average bytes scanned per query - efficiency metric"
    - name: "avg_query_complexity_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(query_complexity_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average query complexity score"
    - name: "total_rows_returned"
      expr: SUM(CAST(rows_returned AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total rows returned across all queries"
    - name: "avg_rows_returned"
      expr: AVG(CAST(rows_returned AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average rows returned per query"
    - name: "query_reuse_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN saved_query_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)

    - name: "query_sharing_rate"

    - name: "distinct_users"

      comment: "Number of unique users executing self-service queries - adoption metric"
    - name: "distinct_data_products"

    - name: "avg_time_to_conversion_minutes"
      expr: AVG(CAST(time_to_conversion_minutes AS DOUBLE))

    - name: "unique_profit_centers"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT profit_center_id)
      comment: "Number of unique profit centers with budgets"
$$
metric_views.description: Budget and forecast metrics tracking plan vs actual performance, variance analysis, and financial planning accuracy

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `retail_ecm`.`_metrics`.`loyalty_engagement_campaign`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Campaign performance metrics tracking member engagement, participation, and ROI"
  source: "`retail_ecm`.`loyalty`.`engagement_campaign`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "campaign_status"
      expr: campaign_status
      comment: "Current status of the engagement campaign (Active, Completed, Cancelled, etc.)"
    - name: "campaign_type"
      expr: campaign_type
      comment: "Type of engagement campaign (Bonus Points, Tier Upgrade, Spend Challenge, etc.)"
    - name: "campaign_start_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', start_date)
      comment: "Month when campaign started"
    - name: "campaign_start_year"
      expr: YEAR(start_date)
      comment: "Year when campaign started"
    - name: "opt_in_required_flag"
      expr: opt_in_required_flag
      comment: "Whether campaign requires member opt-in"
    - name: "personalization_enabled_flag"
      expr: personalization_enabled_flag
      comment: "Whether campaign uses personalization"
    - name: "channel_email_flag"
      expr: channel_email_flag
      comment: "Whether campaign uses email channel"
    - name: "channel_sms_flag"
      expr: channel_sms_flag
      comment: "Whether campaign uses SMS channel"
    - name: "channel_in_store_flag"
      expr: channel_in_store_flag
      comment: "Whether campaign uses in-store channel"
  measures:
    - name: "total_campaigns"
      expr: COUNT(engagement_campaign_id)
      comment: "Total number of engagement campaigns"
    - name: "active_campaign_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN campaign_status = 'Active' THEN engagement_campaign_id END)
      comment: "Count of currently active campaigns"
    - name: "total_actual_participation"
      expr: SUM(CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(actual_participation_count, '[^0-9]', '') AS BIGINT))
      comment: "Total actual member participation across campaigns"
    - name: "total_expected_participation"
      expr: SUM(CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(expected_participation_count, '[^0-9]', '') AS BIGINT))
      comment: "Total expected member participation across campaigns"
    - name: "avg_participation_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(actual_participation_rate_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average actual participation rate percentage across campaigns"
    - name: "avg_target_participation_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(target_participation_rate_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average target participation rate percentage across campaigns"
    - name: "participation_rate_achievement_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CAST(actual_participation_rate_pct AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(AVG(CAST(target_participation_rate_pct AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage achievement of target participation rate (campaign effectiveness)"
    - name: "total_actual_incremental_spend"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_incremental_spend_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual incremental spend generated by campaigns"
    - name: "total_target_incremental_spend"
      expr: SUM(CAST(target_incremental_spend_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total target incremental spend across campaigns"
    - name: "incremental_spend_achievement_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(actual_incremental_spend_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(target_incremental_spend_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage achievement of target incremental spend (ROI indicator)"
    - name: "avg_points_multiplier"
      expr: AVG(CAST(points_multiplier AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average points multiplier offered across campaigns"
    - name: "avg_qualifying_spend_threshold"
      expr: AVG(CAST(qualifying_spend_threshold AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average spend threshold required to qualify for campaign benefits"
    - name: "personalized_campaign_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN personalization_enabled_flag = TRUE THEN engagement_campaign_id END)
      comment: "Count of campaigns using personalization"
$$
metric_views.description: Campaign performance metrics tracking member engagement, participation, and ROI

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `retail_ecm`.`_metrics`.`loyalty_membership`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core loyalty membership performance metrics tracking member value, engagement, and lifecycle health"
  source: "`retail_ecm`.`loyalty`.`loyalty_membership`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "membership_status"
      expr: membership_status
      comment: "Current status of the loyalty membership (Active, Inactive, Closed, etc.)"
    - name: "enrollment_channel"
      expr: enrollment_channel
      comment: "Channel through which member enrolled (In-Store, Online, Mobile App, etc.)"
    - name: "enrollment_year"
      expr: YEAR(enrollment_date)
      comment: "Year the member enrolled in the loyalty program"
    - name: "enrollment_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', enrollment_date)
      comment: "Month the member enrolled in the loyalty program"
    - name: "member_tenure_years"
      expr: CASE WHEN enrollment_date IS NOT NULL THEN FLOOR(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(closed_date, CURRENT_DATE()), enrollment_date) / 365.25) ELSE NULL END
      comment: "Number of complete years since enrollment"
    - name: "vip_flag"
      expr: vip_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether member has VIP status"
    - name: "fraud_flag"
      expr: fraud_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether member has been flagged for fraud"
    - name: "language_preference"
      expr: language_preference
      comment: "Member's preferred language for communications"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency code for member's points and transactions"
    - name: "opt_in_email"
      expr: opt_in_email
      comment: "Whether member has opted in to email communications"
    - name: "opt_in_sms"
      expr: opt_in_sms
      comment: "Whether member has opted in to SMS communications"
  measures:
    - name: "total_members"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT loyalty_membership_id)
      comment: "Total number of unique loyalty members"
    - name: "total_lifetime_points_earned"
      expr: SUM(CAST(lifetime_points_earned AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total points earned by members over their lifetime"
    - name: "total_lifetime_points_redeemed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(lifetime_points_redeemed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total points redeemed by members over their lifetime"
    - name: "total_current_points_balance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(current_points_balance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total current points balance across all members (outstanding liability)"
    - name: "total_lifetime_spend"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_spend_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total lifetime spend amount across all members"
    - name: "avg_lifetime_spend_per_member"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_spend_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average lifetime spend per member (customer lifetime value proxy)"
    - name: "avg_current_points_balance"
      expr: AVG(CAST(current_points_balance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average current points balance per member"
    - name: "points_redemption_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(lifetime_points_redeemed AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(lifetime_points_earned AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of earned points that have been redeemed (engagement indicator)"
    - name: "avg_points_expiring_soon"
      expr: AVG(CAST(points_expiring_soon AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average points expiring soon per member (urgency metric)"
    - name: "active_member_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN membership_status = 'Active' THEN loyalty_membership_id END)
      comment: "Count of members with Active status"
    - name: "vip_member_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN vip_flag = TRUE THEN loyalty_membership_id END)
      comment: "Count of members with VIP status"
    - name: "fraud_flagged_member_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fraud_flag = TRUE THEN loyalty_membership_id END)
      comment: "Count of members flagged for fraud (risk metric)"
    - name: "email_opt_in_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN opt_in_email = TRUE THEN loyalty_membership_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT loyalty_membership_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of members opted in to email communications"
$$
metric_views.description: Core loyalty membership performance metrics tracking member value, engagement, and lifecycle health

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `retail_ecm`.`_metrics`.`loyalty_points_ledger`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Points transaction metrics tracking earning, redemption, and liability dynamics"
  source: "`retail_ecm`.`loyalty`.`points_ledger`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "transaction_type"
      expr: transaction_type
      comment: "Type of points transaction (Earn, Redeem, Adjust, Expire, Reversal, etc.)"
    - name: "transaction_status"
      expr: transaction_status
      comment: "Status of the points transaction (Posted, Pending, Reversed, etc.)"
    - name: "channel"
      expr: channel
      comment: "Channel where points transaction occurred (In-Store, Online, Mobile, Partner, etc.)"
    - name: "transaction_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('DAY', transaction_timestamp)
      comment: "Date of the points transaction"
    - name: "transaction_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', transaction_timestamp)
      comment: "Month of the points transaction"
    - name: "transaction_year"
      expr: YEAR(transaction_timestamp)
      comment: "Year of the points transaction"
    - name: "is_promotional"
      expr: is_promotional
      comment: "Whether the points transaction was part of a promotional campaign"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency code for the transaction"
    - name: "expiration_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', expiration_date)
      comment: "Month when points from this transaction will expire"
  measures:
    - name: "total_points_transactions"
      expr: COUNT(points_ledger_id)
      comment: "Total number of points transactions"
    - name: "total_points_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(points_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net total points amount (positive for earn, negative for redeem)"
    - name: "total_points_earned"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Earn' THEN CAST(points_amount AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total points earned across all earn transactions"
    - name: "total_points_redeemed"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Redeem' THEN ABS(CAST(points_amount AS DOUBLE)) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total points redeemed (absolute value)"
    - name: "total_points_expired"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Expire' THEN ABS(CAST(points_amount AS DOUBLE)) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total points expired (breakage revenue opportunity)"
    - name: "total_points_liability"
      expr: SUM(CAST(points_liability_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total financial liability associated with outstanding points"
    - name: "avg_points_per_transaction"
      expr: AVG(CAST(points_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average points amount per transaction"
    - name: "avg_earn_multiplier"
      expr: AVG(CAST(earn_multiplier AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average earn multiplier applied to transactions"
    - name: "total_qualifying_spend"
      expr: SUM(CAST(qualifying_spend_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total spend amount that qualified for points earning"
    - name: "avg_redemption_value_per_point"
      expr: AVG(CAST(redemption_value_per_point AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average monetary value per point at redemption (margin indicator)"
    - name: "promotional_points_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_promotional = TRUE THEN CAST(points_amount AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(points_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of points issued through promotional campaigns"
    - name: "breakage_rate_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(breakage_rate AS DOUBLE) * 100)
      comment: "Average breakage rate percentage (expected points expiry without redemption)"
    - name: "reversal_transaction_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Reversal' THEN points_ledger_id END)
      comment: "Count of reversal transactions (quality and fraud indicator)"
$$
metric_views.description: Points transaction metrics tracking earning, redemption, and liability dynamics

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `retail_ecm`.`_metrics`.`loyalty_redemption`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Redemption performance metrics tracking member reward utilization and fulfillment efficiency"
  source: "`retail_ecm`.`loyalty`.`redemption`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "redemption_status"
      expr: redemption_status
      comment: "Status of the redemption (Completed, Pending, Cancelled, Reversed, etc.)"
    - name: "redemption_type"
      expr: redemption_type
      comment: "Type of redemption (Discount, Product, Gift Card, Partner Reward, etc.)"
    - name: "channel"
      expr: channel
      comment: "Channel where redemption occurred (In-Store, Online, Mobile, Partner, etc.)"
    - name: "fulfillment_method"
      expr: fulfillment_method
      comment: "Method of fulfillment (Instant, Voucher, Ship-to-Home, etc.)"
    - name: "redemption_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('DAY', redemption_timestamp)
      comment: "Date of the redemption"
    - name: "redemption_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', redemption_timestamp)
      comment: "Month of the redemption"
    - name: "redemption_year"
      expr: YEAR(redemption_timestamp)
      comment: "Year of the redemption"
    - name: "is_fraudulent"
      expr: is_fraudulent
      comment: "Whether the redemption was flagged as fraudulent"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency code for the redemption monetary value"
  measures:
    - name: "total_redemptions"
      expr: COUNT(redemption_id)
      comment: "Total number of redemption transactions"
    - name: "total_points_redeemed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(points_redeemed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total points redeemed across all transactions"
    - name: "total_redemption_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(monetary_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total monetary value of all redemptions (cost to business)"
    - name: "avg_points_per_redemption"
      expr: AVG(CAST(points_redeemed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average points redeemed per transaction"
    - name: "avg_redemption_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(monetary_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average monetary value per redemption"
    - name: "redemption_value_per_point"
      expr: ROUND(SUM(CAST(monetary_value AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(points_redeemed AS DOUBLE)), 0), 4)
      comment: "Average monetary value per point redeemed (economics indicator)"
    - name: "completed_redemption_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN redemption_status = 'Completed' THEN redemption_id END)
      comment: "Count of successfully completed redemptions"
    - name: "cancelled_redemption_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN redemption_status = 'Cancelled' THEN redemption_id END)
      comment: "Count of cancelled redemptions (friction indicator)"
    - name: "cancellation_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN redemption_status = 'Cancelled' THEN redemption_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(redemption_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of redemptions that were cancelled"
    - name: "fraudulent_redemption_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_fraudulent = TRUE THEN redemption_id END)
      comment: "Count of redemptions flagged as fraudulent (risk metric)"
    - name: "fraud_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_fraudulent = TRUE THEN redemption_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(redemption_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of redemptions flagged as fraudulent"
    - name: "avg_fraud_detection_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(fraud_detection_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average fraud detection score across redemptions"
